text: Kasubong niya sing pamatasan si anay Heneral George Patton Jr.
english: Former General George Patton Jr. had a similar attitude.

text: sang US Army, nga ginakilala nga isa sang mga bantugon nga baganihan sang Ikaduha nga Gyera Kalibutan nga nanguna upod sa Allied Forces sa paglusob sa Alemanya tubtub nagyaub ini.
english: of the US Army, who is recognized as one of the great heroes of World War II who led the Allied Forces to invade Germany until it collapsed.

text: Kon ano ang nagtulak sa ila nga duha sa sina nga pamatasan, ang ila pagtuo isa seguro sa mga kabangdanan.
english: As for what drove them both to that behavior, their faith was probably one of the factors.

text: Si Presidente Duterte, bisan nagdaku sa pamilya nga katoliko kag nagtuon sa idalom sang mga pari, wala nagapati – sa iya pag-aku mismo sa publiko – nga may Impyerno kag Langit para sa mga nagtaliwan nga mga kalag.
english: President Duterte, although raised in a Catholic family and studied under priests, does not believe – by his own public admission – that there is Hell and Heaven for the departed souls.

text: Si Patton, samtang nagdaku sa pamilya nga Episcopalian (isa sang mga denominasyon Kristiyano), wala man gapati sa Impyerno kag Langit kay nagapati siya sa Reincarnation.
english: Patton, while raised in an Episcopalian family (one of the Christian denominations), also did not believe in Hell and Heaven because he believed in Reincarnation.

text: Sa sini nga pagpati, si Patton gatuo nga wala padulongan ang kalag kundi ang pagsaylo-saylo lang sa katauhan sang sapat ukon kapareho nga tawo.
english: In this belief, Patton believed that the soul had no destination but only moved from animal to human.

text: Ginsugid gani niya nga sadto pa nagkabuhi na siya sa pagkatawo sang lain-lain nga mga soldado.
english: He even told that he had lived in the bodies of various soldiers.

text: Tungod wala ining duha gapati sa Impyerno, sa diin sunu sa pagtudlo sang Kristiyano nga pagtuluohan ang makasala sing mortal magaantos sing tuman, wala sila mahadlok sa consequencia sang ila ginahimo kag luyag himuon.
english: Because these two do not believe in Hell, where according to the teachings of the Christian faith those who sin mortally will suffer greatly, they are not afraid of the consequences of what they do and want to do.

text: In fact, kontra ni Duterte ang Simbahan Katoliko, sa iya siling mismo, tungod sa personal nga pag-abuso sa iya sadto sang isa ka pari katoliko.
english: In fact, Duterte is against the Catholic Church, he said, because of the personal abuse he suffered by a Catholic priest.

text: Kontra man ni Patton ang katoliko.
english: Patton was also anti-catholic.

text: Ginpamatud-an niya ini sang ginbalabagan niya ang pagpakasal sang iya anak sa isa ka katoliko.
english: He proved this when he blocked the marriage of his daughter to a catholic.

text: Wala pili si Duterte agud insultuhan ang mga tawo nga indi niya mauyunan, kag sa masami ginatawag niya ini nga “Putang ina mo!” (Your mother is a prostitute), nga naglakip kay anay US President Barack Obama kag bisan si Pope Francis, nga lider sa bug-os nga kalibutan sang Simbahan Catolica.
english: Duterte is indiscriminate in insulting people he disagrees with, often calling them “Putang ina mo!” (Your mother is a prostitute), which included former US President Barack Obama and even Pope Francis, worldwide leader of the Catholic Church.

text: Si Patton kasubong man kon mamuyayaw.
english: Patton is similarly sarcastic.

text: Ginatawag niya ang ginakaugtan niya sing “Son of a Whore!” (Anak ka sang alput).
english: He calls the one he hates “Son of a Whore!” (You are the son of an alput).

text: Wala man siya pili sang iya insultuhan, lakip na gani ang isa ka ultimo nga soldado.
english: He was indiscriminate in his insults, including one of the last soldiers.

text: Gintawag niya ini nga “coward” (talawan) kag gintampa niya ini sang pila kabeses samtang gatalangison ang soldado sa iya nadangtan nga kapahamakan sa inaway.
english: He called him a “coward” and slapped him several times while the soldier was crying over his defeat in battle.

text: Tungod sa sining insidente nga nabalhag sa tanan nga pahayagan sa Uropa, na-suspendir si Patton sang madugay bag-o makabalik sa pagpamuno sa patag-awayan nga sa idalom na sang iya anay subordinate officer.
english: Because of this incident, which was published in all European newspapers, Patton was suspended for a long time before returning to command the battlefield under his former subordinate officer.

text: Lubos nga nagpahuway si Patton sang ginpakamalaut niya ang Rusya nga sadto kaalyado sang Estados Unidos kag Britanya nga wala magustuhi sang dalagku nga mga pulitiko.
english: Patton was fully relaxed when he condemned Russia then an ally of the United States and Britain which was not liked by the big politicians.

text: Sa iya bahin, si Duterte ginpakamalaut sang mga tumuluo sang Isahanon nga Diyos, nga galakip sang mga katoliko,iban nga grupo sang mga Kristiyano kag bisan sang mga Muslim, sang gintawag niya ang Diyos nga “stupid”.
english: For his part, Duterte was condemned by believers of the One God, including Catholics, other Christian groups and even Muslims, when he called God “stupid”.

text: Tungod sini, napilitan siya sa pagpangayo sing pasaylo.
english: As a result, he was forced to apologize.

text: Apang sa Diyos gid lamang, siling niya, kag indi lakip ang mga tumuluo sa nagaisahanon nga Diyos.
english: But only to God, he said, and not including believers in the one God.

text: “Sorry God…”, siling niya sa isa ka interbyu sa TV.
english: “Sorry God…”, he said in a TV interview.

text: Wala malipay sini ang Simbahan Catolica nga nagsiling nga indi sinsero ang pagpangayo sing pasaylo sa Diyos ni Duterte.
english: This did not please the Catholic Church which said that Duterte's apology to God was not sincere.

text: Tungod man seguro sa pagkadismaya sang mga tumuluo sang Isahanon nga Diyos, nagnubo ang trust rating ni Duterte sa mga pumuluyo pagkatapos sining pag-insulto niya sa Diyos.
english: Perhaps because of the disappointment of the believers in the One God, Duterte's trust rating among the people dropped after his insult to God.

text: Kon ginpatawad na gid man sang Diyos kag sang kadam-an nga mga pumuluyo si Duterte sa pagtawag niya sa Diyos nga “stupid”, Diyos gid lang ang nakahibalo.
english: If God and the majority of the people have forgiven Duterte for calling God “stupid”, only God knows.

text: Gapati kita ugaling nga may kapatawaran ang Diyos kay Duterte sa iya pagpakamalaut sa Diyos.
english: We believe, however, that God has forgiven Duterte for his blasphemy.

text: Kag kabay man nga matagaan sang Diyos sing paghangop ang mga tumuluo Niya nga wala sing kaisug sa pagpabutyag sang ila balatyagon apang nagpakita bisan sa hipos lang sang ila pag-apin sa Iya nga aton palangga nga Diyos.
english: And may God also give understanding to His believers who do not have the courage to express their feelings but have shown even in silence their defense of Him our beloved God.

text:

Madamo sang mga nagahangad kay anay konsehal Dave Jamora ang nakibot sa balita nga may handom pa siya sa pagbalik sa konseho sang siyudad sang Iloilo pagkatapos sang madamo nga tinuig.
english:
***

Many fans of former councilor Dave Jamora were surprised by the news that he still has a desire to return to the Iloilo City Council after many years.

text: Anom ka tuig ini siya nga nadula sa eksena sang pulitika sang ma-ospital siya sa sobra niya nga kapisan sa pag-serbisyo sa pumuluyo.
english: He disappeared from the political scene for six years when he was hospitalized for his excessive efforts to serve the people.

text: Naghandom siya sa pagdalagan sa ikatlo nga termino sang mag-ayu siya, apang gin-rekomendar gid sang iya pamilya – asawa kag isa ka anak – nga magpahuway na gid lang siya sa pulitika.
english: He dreamed of running for a third term when he recovered, but his family – wife and one child – strongly recommended that he take a break from politics.

text: Luyag na gid lang nila nga indi na siya magbalik sa pulitika kag magdumala na lang sang pila nila ka negosyo.
english: They just want him to stay out of politics and run some of their businesses.

text: Kag dira na nagsugod ang pagpati sang iban nga indi na gid lang siya magabalik pa sa pulitika.
english: And that's when some people started to believe that he would never return to politics.

text: Apang, sang sini lang, nagpabutyag si Jamora sa pagbalik sa pulitika.
english: However, recently, Jamora has expressed concern about returning to politics.

text: Nalipay sini ang mga humalangad niya, kag nagpabutyag man sila sang ila luyag nga maka–serbisyo siya liwat sa mga pumuluyo.
english: This made his fans happy, and they also expressed their wish that he could serve the people again.

text: In fact, nalakip na gani siya sa survey sang isa ka lokal nga istasyon sang radyo sa pagka-konsehal sa palabuton nga eleksyon sa 2019.
english: In fact, he has even been included in a local radio station's survey for councilor in the upcoming 2019 elections.

text: Sadto gani ginatulod pa siya agud magdalagan sa pagka-Vice Mayor.
english: He was even pushed to run for Vice Mayor.

text: Malayo na seguro ugaling ang handom sang iya humalangad nga magdalagan pa siya sa pagka-Vice Mayor.
english: However, his fans' dream of running for Vice Mayor is probably far away.

text: Madugay na siya nga wala mabatii sang mga pumuluyo sa sulod sang anom ka tuig.
english: He had not been heard from by the villagers for a long time in six years.

text: Kag madamo na sa ila ang gapati nga indi na gid siya mag-entra sa pulitika bisan luyag pa nila.
english: And many of them believe that he will never enter politics even if they want to.

text: Bisan pa sa sini nga scenario, gapasalamat gid siya nga nadumduman siya gihapon sang madamo, labi na gid sa padayon nga survey sang radyo nga galakip sa iya sa 12 nga paga-botohon sa pagka-konsehal.
english: Despite this scenario, he is grateful that he is still remembered by many, especially in the ongoing radio survey that includes him among the 12 candidates for councilor.

text: Sa sining padayon nga survey, wala nagahulog si Jamora sa ika-12 nga pwesto.
english: In this continuous survey, Jamora does not drop to 12th place.

text: Gasaka-saka gani siya sa ika-10 nga pwesto, nga ginapatihan sang iya humalangad nga magasaka pa gid sa pag-abot sang aktwal nga kampanyahanay.
english: He is even climbing to 10th place, which his fans believe will rise even more when the actual campaign comes.

text: Kilala si Jamora sa iya karisma sa kampanyahanay sa sulod sang duha niya ka terrmino bilang konsehal.
english: Jamora was known for his campaign charisma during his two terms as a councilor.

text: Sadto nanguna gani siya sa mga bag-uhan nga mga kandidato sa pagka-konsehal.
english: He even led the new councilor candidates.

text: Nagpang-apat siya sa likod sang mga beterano kag gung-an nga mga konsehal nga sanday Tupas, Ganzon kag Zulueta.
english: He came fourth behind veteran and young councilors Tupas, Ganzon and Zulueta.

text: Pila sang importante nga nabuhatan ni Jamora amo ang pagpanguna sa pag-away sa Climate Change sa siyudad.
english: Some of Jamora's important achievements include leading the fight against climate change in the city.

text: Siya ang nagpanikasug nga isulong ang “First Iloilo City Environmental Summit” sadtong Enero 6-7, 2011.
english: He was the one who tried to promote the “First Iloilo City Environmental Summit” on January 6-7, 2011.

text: Mga 120 sang mga kilala nga mga environmentalist kag mga advocate halin sa madamo nga bahin sang pungsod ang nagtambong kag naghatag sang ila rekomendasyon.
english: About 120 of the prominent environmentalists and advocates from many parts of the country attended and gave their recommendation.

text: Ining report sang Summit gin-rekomendar niya sa pagpatuman sang panguluhan sang siyudad kag natungdan nga mga ahensya sang gobyerno nasyonal.
english: He recommended this Summit report for implementation by the city government and concerned national government agencies.

text: Lakip sa sining kawsa niya batok sa Climate Change amo ang pag-away sa polusyon sang mga salakyan kag ang pagbinaha sa siyudad, ang semanal nga panglimpyo sa barangay, ang pag-regulate sang higko sa kahanginan sang mga planta, ang pag-amlig nga indi masulod sang dagat ang aton nga mga bubon kag source of potable water, ang pagpasanyog sang kabuhi sa kadagatan sa pagpalapta sang mga mangrove sa Iloilo River kag mga tributaries sini, kag iban pa.
english: Among his causes against Climate Change are the fight against vehicle pollution and flooding in the city, the weekly cleaning of the barangay, the regulation of air pollution from plants, the protection of our wells and sources of drinking water, the promotion of marine life in the spread of mangroves. Iloilo River and its tributaries, and others.

text: Isa pa ka importante nga hingyu ni Jamora amo ang pagpasar sang “Anti-Discrimination in Job Hiring in Iloilo City”, nga ginpasar sang konseho kag ni meyor sadtong 2012, apat ka tuig bag-o mapasar sang 2016 ang kasubong nga kasuguan sang Kongreso sang Pilipinas.
english: Another important request of Jamora is the passage of the “Anti-Discrimination in Job Hiring in Iloilo City”, which was passed by the council and the mayor in 2012, four years before the Philippine Congress passed a similar law in 2016.

text: Ang ining ordinansa nagadumili sa pag-publicar ukon pagpahibalo sang notisya nga naga-limite sang pag-apply sa trabaho sa may edad tubtub lang 25 ukon 35, kag nagabukas sang kahigayunan sa may edad-edad na nga maka-trabaho kon luyag nila.
english: This ordinance prohibits the publication or announcement of a notice limiting the application of employment to the age of 25 or 35, and opens up the opportunity for the elderly to work if they wish.

text: Ang may luyag mag-trabaho galakip sa mga OFW nga nagbalik sa pungsod kag mga senior citizen ga-edad 60 anyos pataas nga “makasarang pa mag-ubra” sa ila kinamatarong sa “equal economic opportunity” sa idalom sang aton Konstitusyon.
english: Those who wish to work include OFWs who have returned to the country and senior citizens aged 60 years and above who are “able to work” in their right to “equal economic opportunity” under our Constitution.

english: British singer Ed Sheeran joined his “best friend” Taylor Swift on the final leg of his European leg of the Eras Tour at Wembley Stadium in London.

text: Sa atubang sang 92,000 fans, perfect ang mash-up performance sang duha ka superstars sa duha ka kanta nga magkaupod nila nga ginhimo— ang 2012 hit nga Everything Has Changed kag 2017 collaboration nga End Game.
english: In front of 92,000 fans, the two superstars gave a perfect mash-up performance of two songs they created together— the 2012 hit Everything Has Changed and 2017 collaboration End Game.

text: Sunod man nga nag-upod si Swift sa pagkanta sang mega-ballad ni Sheeran nga Thinking Out Loud.

english: The concert was the 34-year-old American music icon's first performance after his three shows in Vienna were canceled last week due to an alleged planned terror attack in Austria.

text: Wala na gin-mensyonar sang multi-awarded music star ang amo nga mga insidente samtang yara siya sa entablado apang halangpon nga pribado ang iya pagpakig-angot sa mga pamilya sang biktima.
english: The multi-awarded music star did not mention the incidents while he was on stage but kept his communication with the families of the victims private.

text: Sa iya concert, gin-treat sini ang fans sa masobra 40 ka hit songs nga naglawig sang masobra tatlo ka oras lakip na ang Cruel Summer, Blank Space, Style, Anti-Hero, Lavender Haze, I Can Do It With A Broken Heart, All Too Well, Look What You Made Me Do, Karma, Shake It Off kag madamo nga iban pa.
english: During his concert, he treated fans to over 40 hit songs lasting over three hours including Cruel Summer, Blank Space, Style, Anti-Hero, Lavender Haze, I Can Do It With A Broken Heart, All Too Well, Look What You Made Me Do, Karma, Shake It Off and many more.

english: Prior to his Wembley run, Taylor has also performed in Edinburgh, Liverpool, Cardiff and Dublin as part of his UK and Ireland leg.

text: Ini nga Eras Tour— nga magatakop na antes matapos ang 2024 — ang nakalibot na sa nagkalain-lain nga parte sang kalibutan.
english: This Eras Tour— which will wrap up before the end of 2024 — has already toured various parts of the world.

text: Nagsugod ini sa Glendale, Arizona sang Marso sang 2023 kag naglawig sang anum ka bulan sa US antes gindala sa Mexico, Argentina kag Brazil.
english: It started in Glendale, Arizona in March of 2023 and spent six months in the US before being taken to Mexico, Argentina and Brazil.

text: Sini nga 2024, may shows man ini sa Japan, Australia kag Singapore antes ginsuguran ang European leg sa France sang Mayo.
english: This 2024, it will also have shows in Japan, Australia and Singapore before kicking off the European leg in France in May.

text: Pagkatapos sini, natalana nga magbalik si Taylor sa tour sa US kag Canada.

english: For Obiena's part, he almost ended the Philippines' 88-year wait for a medal in athletics after he finished fourth.

text: Inilabas na ng Aircraft Investigation Bureau ng India ang kanilang paunang ulat kaugnay sa pagbagsak ng isang eroplano ng Air India noong Hunyo.
english: India's Aircraft Investigation Bureau has released its preliminary report on the crash of an Air India plane in June.

text: Batay sa imbestigasyon, sinasabing pinutol ang fuel control switches sa loob ng cockpit ng Boeing 787 Dreamliner, dahilan kaya’t hindi nakapagpadala ng gasolina sa mga makina ng eroplano.
english: According to the investigation, the fuel control switches inside the cockpit of the Boeing 787 Dreamliner were cut off, preventing fuel from being sent to the plane's engines.

text: Ayon pa sa ulat, ito rin ang lumabas sa black box ng eroplano na naglalaman ng 49 na oras na flight data at dalawang oras na cockpit voice recording.
english: According to the report, it also appeared in the plane's black box containing 49 hours of flight data and two hours of cockpit voice recordings.

text: Sa nasabing recording, maririnig na tinanong ng kapitan ang co-pilot kung bakit niya pinutol ang suplay ng gasolina, ngunit itinanggi ito ng huli.
english: In the recording, the captain can be heard asking the co-pilot why he cut off the fuel supply, but the latter denied it.

text: Ang nasabing fuel cutoff switch ay matatagpuan sa pagitan ng dalawang piloto at may locking mechanism upang maiwasan ang aksidenteng paggalaw nito.
english: The fuel cutoff switch is located between the two pilots and has a locking mechanism to prevent accidental movement.

text: Ayon pa sa mga imbestigador, umabot na sa 180 knots ang bilis ng eroplano nang biglaang mawalan ng power ang dalawang makina nito dahil sa fuel cutoff.
english: According to investigators, the plane reached 180 knots when its two engines suddenly lost power due to a fuel cutoff.

text: Ang kapitan ng flight ay isang 56-anyos na lalaki na may kabuuang 15,000 flying hours, samantalang ang co-pilot ay 32 taong gulang at may 3,400 oras ng karanasan sa paglipad.
english: The captain of the flight was a 56-year-old man with a total of 15,000 flying hours, while the co-pilot was 32 years older and had 3,400 hours of flying experience.

text: Matatandaang noong Hunyo 12, lumipad ang nasabing eroplano mula Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel International Airport patungong London nang ito ay bumagsak sa hindi pa natutukoy na lokasyon.
english: On June 12, the plane was flying from Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel International Airport to London when it crashed at an undisclosed location.

text: Sa kabuuang 242 na sakay ng eroplano, kabilang ang mga crew, 169 ay Indian nationals, 53 ay Britons, pito ang Portuguese, at isa ay Canadian.
english: Of the 242 people on board, including the crew, 169 were Indian nationals, 53 were British, seven were Portuguese, and one was Canadian.

text: Isang Briton lamang ang naiulat na nakaligtas sa insidente.
english: Only one Briton was reported to have survived the incident.

english: Leandro Leviste the entire document from the late former Department of Public Works and Highways official Undersecretary Catalina Cabral.

text: Una na ginpahayag sini nga maya ara sang ginakaptan nga listahan ini sang mga proponents sa maanomaliya nga mga proyekto nga nakuha sini sa napatay nga opisyal.
english: Earlier, he said he had a list of proponents of the anomalous projects he got from the late official.

text: Suno kay Assistant Ombudsman Atty. Mico Clavano,ginpalapitan sang mga imbestigador sang Office of the Ombudsman ang tiglikom kasunod sang gintuad sini sa publiko may ara ini sang kopya nga ginauyatan.
english: According to Assistant Ombudsman Atty. Mico Clavano, investigators of the Office of the Ombudsman approached the secretary after he confessed to the public that he had a copy in his possession.

text: Suno pa sa iya nga natabo ini samtang buhi pa si former Public Works Usec.
english: He said this happened while former Public Works Usec.

text: Catalina Cabral sang ginrepresenta ini sang iya legal counsel.
english: Catalina Cabral when she was represented by her legal counsel.

text: SIMPLE lang ang pagtan-aw ni Presidente Duterte kon ano ang kamatuoran sang Diyos: “To see is to believe”, kon sa Iningles pa.
english: PRESIDENT Duterte's view of the truth of God is simple: “To see is to believe”.

text: Sa madamo nga kahigayunan ugaling, ang ining “simplistic” nga pagkilala sang kamatuoran nagakinahanglan sang mas madalom nga paghangop agud lubos nga matungkad.
english: In many cases however, this “simplistic” recognition of truth requires a deeper understanding to be fully appreciated.

text: Sunu sa kay Presidente, kinahanglan gid makita niya ang Diyos agud magpati siya.
english: According to the President, he must see God in order to believe.

text: Ugaling, ang diyos nga luyag niya makita amo ang may kapinasahe nga indi pareho sang Diyos nga ginakilala sang mga katoliko nga may kaluoy bisan sa mga kaaway, nga supak sa ginapatihan ni Presidente sa iya maduguon nga Gyera sa Droga.
english: However, the god he wants to see is one with a passion that is not like the God recognized by Catholics as having mercy even on enemies, which is contrary to what the President believes in his bloody War on Drugs.

text: “Love your enemies,” siling gani ni Kristo.
english: “Love your enemies,” Christ said.

text: Gintawag pa niya gani ang Diyos nga “stupid”, ukon wala sing namasngaan sa iya kakulangan sing ihibalo kag paghangop sa istorya sang pagtuga sang kalibutan kag sang bug-os nga universo.
english: He even called God “stupid”, or ignorant of his lack of knowledge and understanding of the story of the creation of the world and the entire universe.

text: Bisan ang anak sang Preidente nga si Sara, nga meyor sang Davao City, kumpormi man sa kakulangan sang iya amay.
english: Even the President's daughter, Sara, who is the mayor of Davao City, agrees with her father's shortcomings.

text:
Nangayo siya gani sing paghangop sang mga pumuluyo sa iya amay kay “Indi siya pari, pastor ukon amam!”

Apektado man sang sining pagtawag ni Presidente sa Diyos nga “stupid” ang iban nga denominasyon Kristiyano nga nagatuo man sa pareho nga Diyos.
english:
He even asked the people to understand his father because “He is not a priest, pastor or father!”

Other Christian denominations that believe in the same God are also affected by the President's calling God “stupid”.

text: Pati na ang mga Muslim nga nagapati man sa Diyos ni Adan kag ni Eba kag ni Abraham sang mga Kristiyano.
english: Even Muslims who believe in the God of Adam and Eve and Abraham of Christians.

text: Lain lang ugaling ang ila pagtawag sa Diyos nga naga-isahanon.
english: But they call God alone differently.

text: Ginhangkat pa gani ni Presidente Duterte ang Diyos nga magpakita upod sa iya sa isa ka “selfie” nga pagpa-retrato, agud mapamatud-an niya kuno kon bala matuod nga naga-existir gid man ang Diyos.
english: President Duterte even challenged God to appear with him in a selfie, so that he could prove whether God really exists.

text: Ang problema lang ugaling kay wala pa sing tawo nga nakakita sa Diyos sa Iya lubos nga kamatuoran.
english: The problem is that no one has ever seen God in His full truth.

text: Kon may ginasiling nga “nakakita” sa Diyos ina lang sa paagi sang mga nagakalain-lain nga forma – ang pating sa uluhan sang pagbunyag ni Kristo, ang gakalayo nga tanom nga ginpakita kay Moses, kag iban pa.
english: If anyone is said to have “seen” God it is only through various forms – the shark at the head of Christ’s baptism, the burning bush shown to Moses, and so on.

text: Yara man, sa pagpati sang mga katoliko, ang Diyos sa katauhan ni Kristo.
english: There is also, in the Catholic belief, God in the person of Christ.

text: Kag bisan sa mga kubos kag ginapigos nga nagakinahanglan sang kaluoy kag pagpangapin.
english: And even to the poor and oppressed who need compassion and advocacy.

text: Sa mga personal nga kahigayunan, “nagapakita” ang Diyos sa panghuna-huna kag tagipusuon sang pila ka tawo agud magamit Niya sa Iya “Divine purpose”, katulad ni San Pablo nga kilala sa pagpamigos sang mga Kristiyano nga gin-iwagan sang Diyos, naghinulsol kag nangin-tagpangapin pa nila.
english: On personal occasions, God “appears” in the minds and hearts of some people so that He can use them for His “Divine purpose”, like St. Paul who was known for persecuting Christians whom God had enlightened, repented and became their defender.

text: Who knows, basi mangin San Pablo man gani si Presidente.
english: Who knows, maybe St. Paul will become President.

text:
***

Gina-kondenar naton ang mga kasal-anan sang mga natungdan nga mga pari nga masami atakehon ni Presidente Duterte, apang indi man seguro “fair and just” nga lamitahon ta ang bug-os nga Simbahan.
english:
***

We condemn the sins of the priests concerned who are often attacked by President Duterte, but it is probably not “fair and just” to criticize the entire Church.

text: Indi ini katulad sa “original sin”, ukon una nga pagpakasala, nga gindala nanday Adan kag ni Eba sa ila katauhan nga ginsalu ukon ginpanubli sang ila kabataan kag iban pa nga katauhan.
english: This is not like the “original sin”, or first sin, that Adam and Eve brought into their humanity that their children and other humans inherited.

text: Ang sala sang mga pari wala sa level sang “original sin”.
english: The sin of the priests is not on the level of “original sin”.

text: Indi pwede ipanubli sang mga pari kag sang Simbahan sa mga tumuluo ang ila separado kag wala kaangtanan nga pagkatawo.
english: Priests and the Church cannot bequeath to the faithful their separate and unrelated identities.

text: Ining “original sin” nanday Adan kag ni Eba napanubli nila sa ila mga anak tungod sang ila kaangtanan bilang mga anak nila kag sang masunod pa nga mga kabataan.
english: This “original sin” of Adam and Eve was passed on to their children because of their relationship as their children and future children.

text: Ining pagpakasala nila nangin kabangdanan sang ila pagka-mamalatyon, pagkahuyang batok sa mga balatian kag pag-sufrir sa madamo nga bagay, kag pagkadula sang pangako sang wala katubtuban nga kabuhi kag kalipayan upod sa Diyos tubtub sa pagbukas sang langit nga dala sang Diyos sa katauhan ni Kristo.
english: This sin of theirs became the cause of their mortality, vulnerability to disease and suffering in many ways, and the loss of the promise of eternal life and happiness with God until the opening of heaven that God brought to the humanity of Christ.

text: Of course, lain ang pagtuo ni Presidente parti sini kag gina-respeto ta ining pagtuo niya.
english: Of course, the President has a different belief about this and we respect his belief.

text: Tani gin-respeto man niya ang pagtuo sang iban.
english: I wish he respected the faith of others.

text: Dismayado gid kita nga kinahanglan pa niya pakamalauton ang ginatuohan ta nga Diyos sa pagtawag sini nga “stupid”.
english: We are very disappointed that he has to curse the God we believe in by calling it “stupid”.

text: In fact, “blasphemy” sa Diyos, ukon “Sin against the Holy Spirit”, ining ginhimo ni Presidente nga daku kaayo nga kasal-anan.
english: In fact, “blasphemy” against God, or “Sin against the Holy Spirit”, this President has done is a very serious sin.

text: Gapati kita ugaling sa wala tupong nga pagkamaluluy-on sang Diyos nga kon hinulsulan lang ni Presidente Duterte ang ining iya sala mapatawad siya gihapon sang Diyos.
english: However, we believe in God's incomparable mercy that if President Duterte repents of his sin, God will forgive him.

text: Gapamag-an sang kasal-anan ang kakulangan sa ihibalo sang isa ka tawo kon ano gid ang malain.
english: Sin is mitigated by a person's lack of knowledge of what is truly evil.

text: “Amay, patawara sila kay wala sila kahibalo sang ila ginahimo,” siling gani ni Kristo sa krus.
english: “Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they are doing,” Christ said on the cross.

english: Star point guard Jamal Murray's stay with the Denver Nuggets will be extended.

text: Ini matapos nagpirma ini sang kontrata kun sa diin may apat ka tuig nga extension sa team — buot silingon, magalab-ot pa sa 2028-2029 season si Murray nga amo man ang all-time leader sang Nuggets sa 3-pointers.
english: This comes after he signed a four-year extension with the team — meaning Murray, who is also the Nuggets' all-time leader in 3-pointers, will reach the 2028-2029 season.

text: Ginapahayag nga nagadangat sa $208 million ukon P11.59-billion ang napirmahan nga contract.
english: The signed contract is reportedly worth $208 million or P11.59-billion.

text: Sang nagligad nga season, naka-average si Murray sang 21.2 points kag 6.5 assists, apang nakapasakop lamang sa 59 games bangud sa injuries.
english: Last season, Murray averaged 21.2 points and 6.5 assists, but only participated in 59 games due to injuries.

text: Matandaan nga wala man ini nakit-an sa 2021-22 season bangud sa injury, apang nangin daku nga bagay ang iya pagbalik sang ginbuligan sini ang Nuggets nga makuha ang labing-una nga NBA title para sa franchise sang 2023.
english: He also missed the 2021-22 season due to injury, but his return was a big deal when he helped the Nuggets win the first-ever NBA title for the franchise in 2023.

text: Ginsundan ini sang regular season nga napuno na naman sang injuries nga ginalantaw man nga rason sang pigado sini nga performance sa Paris Olympics kun sa diin ginbangko ini sa kalabanan nga hampang kag nag-average lamang sang 6 points per game sa bilog nga Summer Games.
english: This was followed by a regular season that was again filled with injuries which is also seen as the reason for his poor performance at the Paris Olympics where he was benched in most games and averaged only 6 points per game throughout the Summer Games.

text: Sa Denver, siya ang ginakabig nga pick-and-roll partner sang three-time MVP nga si Nikola Jokic nga amo man ang naghatag sa Nuggets sang isa sa best offensive duos sa NBA.
english: In Denver, he was considered the pick-and-roll partner of three-time MVP Nikola Jokic who also gave the Nuggets one of the best offensive duos in the NBA.

text: Nakabati ka man bala sang abiso sang mga katigulangan nga nagakadapat hibaluon mo ang imo worth ukon bili bilang tawo agud nga indi mo na ini pagpangitaon sa iban?
english: Have you ever heard the advice of the ancestors that you should know your worth as a human being so that you do not look for it in others?

text: Sa Nigeria, nangin unod sang mga balita ang isa ka 26 anyos nga lalaki nga gin-aresto matapos gintanyag kag ginbutangan sang price tag ang iya kaugalingon.
english: In Nigeria, a 26-year-old man who was arrested after offering and putting a price tag on himself made headlines.

text: Ginkulintas ni Aliyu Na Idris ang cardboard nga may nakasulat nga mga tinaga nga ”this man is for sale” samtang ginalibot ang bilog nga syudad sang Karo.
english: Aliyu Na Idris necklaced the cardboard with the words ”this man is for sale” written on it while touring the entire city of Karo.

text: Nakahibalo ka bala kun pila ang tanyag niya sa iya kaugalingon?
english: Do you know how much he offered himself?

text: $50,000 ukon P2.5 Million!
english: $50,000 or P2.5 Million!

text: Sang ginpamangkot siya sang mga otoridad kun ngaa nahimo niya ini, ginrason sang lalaki ang kapigaduhon nga amo ang nagtulod sa iya nga magpangita sang buyer agud baklon siya sa nasambit nga kantidad.
english: When asked by the authorities why he did this, the man cited poverty as prompting him to find a buyer to buy him for the said amount.

text: Plano niya kuntani nga ihatag ang kwarta sa iya ginikanan para sa adlaw-adlaw nila nga galastuhon.
english: He planned to give the money to his parents for their daily expenses.

text: Isang 57-anyos na lalaki ang hinatulan ng tatlong linggong pagkakabilanggo matapos magpakita ng hindi angkop na asal sa loob ng pampublikong tren, bunga umano ng matagal nang emosyonal na paghihirap at tensyon sa kaniyang relasyon.
english: A 57-year-old man was sentenced to three weeks in prison after exhibiting inappropriate behavior inside a public train, allegedly the result of long-standing emotional suffering and tension in his relationship.

text: Ayon sa imbestigasyon, si Cheng Choong Peng ay umamin sa pagkakasala ng public nuisance matapos mahuling nagsarili sa loob ng MRT train noong Mayo 20, 2025.
english: According to the investigation, Cheng Choong Peng pleaded guilty to public nuisance after being caught alone inside an MRT train on May 20, 2025.

text: Sa hindi inaasahang pangyayari, ilang patak ng semilya ang napunta sa pantalon ng isang babaeng pasahero na agad nagsumbong sa pulisya.
english: In an unexpected incident, a few drops of semen went into the pants of a female passenger who immediately reported the matter to the police.

text: Sa kanyang salaysay, inilahad ni Cheng ang patuloy na tensyon sa kanilang pagsasama ng kanyang asawa.
english: In his account, Cheng revealed the ongoing tension in his relationship with his wife.

text: Giit niya, madalas siyang tanggihan ng misis kapag siya’y naghahangad ng intimacy, dahilan upang siya’y makaranas ng matinding frustration at pagkabigo.
english: He said his wife often rejected him when he sought intimacy, causing him to experience severe frustration and disappointment.

text: Ang kakulangan sa emosyonal at pisikal na koneksyon ay nagtulak sa kanya na gumawa ng hindi katanggap-tanggap na hakbang sa pampublikong lugar.
english: The lack of emotional and physical connection pushed him to take unacceptable steps in public.

text: Bagamat hindi katanggap-tanggap ang kanyang ginawa, binigyang-diin ng ilang eksperto na maaaring ugat ng insidente ang kakulangan sa mental health support at relationship counseling, partikular para sa mga kalalakihang nahihiyang humingi ng tulong.
english: Although his actions were unacceptable, some experts pointed to the lack of mental health support and relationship counseling, particularly for men who are embarrassed to ask for help, as the root cause of the incident.

text: Sa ulat ng Straits Times, pinatawan si Cheng ng tatlong linggong pagkakakulong matapos ang pag-amin niya sa korte.
english: According to the Straits Times, Cheng was sentenced to three weeks in prison after his confession in court.

text: Sa ilalim ng batas ng Singapore, ang sinumang mapatunayang guilty sa public nuisance ay maaaring makulong ng hanggang tatlong buwan o pagmultahin ng hanggang $2,000, o parehong parusa.
english: Under Singapore law, anyone found guilty of public nuisance can be jailed for up to three months or fined up to $2,000, or both.

text: Samantala, humingi ng paumanhin ang akusado sa babaeng nadamay, at nangakong hindi na uulitin ang nasabing asal.
english: Meanwhile, the accused apologized to the victim, and promised not to repeat the said behavior.

text: Patuloy rin ang paalala ng mga awtoridad sa publiko na irespeto ang mga pampublikong lugar at sikaping humingi ng tulong kung may kinakaharap na personal na suliranin.
english: The authorities also continue to remind the public to respect public places and to ask for help if they are facing personal problems.

text: Nabun-an sa mata ang isa ka pulis matapos nga gin-aresto ang isa ka lalaki nga nagmaoy sa Brgy.Milagrosa, Sta Catalina, Negros Oriental.
english: A policeman was stabbed in the eye after a man was arrested for robbery in Brgy. Milagrosa, Sta Catalina, Negros Oriental.

text: Nag­responde ang amo nga pulis nga may ranggo nga Police Executive Master Sergeant agud arestuhon ang lalaki nga may ginbuno nga isa ka babaye.
english: The police officer, who has the rank of Police Executive Master Sergeant, responded to arrest the man who stabbed a woman.

text: Sang iya ini gindakop, hinali lang nga ginhan-usan sang suspek ang pulis ng naigo sa mata kag nagresulta sa pagdinugo sini.
english: When he arrested him, the suspect suddenly stabbed the policeman in the eye and resulted in him bleeding.

text: Madasig naman ini nga gindala sa ospital.
english: He was rushed to the hospital.

text: Ginkinahanglan nga ipaidalom ini sa operasyon bangud na-damage ang major artery sa iya mata.
english: He had to undergo surgery because the major artery in his eye was damaged.

text: Nakahunong na sa presuhan ang suspek.
english: The suspect is now in custody.

text: Nag-atubang na sa Senado ang duha ka independent contractors sang isa ka TV network nga sanday Richard Dode Cruz kag Jojo Nones kasunod sang alegasyon nga sexual abuse sang Sparkle actor nga si Sandro Muhlach.
english: Two independent contractors of a TV network, Richard Dode Cruz and Jojo Nones, have appeared before the Senate following allegations of sexual abuse by Sparkle actor Sandro Muhlach.

text: Pareho nga nanginwala ang duha sa atubang sang mga senador kag amay ni Sandro nga si Niño Muhlach.
english: Both denied the allegations in front of senators and Sandro’s father, Niño Muhlach.

text: Suno kanday Cruz kag Nones, nahadlok sila nga mabutang sa sentro sang “media circus” kag “premature trial” rason nga wala sila nakatambong sa una nga Senate hearing sang Agusto 7 kasunod sang criminal complaint nga napasaka sang pamilya Muhlach sa National Bureau of Investigation (NBI).
english: Cruz and Nones said they were afraid of being at the center of the media circus and premature trial, which is why they did not attend the first Senate hearing on August 7 following the criminal complaint filed by the Muhlach family with the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI).

text: Pahayag ni Nones: “Bago po ang lahat, gusto po naming humingi ng paumanhin sa hindi namin pagdalo sa unang pagdinig.
english: Nones' statement: “First of all, we would like to apologize for not attending the first hearing.

text:
Inaamin po namin na natakot po kaming ma-subject sa media circus at premature trial.”

“Gayundin po, natakot din kami na malabag namin ang confidentiality ng imbestigasyon na isinasagawa ng NBI [National Bureau of Investigation] nang nagsimula na ang mga panahong iyon at nagpapatuloy pa rin sa ngayon.”

“Nasabihan po kasi kami na bawal ilabas ang lahat ng mga counter-allegations at ebidensiya namin sa publiko, dahil ayon sa NBI ay kahit ang alegasyon ng diumano’y biktima ay hindi pa rin nila maaaring ilabas dahil subject pa ito sa validation ng kanilang ahensiya.”

“Lahat pa raw po ng hawak ng NBI ay hindi pa ebidensiya hangga’t hindi pa napapasa sa piskalya.
english:
We admit that we were afraid of being subjected to a media circus and premature trial.”

“However, we are also afraid that we will violate the confidentiality of the investigation conducted by the NBI [National Bureau of Investigation] when those times began and continue today.”

“We were told that all our counter-allegations and evidence are not allowed to be released to the public, because according to the NBI, even the allegation of the victim is not yet available because it is still subject to validation by their agency.”

“All the NBI's bodies are not evidence until they are passed to the prosecutor's office.

text:
Subalit matapos po naming mapanood ang nakaraang pagdinig ay nakita po namin na hindi mangyayari ang aming kinakatakutan dahil sinabi at siniguro naman po ng kagalang-galang nating chairman na si Senator Robin Padilla na hindi magiging korte ang senado.”

“Kaya humihingi rin po kami ng patawad sa kagalang-galang nating senador na si Jinggoy Estrada, kung naunahan po kami ng takot, kaba, at pangamba.”

Ginklaro man nila ang ila employment status sa network kun sa diin ginsiling nga ginabayaran lamang sila sang per-project basis.
english:
However, after watching the last hearing, we saw that what we feared would not happen because our respected chairman, Senator Robin Padilla, said and assured that the Senate will not become a court.”

“So we also apologize to our honorable senator Jinggoy Estrada, if we were preceded by fear, anxiety, and fear.”

They also clarified their employment status with the network where it was said that they are only paid on a per-project basis.

text: Scriptwriter si Cruz kag creative consultant halin sang 2000, samtang si Nones naman ang isa ka drama consultant sa afternoon soaps sang network kun sa dii may prior experience man sa iban nga mga network.
english: Cruz has been a scriptwriter and creative consultant since 2000, while Nones is a drama consultant on the network's afternoon soaps with prior experience on other networks.

text: Matandaan nga nag-ugat ang alegasyon sa ginaalegar natabo sa gala night sang Hulyo.
english: The allegation stemmed from an alleged gala night in July.

text:
Paathag ni Cruz: “Opo, kami po ang independent contractors ng GMA Network na tinutukoy sa mga online post na kumalat noon mga nakaraang araw.”

“Subalit, hindi po kami gumawa ng anumang sexual harassment or abuse laban kay Sandro Muhlach.”

“Sa pagkakataong ito, sa harap ninyong lahat, mariin pong itinatanggi namin ang lahat ng mapanirang akusasyon na ito laban sa amin.”

“Kami po ay hindi executives ng GMA Network, tulad ng lumalabas.

Taliwas sa sinasabi online, wala po kaming kapangyarihan o impluwensiya sa network, lalung-lalo na sa mga artista nito.”

“Sinabi naman po ng GMA na hindi kami regular employee ng network.
english:
Contrary to what is said online, we have no power or influence over the network, especially over its artists.”

“GMA said that we are not regular employees of the network.

text:
Alam po namin na konting pagkakamali lamang na nagawa namin sa produksiyon ay maaaring ma-terminate ang aming kontrata at mawalan kami ng trabaho.”

Dugang pa ni Cruz sa pagdepensa sa ila kaugalingon: “Sa tinagal-tagal namin sa industriya, wala po kahit ni isang reklamo, sexual man or anuman ang nag-file sa amin.
english:
We know that the slightest mistake we make in production can terminate our contract and lose our jobs.”

Cruz added in their defense: “In our long time in the industry, not a single complaint, sexual or anything has been filed against us.

text:
Kaya hindi po namin sisirain ang iniingatan naming pangalan, karera, at reputasyon para makapang-abuso o harass ng isang tao.”

Apisar sang ila pagpanginwala, nagapati ang senado nga may mabaskog nga ebidensya batok sa mga kontraktor base sa naistoryahan sa executive session kasunod man sang request ni Senator Robinhood Padilla para sa imbestigasyon.
english:
So we will not ruin our name, career, and reputation to abuse or harass someone.”

Despite their denial, the Senate believes that there is strong evidence against the contractors based on what was discussed in the executive session following Senator Robinhood Padilla's request for an investigation.

text: “We cannot yet divulge the details of the executive session, but Senators Padilla, Poe, and Bato agreed that there is strong evidence against these two gentlemen,” pahayag ni Senate President Pro Tempore Jinggoy Estrada.#
english: “We cannot yet divulge the details of the executive session, but Senators Padilla, Poe, and Bato agreed that there is strong evidence against these two gentlemen,” said Senate President Pro Tempore Jinggoy Estrada.#

text: SA ATON demokrasya indi basta panag-iyahan lang naton ukon ipatuman ang isa ka bagay – katulad sang pag-angkon sang propyedad kag mga intereses, ang pag-dampig sa aton kabuhi, kag ang pag-amlig kag pagsulong sang aton mga kinamatarong personal kag sosyal – bisan pa sa aton pensar makapaayo ini sa aton.
english: IN OUR democracy we do not simply own or enforce something – such as the acquisition of property and interests, the protection of our lives, and the protection and advancement of our personal and social rights – even if we think it will benefit us.

text: Kinahanglan nga ang pagpanag-iya kag pagpatuman sini nasandig gid sa nagakaigu nga prinsipyo sang husto (right) ukon matarong (just).
english: Its ownership and implementation must be based on the appropriate principle of right or just.

text: Otherwise, ang isa ka buhat sala (wrong) ukon indi matarong (unjust).
english: Otherwise, an act is wrong or unjust.

text: Angot diri, may ginapatihan kita nga mga prinsipyo moral kag ethical nga dapat naton sandigan sang kon ano ang Husto ukon Matarong nga puede naton itudlo sa aton pagtuo (relihiyon) ukon ginakilala nga mga kasuguan sa sosyedad nga amo ang magasiling sa aton kon tadlong ang aton ginahimo ukon indi.
english: In this regard, we have believed moral and ethical principles that we must base on what is right or just that we can teach in our faith (religion) or recognized laws in society that will tell us if we are doing right or not.

text:
Sa ina nga pagpati, upod kita sa prinsipyo nga “The end does not justify the means.”

Ang ining pagpati nagasiling nga bisan ano kaayo sang aton ginapatihan sa mga bagay apang kon labag ang pag-angkon ukon pagpatuman sini sa prinsipyo moral ukon ethical, indi dapat ini naton himuon kay indi nagakadapat.
english:
In that belief, we share the principle that “The end does not justify the means.”

This belief says that no matter how good we believe in things, if it is against moral or ethical principles, we should not do it because it is not appropriate.

text: In fact, dapat kita manabat sa mga consequencia sini – pagpakamalaut (censure) man ukon aktuwal nga penalidad.
english: In fact, we must be held accountable for the consequences – whether censure or actual punishment.

text: Por ejemplo, indi husto nga mangawat kita sang pagkaon (nga makapaayo sang aton ikaayong lawas) tungod sang aton kagutom.
english: For example, it is wrong for us to steal food (which can improve our health) because we are hungry.

text: Ang dapat mangayo ka ukon pangabudlayan mo ini kay amo na ang husto nga ugali.
english: You should ask or work for it because that's the right attitude.

text: Indi man husto nga i-torture ang isa ka tawo agud mahibal-an lang kon sin-o gid ang may kasal-anan.
english: It is also not right to torture someone just to find out who is really guilty.

text:
Dapat  gamitan gid ini sang lehitimo nga kinaalam agud mahibal-an sa idalom sang aton Konstitusyon  nga naga-insistir sa pagpatuman sang “due process” kag “supremacy of the law.”

Indi basta magpahapos lang, katulad sang ginahimo sang mga mapintas nga pagginahum nga nagagamit sing pamahog, torture, kag iban pa nga pahapos nga medyos sa pagpilit nga makuha ang kamatuoran ukon ipatuman ang luyag sang yara sa gahom.
english:
It must be used by legitimate wisdom to know under our Constitution that insists on the implementation of “due process” and “supremacy of the law.”

Do not simply appease, as do tyrannical regimes that use threats, torture, and other easy means to force the truth or to enforce the will of those in power.

text: Gawi ina ya sang mga diktador kag mga pasista, nga indi santu sa aton ginapatihan nga pagdala sang mga pumuluyo sing may dignidad sa aton Demokrasya.
english: That is the behavior of dictators and fascists, which is not in accordance with our belief in bringing the people with dignity to our Democracy.

text: “Unjust” man nga patyon ang isa ka kriminal samtang naga-sungka na siya sa mga otoridad sa luyag ta lang nga madula ang malain sa aton sosyedad.
english: It is also “unjust” to kill a criminal while he is surrendering to the authorities just because we want to eradicate evil from our society.

text: Indi kita dapat malipat sa kamatuoran nga makasasala kita tanan nga dapat maghalong sa pag-kondenar sa isigkatawo.
english: We must not forget the fact that we are all sinners who must be careful about condemning others.

text: “Condemn and you will be condemned,” siling gani sang Balaan nga Kasulatan.
english: “Condemn and you will be condemned,” as the Holy Scriptures say.

text: Indi man husto nga mangdakop na lang kita sang mga tambay tungod lang sa aton suspetso nga basi may malain sila nga himuon samtang bisan kasuguan wala man gani kita masandigan.
english: It is not right for us to arrest the hangouts just because we suspect that they might do something wrong when we cannot even rely on the law.

text: Dakpa lang ang may paglabag sa kasuguan, indi kay sa suspetso lang nga wala sing maathag nga basehan.
english: Only arrest those who have broken the law, not just on suspicion without a clear basis.

text: In fact, sa aton mismo nga kasuguan, hilway ang pumuluyo sa kon ano ang luyag nila himuon nga wala man ga-perhwisyo sa iban ukon nagalabag sa kasuguan.
english: In fact, in our own law, the people are free to do what they want without harming others or violating the law.

text:
-0-0-0-

Makadalayaw matuod ang nagasunod sing prinsipyo nga “The end does not justify the means.” Maka-Diyos ini kag maka-Tawo.
english:
-0-0-0-

It is truly commendable to follow the principle “The end does not justify the means.” It is both Godly and Human.

text: Gani ginadayaw naton ang panindugan sang kapulisan sa Bacolod City angot sa kon paano ang pagdakop sing nagaka-igu sang mga tambay sa sining siyudad.
english: Therefore, we commend the stand of the police in Bacolod City regarding how to properly arrest the tambay in this city.

text: Indi katulad sadtong ginhimo sang mga pulis sa Metro Manila, sa diin gindakop ang isa naton ka utod nga taga-Iloilo.
english: Unlike what the police did in Metro Manila, where one of our brothers from Iloilo was arrested.

text: Gindakop siya nga wala sing madamo nga pamangkot sang may ginbakal lang siya sa tyangge sang dis-oras.
english: He was arrested without much questioning when he just bought something at the stall at noon.

text: Ang masubo pa kay gin-upod siya sa mga hurong sa prisuhan nga napatay gid sa ila pagkastigo.
english: Unfortunately, he was put in prison with the fools who died of their beatings.

text: Siling ni Police Sr.
english: Police Sr. said.

text: Supt.
english: Supt.

text: Francisco Ebreo, acting director sang Bacolod City Police Offfice (BCPO), naga-amlig gid sila sa pangpangdakop sang mga tambay.
english: Francisco Ebreo, acting director of the Bacolod City Police Office (BCPO), said they are very careful about the arrest of hangouts.

text: Wala sila, siling niya, nagapangdakop sang tambay nga wala naman ginahimo nga violation sang kasuguan.
english: They do not, he said, arrest hangers-on who are not committing a violation of the law.

text: Ginpasalig man niya ang publiko nga ang ila kinamatarong sa aton hilway nga pungsod indi ma-violate sang mga kapulisan.
english: He also assured the public that their rights in our free country will not be violated by the police.

text: Okey ka, Tsip!
english: You’re okay, Chip!

text: Nagnubo sang 34% ang kaso sang fireworks-related injuries (FWRI) sa tuig 2025 sa probinsya sang Iloilo kun ikumpara sa tuig 2024.
english: The number of fireworks-related injuries (FWRI) cases in 2025 in Iloilo province will decrease by 34% compared to 2024.

text:
Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Rodney Labis, Chief sang Health Service Delivery Division sang Iloilo Provincial Health Office (IPHO) iya ginpahayag nga may 28 ka bag-o nga kaso nga narekord halin New Year’s Eve tubtob nga una ka adlaw sang Enero,

Samtang 52 ka kaso naman ang narekord humalin December 21 tubtob sa katapusan sang tuig.
english:
In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Rodney Labis, Chief of the Health Service Delivery Division of the Iloilo Provincial Health Office (IPHO) said there were 28 new cases recorded from New Year's Eve to January 1,

Meanwhile, 52 cases were recorded from December 21 to the end of the year.

text: Sa kabug-usan, 27 ka banwa sa probinsya sang Iloilo ang may narekord nga mga kaso.
english: A total of 27 towns in Iloilo province have recorded cases.

text: Pinakadamo nga kaso ang narekord sa Sara nga may ara sang 5 ka kaso, samtang 4 ka kaso ang narekord sa Sta.
english: The highest number of cases was recorded in Sara with 5 cases, while 4 cases were recorded in Sta.

text: Barbara kag Pototan.
english: Barbara and Pototan.

text: Base sa regional data, ang pinakadamo nga biktima sang FWRI amo ang naga-edad 10–19 anyos, kag kalabanan ang mga lalaki.
english: Based on regional data, the highest number of FWRI victims were aged 10–19 years, and mostly males.

text: Samtang, 9% naman ang sa kababainhan.
english: Meanwhile, 9% are for women.

text: Ginpahayag man nga illegal nga boga kag kamara ang ginhalinan sang kadam-an nga mga injury.
english: It was also reported that illegal guns and chambers were the cause of most of the injuries.

text: Ginpahanumdom sang IPHO nga posible pa nga madugangan ang ini nga mga kaso bangud sa Enero 6 pa matapos ang surveillance period.
english: The IPHO reminded that there is a possibility that these cases will increase because the surveillance period will end on January 6.

text: Nagpasalamat naman ang Provincial Government sang Iloilo sa tanan nga nagsuporta sa kampanya nga “Iwas Paputok”, nga ginakabig nga isa sa mga rason sa pagnubo sang kaso sang fireworks-related injuries sa probinsya.
english: The Provincial Government of Iloilo thanked all those who supported the “Iwas Paputok” campaign, which is considered one of the reasons for the decline in fireworks-related injuries in the province.

text: ILOILO CITY -Makabulig sa pag-angkon sang maayo nga cadiovascular health ang paglangoy.
english: ILOILO CITY -Swimming can help achieve good cardiovascular health.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mark Consing, swimming instructor, iya ginpahayag nga ang paglangoy ang isa ka sahi sang ehersisyo nga makabulig sa pagpabaskog sang cadiovascular muscle kasubong sang baga.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Mark Consing, swimming instructor, said swimming is a type of exercise that can help strengthen cardiovascular muscles such as the lungs.

text: Ginpahayag ni Consing nga ang mga may yara sang athsma kag ang mga senior citizen ang ginapanugyanan nga maglangoy.
english: Consing said those with asthma and senior citizens are advised to swim.

text: Magluwas sa health benefits, ang ihibalo sa paglangoy ang mahimo nga magamit bilang water survival technique.
english: In addition to the health benefits, knowledge of swimming can be used as a water survival technique.

text: Bilang isa ka swimming instructor, ginapanugyan ni Consing nga mas makapaayo nga ang mga lapsag ang tudlu-an na sa paglangoy.
english: As a swimming instructor, Consing suggests that it is better for babies to be taught to swim.

text: Lakip sa mga basic swimming techniques nga dapat matun-an amo ang pagginhawa sa tubig, floating ukon paglutaw kag ang glide ukon pagbuylo.
english: Among the basic swimming techniques to be learned are water breathing, floating and gliding.

text: Kun matun-an na ang basic techniques, mahimo na mga matun-an ang nanari-sari nga stroke sa paglangoy.
english: Once the basic techniques are learned, the various swimming strokes can be learned.

text: Isa na lang sa anum ka mga tiglawas sang Pilipinas ang may tyansa pa nga makabulsa sang medalya sa 17th Paralympic Games nga ginapatigayon sa Paris, France.
english: Only one of the six representatives of the Philippines still has a chance to pocket a medal at the 17th Paralympic Games being held in Paris, France.

text: Ini amo ang para javelin thrower nga si Cendy Asusano nga amo ang “last Filipino athlete standing”.
english: This is para javelin thrower Cendy Asusano who is the “last Filipino athlete standing”.

text: Maga-compete siya alas kuatro karon sa hapon oras sa Pilipinas para sa finals sang women’s javelin throw F54 event.
english: She will compete at 4 pm Philippine time for the finals of the women's javelin throw F54 event.

text: Tumandok si Asusano sang Donsol, Sorsogon kag naka-qualify para sa iya una nga Paralympic Games sang nakalab-ot ang iya record sa 14.23 meters kag nagpang-apat anay sa 2023 Hangzhou Asian Para Games sa China.
english: Asusano is a native of Donsol, Sorsogon and qualified for her first Paralympic Games when she reached a record of 14.23 meters and placed fourth at the 2023 Hangzhou Asian Para Games in China.

text: Antes kay Asusano, nag-compete pa kagab-i ang para swimmer nga si Angel Otom sang Olongapo City apang napaslawan liwat nga makakuha sang medalya.
english: Before Asusano, para swimmer Angel Otom of Olongapo City competed last night but again failed to win a medal.

text: Nagpang-lima si Otom sa women’s 50m butterfly S5 sang nagdangat sa 45.78 seconds ang iya time sa karera nga gindaog naman sang powerhouse nga China.
english: Otom finished fifth in the women's 50m butterfly S5 with a time of 45.78 seconds, which was won by powerhouse China.

text: Ang 21-anyos nga si Otom ang nabun-ag nga wala sang wala nga butkon kag underdeveloped man ang tuo nga butkon.
english: The 21-year-old Otom was born without a left arm and an underdeveloped right arm.

text: Isa siya ka seven-time gold medalist sa ASEAN Para Games kag apisar debut niya ini sa Paralympics, duha ka finals ang iya napasakupan kun sa diin nagpang-anum siya sa women’s 50m backstroke S5 sang nagligad nga adlaw.
english: She is a seven-time gold medalist at the ASEAN Para Games and despite making her debut at the Paralympics, she has participated in two finals where she finished sixth in the women's 50m backstroke S5 yesterday.

text: May nalakip nga Pilipino sa gin-aresto sang mga pulis sa Pakistan sa call center nga na-involve sa Ponzi schemes kag investment fraud.
english: A Filipino was among those arrested by Pakistani police in a call center involved in Ponzi schemes and investment fraud.

text: Suno sa National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency, paagi sa sini nga fraudulent network, ginatunto ang publiko kag gina-kuhaan sang daku nga kantidad sang kuwarta.
english: According to the National Cyber ​​Crime Investigation Agency, through this fraudulent network, the public is being misled and extorted large sums of money.

text: Naga-operate ang network sa syudad sang Faisalabad sa east nga parte sang pungsod.
english: The network operates in the city of Faisalabad in the eastern part of the country.

text: “During the raid, a large call center was uncovered, which was involved in Ponzi schemes and investment fraud,” kabahin sang statement sang agency.
english: “During the raid, a large call center was uncovered, which was involved in Ponzi schemes and investment fraud,” part of the agency’s statement.

text:
“Through this fraudulent network, the public was being deceived and vast sums of money were being illegally collected.”

149 tanan ang nadakpan kun sa diin 78 ang Pakistanis, 48 ang Chinese, samtang ang iban naman ang naghalin sa Nigeria, sa Pilipinas, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe kag Myanmar.
english:
“Through this fraudulent network, the public was being deceived and vast sums of money were being illegally collected.”

A total of 149 were arrested, of which 78 were Pakistanis, 48 ​​were Chinese, while others were from Nigeria, the Philippines, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe and Myanmar.

text: 18 naman ang mga babaye sa mga arestado.
english: 18 of those arrested were women.

text: Tanan sila ang yara na sa kustodiya sang awtoridad.#
english: All of them are now in the custody of the authorities.

text: Nalab-ot sang isa ka mag-asawa ang ila nga handom nga makabal sang ila nga dream house, bangud sa isa nila ka abyan nga hubog ukon yara sa impluwensya sang makahulubog nga ilimnon.
english: A couple achieved their dream of buying their dream house, thanks to a friend who was drunk or under the influence of alcohol.

text: Plano kuntani nanday Celyn Rafar kag sang iya nga bana nga ipaiway ang pagbakal sang balay bangud sa pandemya.
english: Celyn Rafar and her husband were planning to postpone the purchase of a house due to the pandemic.

text: Suno kay Rafar, bag-o pa man naglupok ang pandemic, nahulugan na nila ang ila baklon kuntani nga balay.
english: According to Rafar, even before the pandemic broke out, they had already bought a house.

text: Apang nadulaan sang trabaho ang iya nga bana rason nga wala naaprubahan ang ila nga loan para sa ila pagabaklon nga dream house.
english: But her husband lost his job and their loan for their dream house was not approved.

text: Apang sa adlaw mismo sang ila nga kasal, ginpasalig sang ila abyan nga nahubog sa event nga mabulig ini agud makabakal ang mag-asawa sang ila ginahandom nga balay.
english: But on the day of their wedding, their friend who was drunk at the event assured them that he would help the couple buy their dream house.

text: Pagdumdom ni Rafar, nagalang-lango lang ini bangud sa kahulugbon.
english: Rafar thought he was just drunk.

text: “Akala ko joke lang.
english: “I thought it was a joke.

text:
Although capable naman s’ya pero baka biro lang kasi lasing eh,”

Apang sa mga masunod nga adlaw, nagduhol na ang abyan sang couple sang tseke nga nagabalor P2 Million.
english:
Although he's capable but maybe he's just joking because he's drunk,”

But in the following days, the couple's friend handed over a check worth P2 million.

text: Tuman naman ang kakibot kag pagpasalamat sang mag-asawa sa diin fully-paid na subong ang dream house nga ila sayluhan.
english: The couple was surprised and grateful that the dream house they are going to move into is now fully-paid.

text: Normal para sa mga lalaki nga maka-eksperyensya sang prostate enlargement ukon ang pagdako sang prostate samtang naga tigulang.
english: It is normal for men to experience prostate enlargement or the enlargement of the prostate as they age.

text: Suno kay Dr. Bibly Macaya, ang prostate ang isa ka gland sa idalom sang bladder nga nagahimo sang likido nga nagasuporta sa sperm sang lalaki.
english: According to Dr. Bibly Macaya, the prostate is a gland under the bladder that produces a fluid that supports a man's sperm.

text: Pagdangat sa 50 anyos sang mga lalaki, nagadako ang prostate bangud.
english: By the time men reach the age of 50, the prostate enlarges because.

text: Nagadangat sa 40 tubtob 60 gramo ang masami nga bug-at sang nagdako nga prostate apang may mga hitabo nga nagadako ini tubtob sa 200 gramo nga makabig sobra.
english: An enlarged prostate usually weighs 40 to 60 grams but in some cases it can grow up to 200 grams which is considered excessive.

text: Isa sa mga sintomas sang pagdako sang prostate amo ang masami nga pag-ihi.
english: One of the symptoms of prostate enlargement is frequent urination.

text: Makapila ka beses ang mga kalalakihan nga nagabugtaw sa tungang gab-i agud lamang nga mangihi.
english: Many times men wake up in the middle of the night just to pee.

text: Panugyan sang eksperto, kinahanglan paoperahan ang prostate kun magbug-at na ini sa 80 gramo kag kun may yara na sang bato.
english: Experts advise that the prostate should be operated on when it weighs more than 80 grams and if there are stones.

text: Ginlutos sang Olympic pole vault champion nga si Armand ‘Mondo’ Duplantis ang Norwegian 400m hurdler nga si Karsten Warholm sa 100m exhibition race sa Zurich, Switzerland.
english: Olympic pole vault champion Armand ‘Mondo’ Duplantis defeated Norwegian 400m hurdler Karsten Warholm in the 100m exhibition race in Zurich, Switzerland.

text:
Naglab-ot sa 10.37 seconds ang time ni Mondo, samtang natapos naman ni Warholm ang karera sa time nga 10.47 nga pareho nila nga ‘personal best.’

Ginpatigayon ang race sa Letzigrund Stadium kun sa diin natalana man sila nga mag-compete sa ila tagsa ka sports event sa Diamond League meeting subong nga semana.
english:
Mondo's time was 10.37 seconds, while Warholm finished the race in 10.47, a personal best.

The race was held at the Letzigrund Stadium where they are also scheduled to compete in their respective sports events in the Diamond League meeting this week.

text: “I’m pretty fired up.
english: “I’m pretty fired up.

text: How could I not be?” pahayag ni Duplantis sang yara na sa finish line.
english: How could I not be?” Duplantis said at the finish line.

text:
“Stop playing with me!”

Wala naman sang kalain sang buot ang 28-anyos nga Norwegian athlete para sa pole vault legend sang Sweden.
english:
“Stop playing with me!”

The 28-year-old Norwegian athlete holds no grudges for Sweden's pole vault legend.

text: “I got to give it to Mondo, he beat me, fair and square, so it was a great race,” pahayag sini.
english: “I got to give it to Mondo, he beat me, fair and square, so it was a great race,” stated sini.

text: “He was out [of] the blocks fast.
english: “He was out [of] the blocks fast.

text:
He was out really sharp.”

Sunod nga ginhatagan ni Duplantis si Warholm sang isa ka Sweden jersey agud suksukon sa karera sa 400m hurdles sa Diamond League.
english:
He was out really sharp.”

Duplantis next gave Warholm a Sweden jersey to wear in the 400m hurdles race in the Diamond League.

text: Nahibaluan nga si Warholm ang isa ka 400m hurdles world record holder kag three-time world champion apang napaslawan ini nga madepensahan ang iya Olympic title nga nadag-an sa Tokyo 2020 sang nag-compete ini liwat sa Paris Games.
english: Warholm is a 400m hurdles world record holder and three-time world champion but failed to defend his Olympic title won at Tokyo 2020 when he competed again at the Paris Games.

text: Kilala naman si Duplantis nga apisar sa iya edad nga 24-anyos pa lamang, nag-set sang 10 ka world records sa pole vault, umpisa sa height nga 6.17m sang 2020 tubtub sa 6.25m sa Paris 2024 kag 6.26m sa Diamond League sa Poland pagkasunod nga sinemana.
english: Duplantis is known for setting 10 world records in the pole vault, from a height of 6.17m in 2020 to 6.25m in Paris 2024 and 6.26m in the Diamond League in Poland the following week.

text: Sang high school pa lamang si Mondo, nakadalagan ini sa time nga 10.57 seconds suno sa Olympics.com.
english: When Mondo was in high school, he ran a time of 10.57 seconds according to Olympics.com.

text: Una man ini nagpabutyag sang interes nga mag-compete sa sprint relays para sa Sweden magluwas sa pagpasakop sa pole vault.#
english: She also previously expressed interest in competing in the sprint relays for Sweden in addition to participating in the pole vault.#

text: WALA kwestyon nga ang poder sa pag-appoint sang myembro sang Board of Directors sang Metro Iloilo Water District (MIWD) yara na sa meyor sang Siyudad sang Iloilo kag indi na sa gobernador sang Probinsya sang Iloilo.
english: There is no question that the power to appoint members of the Board of Directors of the Metro Iloilo Water District (MIWD) is now with the mayor of Iloilo City and not with the governor of Iloilo Province.

text: Ina tungod sa desisyon sang Korte Suprema sa kaso Rama, et al versus Moises, et al, G.R. No.
english: That is because of the decision of the Supreme Court in the case of Rama, et al versus Moises, et al, G.R. No.

text: 197146 sadtong Disyembre 6, 2016 nga nag-athag sang kinamatarong sang siyudad kag sang probinsya sa diin nahamtang ang water district sa sining duha ka local govenment unit.
english: 197146 of December 6, 2016 which clarified the rights of the city and the province where the water district is located to these two local government units.

text: Sa sining kaso, gin-deklarar sang Korte Suprema ang Section 3(b) sang Presidential Decree No.198 nga “unconstitutional”.
english: In this case, the Supreme Court declared Section 3(b) of Presidential Decree No.198 “unconstitutional”.

text: Ginhatag man sini ang poder sa pag-appoint sang myembro sang Board of Directors sang water district sa meyor sang siyudad nga nagaserbisyo sa mas madamo nga mga “active water service connections” sangsa probinsya.
english: It also gave the power to appoint members of the Board of Directors of the water district to the mayor of the city that serves more active water service connections than the province.

text: “Unconstitutional” ining Section 3(b) sang PD 198, nga ginpasar sadto ni Presidente Ferdinand Marcos sang 1973, sunu sa Korte Suprema, tungod gin-supersede, ukon nasapawan, na ini sang subong nga 1987 Constitution sa idalom sang local autonomy provision sini.
english: Section 3(b) of PD 198, passed by President Ferdinand Marcos in 1973, is unconstitutional, according to the Supreme Court, because it has been superseded by the current 1987 Constitution under its local autonomy provision.

text: “Unfair” man ini, dugang sang Korte Suprema, sa paghatag sing poder sa gobernador sang probinsya samtang ang mayoriya sang “active water service connections” yara sa pagtatap sang siyudad.
english: It is also “unfair”, the Supreme Court added, to give power to the provincial governor when the majority of “active water service connections” are in the care of the city.

text: Ang Section 3(b) sang PD 198 nagahatag sing poder sa pag-appoint sang myembro sang Board sa gobernador sang probinsya bisan sobra lang sa 25 porsyento ang ginaserbisyuhan sini, samtang gina-requirer ang siyudad sang indi magnubo sa 75 porsyento.
english: Section 3(b) of PD 198 gives the power to appoint Board members to the provincial governor even if he serves only more than 25 percent, while requiring the city to have at least 75 percent.

text: Sa kaso sang Metro Cebu Water District (MCWD), ginkwestyon sang gobernador sang Cebu ang poder sang meyor sang Cebu sa pag-appoint sang isa ka myembro sang Board tungod kulang sa 75 porsyento ang gina-serbisyuhan sini nga mga kliyente sunu sa survey sadtong 2016.
english: In the case of the Metro Cebu Water District (MCWD), the governor of Cebu questioned the power of the mayor of Cebu to appoint a member of the Board because it serves less than 75 percent of its clients according to the 2016 survey.

text: Nagdaug ang siyudad sang Cebu sa sini nga kaso.
english: Cebu City won the case.

text: Angot sa sining kaso sang MCWD, nagpagwa si Mayor Espinosa sang cease and desist” order kontra sa mga myembro sang MIWD Board nga gin-appoint sadto ni Governor Arthur Defensor, Sr.
english: In connection with this MCWD case, Mayor Espinosa issued a cease and desist order against the members of the MIWD Board appointed by Governor Arthur Defensor, Sr.

text: agud maka-appoint siya sang bag-o nga mga myembro sang Board.
english: so that he can appoint new Board members.

text: Wala ini gintuman sang MIWD.
english: MIWD did not comply.

text: Tungod sini, sang sining ulihi lang, nag-aksyon na si meyor kag nag-appoint sang lima ka myembro sang MIWD Board.
english: Because of this, recently, the mayor took action and appointed five members of the MIWD Board.

text: Ginpahibalo sini ang Local Water Utilities Administration (LWUA) parti sa sining iya aksyon.
english: He informed the Local Water Utilities Administration (LWUA) about his action.

text: Balita naton nga nakasabat na ang MIWD, apang tubtub subong wala pa makahatag sing iya desisyon ukon opinyon ang LWUA.
english: We hear that MIWD has already responded, but so far the LWUA has not given its decision or opinion.

text:
***

Ano ayhan ang desisyon ukon opinyon sang LWUA?
english:
***

What is the decision or opinion of the LWUA?

text: Paboran bala sini ang aksyon ni meyor ukon ang iya sang MIWD nga naga-insistir nga mapabilin sa pwesto ang anay gin-appoint ni Goverrnor Arthur Defensor, Sr.
english: Will he favor the action of the mayor or that of MIWD who insists that the former appointee of Governor Arthur Defensor, Sr.

text: santu sa ruling sang Regional Trial Court?
english: according to the ruling of the Regional Trial Court?

text: Ang iban sa ila sini may term tubtub sa 2019 kag 2022.
english: Some of them have terms until 2019 and 2022.

text: Hangop ta ugaling sa desisyon sang Korter Suprema amo nga indi gilayon ma-implementar ang pagpatuman sang pag-appoint ni Mayor Espinosa tungod nakataya diri ang public interest kag may legal pa nga isyu nga dapat athagon.
english: However, we understand from the decision of the Supreme Court that the implementation of Mayor Espinosa's appointment cannot be implemented immediately because the public interest is at stake and there are still legal issues that need to be clarified.

text: Kon husto kita, posible mag-desisyon ang LWUA nga ihatag anay ang kaso sang meyor kag MIWD sa korte.
english: If we are right, the LWUA may decide to take the case of the mayor and MIWD to court first.

text: Posible nga i-rekomendar sang LWUA nga mag-file anay ang siyudad sang kaso nga naga-nullify sang appointment sang mga na-appoint ni Defensor bag-o mapatuman ni meyor ang iya appointment sang bag-o nga myembro sang MIWD Board.
english: The LWUA may recommend that the city file a case nullifying the appointments of Defensor's appointees before the mayor implements his appointment of new MIWD Board members.
