text: Kun ikaw magselebrar sang imo kaadlawan, nagapang-libre ka man bala sa imo mga abyan ukon ikaw ang nagapa-libre?
english: When you celebrate your birthday, do you give free to your friends or do you give free?

text: Sa syudad sang Valenzuela sa Manila, nagbubo ang pagdayaw sa isa ka tricycle driver nga nagtanyag sang libre nga sakay bilog nga adlaw, kadungan sang iya kaadlawan.
english: In Manila's Valenzuela City, praise poured in for a tricycle driver who offered a free ride all day, in conjunction with his birthday.

text: Santo sa panaysayon sang isa ka pasahero, papuli na siya sang nakasakay siya sa tricycle nga ginamaneho ni Rogelio Aguilar kag nakibot siya sa nagakabit nga placard sa tricycle kun sa diin nakasaad ang mga tinaga nga: “Free rides po tayo today.
english: According to a passenger, he was on his way home when he boarded a tricycle driven by Rogelio Aguilar and was surprised by the placard attached to the tricycle with the words: “Free rides po tayo today.

text:
It’s my birthday celebration.”

Suno kay Marilou Llobera, pagpasalamat kag pag-greet sang ”happy birthday” na lang ang iya ginbayad kay Rogelio.
english:
It’s my birthday celebration.”

According to Marilou Llobera, she only paid Rogelio a thank you and a happy birthday greeting.

text: Pahayag naman ni Rogelio, masami niya ini nga ginahimo kun mag-birthday siya bilang pagpasalamat sa grasya sang Diyos kun sa diin luyag man niya makabulig sa iban nga tawo bisan sa gamay lang nga pamaagi.
english: Rogelio said he often does this when he celebrates his birthday as a thank you for God's grace where he wants to help other people even in a small way.

text: Napalab-ot na sa Local Economic Enterprise Office ang problema sa naguba nga elevator sa newly developed nga Iloilo Central Market.
english: The problem of the broken elevator in the newly developed Iloilo Central Market has been brought to the attention of the Local Economic Enterprise Office.

text: Naguba ini kadungan man sa mamunog nga pag-ulan kahapon nga adlaw.
english: It was damaged during heavy rains yesterday.

text: Suno sa mga vendors, nagapangayo sila sang bulig bangud wala sila nakapangaman sa natabo nga pagkaguba sang elevator.
english: According to the vendors, they are asking for help because they were not prepared for the elevator breakdown.

text: Mabudlay man ini para sa ila ang magpasaka sang mga produkto padulong sa ikatatlo nga panalgan bangud wala naga-function ang elevator.
english: It is also difficult for them to lift products to the third floor because the elevator is not functioning.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Maricel Mabaquiao, head sang Local Economic Enterprise Office (LEEO), iya ginpahayag nga gin-address na sang management ang problema kag ginhimuan na sang report nga igapasa sa SM.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Maricel Mabaquiao, head of the Local Economic Enterprise Office (LEEO), said the management has already addressed the problem and prepared a report to be submitted to the SM.

text: Suno sa iya, may ara sang 100 percent refund para sa mga apektado nga parte sang merkado.
english: He said there would be a 100 per cent refund for the affected parts of the market.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga maayo nga timprano pa lang nahibaluan na ang isyu para ma-address ang problema.
english: He also said it was good that the issue was identified early so that the problem could be addressed.

text: Dugang pa ni Mabaquiao nga magahatag sila sang assistance sa mga apektado nga vendors, ilabi na ang mga nabasa ang produkto nga bugas bangud sa tubig nga halin sa drainage.
english: Mabaquiao added that they will provide assistance to the affected vendors, especially those whose rice products were wet due to water from the drainage.

text: Sa subong, nagaresponde na ang contractor para sa pagpakay-o sang mga naguba, kag ginpasalig nga ma-address ini gilayon.
english: The contractor is now responding to repair the damage, and assured that it will be addressed immediately.

text: Sa Lunes, magahiwat sang walk-through inspection kag imbestigasyon upod ang city engineers.
english: On Monday, a walk-through inspection and investigation will be conducted with city engineers.

text: Nahibaluan man nga kahapon nga adlaw nagkalabuka ang mga tiles malapit sa entrance sang Iloilo Central Market matapos magbulwak ang tubig halin sa naglupok nga drainage.
english: It was also learned that yesterday, the tiles near the entrance of the Iloilo Central Market broke after water overflowed from the burst drainage.

text: KALUOYAN sang Diyos si Presidente Duterte sa daku niya nga kasal-anan sa pagtawag sa Diyos nga “stupid”, ukon wala namang-an, sa pagtuga sini kay Adan kag kay Eba.
english: God have mercy on President Duterte for his great sin of calling God “stupid”, or ignorant, in creating Adam and Eve.

text: Wala lang niya gin-insultuhan ang Diyos nga ginatuohan sang halos 90 ka porsyento nga mga Kristiyano sa pungsod, kundi sang lapaw duha pa ka bilyon nga mga Kristiyano sa kalibutan.
english: He not only insulted the God of nearly 90 percent of Christians in the country, but of more than two billion other Christians in the world.

text: “What is this stupid God?
english: “What is this stupid God?

text: You created something perfect and then you think of an event that would destroy the quality of your work,” siling ni Duterte, sa pag-quote sang Inquirer, parti sa pagtuga sang Diyos kay Adan kag Eba kag pagpakasala sini nila sa pagkaon sa ginadilian nga mansanas.
english: You created something perfect and then you think of an event that would destroy the quality of your work,” Duterte said, quoting the Inquirer, about God creating Adam and Eve and making them sin by eating the forbidden apple.

text: Sa matuod, sala si Presidente sa pagbasol sa Diyos sa kasal-anan nanday Adan kag Eba.
english: In fact, the President is wrong to blame God for the sin of Adam and Eve.

text: Indi ta mabasol ang Diyos sa pagpakasala sang duha.
english: We cannot blame God for the sin of the two.

text: Gintagaan sila sang Diyos sing Kahilwayan sa pagpili sa tunga sang Maayo kag Malain agud mapaseguro ang ila pagkatutum sa pagkamatarong sang Diyos.
english: God gave them the freedom to choose between Good and Evil to ensure their faithfulness to God's righteousness.

text: Gani, kon nagpakasala gid man sila ina ila gid lang kasal-anan.
english: So, if they have sinned, it is their own fault.

text: Kabay nga may kapatawaran pa si Presidente sa pagpakamalaut sang palangga naton nga Diyos.
english: May the President have forgiveness for cursing our beloved God.

text:
***

Ginakasubo gid naton ang natabo sa isa ta ka utod nga Ilonggo nga nangayaw sa pag-ubra kag napatay sa Metro Manila pagkatapos nga gindakop siya sang mga pulis kag mapriso tungod sa pag-istambay sang dis-oras sa isa ka tyangge nga wala sing pang-ibabaw nga bayo.
english:
***

We are deeply saddened by the incident of an Ilonggo brother who went to work and died in Metro Manila after he was arrested by the police and imprisoned for hanging out for hours in a stall without outer clothes.

text: Ang ining pagdakop kay Genesis “Tisoy” Argoncillo sang Barangay Bagongon, Concepcion, Iloilo angot sa mando ni Presidente Duterte agud limpyuhan ang dalanon sang mga istambay (tambay, sa tagalog).
english: The arrest of Genesis “Tisoy” Argoncillo of Barangay Bagongon, Concepcion, Iloilo is in connection with President Duterte's order to clean up the streets of street vendors.

text: Upod kita sa Presidente sa pagsaway sa mga tawo nga pa-tambay-tambay lang nga wala naman sing maubra kundi ang mag-istambay lang sa dalanon, labi na gid sa kariit sang panahon sa subong nga lapnagon ang pagpangawat, kidpnapay, kag pagpatay.
english: We join the President in condemning the people who are just hanging out with nothing to do but hang out on the streets, especially in these difficult times when theft, kidnapping, and murder are rampant.

text: Okey man lang ina kon nagapahangin-hangin lang sang malinong ukon nagasugilanun sing matawhay kag indi perhwisyo sa mga kasilingan, kag wala naman nagalabag sang aton mga kasuguan.
english: It's okay if you're just having a good time or talking quietly and not harming your neighbors, and it doesn't violate our laws.

text: Kinamatarong man ina nila sa ila kahilwayan bilang pumuluyo sang hilway nga pungsod.
english: It is also their right to freedom as citizens of a free country.

text: Ang problema ugaling kay wala sing maathag nga guidelines ang mga pulis bahin sa sining pagpangdakop sang mga tambay.
english: The problem, however, is that the police do not have clear guidelines regarding the arrest of hangouts.

text: Gani ang natabo nagapinagusto lang ang mga pulis sing pagpangdakop.
english: So what happened was that the police were just making arrests.

text: In fact, daw wala man gani sing kasuguan kontra sa pagtambay.
english: In fact, there doesn't even seem to be a law against hanging out.

text: Kon may ara, ina sa mga gawi nga ginadumili sang mga lokal lang nga mga ordinansa.
english: If anything, it's in practices that are prohibited only by local ordinances.

text: Ang mga ini wala man gapalahero.
english: They don't drive either.

text: May ara nga ginadakop tungod wala sing pang-ibabaw nga panapot sa lugar nga wala naman sing ordinansa nga nagadumili sini.
english: Some are arrested for not wearing outerwear in a place where there is no ordinance prohibiting it.

text: May ara man kon tubtub ano oras lang nga puede maka-inom, nga lain man sa iban nga lugar.
english: There are also limits on how long you can drink, which varies from place to place.

text: Sa siyudad sang Iloilo, wala na sing inom pag-abot sang a las dos sang aga agud malikawan ang masami nga kinagamo sa Smallville.
english: In Iloilo City, there is no drinking after 2 am to avoid the frequent riots in Smallville.

text: Sa nahibal-an man naton diri sa siyudad sang Iloilo, ang pagdumili sa pag-uba sang bayo natumod lang sa sulod sang merkado publiko.
english: As we know here in Iloilo City, the ban on undressing is only specified inside the public market.

text: Kon may kasubong nga pagdumili iya na ina ya sang mga pribado nga mga supermarket sa ila man kaugalingon nga regulasyon.
english: If there is such a ban, it is up to the private supermarkets in their own regulations.

text: May dapat man pahamtangan sang suspetsado sa nagakabagay nga kulungan.
english: The suspect should also be placed in a suitable jail.

text: Indi mo masimpon ang suspetsado nga may mamag-an nga kaso upod sa mga may mabug-at nga krimen.
english: You can't mix a suspect with a light case with those with a serious crime.

text: Sa kaso ni Argoncillo, ginbutang siya upod sa mga priso nga hurong nga nagsapote todo-todo sa iya tubtub mapatay.
english: In Argoncillo's case, he was placed with prisoners who were stupid enough to beat him to death.

text: Tungod pagusto lang sa pag-interpretar ang aton kapulisan kon ano ang bagay nila himuon, ang natabo amo nga daw wala na sing kasuguan.
english: Because our police are willing to interpret what they should do, what happened is that there seems to be no law.

text:
***

Bilang isa ka demokrasya, ang Pilipinas nagatindug sa kinamatarong sang kada pumuluyo sa hilway nga pagginawi basta indi lang siya makatapak sa kinamatarong sang iban kag, kon makasayop gid man, nga matagaan siya sing kinamatarong sa pagsabat sang mga reklamo kontra sa iya.
english:
***

As a democracy, the Philippines stands for the right of every citizen to freedom of movement as long as he does not violate the rights of others and, if he makes a mistake, that he is given the right to answer complaints against him.

text: Pila ka importante nga kinamatarong sa aton Demokrasya amo ang “right to due process” kag “right to a fair and public  trial”.
english: Some important rights in our democracy are the right to due process and the right to a fair and public trial.

text: Sa idalom sa sining kinamatarong, ang pag-sita kag pagdakop sang isa ka pumuluyo dapat sandig sa maathag nga kasuguan (rule of law) kag indi lang sa haum-haum sang pulis.
english: Under this right, the seizure and arrest of a citizen must be based on the rule of law and not merely on the discretion of the police.

text: Salamat lang kay sa Iloilo ginakilala ini sang aton kapulisan diri.
english: Thankfully, in Iloilo, our police here recognize this.

text: Nagpasalamat sa Bombo Radyo kag kay Iloilo City Lone District Representative Julienne “Jamjam” Baronda ang anak sang Ilongga nga overseas Filipino worker (OFW) sa Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates.
english: The son of an Ilongga overseas Filipino worker (OFW) in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, thanked Bombo Radyo and Iloilo City Lone District Representative Julienne “Jamjam” Baronda.

text: Ini bangud nga may kumpirmasyon na nga dal-on ang bangkay sini pauli sa Pilipinas.
english: This is because there is confirmation that his body will be brought back to the Philippines.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay “Alyas Boy”, iya ginpahayag nga nakontak na sila sang Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA) sa Abu Dhabi kag sa Region 6 para sa pagproseso sang pagpauli sa bangkay sang iya iloy.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, “Alyas Boy” said they have already contacted the Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA) in Abu Dhabi and Region 6 to process the return of his mother's body.

text: Ini matapos nga mabaton sang Embahada sang Pilipinas ang sulat nga naga-request sa mga kinahanglanon sa pagpauli sang iya iloy.
english: This was after the Philippine Embassy received a letter requesting the necessities for the return of his mother.

text: Suno kay Alyas Boy, may ara sang working visa ang iya iloy, gani natigayon nga ma-resolbar kag napamatud-an man nga indi ini TNT sa Abu Dhabi.
english: According to Alyas Boy, his mother has a working visa, so it was resolved and it was also proven that it was not TNT in Abu Dhabi.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Alyas Boy nga sang una nagapati ini nga may ara sang foul play nga natabo sa kamatayon sang iya iloy, apang sa iya pagpakig-angut sini sa mga kaabyanan sang iya iloy, nahibaluan sini nga may ara ini sang problema.
english: Alyas Boy also said that at first he believed that there was a foul play in the death of his mother, but when he talked to his mother's friends, he learned that there was a problem.

text: Suno pa kay ”Alyas Boy”, nagaproblema sa pinansyal ang iya iloy kag amo man ang madali nalang nga expiration sang iya visa.
english: According to ”Alyas Boy”, his mother is having financial problems and her visa is about to expire.

text: Magluwas nga madamo ini sang galastuhan kag kinahanglan nga suportahan, ginpahayag man nga may ara man sang mga kautangan ang ila pamilya.
english: Besides having a lot of expenses and needing to be supported, it was also said that their family also has debts.

text: NATULTULAN  bala ninyo ang “Guanco River” diri sa siyudad sang Iloilo?
english: HAVE you ever found the “Guanco River” here in Iloilo City?

text: Kon wala pa, amo ini ang extension sang Guanco St.
english: If you haven’t already, this is the extension of Guanco St.

text: (pakadto sa Muelle Loney) nga karon ginatawag sang madamo diri nga Guanco River tungod lubog ini sa tubig sa sulod na sang pila ka adlaw.
english: (to Muelle Loney) which is now called the Guanco River because it has been flooded for several days.

text: “Guanco Lake” gani ang tawag sang iban sini tungod yara ini sa dalanon nga wala lutsan pagwa sa sagad ula sang ulan diri.
english: “Guanco Lake” is what some people call it because it is on a road that does not get out of the rain.

text: Sadtong ugto sang Lunes sang nakasaboy kita sa upisina sang isa ka abyan diri, lapit sa tuhod ang dalom sang tubig diri nga halos malapawan na ang sidewalk.
english: On Monday afternoon when we met at a friend's office here, the water here was knee deep and almost overwhelmed the sidewalk.

text: Nagtuhaw ini kuno sang pila ka adlaw nga nagligad sang nag-ula ang Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) sang semento sa parti sang dalan, nga gina-repair sini, sa bibi sang Iloilo Pier malapit sa drainage pagwa sa Iloilo River halin sa Guanco Street.
english: This allegedly occurred a few days ago when the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) poured cement on the part of the road, which it is repairing, on the edge of the Iloilo Pier near the drainage out of the Iloilo River from Guanco Street.

text: Law-law nga trabaho matuod!
english: Law-law work indeed!

text: Ang buho lang kuno sang poste ang gintampukan, ang ila ya gintampukan pati na ang alagyan tubig sang drainage pakadto sa Iloilo River.
english: Only the hole of the pole was covered, they also covered the drainage waterway to the Iloilo River.

text: Pero, basi mapasenyahan ta man ang DPWH (kon ila gid man trabaho ini) tungod galalain na sila sa madamo nga reklamo sang mga pumuluyo.
english: However, maybe we can blame the DPWH (if it's their job) because they're getting worse with the many complaints of the residents.

text: Man, daw ginapabay-an lang nila ang dapat madasig nga trabaho sa dalanon sang mga lay-ud nga mga kontraktor.
english: Man, they seem to be just letting what should be quick work go the way of lazy contractors.

text:

Siling sang National Food Authority (NFA) maganubo na ang bili sang commercial rice tungod sige na ang pagpasulod sa merkado sang mga NFA rice halin sa Thailand kag Vietnam.
english:
***

The National Food Authority (NFA) says the price of commercial rice will drop as NFA rice from Thailand and Vietnam continues to enter the market.

text: Maganubo na ini kuno sang mga P1 tubtub P2 ang kada kilo samtang sige na ang pagbakal sang aton pumuluyo (tag-lima ka kilo lang kada adlaw) sang NFA rice sa tag-P27 tubtub P32 ang kada kilo, depende kon sa diin ginadala ini sang delivery.
english: It will be reduced by P1 to P2 per kilo while our people continue to buy (only five kilos per day) of NFA rice at P27 to P32 per kilo, depending on where the delivery is brought.

text: Aba, Indi matuod ina a!
english: Well, that's not true!

text: In fact, bisan diin nga balita mamati (ukon magtan-aw sa TV) ang mga pumuluyo amo man gihapon ang bili sang mga commercial rice.
english: In fact, no matter where the news is listened to (or watched on TV) the price of commercial rice is the same.

text: Ang manubo nga bili yara gihapon sa P42 tubtub P45 kada kilo.
english: The low price is still at P42 to P45 per kilo.

text: Nagmahal pa gani kuno ang ining NFA rice sa pila ka lugar tungod sa kadugay sang pagdiskarga sang NFA rice sa mga pantalan.
english: The price of NFA rice has even increased in some areas due to the delay in unloading NFA rice at the ports.

text: Tungod kuno sa malain nga panahon.
english: It was supposedly due to bad weather.

text: Tuod?
english: Facts?

text: Samtang, isa ka negosyante sa bugas ang nagsiling nga basi indi na nila mapanubo ang bili sang commercial rice.
english: Meanwhile, a rice trader said they may not be able to reduce the price of commercial rice.

text: Ina tungod mahal ang bakal nila sini.
english: That's because they buy it expensive.

text: Halos man gani sila maka-ganansya kuno sa pagbakal sini sa mangunuma sang tag-P25 kada kilo.
english: They almost make a profit by buying it from farmers at P25 per kilo.

text: Pero, indi ta pagbasulon ang mga mangunguma nga nagahingamu man gani makaganar sing maayad-ayad halin sa mga private traders.
english: However, let's not blame the farmers who are also trying to make a good profit from private traders.

text: Basulon ta ang gobyerno nga halos makabulig sa pagpa-ayad sang pangabuhi sang mga mangunguma.
english: Let's blame the government for almost helping to improve the lives of farmers.

text: Maayo pa ang private traders kay nagahatag sang maayo nga kita sa mga mangunguma.
english: Private traders are better because they give good income to farmers.

text:
Gindala-pauli sang Creamline Cool Smashers ang ila ika-siyam na nga korona sa Premier Volleyball League (PVL) matapos ginpatilaw sang mapait nga kalutusan ang Akari Chargers sa 2024 PVL Reinforced Conference knockout final subong nga gab-i.

Gingamit sang Creamline ang ila malawig nga eksperyensya kag championship poise agud nga maasud-asud ang mga puntos, 25-15, 25-23, 25-17, nga amo ang naghatag sa Akari sang ila una kag isahanon nga kapierdehan subong nga conference.
english:
The Creamline Cool Smashers brought home their ninth Premier Volleyball League (PVL) crown after suffering a bitter defeat to the Akari Chargers in the 2024 PVL Reinforced Conference knockout final tonight.

Creamline used their long experience and championship poise to rattle the points, 25-15, 25-23, 25-17, handing Akari their first and only loss this conference.

text: Sa opening frame pa lang, ginsuguran na sang CCS ang atake paagi sa 7-0 run paagi sa MVP frontrunner nga si Bernadeth Pons kag veteran middle blocker nga si Bea de Leon.
english: Right in the opening frame, CCS started the attack with a 7-0 run through MVP frontrunner Bernadeth Pons and veteran middle blocker Bea de Leon.

text: Pang-winningest team sa PVL history nga pwersa ang ginpakita sang CCS apisar nga wala ang ila key players nga sanday Tots Carlos, Jema Galanza, kag Alyssa Valdez.
english: CCS showed the winningest team in PVL history despite the absence of their key players Tots Carlos, Jema Galanza, and Alyssa Valdez.

text: Ini ang ila una nga Reinforced Conference title halin sang 2018.
english: It was their first Reinforced Conference title since 2018.

text: Sa nagligad nga duha ka Reinforced tilts, nagpangatlo lamang ang team sang 2022 kag first runner-up sang 2019 edition.
english: In the previous two Reinforced tilts, the team only finished third in 2022 and first runner-up in the 2019 edition.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, ang katapusan naman nga sweep nga nahimo sa finals game ang natabo man sa Creamline batok sa KingWhale Taipei sa 2022 Invitational Conference.
english: On the other hand, the last sweep in the finals game also took place in Creamline against KingWhale Taipei in the 2022 Invitational Conference.

text: Nahibaluan nga antes ang finals, perpekto ang rekord sang Akari, 10-0, apisar nga nangin kontrobersyal ang semifinal win sini batok sa PLDT.
english: Before the finals, Akari had a perfect record, 10-0, despite its controversial semifinal win against PLDT.

text: Ini nga one-game championship showdown ang orihinal kuntani nga gin-schedule sang Lunes, Septyembre 2, apang ginsaylo subong nga Myerkules bangud sa Bagyo Enteng.#
english: This one-game championship showdown was originally scheduled for Monday, September 2, but was moved to Wednesday due to Typhoon Enteng.#

text: Gin-ban sang Department of Agriculture (DA) ang importasyon sang poultry products halin sa The Netherlands bangud sa mga kaso sang bird flu sa amo nga pungsod sa Europa.
english: The Department of Agriculture (DA) has banned the import of poultry products from The Netherlands due to cases of bird flu in the European country.

text: Nasakop sa Memorandum Order No.
english: Covered in Memorandum Order No.

text: 56 ang domestic kag wild birds kag tanan nga ila produkto lakip na ang poultry meat, day-old chicks, eggs kag semen.
english: 56 domestic and wild birds and all their products including poultry meat, day-old chicks, eggs and semen.

text: Gin-suspend man sang DA ang pag-proseso kag evaluation sang applications amo man ang pag-paguwa sang sanitary kag phytosanitary import clearances.
english: The DA also suspended the processing and evaluation of applications as well as the issuance of sanitary and phytosanitary import clearances.

text: Tanan nga veterinary quarantine officers ukon inspectors ang maga-check man sa tanan nga poultry commodities sa major ports sa Pilipinas.
english: All veterinary quarantine officers or inspectors will also check all poultry commodities in major ports in the Philippines.

text: Ang mandu sang DA ang kasunod sang report sang Dutch authorities nga may outbreak sang highly pathogenic avian influenza sa Putten, Gelderland kasunod sang outbrteak sa domestic birds sang Nov.
english: The DA's order follows a report by Dutch authorities of an outbreak of highly pathogenic avian influenza in Putten, Gelderland following an outbreak in domestic birds in Nov.

text: 17 subong nga tuig.
english: 17 this year.

text: Base sa World Organization for Animal Health (WOAH), isa ka makalalaton nga viral disease ang avian influenza nga nagaapekto sa domestic kag wild birds.
english: According to the World Organization for Animal Health (WOAH), avian influenza is a contagious viral disease that affects both domestic and wild birds.

text: Tuga ini sang viruses nga may multiple subtypes nga may genetic characteristics nga madasig nga naga-evolve.
english: It is caused by viruses with multiple subtypes with genetic characteristics that evolve rapidly.

text:
𝗠𝗔𝗡𝗜𝗟𝗔 — Para sa iya boluntaryo nga pagbulig sa mga biktima sang Bagyong Carina, ginhatagan sang pasidungog ang aktor nga si Gerald Anderson sang Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) kag ginhatagn sang “search and rescue medal.”

Sa isa ka seremonya nga ginpatigayon sa headquarters sang PCG sa Port Area, Manila, ginkilala ni PCG commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil Gavan si Anderson para sa iya pagbulig nga wala nagapangayo sang bayad.
english:
𝗠𝗔𝗡𝗜𝗟𝗔 — For his voluntary help to the victims of Typhoon Carina, actor Gerald Anderson was honored by the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) and awarded the “search and rescue medal.”

In a ceremony held at the PCG headquarters in Port Area, Manila, PCG commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil Gavan recognized Anderson for his selfless assistance.

text: Ang medalya nga ini ginahatag sa mga indibidwal nga nagahimo sang “exemplary” nga mga buhat sa paghimakas sang search and rescue nga nagresulta sa pagpreserba sang kabuhi, kag kinahanglan nga makita ang boluntaryo nga partisipasyon bisan sa dako nga risgo kag sakripisyo sa panahon sang amo nga operasyon.
english: This medal is awarded to individuals who perform “exemplary” acts in the search and rescue struggle that result in the preservation of life, and must see voluntary participation even at great risk and sacrifice during the operation.

text: Si Anderson, nga isa ka Army reservist kag may ranggo nga Auxiliary Commander sa PCG, nag-viral sang nagligad nga bulan sang iya pagbulig sa pag-rescue sang isa ka pamilya, lakip na ang isa ka bata, nga na-stranded sa Barangay Sto.
english: Anderson, who is an Army reservist and holds the rank of Auxiliary Commander in the PCG, went viral last month when he helped rescue a family, including a child, who was stranded in Barangay Sto.

text: Domingo, Quezon City, tungod sa pagbaha nga dala sang Bagyong Carina.
english: Sunday, Quezon City, due to flooding caused by Typhoon Carina.

text: Ini, indi amo ang una nga tion nga nag-upod si Anderson sa mga rescue operations, bangud nagbulig man siya sang panahon sang Bagyong Ondoy, nga nagdulot sang mga pagdayaw gikan sa nagkalain-lain nga grupo.
english: This is not the first time Anderson has been involved in rescue operations, as he also helped during Typhoon Ondoy, which brought praises from various groups.

text: Sa pahayag, ginpunto ni PCG spokesperson Rear Admiral Armand Balilo nga si Anderson permi present sa mga relief operations kag disaster rehabilitation sang Coast Guard.
english: In a statement, PCG spokesperson Rear Admiral Armand Balilo pointed out that Anderson is always present in the relief operations and disaster rehabilitation of the Coast Guard.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Balilo nga si Anderson padayon nga nagabulig sa mga Aetas sa Zambales, sa mga pamilya nga apektado sa Marawi, kag bisan nag-donate sang medical supplies kag tents sa kasagsagan sang COVID-19 pandemic.
english: Balilo also said Anderson continues to help the Aetas in Zambales, the families affected in Marawi, and even donated medical supplies and tents during the height of the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Lauman ang magal-umon nga tyempo nga may lapta-lapta nga pag-ulan kag isolated thunderstorms sa Visayas bangud sa epekto sang shearline.
english: Cloudy weather with patchy rain and isolated thunderstorms is expected in the Visayas due to the effect of the shearline.

text: Amo man sini ang forecast sang Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA) para sa Catanduanes, Albay, Sorsogon, Masbate, kag Palawan.
english: The same is the forecast of the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA) for Catanduanes, Albay, Sorsogon, Masbate, and Palawan.

text: Suno pa sa state weather bureau subong nga aga, magadala naman sang pag-ulan ang northeast monsoon ukon amihan sa Cordillera Administrative Region, Cagayan Valley, Aurora, Quezon, nabilin nga bahin sang MIMAROPA, kag nabilin nga bahin sang Bicol Region.
english: According to the state weather bureau this morning, the northeast monsoon will bring rains to the Cordillera Administrative Region, Cagayan Valley, Aurora, Quezon, the rest of MIMAROPA, and the rest of the Bicol Region.

text: Magadala man ang Amihan sang magal-umon nga tyempo kag pagpanalithi sa Metro Manila kag sa nabilin nga bahin sang Luzon.
english: The North will also bring cloudy weather and thundershowers in Metro Manila and the rest of Luzon.

text: Nagpaandam ang bureau sang posible matabo nga landslides ukon flash floods bangud sang nasambit nga shearline kag amihan.
english: The bureau warned of possible landslides or flash floods due to the said shearline and north.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, maga-apekto naman ang easterlies kag magaresulta sa lapta-lapta nga pag-ulan kag thunderstorms sa Mindanao.
english: Meanwhile, easterlies will affect the area and result in scattered rains and thunderstorms in Mindanao.

text: Ginklaro sang weather bureau nga wala ini sang na-monitor nga low-pressure area ukon tropical cyclone sa guwa kag sulod sang Philippine area of responsibility as of broadcast time.
english: The weather bureau clarified that it did not monitor any low-pressure area or tropical cyclone outside or inside the Philippine area of ​​responsibility as of broadcast time.

text: “UNFRIENDLY” nga meter reading sang PECO.
english: PECO's “UNFRIENDLY” meter reading.

text: Wala gid man kami sing reklamo sa Panay Electric Company (PECO) tubtub sang sining ulihi lang.
english: We have never had any complaints with the Panay Electric Company (PECO) until recently.

text: Maasikaso man ang PECO, labi na gid sa pagpanguna ni Engr.
english: PECO will also take care of it, especially under the leadership of Engr.

text: Randy Pastolero sa amon problema sa suga diri sa amon ginapuy-an sa tupad sang Panay News Compound sa PODCO, Q. Abeto St., Mandurriao.
english: Randy Pastolero for our electricity problem here in our house next to the Panay News Compound in PODCO, Q. Abeto St., Mandurriao.

text: Isa lang ka tawag kay Engr.
english: Just one call to Engr.

text: Pastolero ara dayon ang PECO trouble shooting team.
english: Pastolero immediately the PECO trouble shooting team.

text: Tungod sini, natun-an na namon nga kilalahon siya nga isa ka suod nga abyan nga masaligan sa pagbulig sa amon problema sa kuryente diri.
english: Because of this, we have learned to recognize him as a close friend who can be trusted to help us with our electricity problem here.

text: Wala man kami sing reklamo sa amon meter reading tubtub sa sining ulihi lang, kay ang pagbalyar sang reading indi gid man daku, kag kon nagasaka nagapanaug man.
english: We also had no complaints about our meter reading until recently, as the fluctuation of the reading was negligible, and when it went up it went down.

text: Sining ulihi ugaling, sobra-sobra na gid ang pagsaka sang amon PECO bill.
english: Lately, however, our PECO bill has been going up too much.

text: Indi na “friendly”!
english: Not “friendly” anymore!

text: Ang ulihi namon nga monthly bill, nga due date sa Hulyo 2, 2018 naglab-ut sa P2,555.63.
english: Our last monthly bill, due on July 2, 2018 amounted to P2,555.63.

text: Na-shock kami sini, kay samtang halos amo-amo man pirme ang amon konsumo sa kuryente ining monthly bill nagpasaka sang amon balayran sa P1,285.73 base sa nagligad nga bulan namon nga bill nga P1,269.90!
english: We were shocked by this, because while our electricity consumption was almost the same, this monthly bill increased our bill to P1,285.73 based on our previous month's bill of P1,269.90!

text: Ang ining  saka sang amon bill (P1,285.73) sobra ini sa isa ka bulan namon nga bill (P1,269.90) sang nagligad nga billing notice.
english: This increase in our bill (P1,285.73) is more than our one-month bill (P1,269.90) from the previous billing notice.

text: Imposible!
english: Impossible!

text: Bayaran namon ining ulihi nga bill (P2,555.63), apang UNDER PROTEST!
english: We will pay this late bill (P2,555.63), but UNDER PROTEST!

text: Kag ma-file na kami sang formal nga reklamo sa PECO.
english: And we will file a formal complaint with PECO.

text:
***

Sa aton panahon karon nga madamo sang aton mga pulitiko ang may “mistress” ukon kerida, isa ka talagsahon nga kaisug matuod ang panindugan ni PRO-6 police director Chief Superintendent John Bulalacao batok sa pagpangerida sang mga pulis.
english:
***

In our time when many of our politicians have mistresses, PRO-6 police director Chief Superintendent John Bulalacao's stand against police harassment is a rare courage.

text: Ining panindugan ni PRO-6 tsip iya ginpabutyag sa pahayagan sang Panay News sa pahina 4 sang isyu sini sadtong Hunyo 16, 2018.
english: This position of PRO-6 chief was expressed in the newspaper Panay News on page 4 of its issue on June 16, 2018.

text: Sunu sa iya, samtang  “private matter” ini sang mga pulis, ini nagapakamalain sang imahen sang kapulisan sa kabug-usan.
english: He said that while this is a “private matter” of the police, it tarnishes the image of the police as a whole.

text: Ginapadumdum pa gani niya sila sang “ethical standards” para sa mga pulis.
english: He even reminds them of the “ethical standards” for police officers.

text:
Ining ethical standards, siling niya, gasakop sang “morality, judicious use of authority, justice, humility, orderliness, and perseverance.”

“Actually,” sunu gani sa iya, “meron din silang magiging kasalanan sa ating batas at sa Diyos.
english:
These ethical standards, he said, cover “morality, judicious use of authority, justice, humility, orderliness, and perseverance.”

“Actually,” he said, “they will also be guilty of sin against our law and against God.

text:
I do not encourage them to have extra marital affairs dahil hindi maganda sa imahe nga atong PNP.”

In fact, samtang wala man niya ginhinambit ini, ang ining “extra-marital affair” sang mga pulis dapat galakip man sang mga kababainhan sa kapulisan.
english:
I do not encourage them to have extra marital affairs because it is not good for the image of our PNP.”

In fact, while he did not mention it, this “extra-marital affair” of the police should also include women in the police.

text: Ina tungod indi lang ang mga may asawa nga pulis ang nagapangerida; ang pulis nga babaye puede man nga magpangerido.
english: That's because it's not just married police officers who are injured; the policewoman can also get hurt.

text: Isa ka balita diri mismo sa rehiyon sadtong nagligad nga pila ka bulan nagpahayag sang kaso sang isa ka pulis nga babaye nga gin-akusar sang iya bana nga OFW sa iya pagpangerido sa kapareho nga pulis nga may asawa man gani.
english: A news report here in the region a few months ago revealed the case of a policewoman who was accused by her OFW husband of injuring a fellow policeman who was also married.

text: Talagsahon ini nga kaisug matuod ang ining panindugan ni Chief Supt.
english: This is a rare courage. This stand of Chief Supt.

text: Bulalacao batok sa pagpangerida sang mga pulis.
english: Bulalacao against police injuries.

text: Ina tungod posible nga indi mauyunan ini sang mga mas mataas pa sa iya sa gobyerno, nga may mga kabit (kerida ukon kerido).
english: That's because it's likely to be disapproved of by those higher up in government, who have mistresses (kerida or kerido).

text: Ang pila sa ila gani ginapabugal pa nila sa pagpahayag sa publiko nga may kerida sila.
english: Some of them even take pride in publicly announcing that they have a girlfriend.

text: Tungod sini, posible nga hingabuton siya sining mas dalagku nga mga pinuno sa gobyerno kag basi itapok siya sa malayo nga lugar sa Pilipinas sa diin indi siya mabatian kag mabusalan ang iya baba nga indi makapalapnag sining iya panindugan.
english: Because of this, he may be persecuted by these higher government officials and may be thrown into a remote area of ​​the Philippines where he will not be heard and his mouth will be shut so that he cannot spread his position.

text: Basi masaklaw sila sa sining iya panindugan, luas lang kon kabalan kag madamol sila sang guya ng indi magpa-apekto sa kon ano man nga pagpakamalain sa ila.
english: They might be offended by his position, unless they are stupid and thick-faced and will not be affected by any criticism of them.

text: Kon indi gani sila (ining mas dalagku sa gobyerno) magpa-apekto, sin-o ayhan sa mga tinawo ni Tsip Bulalacao ang magasunod sa iya pangabay nga likawan ang pag-pangerida?
english: If they (these higher-ups in government) don't care, who among Tsip Bulalacao's men will follow his request to avoid injury?

text: Daw wala seguro.
english: I don't think so.

text: “Gapangerida gani ang mga pinaka- boss, kami pa?” ang laban-laban  masiling nila sa sining pangabay ni Tsip Bulalacao.
english: “Even the bosses are injured, what about us?” the most they can say about this request of Tsip Bulalacao.

text: Itugyan na gid lang naton seguro ining problema sa ginluiban nga asawa ukon bana.
english: We should probably leave the problem to the betrayed spouse.

text: Tsip, diri ka na lang seguro tutok sa pagpatuman sang kasuguan sa human rights kag due process nga gina-reklamo batok sa mga pulis, indi lang diri sa pungsod kundi bisan pa sa iban nga pungsod kag bisan sa United Nations.
english: Chip, you should probably focus on enforcing human rights and due process complaints against police officers, not only here in the country but also in other countries and even in the United Nations.

text: Naga-yellow bala ang imo nga supat kag nagasakit ang imo tyan kag lawas?
english: Does your stool turn yellow and does your stomach and body hurt?

text: Mahimo nga sintomas na ina sang Hepatitis A, nga isa ka balatian sa atay nga madasig maglaton sa tawo.
english: It may be a symptom of Hepatitis A, a highly contagious liver disease.

text:
Suno kay Dr. Bernadette Seludo, infectious disease specialist, makuha ang Hepatitis A kun nakaptan, nainom ukon nakaon ang isa ka butang nga kontaminado sang feces ukon higko nga may yara sang Hepatitis A.

Paathag ni Seludo, ang mayor nga kabangdanan sang Hepatitis A amo ang higko sang isa ka indibidwal nga mahimo maglapta kun indi ini maghugas sang iya kamot.
english:
According to Dr. Bernadette Seludo, infectious disease specialist, said you can get Hepatitis A if you touch, drink or eat something contaminated with feces or dirt that contains Hepatitis A.

Seludo explained that the main cause of Hepatitis A is the feces of an individual that can spread if he does not wash his hands.

text: Masami nga makuha ang ini nga balatian kun mahilig ang isa ka tawo magkaon sang street food nga yara sa karsada bangud mas madasig ini makaangkon sang virus.
english: This disease is often caught when a person likes to eat street food on the street because it is more likely to catch the virus.

text: Halimbawa amo ang isaw sang manok sa diin may yara sang kahigayunan nga nagatingob ang higko sang manok sa sulod sini.
english: Example is chicken sausage where there is a chance of chicken poop clumping together inside it.

text: Pila lamang sa sintomas sang Hepatitis A amo ang pag-angkon sang sakit, nagasuka, nagakakapoy, nagasakit ang tyan, wala gina ganahan sa pagkaon, naga duag yellow ang mata kag supat kag tuman nga pagkatol sa lawas.
english: Some of the symptoms of Hepatitis A are fever, vomiting, fatigue, abdominal pain, loss of appetite, yellow eyes and rash and severe itching.

text: Mahimo man ini makuha sa pakikipag-sex kag mahimo pa nga ikonsidera nga sexually transmitted disease.
english: It can also be transmitted through sexual intercourse and can even be considered a sexually transmitted disease.

text: Malikawan man dugang pa ni Seludo ang nasambit nga balatian kun regular nga nagahugas sang kamot kag nagahalong sa pagluto ukon pag pili sang pagkaon.
english: Seludo added that the disease can be prevented by washing hands regularly and being careful when cooking or choosing food.

text: Panugyan sang eksperto, kun mabatyagan ang mga sintomas sang Hepatitis A, gilayon nga magpakonsulta sa doktor.
english: Experts advise that if you experience symptoms of Hepatitis A, consult a doctor immediately.

text: Nagpaguwa ang Social Security System (SSS) sang 13th month kag December pensions nga nagabalor sang PHP32.19 billion sa masobra 3.6 million ka mga pensyonado.
english: The Social Security System (SSS) released 13th month and December pensions worth PHP32.19 billion to more than 3.6 million pensioners.

text: Suno kay SSS officer in charge Voltaire Agas, ang una nga batch ginpanagtag sa 2.09 million ka mga pensionado sang Nobyembre 29, nga nagabalor sang PHP17.9 billion, nga nagasakop sa mga pensyonado nga may mga dates of contingency sa sulod sang una tubtob ika-15 nga adlaw sang bulan.
english: According to SSS officer in charge Voltaire Agas, the first batch was distributed to 2.09 million pensioners on November 29, worth PHP17.9 billion, covering pensioners with dates of contingency during the first to 15th day of the month.

text: Ang ikaduha nga batch, nga nagalab-ot sa PHP14.3 billion, ginpaguwa sang Disyembre 4, nga nakabenepisyo sa 1.52 million ka mga pensyonado.
english: The second batch, amounting to PHP14.3 billion, was released on December 4, benefiting 1.52 million pensioners.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang SSS nagpaguwa man sang mga PHP41.6 million nga balor sang 13th month kag December pensions sa masobra 6,000 ka mga pensyonado paagi sa mga bangko kag tseke nga wala nagapasakop sa PESONet.
english: It is known that the SSS also released about PHP41.6 million worth of 13th month and December pensions to more than 6,000 pensioners through banks and checks that do not participate in PESONet.

text: Sa edad kun sa diin kadam-an sa mga babaye ang masako na sa paghampang sa ila mga apo, may Indian nga babaye nga 70 anyos na ang edad apang nakabun-ag pa sa iya pinakauna nga anak.
english: At an age when most women are busy playing with their grandchildren, there is an Indian woman who is 70 years old but has yet to give birth to her first child.

text: Si Jivuben Valabhai Rabari kag ang iya nga bana ang madugay na nga nagatinguha nga magbusong apang sa sulod sang 45 ka-tuig nga pag-updanay, napaslawan ang mga ini nga magka-anak.
english: Jivuben Valabhai Rabari and her husband had been trying to conceive for a long time but during their 45-year marriage, they failed to have children.

text: Bangud sa handum sang babaye nga makabun-ag, nagpa-idalom ini sa in vitro fertilization (IVF) treatment.
english: Due to the woman's desire to have children, she underwent in vitro fertilization (IVF) treatment.

text: Suno kay Dr. Naresh Bhanushali, 20 ka-tuig na siya nga naga-conduct sang linibo nga IVF treatment kag wala pa siya sang may nakit-an nga pinasahi nga kaso sa diin makabig niya nga milagro ang madinalag-on nga pagbusong kag pagbun-ag sang tigulang.
english: According to Dr. Naresh Bhanushali, he has been conducting thousands of IVF treatments for 20 years and has not seen any special case where he can consider the successful pregnancy and birth of an elderly woman as a miracle.

text: Dugang pa sang doktor, ginkalipay nila nga successful ang nangin pagbun-ag sang 70 anyos apang ginahingyo nila sa gihapon ang pumuluyo nga indi mag-attempt sa pagbun-ag kun tigulang na bangud dako ini sa gihapon nga risgo sa ikaayong lawas.
english: The doctor added that they are happy that the 70-year-old was successful in giving birth but they still urge the public not to attempt to give birth when they are old because it is still a big risk to health.

text: INDI na gid mapunggan ang pag-antos sang aton mga pumuluyo sa padayon nga pagsaka sang mga tig-una naton nga kinahanglanon.
english: THE suffering of our people is unbearable with the continuous rise in our basic needs.

text: Siling gani sang Bangko Sentral sang Pilipinas (BSP) ang   pagsaka sang bili sang balaklon – “inflation” kon tawgon sang mga ekonomista – magapadayon pa tubtub sa katapusan sining tuig 2018.
english: The Central Bank of the Philippines (BSP) says the rise in commodity prices – “inflation” as economists call it – will continue until the end of 2018.

text: Maayo lang kay nakahingagaw ang pag-abot sang sini lang sang barato nga NFA rice – P27-P32 kontra sa sobra P40 kada kilo nga commercial rice – sa aton mga 10 ka milyon nga pumuluyo nga nagabakal sang NFA rice.
english: Fortunately, the recent arrival of cheap NFA rice – P27-P32 against more than P40 per kilo of commercial rice – has brought relief to our 10 million people who buy NFA rice.

text: Bisan pa sina, ang iban nga kinahanglanon naton sige gihapon ang ila pagmahal – de lata, isda, karne, baboy, manok kag iban pa – tungod sa madamo nga rason lokal kag internasyonal, lakip na ang pagdugang sang buhis sa petrolyo kag iban pa sa idalom sang TRAIN Law.
english: However, some of our necessities continue to become more expensive – canned goods, fish, meat, pork, poultry and others – for many reasons locally and internationally, including the increase in taxes on petroleum and others under the TRAIN Law.

text: Ang TRAIN Law nagatumod sa Tax Reform for Acceleration and Inclusion Law, nga gindihon sang gobyerno agud makakita sang mga P90 ka bilyon para sa madamo nga proyekto kag programa para sa mga pumuluyo.
english: The TRAIN Law refers to the Tax Reform for Acceleration and Inclusion Law, which the government enacted to raise about P90 billion for many projects and programs for the people.

text: Ugaling lang kay, samtang pensar sang gobyerno indi man gid makahalalit ang matuga nga “inflation”, ang natabo amo nga naglapaw na ini sa wala nila gina-expectar.
english: However, while the government thought that inflation would not be harmful, what happened was that it exceeded their expectations.

text: Amo gani nga na-obligar na ang gobyernong Duterte nga pasugtan ang pagpasaka sang sueldo sang mga minimum wage earners sa pribado nga mga negosyo, nga nagpa-angal sa aton mga negosyante.
english: That's why the Duterte government is obliged to allow the salary increase of minimum wage earners in private businesses, which has made our businessmen complain.

text: Ginpasugtan man ang pagpasaka sang pletahan sang pila ka bus sa Metro Manila, kag naga-petisyon man gani ang iban nga grupo sa transportasyon agud pasakaan ang ila pamasahe.
english: Some buses in Metro Manila have also been approved to increase their fares, and some transportation groups are even petitioning to increase their fares.

text: May gina-proponer man nga “subsidy”, ukon bulig pinansyal, sa iban nga grupo sa transportasyon.
english: Subsidies, or financial assistance, are also being proposed for other transportation groups.

text: Sige man ang petisyon sang mga manunudo nga pasakaon ang ila sueldo.
english: Teachers also keep petitioning for a salary increase.

text: Medyo mas madalum-dalom seguro ang problema sang mga pumuluyo sa informal sector nga wala sing regular nga trabaho kag sueldo.
english: The problem of the people in the informal sector who do not have regular jobs and salaries is probably a little deeper.

text: Katulad sang mga minilyon nga sidewalk vendors, pedicab drivers, ang magagmay nga mga mangunguma kag mangingisda, mga magagmay nga mga negosyo, kag ang mga self-employed.
english: Like the millions of sidewalk vendors, pedicab drivers, small farmers and fishermen, small businesses, and the self-employed.

text: Wala sila regular nga sueldo agud puede man mapasakaan sang gobyerno, ti maano na lang sila sini?
english: They don't have a regular salary so the government can raise them, so what about them?

text: Ang isa ka medyos da amo nga kitaon nila ang ila kakulangan paagi sa pagpataas sang ila ginabaligya nga produkto kag serbisyo.
english: One way is to make up for their shortfall by increasing the number of products and services they sell.

text: Ti, dugang pa ini sa “inflation”.
english: Well, it’s in addition to “inflation”.

text: Ano na lang ang mahimo sang gobyerno sini?
english: What can the government do about it?

text: Indi ini sugot nga suspendihon ang TRAIN Law, gani ginahimulatan gid sini nga makakita sang iban nga mga solusyon.
english: It does not agree to suspend the TRAIN Law, so it is eager to find other solutions.

text: Katulad sag pagpursige sa pagbantay sa mga hoarders kag profiteers sang mga produkto nga gapataas sang bili sang mga balaklon.
english: Like the pursuit of watching out for hoarders and profiteers of products that increase the price of goods.

text: Ginadumilian man sang gobyerno ang pagpasaka sang bili sang petrolyo nga madugay na nabakal sing barato kag abanse sang mga nagabaligya sini.
english: The government also prohibits raising the price of petroleum that has long been bought cheaply and in advance by its sellers.

text: Sang sini lang gani, nag-import man kita sang kalamay agud mapunggan ang pagtaas sang bili sining produkto nga kinahanglan sang madamo sa aton adlaw-adlaw nga pag-inom sang kape.
english: Recently, we have also imported sugarcane to curb the increase in the price of this product that many need in our daily coffee drinking.

text: Samtang, sige man ang padihot sang BSP agud mapahagan-hagan ang pagsaka sang bili sang mga balaklon nga mahimo sini sa idalom sang iya poder kag capacidad.
english: Meanwhile, the BSP continues to try to mitigate the rise in the price of goods that it can do under its power and capacity.

text: Katulad sang pagpataas sang interes sa pautang agud matapna ang sige pangutang sang mga investors.
english: Such as raising interest rates on loans to prevent investors from borrowing.

text: Pagpasaka man sang interes sang security stocks kag bonds sang gobyerno agud magdahog ang baklanay sini kag ma-ibanan ang nagalagaw nga kwarta.
english: Also raising the interest rate on government security stocks and bonds to increase their sales and reduce the circulation of money.

text: Kasubong man ang pagpasaka sang reserba nga kwarta sang mga bangko agud ibanan ang kwarta nila nga ipautang.
english: Similarly, banks are raising their reserves to reduce the amount of money they have to lend.

text: Meantime, good luck na lang sa aton tanan samtang ginaatubang ta ang ining problema sa “inflation”.
english: Meantime, good luck to all of us as we face this inflation problem.

text: Makatol, masapnot kag nagapalamula ang panguna nga senyales sang sakit sa supat nga ang tawag amo ang eczema.
english: Itching, itching and redness are the main symptoms of eczema.

text: Suno kay Dr. Liza Ramoso-Ong,  isa ka internist kag espesiyalista sa sakit sa supat, madasig nga nagakapilas kag nagapula ang palibot sang nagabukol-bukol nga rashes ang ginatunaan sang balatian nga eczema.
english: According to Dr. Liza Ramoso-Ong, an internist and specialist in skin diseases, said eczema is caused by rapidly scaling and redness around the blisters.

text: Sa masami mga kabataan ang nagakaangkon sang nasambit nga balatian apang indi ini makalalaton.
english: Usually children get the disease but it is not contagious.

text: May yara naman sang tatlo ka sahi sang eczema.
english: There are also three types of eczema.

text: Ini amo ang atopic, infantile kag dermatitis.
english: These are atopic, infantile and dermatitis.

text: Panugyan sang eksperto, indi nagakadapat nga kaluton ang supat bangud mahimo ini nga maimpeksyon kag mas maglala pa ang pagkatol sini nga mahimo makabatyag sang pagkahapdi kag makaangkon sang pilas.
english: Experts advise that the tick should not be bitten because it can become infected and make the itch worse, which can cause pain and injury.

text: Kinahanglan man nga likawan ang paggamit sang habon ukon cream ilabi na kun nagakapilasan na ang supat.
english: It is also important to avoid using soap or cream especially if the skin is already injured.

text: Ipakonsulta na gilayon sa dermatologist ukon espesyalista sa supat agud mahatagan sang nagakaigo ng pagbulong.
english: Consult a dermatologist or skin specialist immediately for proper treatment.

text: Nagtapos sa ikaanom nga pwesto sa finals sang women’s 50m backstroke – S5 event sang 2024 Paris Paralympics ang Pinay para swimmer nga si Angel Otom.
english: Filipino para swimmer Angel Otom finished sixth in the finals of the women’s 50m backstroke – S5 event of the 2024 Paris Paralympics.

text: Nakarecord si Otom sang 44.00 seconds agud magpang-anom sa walo ka finalists kun sa diin nakuha sang China ang top three spots.
english: Otom recorded 44.00 seconds to finish sixth among the eight finalists with China taking the top three spots.

text: Nagdaug sang gold si world kag Paralympic record holder Lu Dong nga may 37.51 seconds, silver medalist si He Shenggao nga may 39.93 seconds kag bronze medalist si Liu Yu nga may 42.37 seconds.
english: World and Paralympic record holder Lu Dong won gold with 37.51 seconds, silver medalist He Shenggao with 39.93 seconds and bronze medalist Liu Yu with 42.37 seconds.

text: Natalana naman nga mag-compete si Otom sa women’s 50m butterfly – S5 event sa Biyernes.
english: Otom is scheduled to compete in the women’s 50m butterfly – S5 event on Friday.

text: Ginpalab-ot ni Pope Leo XIV kay Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy nga handa ang Vatican nga magpatunga kag mag-host sang peace talks sa tunga sang Russia kag Ukraine.
english: Pope Leo XIV conveyed to Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy that the Vatican is ready to mediate and host peace talks between Russia and Ukraine.

text: Ginpaambit niya ini sang nagkitaay sila sang Ukrainian leader sa ikaduha na nga tion sa sulod sang duha ka bulan sang iya pagpungko bilang Santo Papa.
english: He shared this when he met with the Ukrainian leader for the second time in two months of his tenure as Pope.

text: Sa statement sang Vatican, ginsiling nga nag-istoryahanay sanday Zelensky kag Pope Leo sa Castel Gandolfo ukon sa lugar kun sa diin nagabakasyon subong ang Holy Father.
english: In a statement, the Vatican said Zelensky and Pope Leo met at Castel Gandolfo or the area where the Holy Father is currently on vacation.

text: Didto naman si Zelensky sa Italya agud magtambong sa conference halin Hulyo 10-11 nga ginalauman nga magtutok sa pagbangon kag long-term reconstruction sang Ukraine kasunod sang invasion nga ginmandu ni Russian President Vladimir Putin.
english: Zelensky is in Italy to attend a conference from July 10-11 that is expected to focus on Ukraine's recovery and long-term reconstruction following the invasion ordered by Russian President Vladimir Putin.

text: Una nagkitaay sanday Pope kag Zelensky sa Vatican sang Mayo 18.
english: The Pope and Zelensky first met at the Vatican on May 18.

text: Naka-istoryahanay man si Pope Leo kag si Putin sa telepono sang Hunyo 4 kun sa diin gin-engganyo sini ang Russian leader nga tapuson na ang tatlo ka tuig nga gyera.
english: Pope Leo also had a telephone conversation with Putin on June 4 where he urged the Russian leader to end the three-year war.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag sang Russian officials nga indi seryoso nga venue ang Vatican para sa peace talks bangud ang Holy See ang ginapalibutan sang Italya, isa ka myembro sang NATO nga nagasuporta sa Ukraine.
english: Russian officials have previously said the Vatican is not a serious venue for peace talks because the Holy See is surrounded by Italy, a NATO member that supports Ukraine.

text: Ginpagwa na ang panibag-o nga mixed oil price movement subong nga semana.
english: The new mixed oil price movement was released this week.

text: Ini ang base sa international trading sa apat ka sunod-sunod nga adlaw.
english: This is based on international trading for four consecutive days.

text:
Ang price adjustments amo ang mga masunod:

Gasoline   – magasaka sang  P0.40 per liter
Diesel     – maganubo sang  P0.50 per liter
Kerosene   – maganubo sang  P0.75 pr liter

Suno kay Department of Energy-Oil Industry Management Bureau Assistant Director Rodela Romero, ang pagsaka sa presyo sang Gasolina ang naangot sa geopolitical climate sa Middle East kag atrasado nga output hikes sa Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries.
english:
The price adjustments are as follows:

Gasoline – to rise by P0.40 per liter
Diesel – to drop by P0.50 per liter
Kerosene – to drop by P0.75 per liter

According to Department of Energy-Oil Industry Management Bureau Assistant Director Rodela Romero, the increase in gasoline prices is linked to the geopolitical climate in the Middle East and delayed output hikes in the Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries.

text: Samtang ang rollback sa Diesel kag Kerosene ang bangud sa demand outlook para sa 2025 partikular sa top importer nga China, kag ang pagbaskog sang US dollar.
english: Meanwhile, the rollback in Diesel and Kerosene is due to the demand outlook for 2025 particularly in top importer China, and the strengthening of the US dollar.

text: Madamo nga tawo ang naga-eksperyensya sang paka-kalbo.
english: Many people experience baldness.

text: Isa ang pattern hair loss ukon ang ginatawag nga androgenetic alopecia sa kilala nga sahi sang pagka-upos sang buhok.
english: Pattern hair loss or the so-called androgenetic alopecia is one of the well-known types of hair loss.

text: Suno kay Dr. Claudine Yap-Silva, isa ka dermatolist, genetic ang pag-angkon sang nasambit nga kondisyon.
english: According to Dr. Claudine Yap-Silva, a dermatolist, said the condition is genetic.

text: Posible man nga malikawan ang pagka-upos sang buhok bangud sa androgenetic alopecia kun gilayon nga magpakonsulta sa doktor, ilabi na ang mga yara sa edad 30 tubtob 40.
english: It is also possible to prevent hair loss due to androgenetic alopecia if you consult a doctor immediately, especially those in their 30s to 40s.

text: Dugang pa ni Silva, may ginahatag nga bulong ang mga doktor para sa mga naga-eksperyensya sang pattern hair loss.
english: Silva added that doctors provide medication for those experiencing pattern hair loss.

text: Kun severe ukon malala naman ang kondisyon ang mahimo nga magpaidalom ang pasyente sa hair transplant.
english: If the condition is severe, the patient may undergo a hair transplant.

text: Panugyan sang eksperto, indi paglikawan ang paggamit sang shampoo bangud nagatuga pa ini sang pagka-upos snag buhok.
english: Experts advise not to avoid using shampoo because it causes hair loss.

Nag-proponer si Konsehal Lyndon Acap sadtong nagligad nga sesyon sang Konseho nga ibalik sa “city roads” ang mga ”national roads” nga ginpa-pasaran hagna ni Kongresista Jerry P. Treñas sa Kongreso nga nangin kasuguan na.
english:
***

Councilor Lyndon Acap proposed during the last session of the Council to return to “city roads” the “national roads” that Congressman Jerry P. Treñas passed a bill in Congress that became law.

text: Tungod sang daku nga kaayuhan nga igadulot sa siyudad sining hagna ni Treñas gin-updan gani ini sing lubos sang Konseho sa isa ka resolusyon.
english: Because of the great benefits that Treñas' bill will bring to the city, the Council fully supported it in a resolution.

text: For one, wala gasto ang siyudad sa pagpa-ubra sining mga dalanon.
english: For one, the city does not spend money to build these roads.

text: Wala makaboto ugaling si Acap sa sining resolusyon tungod napierde ini sa 2016 nga eleksyon kag nakabalik lang sang sini lang tungod sang pagsaka sa pwesto ni anay Vice Mayor Joe III Espinosa sa pagka-mayor kag ni No.
english: Acap, however, did not vote on the resolution because he lost the 2016 election and returned recently due to the ascension of former Vice Mayor Joe III Espinosa to the post of mayor and No.

text: 1 Councilor Jeffrey Ganzon sa pagka-Vice Mayor.
english: 1 Councilor Jeffrey Ganzon for Vice Mayor.

text: Apang ngaa luyag ni Acap ibalik sa “city roads” ining pila ka dalanon nga “national roads” na?
english: But why does Acap want to return some of these roads to “city roads” that are already “national roads”?

text: In fact, ginpakalain pa ini ni Acap.
english: In fact, Acap even criticized it.

text: Ina tungod gapati siya nga indi na makabyahe ang mga for-hire nga mga tricyle kag trisikad (pedicab) sa sining mga “national roads”.
english: That's because he believes that for-hire tricycles and pedicabs can no longer travel on these national roads.

text: Indi ayhan nagsayop lang si Acap sa iya paghangop sang kasuguan parti sini?
english: Could it be that Acap just misunderstood the law in this regard?

text: Sunu sa DILG Memorandum Circular No.
english: According to DILG Memorandum Circular No.

text: 2007-01 nga suportado naman sang Department of Transportation and Communication (DOTC), ang for-hire nga tricycle kag trisikad puede makabyahe sa pila ka “national roads” kon indi man lang sila makasabad kag makadulot sing disgrasya diri.
english: 2007-01, which is supported by the Department of Transportation and Communication (DOTC), for-hire tricycles and tricycles can travel on certain national roads if they do not interfere and cause accidents.

text: Siling gani sang MC No.
english: According to MC No.

text:
2007-01, sa iningles: “For safety reasons, no tricycle or pedicab should operate on national highways utilized by 4-wheel vehicles greater than 4 tons (lakip ang jeepney) and where normal speed exceeds 40 kilometers per hour.”

In other words, sa akon personal nga paghangop sini, puede ang Konseho makapasar sang ordinansa nga naga-regulate sang pagbiyahe sang tricycle kag trisikad sa mga “national roads” for as long nga indi sila mag-kumpetensya sa madasig nga mga salakyan nga nagadalagan sing sobra sa 40 kph.
english:
2007-01, in English: “For safety reasons, no tricycle or pedicab should operate on national highways utilized by 4-wheel vehicles greater than 4 tons (including jeepney) and where normal speed exceeds 40 kilometers per hour.”

In other words, in my personal understanding, the Council can pass an ordinance regulating the travel of tricycles and trisikads on national roads as long as they do not compete with fast vehicles running more than 40 kph.

text: Sa nahibal-an man naton, ang lokal nga gobyerno may poder sa idalom sang Local Government Code sa paghatag sing frankisa sa ila.
english: As we also know, the local government has the power under the Local Government Code to grant franchise to them.

text: Sa siyudad karon may ordinansa nga kon tawgon Speed Limit Ordinance, nga naga-regulate sang kadasigon sang pagbiyahe sang mga salakyan sa mga masako nga dalanon, katulad sang Diversion Road kag iban nga mayor nga dalanon sang siyudad.
english: The city now has an ordinance called the Speed ​​Limit Ordinance, which regulates the speed of vehicles on busy roads, such as Diversion Road and other major roads in the city.

text: Kalaban sa sining nahingadlan nga mga dalanon ang speed limit indi maglapaw sa 40 kph.
english: Along these named roads the speed limit will not exceed 40 kph.

text: Siyempre ang wala mahingadlan amo ang mga dalanon nga wala sing problema sa kadasigon nga pagpadalagan.
english: Of course what isn’t named are roads that don’t have a speeding problem.

text: Kon may problema dira, tani nadala man sila sa mga dalanon nga ginbutangan speed limit, indi bala?
english: If there was a problem there, they would have been caught on the roads with speed limits, right?

text: Sa mga dalanon nga nahingadlan sa Speed Limit Ordinance, wala dira bisan isa sang mga dalanon nga ginpa-converter ni Trenas halin sa “city roads” pakadto sa “national roads”.
english: Of the roads named in the Speed ​​Limit Ordinance, none of the roads that Trenas converted from “city roads” to “national roads”.

text: In other words, ining mga “national roads” wala sing problema sa kadasigon nga sobra sa 40 kph sa diin ginapa-ban sang DILG MC No.
english: In other words, these “national roads” have no problem with speeds exceeding 40 kph where DILG MC No.

text: 2007-01 ang pagbiyahe sang for-hire nga tricycles kag pedicabs.
english: 2007-01 the travel of for-hire tricycles and pedicabs.

text: Wala kita nagasiling nga sayop si Acap sa iya paghangop angot sa sining “national roads”.
english: We are not saying that Acap is wrong in his understanding of these “national roads”.

text: Ang masiling ko lang nga daw husto man ako seguro sa akon paghangop sang DILG MC No.
english: I can only say that I am probably right in my understanding of DILG MC No.

text: 2007-01 nga dapat wala sing problema ining mga “national roads” para sa mga for-hire nga tricycle kag trisikad.
english: 2007-01 that these national roads should be free of problems for for-hire tricycles and tricycles.

text: ILOILO CITY- Pabor ang duha ka mga Ilonggo nga mamalidha sa ginaduso nga postponement sang Barangay kag Sangguniang Kabataan elections nga natalana kuntani sa palaabuton nga Disyembre.
english: ILOILO CITY – Two Ilonggo lawmakers are in favor of the proposed postponement of the Barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan elections scheduled for December.

text: Ini amo sanday Iloilo 2nd District Representative Michael “Mike” Gorriceta kag 5th District Representatives Raul “Buboy” Tupas.
english: They are Iloilo 2nd District Representative Michael “Mike” Gorriceta and 5th District Representatives Raul “Buboy” Tupas.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Representative Michael Gorriceta, iya ginpahayag nga tama na ka ubol sang tiempo agud preparahan ang nasambit nga eleksyon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Representative Michael Gorriceta said there is enough time to prepare for the election.

text: Suno kay Gorriceta, kun dayunon ang eleksyon, mangin kabangdanan inio sang pagbinahin-bahinay sang mga pumuluyo sa barangay gani mas maayo nga magtutok anay sa pag-atubang sa mga problema sang mga pumuluyo sa baylo sang politika.
english: According to Gorriceta, if the election is held, it will cause division among the people in the barangay so it is better to focus on facing the problems of the people instead of politics.

text: Suno naman kay Rep.
english: According to Rep.

text: Raul Buboy Tupas, ginapanan-aw niya nga mas paborable kun wala anay sang eleksyon agud indi ma-hamper ang continuity sang delivery sang social services.
english: Raul Buboy Tupas, he believes that it would be more favorable if there were no elections so as not to hamper the continuity of the delivery of social services.

text: Pahayag niya, ang P8.6 billion nga budget para sa amo nga eleksyon ang mahimo nga gamiton nalang sa pagbulig sa kinahanglanon sang mga pumuluyo sa tunga sang pandemya kag krisis nga ginapangatubang sang pungsod.
english: He said the P8.6 billion budget for the election can only be used to help the needs of the people amid the pandemic and crisis facing the country.

text: NANGIN masupog si Presidente Rodrigo Duterte sa pagpatuman sang iya mga pangako nga away sa droga, krimen kag korapsyon, notwithstanding sang madamo nga pagpakamalaut sa iya.
english: PRESIDENT Rodrigo Duterte has been reluctant to implement his promises to fight drugs, crime and corruption, notwithstanding the many criticisms of him.

text: Gintawag siya nga diktador, kriminal sa iya mapintas nga pagpakig-away sa droga kag kriminalidad sa sosyedad, kag bastos sa iya masami nga pagpamuyayaw sang “Put…ina mo!” nga nagapakanubo sa mga babaye.
english: He was called a dictator, a criminal for his brutal war on drugs and social crime, and rude for his frequent chants of “Put…ina mo!” that demeans women.

text: Wala siya ugaling nagsapak sining pagpakalain sa iya kag nagbalik-pakalain pa gani sa pila ka opisyal kag grupo sang iban nga pungsod, kag bisan sa United Nations, labi na gid sa isyu sang human rights kag due process of law.
english: He, however, ignored this criticism and even repeatedly criticized some foreign officials and groups, and even the United Nations, especially on the issue of human rights and due process of law.

text: Bisan pa sina, wala gihapon malingkang ang pagsalig sang mga pumuluyo sa iya paagi sa padayon nga paghatag sa iya sang mataas nga grado sa pulso sang banwa.
english: Despite that, the people's confidence in him has not wavered by continuing to give him a high grade on the pulse of the town.

text: Nangin masupog man si Presidente sa pagpatuman sang iya mga programa para sa pangabuhian sang mga pumuluyo, labi na gid sang ginpirmahan na niya ang Tax Reform for Acceleration and Inclusion (TRAIN) Law sadtong Enero 2018.
english: The President has also been reluctant to implement his programs for the livelihood of the people, especially since he signed the Tax Reform for Acceleration and Inclusion (TRAIN) Law in January 2018.

text: Ining kasuguan nagapanubo sang personal income tax rates kag naga-exempt sa buhis sang mga may kita sang P250,000 panubo kada tuig.
english: This law lowers personal income tax rates and exempts from taxes those who earn less than P250,000 per year.

text: Matuod ginpataas man ang pila ka buhis, katulad sang excise tax sa petrolyo sang P2.50 kada litro sa diesel kag P7 kada litro sang gasolina, nga ga-apekto sa madamo, kag iban pa nga nagalab-ut sa P90 ka bilyon kada tuig.
english: It is true that some taxes have also been increased, such as the excise tax on petroleum of P2.50 per liter on diesel and P7 per liter on gasoline, which affects many, and others that reach P90 billion per year.

text: Apang ini tanan ginpatuman agud matustusan ang mga flagship program sang gobyerno sa free education tubtub sa kolehiyo, libre nga healthcare, double-pay sa mga pulis kag soldado agud mangin mas mapisan sila sa pag-away sa mga salot sa sosyedad, pagpasaka sang mga pension sang mga retirado, padayon nga pagpaluntad sang “Build.Build.
english: But all this was implemented to finance the government's flagship programs in free education to college, free healthcare, double-pay to the police and soldiers to make them more active in fighting the plagues in society, raising the pensions of retirees, continuing to implement “Build.Build.

text: Build.” nga programa sa infrastructure, kag iban pa.
english: Build.” infrastructure program, among others.

text:
***

Ugaling may problema nga nagtuhaw sa panugod gid mismo sang pag-implementar sang TRAIN Law.
english:
***

However, a problem arose at the very beginning of the implementation of the TRAIN Law.

text: Samtang ginapanan-aw  ni Budget Secretary  Benjamin Diokno nga may matabo nga “slight inflationary impact” lang sa pag-implementar sang TRAIN Law, ang natabo amo nga nagtaas sing sobra-sobra ang inflation, ukon ang pagtaas sang mga balaklon.
english: While Budget Secretary Benjamin Diokno expected a slight inflationary impact from the implementation of the TRAIN Law, what happened was that inflation, or the increase in prices of goods, increased excessively.

text: Sa lugar tani nga dapat magtaas ini sa 2018 sang mga 2.4% lang, naglab-ut na ini sa 4.6% sang Abril kag magasige pa taas ini sa 5.4% suno sa Bangk Sentral sang Pilipinas (BSP) mismo.
english: Instead of rising in 2018 by only about 2.4%, it reached 4.6% in April and will continue to rise to 5.4% according to the Central Bank of the Philippines (BSP) itself.

text: Ngaa natabo ini?
english: Why did this happen?

text: Ang pagpati sang pila ka expert sa ekonomiya amo nga “wrong timing” ang pag-implementar sang TRAIN Law.
english: Some economic experts believe that the implementation of the TRAIN Law was “wrong timing”.

text: Unfortunately, ang TRAIN Law, sunu sa ila, nagdungan sa pagtaas man sang bili sang langis sa world market nga gapataas man sang bili sang petrolyo diri sa pungsod upod sa dugang nga excise tax sa TRAIN Law.
english: Unfortunately, the TRAIN Law, they said, coincided with the increase in the price of oil in the world market which also increased the price of petroleum here in the country along with the additional excise tax in the TRAIN Law.

text: Nawad-an  man ang gobyerno sang barato nga NFA rice para sa mga 10 ka milyon ta nga mga pumuluyo sa sulod na sang anom ka bulan tubtub subong.
english: The government has also lost cheap NFA rice for about 10 million of our people for the past six months.

text: Ginpatihan nga ang pagtaas sang bili sang langis tungod ini sa pagpanubo sang supply sang Oil Producing Exporting Countries (OPEC), agud mapataas ang ila kita; ang padayon nga kinagamo sa Middle East; kag ang padayon nga inaway sa ekonomiya sang mga pungsod, labi na gid sang Estados Unidos kontra sa Tsina kag bisan pa sang iya mga kaalyado.
english: It was believed that the increase in the price of oil was due to the reduction of supply by the Oil Producing Exporting Countries (OPEC), in order to increase their revenues; the ongoing unrest in the Middle East; and the continuous economic warfare of nations, most notably the United States against China and even its allies.

text: Yara man ang paghuyang sang balor sang peso nga gin-project na sang pila ka ekonomista halin sa P49 sadtong 2017 tubtub P52 sa isa ka US dollar sa karon, nga nagpataas sang binilyon ta nga kautangan kag bili sang aton kinahanglanon nga importasyon sa pagpasanyog sang aton mga industriya.
english: There is also the weakening of the peso that some economists have projected from P49 in 2017 to P52 per US dollar today, which has increased our debt by billions and the value of our imports needed to boost our industries.

text: Tungod sini, madamo na ang mga hublag agud masalbar ang problema sang madamo.
english: Because of this, there are many movements to solve the problems of many.

text: Ang mga drayber nagapangayo na sing dugang nga plete.
english: Drivers are already asking for more fares.

text: Ang pila ka bus sa Metro Manila ginpasugtan na gani sa pagpasaka sing plete sang LTFRB.
english: Some buses in Metro Manila have even been allowed to increase fares by the LTFRB.

text: May nangayu man sing dugang nga sueldo.
english: Some also asked for more pay.

text: Bisan gani ang naga-benepisyo sa TRAIN Law nagabakho man sa pagtaas sang mga balaklon sa kabug-usan.
english: Even those who benefit from the TRAIN Law are complaining about the increase in commodities in general.

text: Tungod sini, may hingyo na sa Senado nga i-suspend anay ang TRAIN Law, ukon bisan ang excise tax lang sa petrolyo.
english: Because of this, there is a request in the Senate to suspend the TRAIN Law, or even the excise tax on petroleum.

text: Bisan si Presidente Duterte daw ma-ungo man gani kag nangayo na sang opinyon sang Kongreso kon bala i-suspend gid bala ang TRAIN Law ukon indi.
english: Even President Duterte seems to be stupid and has already asked Congress for an opinion on whether to suspend the TRAIN Law or not.
