text: Nagahimo sang mga inisyatibo ang key government agencies sa pagpabaskog sang implementasyon sang bag-o lang ginpatuman nga Anti-Agricultural Economic Sabotage (AES) Act.
english: Key government agencies are taking initiatives to strengthen the implementation of the recently enacted Anti-Agricultural Economic Sabotage (AES) Act.

text: Lakip na ang Department of Agriculture (DA), nga nagahimo subong sang Daily Price Index paagi sa regular nga pagbantay sa merkado kag presyo agud masiguro nga ang mga presyo nagapabilin sa sulod sang reasonable range.
english: That includes the Department of Agriculture (DA), which currently develops a Daily Price Index through regular market and price monitoring to ensure that prices remain within a reasonable range.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, naglunsar sang special task force ang Philippine National Police (PNP) agud pakigbatuan ang anti-agricultural smuggling activities.
english: Meanwhile, the Philippine National Police (PNP) launched a special task force to combat anti-agricultural smuggling activities.

text: Katapo sang Anti-Agricultural Economic Sabotage Council ang DA samtang kabahin sang Anti-Agricultural Economic Sabotage Enforcement Group ang PNP.
english: The DA is a member of the Anti-Agricultural Economic Sabotage Council while the PNP is part of the Anti-Agricultural Economic Sabotage Enforcement Group.

text: Ang AES Act, ukon Republic Act 12022, nagaklasipikar sang agricultural smuggling, hoarding, profiteering, kag engaging sa cartels nga ginakabig acts of economic sabotage.
english: The AES Act, or Republic Act 12022, classifies agricultural smuggling, hoarding, profiteering, and engaging in cartels as acts of economic sabotage.

text: Ang mga violators mahimo nga mapriso kag magmulta tubtob sa lima ka pilo sang balor sang mga butang nga involved.
english: Violators can be jailed and fined up to five times the value of the items involved.

text: Ang tikang ginpirmahan nga mangin kasuguan sang Septyembre.
english: The measure was signed into law in September.

text: Apektado sang nanuhay-tuhay nga weather systems ang madamo nga parte sang Pilipinas subong nga adlaw, Enero 2, nga nagdala sang mga pag-ulan-ulan kag mga pagbaha.
english: Various weather systems affected many parts of the Philippines today, January 2, bringing heavy rains and floods.

text: Suno sa Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA), may pag-ulan-ulan kag pagpanaguob sa Western Visayas amo man sa Albay, Sorsogon, Masbate, Romblon, Palawan, kag Northern Samar bangud sa shear line.
english: According to the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA), there will be rain and thundershowers in Western Visayas as well as in Albay, Sorsogon, Masbate, Romblon, Palawan, and Northern Samar due to the shear line.

text: Nagpaandam man ang state weather bureau sang posible nga flash floods ukon pagkatiphag sang duta ilabi na sa manubo nga areas kag sa nabukid man nga mga porsyon bangud sang kasarangan tubtub mamunog nga ulan.
english: The state weather bureau also warned of possible flash floods especially in low-lying areas and hilly portions due to moderate to heavy rains.

text: Sa syudad kag probinsya sang Iloilo, nag-umpisa ang mabaskog nga bubo sang ulan pasado alas tres subong nga hapon.
english: In Iloilo City and province, heavy rains began around 3 pm this afternoon.

text: Sa iban nga areas sa pungsod, nagaapekto ang easterlies amo man ang northeast monsoon ukon ang amihan.
english: In other areas of the country, the easterlies are affected as well as the northeast monsoon.

text: Ginklaro sang weather bureau nga wala ini sang na-monitor nga low-pressure area ukon tropical cyclone sa guwa kag sulod sang Philippine area of responsibility (PAR) as of posting time.
english: The weather bureau clarified that it has not monitored any low-pressure area or tropical cyclone outside or inside the Philippine area of ​​responsibility (PAR) as of posting time.

text: KARON nga nagsugot na ang Pilipinas sa pagbakal sang bugas halin sa Thailand kag Vietnam, pila ayhan ang mangin bili sining imported rice sa pagbaligya sang National Food Authority (NFA)?
english: NOW that the Philippines has agreed to buy rice from Thailand and Vietnam, how much will this imported rice cost to sell to the National Food Authority (NFA)?

text: Sadto tag-P27 ang kada kilo.
english: It used to be P27 per kilo.

text: Amo man bala ang presyo sini para sa aton mga pigado nga mga pumuluyo sa pungsod, nga nagadamo sang mga 6 tubtub 10 ka milyon?
english: Is it the same price for our poor people in the country, who number about 6 to 10 million?

text: Duha ka klase sang bugas ang nahisugtan ta nga baklon – ang bugas nga may 15 porsyento nga broken rice (bugas nga ginautod-utod sa galingan) nga bulubarato, kag ang may 25 porsyento nga broken rice, nga medyo mahal-mahal diutay.
english: We agreed to buy two types of rice – rice with 15 percent broken rice, which is cheap, and 25 percent broken rice, which is a little more expensive.

text: Ang baklon ta nga mga 250,000 ka metrica tonelda nga bugas amo ang 120,000 MT halin sa Thailand kag 130,000 MT halin sa Vietnam.
english: We will buy about 250,000 metric tons of rice, 120,000 MT from Thailand and 130,000 MT from Vietnam.

text: Government-to-government ini nga transaksyon agud mas madasig ang pagpatigayon sini agud makahingabut sa lean months sang tag-talanom sa Hunyo tubtub sa pagsugod sang tag-alani sa Setyembre.
english: This is a government-to-government transaction to speed up the process to reach the lean months of the planting season in June until the beginning of the harvest season in September.

text: Ang NFA spokesperson nga si Rez Estoperez nagsiling nga ang una ang tranche (pauna nga padala) magasugod indi maglapaw sa Mayo 31 tubtub Hunyo 15 sang sini nga tuig.
english: NFA spokesperson Rez Estoperez said the first tranche (advance shipment) will begin no later than May 31 to June 15 this year.

text: Ang mga discharge port patigayunon sa mga puerto sang Bacolod, Cebu, Iloilo, Metro Manila, Poro Point kag Tacloban.
english: The discharge ports will be located in the ports of Bacolod, Cebu, Iloilo, Metro Manila, Poro Point and Tacloban.

text: Ang Bacolod ga-expectar sa pagbaton sang inisyal nga alokasyon nga mga 80,000 ka sako (bags) halin sa Vietnam sa palaabuton nga Hunyo 10.
english: Bacolod expects to receive an initial allocation of about 80,000 bags from Vietnam on June 10.

text: Si NFA-Negros Occidental manager Frisco Canoy nagsiling nga ang iya upisina nakabaton na sang notisya halin sa NFA central office nga suguran na ang pagkarga sang bugas sa puerto sang Vietnam sa Hunyo 9.
english: NFA-Negros Occidental manager Frisco Canoy said his office has already received a notice from the NFA central office to start loading rice at the port of Vietnam on June 9.

text: Matapos ini, siling niya sa sulod sang lima ka adlaw, kag magaabot ang barko sa Bacolod sa sulod sang lima ka adlaw nga byahe.
english: It will be completed, he said, within five days, and the ship will arrive in Bacolod within a five-day voyage.

text: Sa aton pa, maabot na ang una nga tranche sang bugas sa Bacolod sa palaabuton nga Hunyo 19.
english: In other words, the first tranche of rice will arrive in Bacolod on June 19.

text: Ang ikaduha nga tranche nga 80,000 ka sako man ginapaabot nila nga magtupa sa Bacolod sa masunod nga bulan sang Hulyo.
english: The second tranche of 80,000 sacks is also expected to land in Bacolod next July.

text: Tungod sining pag-abot na sang bugas halin sa Vietnam kag Thailand, ginapaabot sang NFA nga ma-stabilize na ang presyo sang bugas sa pungsod.
english: With the arrival of rice from Vietnam and Thailand, the NFA expects the price of rice in the country to stabilize.

text: Sa karon, ang bili sang well-milled nga bugas, nga pulos commercial, sa pungsod nagalakat sa P43 tubtub P45 kada kilo.
english: Currently, the price of well-milled rice, which is all commercial, in the country is running at P43 to P45 per kilo.

text: Ang bulubarato mga P39 kada kilo.
english: The cheapest is about P39 per kilo.

text: Masakit ini para sa mga kubos ta nga mga pumuluyo nga sadto gabakal sang NFAa rice sa tag-P27 lang kada kilo.
english: This is painful for our poor people who used to buy NFAa rice at only P27 per kilo.

text: Ano ayhan ang bili sining bag-o nga importasyon sang bugas halin sa Vietnam kag Thailand?
english: What will be the cost of these new rice imports from Vietnam and Thailand?

text: Sadtong ginabaligya pa sang NFA ang iya bugas sa tag-P27 kada kilo, ginabakal naman sini sa mga mangunguma sang tag-P17 kada kilo.
english: When the NFA was selling its rice at P27 per kilo, it bought it from farmers at P17 per kilo.

text: Karon, ugaling, indi na ini mabakal sang NFA sa amo gihapon nga bili sa mga mangunguma.
english: Now, however, the NFA cannot buy it at the same price from farmers.

text: Ginabakal na ini sang tag-P25 kada kilo sang mga pribado nga mga rice trader, nga wala kita sing kontrol tungod sang free enterprise.
english: It is already being bought at P25 per kilo by private rice traders, whom we have no control over because of free enterprise.

text:
***

Sa una nga impormasyon halin sa NFA central office, puede ini mabaligya sang NFA sa tag-P25 tubtub P30 kada kilo, depende sa klase sang imported nga bugas.
english:
***

According to preliminary information from the NFA central office, the NFA can sell it at P25 to P30 per kilo, depending on the type of imported rice.

text: Pero, wala pa kita sang opisyal nga pahibalo parti sini.
english: However, we don't have any official announcement about it yet.

text: Ginpatigayon sang NFA ang rebidding sang mapaslawan ang bidding sadtong Abril 27 tungod ang offer sang Vietnam kag Thailand naglapaw sa reference price sang NFA.
english: The NFA conducted the rebidding when the bidding failed on April 27 because the offer of Vietnam and Thailand exceeded the NFA's reference price.

text: Sang mag-rebidding na, ang NFA nagtanyag nga magbakal sing bugas sa presyo nga USD (US Dollar) 531 kada MT nga may 15 porsyento nga broken rice kag USD520.50 kada MT sang bugas nga may 25 porsyento nga broken rice.
english: When it came to rebidding, the NFA offered to buy rice at USD (US Dollar) 531 per MT with 15 per cent broken rice and USD520.50 per MT of rice with 25 per cent broken rice.

text: Sa ginhisugtan, ang Thailand ang maga-supply sang 120,000 MT nga may 25 porsyento nga broken rice sa bili nga USD517.50 kada MT.
english: Under the agreement, Thailand will supply 120,000 MT with 25 percent broken rice at USD517.50 per MT.

text: Ang Vietnam ang ma-supply sang 50,000 MT sang bugas nga may 15 porsyento nga broken rice sa bili nga USD 526.50 kada MT kag 80,000 MT nga may 25 porsyento nga broken rice sa bili nga USD 517.50 kada MT.
english: Vietnam will be supplied with 50,000 MT of rice with 15 percent broken rice at USD 526.50 per MT and 80,000 MT with 25 percent broken rice at USD 517.50 per MT.

text: Ini nga mga offer sang duha ka pungsod pulos kabos sa repference price sang NFA.
english: These offers from both countries are all below the reference price of the NFA.

text: Wala masiling kon bala kinahanglan pa magbayad ang NFA sang gasto sa pagbyahe (freight), insurance kag iban pa nga balayran agud malakip ini sa sumada sa aktwal na nga pagbaligya sang subong nga NFA rice sa mga pumuluyo.
english: It was not said whether the NFA will have to pay freight, insurance and other fees to be included in the sumada in the actual sale of the current NFA rice to the public.

text: Temprano pa nga nagpauli ang defending champion sa US Open nga si Novak Djokovic matapos ini gin-upset sang No.
english: Defending US Open champion Novak Djokovic went home early after being upset by the No. 1 seed.

text: 28 seed nga si Alexei Popyrin sa third round sang tournament.
english: 28 seed Alexei Popyrin in the third round of the tournament.

text: 6-4, 6-4, 2-6, 6-4 ang skor nga amo ang nagtapos sa kampanya sang Serbian tennis superstar nga makuha kuntani ang iya ika-25 nga Grand Slam title.
english: The score was 6-4, 6-4, 2-6, 6-4, ending the Serbian tennis superstar's campaign to win his 25th Grand Slam title.

text: Ang kalutusan ni Djokovic nga amo ang gold medalist sa bag-o lang nagtakop nga Paris Olympics amo naman ang naghatag-duag sa karera sang Australian sini nga kasumpong nga nakabulsa sang pinakadaku nga kadalag-an sa iya tennis career sang nalab-ot sini ang round of 16 sang isa ka major tournament sa labing-una nga tion.
english: The defeat of Djokovic, who was the gold medalist at the recently concluded Paris Olympics, also set the stage for the career of his Australian opponent who pocketed the biggest victory of his tennis career when he reached the round of 16 of a major tournament for the first time.

text: Gin-ako ni Djokovic nga ginkapoy siya sa mental kag pisikal nga aspeto sa iya kumpetisyon sa Paris rason man kun ngaa pigado ang iya performance sa New York.
english: Djokovic admitted that he was mentally and physically tired during his competition in Paris, which is why he performed poorly in New York.

text: “I spent a lot of energy winning the gold, and I did arrive to New York just not feeling fresh mentally and physically,” pahayag sini.
english: “I spent a lot of energy winning the gold, and I arrived to New York just not feeling fresh mentally and physically,” stated sini.

text: “But because it’s US Open, I gave it a shot and I tried my best.
english: “But because it’s US Open, I gave it a shot and I tried my best.

text: I didn’t have any physical issues.
english: I didn’t have any physical issues.

text:
I just felt out of gas and you could see that with the way I played.”

Antes kay Djokovic, temprano man nga nalutos ang isa ka heavy favorite nga si Carlos Alcaraz sang Espanya.
english:
I just felt out of gas and you could see that with the way I played.”

Before Djokovic, a heavy favorite Carlos Alcaraz of Spain also lost early.

text: Ginpierde si Alcaraz sang unseeded player nga si Botic Van de Zandschulp.
english: Alcaraz was defeated by unseeded player Botic Van de Zandschulp.

text: Ang pag-upset sa Serbian kag Spaniard players amo ang nagbutang sa top seed nga si Jannik Sinner bilang isahanon na lamang nga paborito nga makadaog sa US Open title matapos man ini nagpangibabaw sa 2024 Australian Open.
english: The upset of the Serbian and Spaniard players put top seed Jannik Sinner as the only favorite to win the US Open title after also dominating the 2024 Australian Open.

text: Ang 2024 US Open amo ang labing-una nga tion sa Grand Slam nga wala sang makit-an nga Djokovic, Rafael Nadal ukon Roger Federer sa Round of 16 halin sang 2004 French Open — tion nga naga-edad pa lang si Djokovic sang 17-anyos.
english: The 2024 US Open will mark the first time at a Grand Slam that neither Djokovic, Rafael Nadal nor Roger Federer will find in the Round of 16 since the 2004 French Open — a time when Djokovic was just 17-years-old.

text:
Hibaluon ang kabangdanan sang pag-atake sa tagipusuon

Masami bala nga nagasakit ang imo nga tagipusuon?
english:
Know the cause of heart attack

Does your heart often hurt?

text: Ang tawo nga may yara sang healthy-living ang nagapanubo sang tsansa sa pag-angkon sang atake sa tagipusuon apang kun ini man ang matabo, kinahanglan tandaan ang pila ka mga pahanumdom.
english: A person who has a healthy lifestyle reduces the chances of having a heart attack but if it does happen, some reminders should be kept in mind.

text: Suno kay Garry Jennings, cardiologist nagikan sa Australian Heart Foundation, indi masarangan sang tagipusuon ang mga kondisyon kaangay sang paghugot kag pagbara sa isa sa mga arterya nga nagasuplay sa tagipusuon kag indi bastante ang pagsulod nga hangin ukon oxygen kag iban pa nga nutrient.
english: According to Garry Jennings, cardiologist from the Australian Heart Foundation, the heart cannot cope with conditions such as narrowing and blockage of one of the arteries that supply the heart and not enough air or oxygen and other nutrients.

text: Pila sa mga kabangdanan sang atake sa tagipusuon amo ang mataas nga blood pressure.
english: Some of the causes of heart attack are high blood pressure.

text: Kun ang blood pressure ang mataas, ang tagipusuon kag mga arterya ang nangin sobra ang unod.
english: When blood pressure is high, the heart and arteries become overloaded.

text: Apang mahimo ini nga mabulong, gani regular nga mag pa check-up sa doktor agud nga hibaluon ang presyon sang dugo.
english: But it can be treated, so regular check-ups with your doctor to check your blood pressure.

text: Ang mataas nga kolesterol ang isa man sa rason kun ngaa gina-atake sa tagipusuon ang isa ka tawo.
english: High cholesterol is also one of the reasons why a person has a heart attack.

text: Tinguhaan nga likawan ang tuman nga koresterol sa pagkaon.
english: Try to avoid too much cholesterol in the diet.

text: Mangin ang indi maayo nga diet kag diabetes ang pila lang sa mga kabangdanan.
english: Poor diet and diabetes are just a few of the causes.

text: Mahimo nga madugangan ang kabug-aton sang isa ka tawo nga nagataas ang  posibilidad sang sakit sa tagipusuon kag iban pa nga problema.
english: A person can gain weight, increasing the risk of heart disease and other problems.

text: Panugyan sang eksperto, magpakonsulta sa doktor para sa ikaayo sang tagipusuon.
english: Expert advice, consult a doctor for heart health.

text: Ang mga manuglatay sa lubid ang masami nga makit-an lang naton sa circus ukon sa mga palagwaon.
english: Rope jumpers are usually only seen in the circus or in shows.

text: Apang mapati ka man ukon indi, ang bug-os nga populasyon sa gamay nga village sa bukid sang Dagestan autonomous republic sa Tsvokra, Russia, ang nakahibalo maglatay ukon maglakat sa tightrope ukon lubid.
english: But believe it or not, the entire population in the small mountain village of the Dagestan autonomous republic in Tsvokra, Russia, knows how to cross or walk a tightrope or rope.

text: Wala sang may nakahibalo sang pat-od nga petsa kun san-o nag-umpisa ang tightrope-walking tradition sa nasambit nga lugar apang pat-od naman nga sa sulod na sang kapin 100 ka-tuig, tanan nga tawo sa amo nga lugar, babaye man ukon lalaki kag mangin ang mga lamharon ang edad, ang nakatuon sa paglatay sa lubid kun sa diin ang iban ang nangin matuod nga circus performers.
english: No one knows the exact date when the tightrope-walking tradition began in the area but it is certain that for more than 100 years, all people in the area, both men and women and even the young, have learned to walk on the rope where some have become real circus performers.

text: Apisar nagnubo sa kapin 3,000 ang populasyon sa Tsvokra village sang 1980s tubtob sa kapin 400 na lang subong, ang tanan nga mga tawo nga nabilin sa amo nga lugar ang trained sa art sang tightrope walking ukon paglatay sa lubid.
english: Although the population of Tsvokra village dropped from more than 3,000 in the 1980s to more than 400 today, all the people left in the area are trained in the art of tightrope walking.

text: Wala sang problema kay re-elected Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas kun mag-upod man sila ni Councilor-elect Plaridel Nava sa oath taking sang tanan nga elected officials sa syudad sang Iloilo sa Hunyo 27.
english: Re-elected Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas has no problem if he joins Councilor-elect Plaridel Nava in the oath taking of all elected officials in Iloilo City on June 27.

text: Ini apisar sang nangin away sang duha sang nagligad nga eleksyon.
english: This is despite the fight between the two in the last election.

text: Una naman nagpahayag si Nava nga apisar siya lang ang nagaisahanon nga nagikan sa opposition nga nalakip sa ‘magic 12’ nga magapungko sa konseho, magatambong man siya sa oath-taking ceremony sa Plaza Libertad sa Lunes.
english: Earlier, Nava said that although he is the only one from the opposition who is included in the 'magic 12' to sit in the council, he will also attend the oath-taking ceremony at Plaza Libertad on Monday.

text: Suno naman sa alkalde, wala siya ‘nagapamersonal’ kay Nava.
english: The mayor said he is not 'personalizing' Nava.

text: Antes sini, ginkumpirma na ni Iloilo City Vice Mayor Jeffrey Ganzon nga wala man sang uyatan nga committee chairmanship si Nava kun opisyal na ini nga magpungko bilang konsehal sang syudad — butang nga suno kay Nava, “no big deal” man para sa iya.
english: Earlier, Iloilo City Vice Mayor Jeffrey Ganzon confirmed that Nava will not hold committee chairmanship when he officially sits as a city councilor — something that Nava said is “no big deal” for him.

text: Magluwas sa mga konsehal kag kay Treñas, maga-take oath man si Iloilo City Rep.
english: Besides the councilors and Treñas, Iloilo City Rep.

text: Julienne Baronda kag si Uswag Ilonggo Party-list Rep Jojo Ang.
english: Julienne Baronda and Uswag Ilonggo Party-list Rep Jojo Ang.

text: Si Senator-elect Miguel Zubiri ang maga-administer sang oath of office.
english: Senator-elect Miguel Zubiri will administer the oath of office.

text: Nagatak-an ka man bala sa view saggwa sang bintana sa inyo nga balay?
english: Do you get tired of the view out the window in your house?

text: Para sa isa ka pamilya sa Bosnia kag Herzegovina, indi ini problema bangud nagtukod ang isa ka amay sang balay nga nagalibot sang 360 degrees agud nanuhay-tuhay nga views ang makit-an sang iya pamilya.
english: For one family in Bosnia and Herzegovina, this was not a problem because one father built a house that rotated 360 degrees so that his family could see different views.

text: Suno sa nasambit nga amay nga si Vojin Kusic, masami sadto nga ginabaylo-baylo sang iya asawa ang mga kwarto sa sulod sang ila nga balay agud lain naman nga view ang ila makita.
english: According to the father, Vojin Kusic, his wife often changed the rooms inside their house so that they could see a different view.

text: Apang bisan ano nila ka saylo sang kwarto, indi sa gihapon kuntento ang iya asawa sa view saggwa sang ila bintana.
english: But no matter how much they moved rooms, his wife was still not satisfied with the view outside their window.

text: Agud nga indi na siya mag-ugtas sang wala untat nga saylo sang kwarto kag malikawan nga mabatian ang reklamo sang iya asawa, nagdesisyon nalang si Kusic nga magtukod sang nagalibot nga balay.
english: In order to avoid the hassle of constantly moving rooms and avoiding hearing his wife's complaints, Kusic decided to build a round house.

text: Lango-lango ni Kusic, mahimo nila palibuton ang ila balay kun may bisita sila nga indi naluyagan.
english: Kusic said they can surround their house if they have a guest they don't like.

text: Naglab-ot sa anum ka-tuig ang pagtukod sa nagalibot nga balay kag mahimo man maislan ang kadasigon sang paglibot sini.
english: The rotating house took six years to build and the speed of its rotation can be changed.

text: Pinakadasig amo ang 22 ka segundo samtang 24 ka oras naman ang pinakadugay.
english: The fastest is 22 seconds while the longest is 24 hours.

text: Nagpanumpa na kahapon nga adlaw si anay PNP chief Nicolas Torre III bilang bag-o nga general manager sang Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA).
english: Former PNP chief Nicolas Torre III was sworn in yesterday as the new general manager of the Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA).

text: Gintal-usan sini si Procopio Lipana sa posisyon.
english: He replaced Procopio Lipana in the position.

text: Suno kay Interior Secretary nga si Jonvic Remulla, ginakonsiderar nila ini nga mandatory retirement para kay Torre sa Philippine National Police.
english: Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla said they are considering this mandatory retirement for Torre in the Philippine National Police.

text: Nahibaluan nga na-relieve si Torre bilang PNP chief sang Agosto 25 kag ginbuslan ini ni Police Lieutenant General Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr.
english: Torre was relieved as PNP chief on August 25 and was replaced by Police Lieutenant General Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr.

text: Isa sa mga rason sang iya pagka-relieve amo ang indi sini pag-ugyon sa sugo sang National Police Commission (NAPOLCOM) bahin sa reassignment sang ila nga key officials.
english: One of the reasons for his relief was his disagreement with the order of the National Police Commission (NAPOLCOM) regarding the reassignment of their key officials.

text: Bilang anay isa ka CIDG chief, ginpangunahan ni Torre ang pag-aresto kay anay Presidente Rodrigo Duterte kag sa iya spiritual adviser nga si televangelist Apollo Quiboloy.
english: As a former CIDG chief, Torre led the arrest of former President Rodrigo Duterte and his spiritual adviser, televangelist Apollo Quiboloy.

text: Gindala si Duterte sa International Criminal Court sa Netherlands kag gin-akusahan sang human rights violation.
english: Duterte was brought before the International Criminal Court in the Netherlands and charged with human rights violations.

text: Sang si Torre pa ang regional police chief sa Davao, ginpangunahan man sini ang operasyon batok kay Quiboloy sa Kingdom of Jesus Christ compound matapos ang 16-ka-adlaw sini nga standoff.
english: When Torre was the regional police chief in Davao, he also led the operation against Quiboloy at the Kingdom of Jesus Christ compound after his 16-day standoff.

text: Sa karon, si Nartatez na ang nagaserbe nga “acting chief” sang PNP.
english: Nartatez is now the acting chief of the PNP.

text: Indi na pagdayunon ang pagpasaka sang kaso batok sa hubog nga mga indibidwal nga nagpuli sa pagtapungol kag pagtumba kanday Superman, Batman, kag Wonderwoman sa Pototan Plaza.
english: The case against the drunk individuals who returned to stab and knock down Superman, Batman, and Wonderwoman in Pototan Plaza will no longer be filed.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Bryan Alamo, hepe sang Pototan Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga natukiban nga lunsay estudyante ang involved sa pagpangsumbag sa superheroes nga nagaserbe kuntani nga dekorasyon sa plaza sang banwa.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Major Bryan Alamo, chief of the Pototan Municipal Police Station, said it was discovered that all the students were involved in the beating of the superheroes who were supposed to serve as decorations in the plaza of the town.

text: Sa anum nga involved, apat ang mga menor de edad.
english: Of the six involved, four are minors.

text: Pahayag ni Alamo, natigayon ang dayalogo sa ginikanan sang mga kabataan, kag bangud sa konsiderasyon sang alkalde suno sa iya, may nalab-ot nga pila ka kasugtanan kaangay sang pagpasabat sa ila sa gasto sa pag-repair sa superheroes.
english: Alamo said the dialogue with the parents of the children was achieved, and due to the mayor's consideration, some agreements were reached such as holding them accountable for the cost of repairing the superheroes.

text: Makaluluoy man suno kay Alamo kun dayunon gid ang complaint, magluwas pa nga nagpabutyag man sang ila nga paghinulsol ang mga involved nga kabataan paagi sa intervention sang Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office.
english: Alamo said it would be unfortunate if the complaint was continued, besides that the involved children also expressed their regret through the intervention of the Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office.

text: Matandaan nga nakit-an sila sa CCTV footage, na-identify, kag gindala sa kustodiya sang pulis bangud sang malicious mischief.
english: They were seen on CCTV footage, identified, and taken into police custody for malicious mischief.

text: Suno kay Alamo, bisan daw nahimo nga kaladlawan ang balita sang nagkalatumba ang superheroes, isa ini ka seryoso nga mensahe nga wala ginapalampas sang pulis ang bisan ano nga insidente — gamay man ukon daku.
english: Alamo said although the news of the superheroes falling seemed to be turned into a joke, it was a serious message that police do not overlook any incident — small or large.

text: “At least, nakatilaw na sila nga na-disiplina sila.
english: “At least, they’ve tasted that they’ve been disciplined.

text:
Kun wala sila nakilala, basi kun mas daku pa gid nga mga insidente ang imbolbaran nila which is illegal,” suno pa sa hepe.#

text: NATINGALA gid ang isa ta ka abyan kon ngaa sa halos kada Domingo niya nga pagsimba wala gid siya sing nakita nga pulis ukon soldado nga nagasimba.
english: A FRIEND of mine wondered why he never saw a policeman or a soldier at church almost every Sunday.

text: Nanotaran ko man ini sa Mandurriao Church sa diin nagasimba kami nga mag-asawa kada Domingo.
english: I also noticed this at Mandurriao Church where my wife and I worship every Sunday.

text: Ugaling, kon wala ini ginmuno sang abyan ko, daw wala man gani sa akon buot.
english: However, if my friend hadn't said it, I wouldn't have thought about it.

text: Apang kay ginmuno na niya ini nagtomar na ako sang interes.
english: But since he said it, I took an interest.

text: Tuod no?
english: True no?

text: Wala gid matuod kami nakakita ni asawahon sang bisan isa ka pulis nga nagasimba diri samtang pila lang ka dupa ang antad sang Mandurriao Police Station sa simbahan.
english: My wife and I never saw a single policeman worshiping here while the Mandurriao Police Station is only a few feet away from the church.

text: Mga erehes bala ang aton mga pulis sa Mandurriao?
english: Are our police in Mandurriao heretics?

text: Indi ayhan sila katoliko kag lain ang ila simbahan?
english: Are they not catholic and have a different church?

text: Malayo seguro.
english: Far probably.

text: Halos 80 porsyento sang mga Filipino mga katoliko.
english: Almost 80 percent of Filipinos are catholic.

text: Indi ako magpati nga wala sing katoliko sa bisan isa lang sa mga pulis diri sa Mandurriao.
english: I don't believe that there is no catholic in any of the police here in Mandurriao.

text: Sa subong, diri na kami sa Mandurriao Church nagasimba kon Domingo sa a las sais sa aga nga misa.
english: Now, we are here at Mandurriao Church worshiping on Sundays at 6:00 am mass.

text: Kag wala matuod kami nakakita sang bisan isa lang ka pulis ukon soldado nga nagasimba diri.
english: And we didn't really see a single policeman or soldier worshiping here.

text: Sadto sang nagasimba pa kami sa Jaro Cathedral kon Domingo, wala man kami nakakita sa ila nga nagasimba diri.
english: When we used to worship at the Jaro Cathedral on Sundays, we didn't see them worshiping here either.

text: Nakaagi man kami sa pagsimba sa San Jose Parochial Church lapit sa Plaza Libertad, apang wala man kami nakakita bisan landong nila diri.
english: We also went to worship at the San Jose Parochial Church near Plaza Libertad, but we didn't see even a shadow of them here.

text: Indi ayhan sa lain sila nga inoras ga-simba?
english: Don't they go to church at different times?

text: Ukon wala gid ini sila nagasimba.
english: Or they don't go to church at all.

text: Kag kon gasimba man, dira lang seguro sa Camp Delgado sang mga pulis kag kon diin nga kampo sang mga soldado.
english: And if you go to church, it's probably at Camp Delgado of the police and some camp of the soldiers.

text: Ambot lang.
english: I don't know.

text: Nahibal-an man naton ugaling nga may katapo sang kapulisan kag mga soldado nga halin sa mga relihiyoso – katulad sang pari, pastor, imam, kag iban pa.
english: We also know, however, that there are members of the police and soldiers who are religious – such as priests, pastors, imams, and others.

text: Non-combatant, ukon indi hangaway, ini sila nga naga-atipan sa kinahanglanon ispiritual sang mga pulis kag mga soldado.
english: Non-combatants, or non-combatants, are those who care for the spiritual needs of police and soldiers.

text: Lakip sang ila obligasyon amo ang paghiwat sang kasal, pag-bendisyon sa mga namatay, kag mga misyon medical.
english: Their duties include conducting weddings, blessing the dead, and medical missions.

text: Kag syempre sa paghiwat sang misa para sa mga katoliko kag sang kasubong nga seremonya sang iban nga pagtuo.
english: And of course to hold masses for Catholics and similar ceremonies of other faiths.

text: Wala ini sila nagadala sing armas, pakilala nga indi sila hangaway.
english: They do not carry weapons, a sign that they are not soldiers.

text: Segurado naton nga ining mga relihiyoso gatudlo gid sa mga pulis kag mga soldado sang pagka-importante sang pagsimba kag pagpadumdum sa ila sang ila obligasyon ispiritwal paagi sa sermon sang pari, kag sa kasubong nga kahiwatan sang iban nga pagtuo.
english: We are sure that these religious people are teaching the police and soldiers the importance of worship and reminding them of their spiritual obligations through the priest's sermon, and in similar activities of other faiths.

text: Matuod, ang Diyos kaupod naton sa tanan nga kahigayunan,  kag makapakig-angot kita sa Iya sa bisan ano nga oras.
english: True, God is with us at all times, and we can communicate with Him at any time.

text: Apang lain gid ang makatambong kita sa misa bisan sa Domingo lang, partikular sa mga katoliko, kay sa bisan sa sermon lang sang pari mapadumdum kita sang mga pulong sang Diyos.
english: But it is very different to attend mass even on Sunday, particularly for Catholics, because even in the priest's sermon we are reminded of the words of God.

text: Sa siling gani sa Mic 4:2, “Come, let us go up to the mountain of the Lord to the house of the God of Jacob.
english: As Mic 4:2 says, “Come, let us go up to the mountain of the Lord to the house of the God of Jacob.

text:
He will teach us His ways, so that we may walk in His paths.”

In fact, importante man nga ang mga pulis kag mga soldado naton makapalapit sa Ginuo bisan sa pagtambong lang sa misa agud indi sila lubos mapalayo sa Diyos kag sa Simbahan, labi na gid kay sa aton sosyedad mga soldado ini sila sang Estado kag indi sang Simbahan.
english:
He will teach us His ways, so that we may walk in His paths.”

In fact, it is also important that our police and soldiers can approach the Lord even by attending mass so that they are not completely separated from God and the Church, especially since in our society they are soldiers of the State and not of the Church.

text: Ang aton Konstitusyon nagaathag sang indi pag-isa sang Estado kag Simbahan.
english: Our Constitution makes clear the incompatibility of State and Church.

text: Tungod sini, mga soldado lang sila sang Estado kag indi sang Simbahan sa idalom sang ginamando nga “Separation of Church and State”.
english: Because of this, they are only soldiers of the State and not of the Church under the mandated “Separation of Church and State”.

text: Dapat lang ugaling nga bisan sa ila lang balatyagon “soldado” man sila gihapon sang Ginuo kag sang Simbahan agud indi madula sa ila ang pagtaha sa ila pagtuo kag sang mga naga-representar sini.
english: However, they must be “soldiers” of the Lord and the Church even in their own feelings so that they do not lose respect for their faith and those who represent it.

text: Indi maayo sa aton pagtuo nga pasapayan lang ang pag-tratar naton sa aton mga pari kag iban pa nga relihiyoso.
english: It is not good for our faith to treat our priests and other religious people indifferently.

text: Gasayop man sila, matuod, pero may paagi sang pagreklamo nga indi man dapat, katulad sang pagpasipala kag pagtamay sa ila nga indi nagakaigu.
english: They make mistakes, of course, but there are ways of complaining that they shouldn't, such as insulting and humiliating them unnecessarily.

text: Tani, bisan sa balatyagon lang “soldado” kita gihapon sang mga nagaulikid sa aton ispiritwal nga kabuhi, kag indi katulad sang mga soldado Romano nga nagayamuhat sa Ginuo, nag-torture sa iya, kag naga-selebrar pa sang iya kamatayon.
english: Hopefully, even in a sense we are still “soldiers” of those who care about our spiritual lives, and not like the Roman soldiers who mocked the Lord, tortured him, and even celebrated his death.

text: Kasunod sang rollout sang Rice-for-All nga programa nga nagatanyag sang bugas sa mas manubo nga presyo nga P40 kada kilo, plano sang Department of Agriculture (DA) nga magbaligya sang mas barato nga sahi sang bugas sa ila Kadiwa ng Pangulo stalls sa Enero 2025.
english: Following the rollout of the Rice-for-All program that offers rice at a lower price of P40 per kilo, the Department of Agriculture (DA) plans to sell cheaper varieties of rice at its Kadiwa ng Pangulo stalls in January 2025.

text: Gin-anunsyo ni DA Assistant Secretary Genevieve Guevarra nga magabaligya ang departamento sang isa ka sahi sang brown rice, nga una nga tawgon nga “Nutri Rice,” sa balor nga P38 kada kilo.
english: DA Assistant Secretary Genevieve Guevarra announced that the department will sell a variety of brown rice, initially called “Nutri Rice,” at P38 per kilo.

text: Magluwas sini, magatanyag ang DA sang rice variety nga ginatawag “Sulit Rice” sa balor nga P36 kada kilo.
english: In addition, the DA will offer a rice variety called “Sulit Rice” at P36 per kilo.

text: Suno kay Guevarra, ang Sulit Rice ang mangin “super broken” nga variety.
english: According to Guevarra, Sulit Rice will be the “super broken” variety.

text: Gin-athag ni Guevarra nga ang “Nutri Rice” kag “Sulit Rice” ang mangin tanyag sang DA sa Bag-ong Tuig, nga nagatuyo sa paghatag sang mas barato kag alternatibo para sa publiko.
english: Guevarra explained that “Nutri Rice” and “Sulit Rice” will be the DA's New Year's offer, which aims to provide a cheaper and alternative for the public.

text: Gintiro-patay sang awtoridad ang isa ka 27-anyos nga lalaki matapos nagpangluthang ini sa law enforcement officers sa Border Patrol facility sa McAllen, Texas, Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: A 27-year-old man was shot dead by authorities after he opened fire on law enforcement officers at the Border Patrol facility in McAllen, Texas, United States of America.

text: Suno sa Department of Homeland Security, natumod ang suspek nga si Ryan Luis Mosqueda nga konektado sa isa ka address sa Michigan.
english: According to the Department of Homeland Security, the suspect was identified as Ryan Luis Mosqueda connected to an address in Michigan.

text: Suno sa ahensya, nagpalupok si Mosqueda sang yara ini sa entrada sang US Border Patrol sector annex rason nga nagbalos man palupok ang Border Patrol agents kag local police.
english: According to the agency, Mosqueda opened fire when he was at the entrance of the US Border Patrol sector annex, prompting Border Patrol agents and local police to return fire.

text: Antes napatay ang suspek, natiruhan man sini ang duha ka mga officer kag isa ka empleyado sang Border Patrol nga subong lunsay yara sa ospital.
english: Before he died, the suspect also stabbed two officers and a Border Patrol employee who are both in hospital.

text: Dala sang suspek sang nag-atake ini ang isa ka rifle kag may lain pa gid nga pusil kag assaultive weapons sa iya nga salakyan.
english: The suspect was carrying a rifle and other firearms and assault weapons in his vehicle.

text: Nakit-an sa salakyan sini nga may naka-spray paint nga mga tinaga nga “Cordis Die” nga makit-an man sa “Call of Duty” video game.
english: His vehicle was found with the words “Cordis Die” spray painted on it, which is also found in the “Call of Duty” video game.

text: Natabo ang shooting nga ini matapos ang pila na ka serye sang bayolente nga mga insidente sa federal immigration facilities sa tunga nga nagasaka nga mga tensyon sa US nga naangot sa immigration enforcement policies sang Trump administration.
english: The shooting comes after a series of violent incidents at federal immigration facilities amid rising tensions in the US over the Trump administration's immigration enforcement policies.

text: Nangin parte pa ang aktres nga si Maris Racal sa bag-o nga version sang kanta nga “Kisapmata” nga ginpaguwa sang iya ex-boyfriend nga si Rico Blanco.
english: Actress Maris Racal was also featured in the new version of the song “Kisapmata” released by her ex-boyfriend Rico Blanco.

text: Ini nga kanta ang popular na nga daan sang ginpaguwa sang Rivermaya sang 1996 apang gin-release ang bag-o nga bersyon ni Rico sa nagkalain-lain nga music streaming platforms sang nagligad nga Hulyo 19.
english: The song was already popular when it was released by Rivermaya in 1996 but Rico's new version was released on various music streaming platforms last July 19.

text: Sa official visualizer nga gin-release sa YouTube channel sang singer-wongwriter, ginpasalamatan sini ang nangin kabahin sang music kag recording kun sa diin nalakip si Maris nga telecaster.
english: In the official visualizer released on the singer-wongwriter's YouTube channel, he thanked those who were part of the music and recording which included Maris the telecaster.

text:
Ang Kisapmata amo ang ikaduha nga gin-release ni Rico halin sa upcoming album sini nga naga-unod sang solo artist versions sang iya “most loved creations.”

Nauna na ginpaguwa sang Oktubre 2023 ang isa pa ka single nga “You’ll Be Safe Here.”

Matandaan nga nangin unod sang mga topiko sanday Maris kag Rico halin sang ginkumpirma sang 26-anyos nga singer-actress sang Hulyo 12 nga bulagay na sila sang 51-anyos nga veteran singer.
english:
Kisapmata is Rico’s second release from its upcoming album featuring solo artist versions of his “most loved creations.”

Previously released in October 2023 is another single “You’ll Be Safe Here.”

Maris and Rico have been in the spotlight since the 26-year-old singer-actress confirmed on July 12 that she and the 51-year-old veteran singer are separated.

text: Mayo 2021 sang nagsugod ang ila relasyon matapos ang ila kolaborasyon sa isa ka music single.
english: Their relationship started in May 2021 after their collaboration on a music single.

text: Masami bala nagabatyag sang kasakit ang imo nga bibig bangud sa singaw?
english: Do you often feel pain in your mouth from steam?

text: Suno kay Dr. Bles Salvador, mahimo nga ang sintomas sang human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) amo ang masami nga ginatubuan sang singaw.
english: According to Dr. Bles Salvador, the symptoms of the human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) may be the most common cause of the rash.

text: Isa sa mga kabangdanan kun ngaa may singaw ang tawo amo ang indi masami nga pag-ilis sang toothbrush nga nagaresulta sang impeksyon.
english: One of the most common causes of bad breath is infrequent toothbrush changes that result in infection.

text: Mas maayo suno kay Dr. Salvador nga baylohan ang toothbrush sa tagsa ka bula ukon kada tatlo ka bulan.
english: It is better, according to Dr. Salvador recommends changing the toothbrush every bubble or every three months.

text: Malikawan ang paglapta sang impeksyon sa baba sang tawo kun ginabaylohan sang bag-o ang toothbrush nga ginagamit.
english: The spread of infection in the human mouth can be prevented by replacing the toothbrush used with a new one.

text: Kung malala na ang pagbatyag sang singaw, mahimo nga sintomas ini sang HIV.
english: If the feeling of steam is severe, it may be a symptom of HIV.

text: Panugyan sang eksperto, mahimo nga butangan sang asin kag baking soda ang tubig nga ipangmumog agud mabuhinan ang singaw.
english: Experts advise that salt and baking soda can be added to the water to be boiled to reduce steam.

text: Makabulig man ang pagbutang sang tawas ukon mga bulong nga gel agud mag-ayo ang mga singaw sa bibig.
english: Applying tawas or gel medicines to soothe lip steams can also help.

text: Ang pinaka-importante amo nga magpakonsulta sa denstista agud nga madapatan sang nagakaigo nga pagbulong.
english: The most important thing is to consult a dentist for proper treatment.

text: ANG gyera sa Marawi City nagpatay sing sobra 1,000 ka tawo, nga naglakip sang sobra 100 ka mga soldado, mga 800 ka mga terorista, kag mga sibilyan nga naipit sa lima ka bulan nga gyera nga nagsugud sadtong Mayo 23, 2017.
english: THE fighting in Marawi City has killed more than 1,000 people, including more than 100 soldiers, some 800 terrorists, and civilians trapped in a five-month war that began on May 23, 2017.

text: Nawasak ang madamo nga mga building, nagwatak-watak ang mga pumuluyo, kag nagluntad ang gutom kag pagmalasakit sang madamo, samtang ang iban naga-kinahanglan pa nga ma-rescue halin sa mga terorista nga nagbihag sa ila.
english: Many buildings were destroyed, residents were scattered, and there was hunger and anxiety for many, while others still needed to be rescued from the terrorists who had captured them.

text: Maabtik man nga nag-alabot ang mga bulig bisan pa sige ang gyera.
english: Relief efforts also arrived quickly despite the ongoing war.

text: Sa survey sang Pulse Asia, anom sa 10 ka mga pumuluyo sa pungsod nagpasalig sang ila ikasarang sa pagbulig.
english: In the Pulse Asia survey, six out of 10 citizens in the country assured their ability to help.

text: Ang gilayon nga mga bulig nag-abot halin sa gobyerno, mga non-government organization (NGO) kag mga mabuligon nga mga indibidwal.
english: Immediate relief efforts poured in from the government, non-government organizations (NGOs) and helpful individuals.

text: Ang iban nga mga pungsod, nga ginapangunahan sang Estados Unidos, nagbulig man.
english: Other countries, led by the United States, have also helped.

text: Pati na ang United Nations.
english: Even the United Nations.

text: Apang kulang gihapon ang mga kinahanglanon sang mga nabiktima sang gyera nga padayon man sa nagapangayo sing bulig.
english: But the needs of war victims who continue to ask for help are still lacking.

text: Sang magkulpa na ang gyera sadtong mga Oktubre, mga 26,000 ka mga pamilya ang nagbalalik na sa ila mga puluy-an nga ma-istaran pa.
english: By the time the war ended in October, some 26,000 families had returned to their habitable homes.

text: Ang iban, nga nawad-an sang ilistaran, ginpahamtang gid lang anay sa mga evacuation center.
english: Others, who lost their homes, were temporarily placed in evacuation centers.

text: Pag-abot sang Enero 2018, mga 800 na ka transitional shelters ang natukod.
english: By January 2018, about 800 transitional shelters had been built.

text: Nagpasalig man ang gobyerno nga suguran na sa second quarter ang pagpatindug sang mga permanente nga mga puluy-an para sa mga nagbakwit.
english: The government also promised to start the construction of permanent homes for the displaced in the second quarter.

text: Samtang sige man ang relief assistance.
english: Meanwhile, relief assistance continues.

text: Sa bahin sang Department of Socal Welfare and Development (DSWD), maabtik nga nagbulig na ini bisan sa pag-ibwal pa lang sang gyera.
english: On the part of the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD), it has been quick to help even in the early days of the war.

text: Nakapain na gani ini sang pang-una nga badyet nga mga P3.5 ka bilyon para sa rehabilitasyon sang mga biktima.
english: It has even allocated an initial budget of about P3.5 billion for the rehabilitation of the victims.

text: Sadtong Nobyembre 2017 gani, mga 4,671, ukon 21,667 ka mga indibidwal, ang napahamtang na sang DSWD sa mga 67 ka evacuaton centers sa Iligan City, Pantao Ragat, Balindong, Calanogas, Malabang kag Saguiran.
english: As of November 2017, about 4,671, or 21,667 individuals, have been placed by the DSWD in about 67 evacuation centers in Iligan City, Pantao Ragat, Balindong, Calanogas, Malabang and Saguiran.

text: Mga 51,133 ka tawo naman ang nag-apply para sa cash-for-work.
english: About 51,133 people applied for cash-for-work.

text: Ang nagbalalik pauli sa ila nagakalain-lain nga mga barangay sa Marawi ginpangtagaan sang masunod: Family food packs, Hygiene kits, kag Kitchen kits.
english: Those who returned to their various barangays in Marawi were given the following: Family food packs, Hygiene kits, and Kitchen kits.

text: Gintagaan man sila sang Financial Assistance nga nagabalor P27,248,000.
english: They were also given Financial Assistance worth P27,248,000.

text:
***

Kon ano pa ang mabulig sa mga biktima, ang  DSWD nagapanugyan ugaling nga indi lang basta maghatag kita sing mga donasyon – kwarta man ukon pagkaon, balayaon, kag iban pa nga mahatag naton sing libre agud makabulig sa mga biktima sang gyera sa Marawi City.
english:
***

As for what else can help the victims, the DSWD suggests that we do more than just give donations – whether it is money or food, shelter, and other things that we can give for free to help the victims of the war in Marawi City.

text: Indi lang ina, siling sang DSWD, kundi, labaw sa tanan, nga mabuligan naton sila sa pagpabalik sang ila dignidad.
english: Not only that, the DSWD said, but, above all, that we can help them restore their dignity.

text: Gaupod kita sa sining panugyan sang DSWD nga importante gid nga mapabalik ang dignidad sang mga biktima.
english: We agree with the DSWD's advice that it is very important to restore the dignity of the victims.

text: Ang tawo gintagaan sang Diyos sang ikasangkol agud magamit niya ang iya kamot, kinaalam kag painu-ino agud mabuhi kag mapauswag ang iya kaugalingon kag pamilya.
english: God has given man the ability to use his hands, mind and intelligence to live and improve himself and his family.

text: Gani, indi lang siya magsalig pirme sa bulig sang gobyerno kag bisan man gani sa Diyos kon masarangan man lang niya, bisan dapat pirme pangayuon ta gihapon nga pun-an sang Diyos ng aton kakulangan.
english: Therefore, he should not always rely on the help of the government and even God if he can, although we should always ask God to fill our needs.

text: In fact, bisan ang pagpa-uswag sang pangabuhi sa Komunismo ukon sa Welfare State kinahanglan man sang paghimakas sang kada isa agud mapa-uswag ang iya pangabuhi, ukon mapaseguro nga indi siya mawad-an sing pangabuhian, nga indi lang pirme nagasalig sa gobyerno.
english: In fact, even the improvement of life in Communism or the Welfare State requires the struggle of each individual to improve his life, or to ensure that he does not lose his livelihood, without always relying on the government.

text: Tungod sini, importante nga mabuligan ining mga biktima sang gyera sa pagpaseguro sang ila kaukod, ihibalo kag kinaalam agud mapabalik, kon indi gid man mapasanyog, ang ila mabungahon nga mga trabaho, negosyo, ukon ano man nga hilikuton sang wala pa ang gyera.
english: Therefore, it is important to help these victims of war to secure their diligence, knowledge and skills in order to restore, if not improve, their productive jobs, businesses, or any pre-war activities.

text: Kon nagadale kita nga may puluy-an na ang tanan kag iban pa nga instruktura, puede man gani mag-bayanihan ukon mag-alamutay ang tanan sang kabudlay agud matigayon ini.
english: If we are happy that everyone has a house and other infrastructure, we can even be heroic or share the hard work to achieve it.

text: Mas maayo gid seguro kon magsulod sila sa isa ka “timebanking”, sa diin maghilisugot sila sa pagpaseguro sang puede iamut nga kabudlay kag ihibalo sang kada isa, katulad sang  ginahimo sang mga pigado nga komunidad sa Estados Unidos kag Britanya, nga indi kinahanglan amutan sing kwarta.
english: It would probably be better if they entered into a “timebanking”, where they agreed to ensure the contribution of each other's hard work and knowledge, as is done by poor communities in the United States and Britain, without having to contribute money.

text: Makabulig diri ang gobyerno sa pag-provide sang mga equipment kag mga materyales nga gamiton sa pagpatindug sang kinahanglanon nga infrastruktura – puluy-an, eskwelahan kag bisan ang pagtukod sang ma-negosyuhan.
english: The government can help by providing equipment and materials to be used in the construction of necessary infrastructure – homes, schools and even the establishment of businesses.

text: Isang barkong bulk carrier na pinamamahalaan ng isang kumpanyang Griyego at may bandilang Liberia—ang Eternity C—ang inatake nitong Lunes sa may baybayin ng Yemen.
english: A bulk carrier operated by a Greek company and flying the Liberian flag—the Eternity C—was attacked on Monday off the coast of Yemen.

text: Ayon sa mga maritime authorities at sa operator ng barko na Cosmoship Management, 22 ang sakay ng barko, 21 sa kanila ay mga Pilipino.
english: According to maritime authorities and the ship's operator, Cosmoship Management, there were 22 people on board, 21 of them Filipinos.

text: Dalawang tripulante ang iniulat na sugatan habang dalawa pa ang kasalukuyang nawawala.
english: Two crew members were reported injured while two others are currently missing.

text: Naganap ang insidente sa layong humigit-kumulang 50 nautical miles timog-kanluran ng daungan ng Hodeidah.
english: The incident occurred about 50 nautical miles southwest of the port of Hodeidah.

text: Inatake umano ang barko gamit ang mga sea drone at apat na bangkang mabilis na may sakay na mga armadong lalaki.
english: The ship was allegedly attacked using sea drones and four speedboats with armed men on board.

text: Ayon sa ulat, pinakawalan ang hindi bababa sa apat na rocket-propelled grenades (RPG) na tumama sa bahagi ng tulay ng barko at nagdulot ng matinding pinsala, kabilang na ang pagkasira ng sistema ng komunikasyon.
english: According to the report, at least four rocket-propelled grenades (RPG) were fired that hit part of the ship's bridge and caused severe damage, including the destruction of the communication system.

text: Sa kasalukuyan, iniulat ng European Union’s Operation Aspides na ang barko ay nasa kondisyon ng pagkaka-anod o adrift.
english: Currently, the European Union's Operation Aspides reports that the ship is in a condition of adrift.

text: Kinumpirma rin ng Cosmoship na may tatlong armadong guwardiya sa barko sa oras ng insidente, ngunit hindi nito napigilan ang malawakang pinsala.
english: Cosmoship also confirmed that there were three armed guards on board at the time of the incident, but this did not prevent extensive damage.

text: Hindi pa tiyak kung anong nasyonalidad ang mga nawawalang tripulante.
english: It is not yet clear what nationality the missing crew members are.

text: Ang insidente ay sumunod lamang ng ilang oras matapos akuin ng mga rebeldeng Houthi ang pananabotahe sa isa pang barkong pag-aari ng Gresya, ang Magic Seas, na kanilang sinasabing lumubog.
english: The incident came just hours after Houthi rebels admitted to sabotaging another Greek-owned ship, the Magic Seas, which they said sank.

text: Gayunman, hindi pa ito kumpirmado.
english: Well, that's not confirmed yet.

text: Ligtas namang nakarating sa Djibouti ang 19 na Pilipinong sakay ng Magic Seas at ang kanilang security guard.
english: The 19 Filipinos aboard the Magic Seas and their security guard arrived safely in Djibouti.

text: Pinaalalahanan ng mga otoridad ang lahat ng Pilipinong marino na patuloy na mag-ingat habang tumatawid sa Red Sea, sumunod sa mga direktiba ng kanilang mga kapitan at security officers, at manatiling alerto sa mga banta ng pag-atake.
english: Authorities urge all Filipino sailors to remain vigilant while crossing the Red Sea, follow the directives of their captains and security officers, and remain alert to threats of attack.

text: Mas nangin maduagon pa gid ang pangalan sang “nation’s girl group” nga BINI sa OPM history matapos nangin labing-una ini nga P-Pop act nga naka-perform sa entablado sang KCON music festival.
english: The nation's girl group BINI became even more successful in OPM history after becoming the first P-Pop act to perform on stage at the KCON music festival.

text: Ini nga kahiwatan ang ginakilala nga pinakadaku nga K-pop fan and artist festival sa kalibutan kun sa diin nagaserbe man nga global launchpad para sa K-pop artists kag platform para sa international exposure.
english: This event is recognized as the largest K-pop fan and artist festival in the world where it also serves as a global launchpad for K-pop artists and a platform for international exposure.

text: Hulyo 28 (Philippine Time), naghugyaw gid ang audience sang nagsaka na ang BINI sa Crypto.com Arena sa Los Angeles, California kag ginpakita ang ila electrifying performance sang ila latest single nga “Cherry on Top” kadungan sang pre-show sang prestihiyoso nga “M Countdown”.
english: On July 28 (Philippine Time), the audience cheered when BINI took to the Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles, California and showcased their electrifying performance of their latest single “Cherry on Top” alongside the pre-show of the prestigious “M Countdown”.

text: Suksok sang grupo ang stylish Y2K-inspired outfits nga kaangay man sa ila ginasuksok sa ila nga music video.
english: The group wore stylish Y2K-inspired outfits similar to those they wear in their music video.

text: Ang BINI isa ka eight-member girl group — sanday Jhoanna, Aiah, Colet, Maloi, Gwen, Stacey, Mikha, kag Sheena — apang wala nakaupod ang ila leader nga si Jhoanna bangud sa hinali nga problema sa ikaayong lawas.
english: BINI is an eight-member girl group — Jhoanna, Aiah, Colet, Maloi, Gwen, Stacey, Mikha, and Sheena — but their leader Jhoanna was unable to join due to a sudden health problem.

text: Matandaan nga may three-day concert ang BINI sang Hunyo kag ginabantayan naman sang fans ang Grand BINIverse nga sunod patigayunon sa Araneta Coliseum sa November 16 kag 17.
english: BINI will have a three-day concert in June and fans are watching the Grand BINIverse to be held at Araneta Coliseum on November 16 and 17.

text: WALA na ginabaisan kon ngaa dapat may ara kita sang aton pungsodnon nga pulong.
english: It is NOT debatable why we should have our national language.

text: Una nga rason amo nga sa Pilipinas may sobra 170 ka mga lokal nga pulong (vernacular) kag tungod sini, sa ngalan sang aton pagkaisa bilang nasyon, kinahanglan gid nga may pungsodnon nga lengwahe kita.
english: The first reason is that in the Philippines there are more than 170 vernaculars and because of this, in the name of our unity as a nation, we must have a national language.

text: Isa pa mahapos ini gamiton, lakip ang rehiyonal nga mga pulong, sa pagtuon sang mga kabataan kay amo mismo ang ginagamit sa panimalay.
english: It is also easy to use, including regional languages, in children's learning because it is used at home.

text: Pinasahi man nga bugal sang mga Filipino nga may ara kita pungsodnon nga pulong.
english: It is also a special pride of Filipinos that we have a national language.

text: Sa pagkilala sa sining pagka-kinahanglan naton sa isa ka lengwahe nasyonal, ang 1935 Philippine Constitution nagmando sa pag-adopt kag pag-develop sini sandig sa isa ka nagaluntad na nga rehiyonal nga pulong.
english: In recognition of this need for a national language, the 1935 Philippine Constitution mandated its adoption and development based on an existing regional language.

text: Maathag nga wala ini nagamando sa pagtukod sining rehiyonal nga pulong bilang lengwahe nasyonal; kundi ang pagtukod lang sang lengwahe nasyonal base sa sining pulong rehiyonal.
english: Clearly, it does not mandate the establishment of this regional language as the national language; but only the establishment of a national language based on this regional language.

text: Ang Institute of National Language (INL) nag-rekomendar sang Tagalog tungod sadtong panahon, kag tubtub subong, ang Tagalog tungod ginagamit ini sang pinakamadamo nga Filipino, labi na gid kay ang kadamuan sang mga Filipino yara nagapuyo mismo sa sentro sang panguluhan sa Metro Manila kag Luzon.
english: The Institute of National Language (INL) recommended Tagalog because at that time, and still today, Tagalog because it is used by the most Filipinos, especially since the majority of Filipinos live in the center of government in Metro Manila and Luzon.

text: Sa amo man nga panahon, ang nagapangaduha kag naga-pangatlo nga mga rehiyonal nga pulong amo ang Cebuano kag Hiligaynon.
english: At the same time, the second and third largest regional languages ​​are Cebuano and Hiligaynon.

text: Ang problema lang ugaling sang pagpalawak sang lengwahe nasyonal sandig sa Tagalog amo nga nalimtan na ang iban nga pulong lokal bisan sa diksyonaryo sang lengwahe nasyonal.
english: The only problem, however, with the expansion of the national language based on Tagalog is that some local languages ​​have been forgotten even in the dictionary of the national language.

text: Kasaw-a, por ejemplo, ang paggamit sang “asawa” nga nagatumod sa isa ka lalake kag babaye nga minyo.
english: It is wrong, for example, to use “wife” to refer to a man and a woman who are married.

text: Ano abe kon usaron na gid lang ang “bana” para sa minyo nga lalake kag “asawa” para sa minyo nga babaye?
english: What if we just use “husband” for a married man and “wife” for a married woman?

text: Sa karon, sunu sa 1987 Constitution (Article XIV, Sec.
english: Currently, according to the 1987 Constitution (Article XIV, Sec.

text: 6), ang aton opisyal nga lengwahe nasyonal amo ang “…Filipino and, until otherwise provide by law, English…” labi na gid sa komunikasyon kag sa pagtudlo sa eskwelahan.
english: 6), our official national language is “…Filipino and, until otherwise provided by law, English…” especially in communication and teaching in schools.

text: Ang English indi lang padayon nga ginagamit naton tungod sa kadugay na naton nga paggamit sini samtang yara kita sa pagginahum sang Estados Unidos sa sulod sang malapit 50 anyos.
english: English is not just a language we continue to use because of how long we have been using it while we were under the rule of the United States for nearly 50 years.

text: Ang English internasyonal man nga lengwahe nga ginagamit sang kadam-an nga pungsod.
english: English is also an international language used by most countries.

text: Kag, tungod sini, ginakilala ini bilang “Language of Success” nga nagahatag bentaha sa mga Filipino sa pagpangita sing maayo nga ubra kag pagpauswag sang ila kinaalam sa mga sentro sang kinaalam sa luas sang pungsod.
english: And, because of this, it is recognized as the “Language of Success” which gives Filipinos an advantage in finding good jobs and improving their knowledge in knowledge centers abroad.

text: In fact, ang English sakop gihapon sang aton Bilingual Education Program halin pa sadtong 1974 sa idalom sang 1973 Constitution nga nagpabilin bisan na-revise na ini sang 1987 Constitution.
english: In fact, English has been part of our Bilingual Education Program since 1974 under the 1973 Constitution which remained even after the 1987 Constitution revised it.

text: Ang 1987 Constitution nagdugang man sa pagtalana sa rehiyonal nga mga pulong bilang mga “auxiliary  official languages” kag “media of instruction” sa mga rehiyon agud mapahapos ang pagtudlo pa gid sa mga kabataan.
english: The 1987 Constitution also added the designation of regional languages ​​as auxiliary official languages ​​and media of instruction in the regions to facilitate further education of children.

text: Sa idalom sang Bilingual Education Program, gina-separar ang paggamit sang Filipino sa mga “specific subject areas” halin Grade 1 sa tanan nga eskwelahan.
english: Under the Bilingual Education Program, the use of Filipino is separated into specific subject areas from Grade 1 in all schools.

text: Ang vernacular sang rehiyon ginatudlo na gani, sa karon, bilang subject sa idalom sang K-12 nga curriculum  sa Grade 1 tubtub 3 kag bilang “medium of instruction” halin kindergarten tubtub sa una nga tatlo ka tuig sa Grade School.
english: The vernacular of the region is now taught as a subject under the K-12 curriculum in Grades 1 to 3 and as a medium of instruction from kindergarten to the first three years of Grade School.

text: Wala sang kasablagan ukon sirkumstansya ang sarang nga makapatay sang handom sang isa ka indibidwal.
english: No disability or circumstance can kill an individual’s dream.

text: Ini ang ginpamatud-an sang naga-isahanon nga World’s Armless Professional Sports Driver sa Czech Republic.
english: This was proven by the only World’s Armless Professional Sports Driver in the Czech Republic.

text: Siya amo si Bartek Ostalowski, isa ka motorsports enthusiast nga nadulaan sang duha ka mga kamot sa edad nga 20 anyos kasunod sang trahedya nga natabo sa iya sang 2006.
english: He is Bartek Ostalowski, a motorsports enthusiast who lost both hands at the age of 20 following the tragedy that befell him in 2006.

text: Apang indi ini nangin upang agud mag-untat na ang iya paglab-ot sa iya handom nga mangin isa ka professional racecar driver.
english: But this did not stop him from achieving his dream of becoming a professional racecar driver.

text: Sa sulod ang tatlo ka-tuig na-master ni Ostalowski ang car racing gamit lang ang iya mga tiil.
english: Within three years Ostalowski mastered car racing with just his legs.

text: Sa subong, si Ostalowski ang naga-isahanon nga professional sport driver sa bilog nga kalibutan nga nagamaneho gamit lang ang iya mga till kag nagasambuwa pa batok sa mga able-bodied driver sa drifting competitions.
english: Today, Ostalowski is the only professional sport driver in the world who drives with only his tills and still competes against able-bodied drivers in drifting competitions.

text: Temprano nga nagpaalam ang Filipino pole vault star nga si EJ Obiena sa iya 2024 season agud nga malikawan nga maglala ang iya gina-suprer nga spine injury nga naangkon sini antes pa man ang pagpasakop sa Paris Olympics.
english: Filipino pole vault star EJ Obiena said goodbye to his 2024 season early to avoid aggravating a spine injury he suffered just before the Paris Olympics.

text: Suno sa 28-anyos nga Pinoy pride, indi na siya magdayon sa pagpartisipar sa ISTAF Berlin sa Germany, Weltklasse Zurich sa Switzerland, kag Diamond League Final sa Belgium sa Septyembre matapos na-diagnose nga may fractured L5 vertebra.
english: According to the 28-year-old Filipino pride, he will not continue to participate in ISTAF Berlin in Germany, Weltklasse Zurich in Switzerland, and Diamond League Final in Belgium in September after being diagnosed with a fractured L5 vertebra.

text: Kun matandaan, nadetalye na sini nga antes ang Olympiada, may problema na ang iya likod apang nakapang-apat pa ini sa finals kag isa ka semana matapos ang Summer Games, nabulsa sini ang bronze medal sa Lausanne Diamond League sa Switzerland.
english: It can be recalled that before the Olympics, he had a problem with his back but he was still fourth in the finals and a week after the Summer Games, he pocketed the bronze medal in the Lausanne Diamond League in Switzerland.

text: Sa iya social media posts, ginsaysay sini nga naglala ang iya back pain kadungan sang Silesia Diamond League sa Poland sini gid lamang nga semana kun sa diin nagpang-lima siya sa mga nag-compete.
english: In his social media posts, he explained that his back pain worsened during the Silesia Diamond League in Poland this week where he finished fifth among the competitors.

text: Kasunod sang MRI kag CT scans, nakumpirma nga nag-suprer si Obiena sang fractured spine.
english: Following MRI and CT scans, it was confirmed that Obiena suffered a fractured spine.

text: Bangud sini, indi naman madayon si Obiena sa Philippine International Pole Vault Challenge nga ginplano kuntani nga ipatigayon sa Ayala Triangle Garden sa Septyembre 20.
english: As a result, Obiena will not be able to participate in the Philippine International Pole Vault Challenge scheduled to be held at the Ayala Triangle Garden on September 20.

text: Wala mapatpat kun patigayunon gihapon ang event, apang nagpasalig ang two-time Olympian nga may ipaguwa pa nga dugang nga mga detalye.
english: It is unclear if the event will still be held, but the two-time Olympian assured that more details will be released.

text: Apang kaangay sa iya nauna nga statements, positibo ang panan-awan ni Obiena kag nagalaum nga pagkatapos sang iya pagpahuway subong nga tuig, maka-recover siya kag makabalik sa kumpetisyon sa 2025.
english: However, similar to his earlier statements, Obiena has a positive outlook and hopes that after this year’s rest, he will be able to recover and return to competition in 2025.

text: “Hopefully, now that I’ve identified the source of my back problems this year, with the required four weeks off to heal, I’m hoping to return pain-free and ready for the 2025 indoor season!” dugang sini.
english: “Hopefully, now that I’ve identified the source of my back problems this year, with the required four weeks off to heal, I’m hoping to return pain-free and ready for the 2025 indoor season!” it added.

english: “Queen of power ballads” Celine Dion happily left France after her successful performance at the opening ceremony of the Paris Olympics that was praised by the whole world.

english: “I’m honored to have performed tonight, for the Paris 2024 opening ceremony, and so full of joy to be back in one of my very favorite cities!

english: At the ceremony, she sang Edith Piaf's “Hymn to Love” which caused some spectators to cry who had been waiting for her comeback performance after being diagnosed with Stiff-Person Syndrome almost two years ago.

english: This is also her second performance at the Summer Games after she was also selected to perform at the Atlanta Olympics in 1996.

english: In addition to the 56-year-old French-Canadian and “My Heart Will Go On” singer, also performing at the Olympics was American superstar Lady Gaga.

text: All systems go na ang Kamara para sa canvassing sang boto para sa presidente kag bise-presidente sa May 9 elections.
english: The House of Representatives is all systems go for canvassing votes for president and vice-president in the May 9 elections.

text: Nagsapol ang mga kongresista para sa briefing sang secretary general sa procedures kag scenarios sa canvassing nga magaumpisa sa Mayo 24.
english: The congressmen met for a briefing by the secretary general on procedures and scenarios for the canvassing that will begin on May 24.

english: According to House Speaker Lord Allan Velasco, the intention of the lawmakers who will be the sitting canvassers is to ensure that the canvassing of votes cast and proclamation of the two highest officials of the country is seamless.

text: Ginpasigurado man sini nga masunod gid ang integridad sang electoral process.
english: He also assured that the integrity of the electoral process will be followed.

text: Sa idalom sang Konstitusyon, mandato sang Kamara kag Senado nga mag-convene sa isa ka joint session agud magporma sang National Board of Canvassers (NBOC) nga amo ang magaisip sang votes kag mag-proclaim sang winners sa 2022 presidential kag vice presidential polls.
english: Under the Constitution, it is the mandate of the House and Senate to convene in a joint session to form the National Board of Canvassers (NBOC) which will count the votes and proclaim the winners in the 2022 presidential and vice presidential polls.

text: Sanday Velasco kag Senate President Vicente Sotto III ang maga-preside sa joint session kun patigayunon na ang canvassing.
english: Velasco and Senate President Vicente Sotto III will preside over the joint session when the canvassing is conducted.

text: Nahibal-an naton ini sang sini lang ugaling.
english: We learned this recently however.

text: Sunu kay Sarmiento, mga 15 porsyento, ukon mga 10,616 lang ugaling, sang mga 75,730 nga claims ang na-aprubahan sang Board.
english: According to Sarmiento, about 15 percent, or only about 10,616, of the 75,730 claims were approved by the Board.

text: Ang partidahanay, sa nahibal-an ta sa pila ka claimants, sandig sa puntos – 1 tubtub 10 – base sa kabug-at sang masakit nga eksperyensya sang claimant.
english: The classification, as we know from some claimants, is based on a score – 1 to 10 – based on the severity of the claimant's painful experience.

text: Ang pinakanubo nga mabaton amo ang P20,000 kag ang pinakataas amo ang P200,000.
english: The minimum amount is P20,000 and the maximum amount is P200,000.

text: Kon ngaa ginsikway ang mga 85% sang mga claims, sunu kay Sarmiento, ina tungod kuno indi mapatihan ang mga claims sining nag-apply para sa kompensasyon.
english: The reason why about 85% of the claims were rejected, according to Sarmiento, is because the claims of those who applied for compensation were not credible.

text: “…It’s because the claimants were not able to prove that they were victims,” siling ni Sarmiento nga gin-quote sa online report sang ABS-CBN sadtong Marso 6 pa.
english: “…It’s because the claimants were not able to prove that they were victims,” Sarmiento said, quoted in an online report by ABS-CBN as early as March 6.

text: Sa aton pa, ang mga 85 porsyento sang mga 75,730, ukon mga 64 ka libu, nga claimants wala maka-pamatuod nga biktima sila sang abuso sang diktadurya ni Marcos.
english: In other words, about 85 percent of the 75,730, or about 64 thousand, claimants failed to prove that they were victims of abuse by the Marcos dictatorship.

text: Apang paano nila ini ginpamatud-an?
english: But how did they prove it?

text: Ang mga claims gintindugan sang mga nakasumpa nga mga biktima kag mga testigo.
english: The claims were backed up by sworn victims and witnesses.

text: Kag sin-o gali ang nag-kontra sining mga testigo kag mga ebidensya?
english: And who actually contradicted these witnesses and evidence?

text: Dapat makilala ini sang mga claimant, apang wala bisan advice halin sa Board bahin sini, agud masabat sang mga claimant ang kontra akusasyon.
english: The claimants should have recognized this, but there was not even advice from the Board about it, so that the claimants could answer the counter charge.

text: Ginsiling matuod sang Board nga ang indi kumpormi sa pagpamat-ud sang Board puede ka-file sang complaint.
english: The Board did say that those who disagree with the Board's decision can file a complaint.

text: Gin-announce na ang deadline sa pag-aprubar sang mga claims sadtong Mayo 12, apang wala man lang bisan advice halin sa Board parti sini.
english: The deadline for approval of claims was announced on May 12, but there was no advice from the Board on this.

text: Ti, paano abe maka-reklamo ang na-reject ang claims kay wala man sila sing isabat kay wala gani bisan advice nga nag-abot sa ila?
english: Well, how can those whose claims were rejected complain because they have nothing to answer because they didn't even receive advice?

text: Bilang isa sang nag-file sang claim nga na-reject (tungod wala sing advice nga na-aprub ako tubtub subong), okey lang ini sa akon kon nakabaton ako bisan advice lang kon ngaa na-reject ang akon claim, basta indi lang binutig kay wala ako nagbinutig sa akon claim.
english: As one of those who filed a claim that was rejected (because I have not received any advice so far), I am fine if I have received even advice on why my claim was rejected, as long as it is not a lie because I did not lie in my claim.

text: In fact, sang gasugilanun pa kami sang mga kaupdanan ko parti sa plano nga mag-file sang claim, ako nagpamalibad na.
english: In fact, when my colleagues and I were talking about the plan to file a claim, I refused.

text: Siling ko nga indi na ako mag-file tungod wala man ako natam-an sang abuso sang rehimeng Marcos.
english: I said that I will not file because I have not been abused by the Marcos regime.

text: “Bastante na sa akon nga napatalsik ang mapintas nga pagginahum ni Marcos,” siling ko gani.
english: “It is enough for me that the tyrannical rule of Marcos has been overthrown,” I said.

text: Ugaling nag-insistir ang akon mga kaupdanan kay “yawat pa kuno ang bisan gamay nga mabaton ko”, gani nagpasugot na lang ako.
english: But my friends insisted that “even a little bit is too much for me”, so I agreed.

text: Na-untat matuod ang trabaho ko sa media sang ginpa-untat sang militar ang amon broadcast column nga On the Air Force nga naga-kritikar kay Marcos, na-untat ang akon pagtuon sa abogasiya, nawad-an ako sing matarong nga ubra, kag na-hostage ako sang militar sa tion sang isa ka protest-rally agud seguruhon nga indi maka-perhwisyo ang mga upod ko nga rallyesta.
english: My media career was indeed interrupted when the military stopped our broadcast column On the Air Force criticizing Marcos, my law studies were interrupted, I lost my job, and the military took me hostage during a protest-rally to ensure that my fellow protesters would not be harmed.

text: Pero wala man ako mapatay, ma-priso, ukon gin-torture, kag nakabalik man ang Kahilwayan sang banwa pagkatapos nga napatalsik si Marcos.
english: But I was not killed, imprisoned, or tortured, and the Freedom of the people was restored after Marcos was overthrown.

text: Of course, makahaladlok ang ma-hostage sang militar nga, sa sina nga panahon, kilala sa kapintas bisan sa mga sibilyan.
english: Of course, it was terrifying to be held hostage by the military which, at that time, was known for its brutality even towards civilians.

text: Kon nagkaginamo gid man ang mga rallyesta naisip ko gani nga basi patyon pa nila ako.
english: If the rallyists really rioted, I thought they might kill me.

text: Nagkinagamo gid man apang nakapalagyo na ako.
english: There was a lot of trouble but I managed to escape.

text: Ang indi ko lang nagustuhan nga pasibangdan ako kag iban pa nga gin-reject ang amon mga claims kay wala kami maka-qualify tungod nagbinutig kami kuno sa amon sworn- affidavit nga amo gid ang mayor namon nga ebidensya.
english: The only thing I didn't like was that I and others were accused of rejecting our claims because we didn't qualify because we lied in our sworn-affidavit which was our main evidence.

text: Tani matagaan man lang kami, nga ang claims na-reject, sing paathag paagi sa isa ka advice man lang halin sa Human Rights Claims Board.
english: I hope that we, whose claims have been rejected, will be given an explanation through an advice from the Human Rights Claims Board.

text: Of course, we deserve that!
english: Of course, we deserve that!

text: Kinahanglan masabat namon ang akusasyon nga nagbinutig kami sa amon claims sa sina nga advice.
english: We had to answer the accusation that we lied in our claims in that advice.

text: Indi ko ina ya matulon nga akusasyon kay matuod ang akon ginsaad sa akon sworn-affidavit.
english: I can't swallow that accusation because what I promised in my sworn-affidavit is true.
