text: Ginapabugal ni presumptive Iloilo Fourth District Representative Dr. Ferjenel Biron nga may mga banwa sa probinsya sang Iloilo nga nagpanindugan para sa Uniteam presidential kag vice presidential candidates apisar nga kay Vice President Leni Robredo nagkadto ang boto sang kadam-an sa Iloilo.
english: Presumptive Iloilo Fourth District Representative Dr. Ferjenel Biron said there are towns in Iloilo province that stood for the Uniteam presidential and vice presidential candidates despite the fact that the vote of the people in Iloilo went to Vice President Leni Robredo.

text: Sa 42 ka mga banwa kag component city sa probinsya, daog si presumptive President Bongbong Marcos sa Barotac Nuevo, Guimbal, Anilao, Sara, Estancia, kag Passi City.
english: Of the 42 towns and component cities in the province, presumptive President Bongbong Marcos won in Barotac Nuevo, Guimbal, Anilao, Sara, Estancia, and Passi City.

text: Suno kay Biron nga amo ang campaign manager sang Uniteam sa Iloilo, daog man si leading vice presidential candidate Sara Duterte-Carpio sa bilog nga kuarto distrito.
english: According to Biron, who is the campaign manager of Uniteam in Iloilo, leading vice presidential candidate Sara Duterte-Carpio also won the entire four districts.

text: Sa kuarto distrito man may pinakagamay nga abanse si Robredo kay Marcos.
english: In the fourth district, Robredo also has the smallest lead over Marcos.

text: Sa kabilugan nga probinsya sang Iloilo, pierde si Marcos kay Robredo.
english: In the entire province of Iloilo, Marcos lost to Robredo.

text: Nakakuha si Marcos sang 374,144 votes samtang si Robredo ang nakakuha sang 579,525 votes.
english: Marcos got 374,144 votes while Robredo got 579,525 votes.

text: Nakuha sang 28-anyos nga Pinoy pole vault star nga si Ernest John “EJ” Obiena sa 2024 Lausanne Diamond League sa Switzerland ang medalya nga ginhandum kag gindumtan sini nga mabulsa kuntani sa Paris Olympics.
english: 28-year-old Pinoy pole vault star Ernest John “EJ” Obiena won the medal he dreamed of and hated to pocket at the Paris Olympics at the 2024 Lausanne Diamond League in Switzerland.

text: Halos pareho nga pole vaulters ang nakasumpong ni Obiena sa amo nga kumpetisyon nga ginpatigayon masobra isa ka semana matapos nagtakop ang Summer Games.
english: Obiena faced almost the same pole vaulters in the competition, which was held more than a week after the Summer Games ended.

text: Bronze medalist ang Pinoy pride kaupod kanday Sondre Guttormsen sang Norway kag Kurtis Marschall sang Australia matapos na-clear ang 5.82 meters sa una nga attempt apang wala na na-clear ang 5.92 sa tatlo ka attempts.
english: Pinoy pride was a bronze medalist along with Sondre Guttormsen of Norway and Kurtis Marschall of Australia after clearing 5.82 meters in the first attempt but failing to clear 5.92 in three attempts.

text: Ang Olympic bronze medalist nga si Emmanouil Karalis sang Greece ang nagpang-anum lamang nga may yara man sang clearance nga 5.82-meters apang mas manubo ang iya puwesto bangud nakalukso ini sa bar sa iya second attempt kag napaslawan sa 5.92 sa tatlo gid ka beses.
english: Olympic bronze medalist Emmanouil Karalis of Greece finished sixth with a clearance of 5.82-meters but placed lower as he jumped the bar on his second attempt and failed at 5.92 on three occasions.

text: Wala naman sang nakibot sang nagpanguna sa tournament ang world number one kag reigning Olympic champion nga si Armand “Mondo” Duplantis sang Sweden samtang nagpangaduha naman ang Paris silver medalist nga si Sam Kendricks sang United States.
english: No one was surprised when world number one and reigning Olympic champion Armand “Mondo” Duplantis of Sweden topped the tournament while Paris silver medalist Sam Kendricks of the United States came second.

text: Matandaan nga sa Paris Games, pareho sanday Obiena kag Karalis nga may clearance nga 5.90 meters apang nagkadto sa Greek pole vault star ang medalya bangud sa tiebreaker.
english: It can be recalled that at the Paris Games, both Obiena and Karalis had a clearance of 5.90 meters but the medal went to the Greek pole vault star due to the tiebreaker.

text: Kasunod sang Olympiada, nakabalik pa si Obiena sa Manila apang pila ka adlaw gid lamang ang iya gindugay bangud nagbalik ini sa Italya para magsabak liwat sa training para sa palaabuton sini nga mga kumpetisyon.
english: After the Olympiad, Obiena returned to Manila but only lasted a few days because he returned to Italy to prepare again for training for his upcoming competitions.

text: Nagapabilin sa high alert status ang mga kapulisan sa Iloilo City para sa paalabuton nga selebrasyon sang Bag-ong Tuig.
english: Police in Iloilo City remain on high alert status for the upcoming New Year celebration.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay PMAJ.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, PMAJ.

text: Shella Mae Sangrines, spokesperson sang Iloilo City Police Office, may ara sang consistent deployment sang mga kapulisan kag mobile patrol nga magalibot sa syudad para sa seguridad sang publiko.
english: Shella Mae Sangrines, spokesperson of the Iloilo City Police Office, said there is a consistent deployment of police and mobile patrols that will patrol the city for public safety.

text: Suno kay Sangrines, nagapakig-angot man sila sa mga barangay officials agud madugangan ang pwersa sa pagbantay sa mga dalanon kag sa mga puwesto nga posible halinan sang mga insidente.
english: Sangrines said they are also liaising with barangay officials to increase the force to guard the roads and places that may be the source of incidents.

text: Ginahingyo man ang mga ginikanan nga bantayan ang ila mga kabataan agud malikawan ang bisan ano nga disgrasya ukon peligro.
english: Parents are also urged to keep an eye on their children to avoid any mishap or danger.

text: Dugang pa niya nga bisan may kapulisan nga nagabantay, kinahanglan gihapon nga ang mga pumuluyo mangin disiplinado kag alerto.
english: He added that even with police on duty, residents still need to be disciplined and alert.

text: Ginapasugtan man nga maglagaw sa gab-i ang mga menor-de-edad, apang kinahanglan nga may upod ang mga ini nga ila nga mga guardian.
english: Minors are also allowed to walk at night, but they must be accompanied by their guardians.

text: 𝗕𝗜𝗖𝗢𝗟 — Maid-id na nga nagapreparar si Blessie Mae Abagat, singer nga taga-Camaligan, Camarines Sur para sa State of the Nation Address (SONA) ni Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Jr sa Lunes, Hulyo 22.
english: 𝗕𝗜𝗖𝗢𝗟 — Blessie Mae Abagat, singer from Camaligan, Camarines Sur, is already preparing for President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.'s State of the Nation Address (SONA) on Monday, July 22.

text: Si Blessie nagapaidalom sa maid-id nga paghanas agud nga magkanta sang pungsodnon nga ambahanon.
english: Blessie undergoes rigorous training in order to sing the national anthem.

text: Ang 27-anyos nga singer ang paga-coach sang iya mga trainers halin sa World Championship of Performing Arts (WCOPA) Philippines.
english: The 27-year-old singer will be coached by her trainers from the World Championship of Performing Arts (WCOPA) Philippines.

text: Suno kay Blessie, wala gid niya ginhuna-huna nga siya ang mapilian nga magkanta sang national anthem sa SONA sa atubang sang mga nagapanguna nga lideres sang pungsod.
english: Blessie said she never thought she would be chosen to sing the national anthem at the SONA in front of the country's top leaders.

text: Nakibot man ini sang gin-message siya ni Miguel isa sa mga provincial directors sang WCOPA Philippines, nga nagsiling nga i-block niya ang July 22 para sa SONA nga wala gilayon nag sink in sa iya nga siya ang napili sa pagkanta sang national anthem para sa SONA ni Presidente Marcos.
english: He was also surprised when Miguel, one of the provincial directors of WCOPA Philippines, messaged him, saying he would block July 22 for the SONA, which did not immediately sink in with him that he was chosen to sing the national anthem for President Marcos' SONA.

text: Suno kay WCOPA Philippines Creative Director Annie Mercado, ginhingyo ni Undersecretary for Broadcast Production Franz Gerard Imperial si WCOPA Philippines National Director Gerry Mercado nga ihatag ang mga pangalan sang mga gold medalists gikan sa kompetisyon, lakip na si Blessie nga gin-handpick pagkatapos sang maid-id nga pagbinagbinag.
english: According to WCOPA Philippines Creative Director Annie Mercado, Undersecretary for Broadcast Production Franz Gerard Imperial asked WCOPA Philippines National Director Gerry Mercado to provide the names of the gold medalists from the competition, including Blessie who was handpicked after careful consideration.

text: Si Blessie isa ka multi-awarded nga artista nga nagdala sang madamo nga mga medalya gikan sa prestihiyoso nga internasyonal nga kompetisyon.
english: Blessie is a multi-awarded artist who has brought home numerous medals from the prestigious international competition.

text: Lakip sa sini ang 2024 Division Medal Champion para sa Vocal Pop nga kategorya, bulawan nga medalya para sa Vocal Gospel, Vocal Contemporary, Vocal World, kag Vocal Broadway.
english: These include 2024 Division Medal Champion for the Vocal Pop category, gold medals for Vocal Gospel, Vocal Contemporary, Vocal World, and Vocal Broadway.

text: Isa man siya ka semifinalist, nga nakakuha sang pilak nga medalya sa kategorya sang Vocal Gospel.
english: She was also a semifinalist, winning a silver medal in the Vocal Gospel category.

text: Nagapasalamat naman si Blessie sa iya mga kaupdanan kag mga trainers sa WCOPA sa pagbulig sa iya nga mapilian nga magkanta sa SONA.
english: Blessie thanked her colleagues and trainers at WCOPA for helping her be selected to sing in the SONA.

text: Dako man ang pagpasalamat sang natungdan sa iya nga mga coaches bangud sila ang nangin palaagyan agud makita siya kag mapili nga bilang isa ka probinsyana, nagahandum lamang ni nga magperform internationally.
english: She also expressed her gratitude to her coaches because they were the means for her to be seen and selected as a provincial, she only dreams of performing internationally.

text: Bag-o kita magtulog sang lamharon ang aton edad, nakahiligan naton maghampang sang pillow fight ukon paghampakanay ukon habuyanay gamit ang ulonan.
english: Before we go to bed when we are young, we like to play pillow fight or hit each other or throw pillows.

text: Apang sa pungsod Japan, makabig kana nga isa ka atleta kun sagad ka sa pillow fight.
english: But in Japan, you're considered an athlete if you're good at pillow fights.

text: Ginakabig man ini nga national sport sa nasambit nga pungsod sa diin bisan ano pa ang edad, pwede maka-intra sa hampang para sa premyo nga kwarta kag kasikatan.
english: It is also considered the national sport in the country where no matter the age, you can participate in the game for prize money and fame.

text: Pagkatapos sang regional qualifying events, nagatipon ang winning teams sa small fishing town sang Ito, sa nabagatnan sang Tokyo agud mag-compete sa All-Japan Pillow Fighting Championships para sa titulo nga Japan’s best pillow fighters.
english: After the regional qualifying events, the winning teams gather in the small fishing town of Ito, south of Tokyo to compete in the All-Japan Pillow Fighting Championships for the title of Japan’s best pillow fighters.

text: ANG ISA KA bumalasa sang aton kolum diri (April 25, 2018) luyag gid sang “otorisado” nga pagpaathag kon ano gid ang generic drug nga ginasulat naton diri sa pila na ka beses.
english: A reader of our column here (April 25, 2018) really wants an “authorized” explanation of what the generic drug is that we have been writing about here for several times.

text: Admitido naton nga indi kita makapaathag nga may otoridad (authority) gid bahin sa generic drug.
english: We admit that we cannot explain that there is authority regarding generic drugs.

text: Ina tungod indi kita doctor sa Pharmacology, ukon kapareho nga espesyalista, kag kon may ginasulat kita diri parti sa generic drug ina sa aton lang ordinary nga paghangop.
english: That's because we are not doctors in Pharmacology, or similar specialists, and if we write here about generic drugs it is in our ordinary understanding.

text: Tungod sini, ginhimud-usan ta gid nga makapangita sang nagakaigo nga source agud masabat ang luyag sang aton bumalasa.
english: Therefore, we have made every effort to find the appropriate source to meet the needs of our readers.

text: Salamat kay sang sini lang nakakita gid man kita sang otorisado nga source sa internet.
english: Thankfully, we recently found an authorized source on the internet.

text: Ining source naton amo si Dr. Ananya Mandal, isa ka doctor sa Pharmacology kag Associate Professor sa Pharmacology sang Bankura Sammilanin Medical College.
english: This source is Dr. Ananya Mandal, a doctor of Pharmacology and Associate Professor of Pharmacology of Bankura Sammilanin Medical College.

text: Konektado man ini siya sa West Bengal Medical Education Service (Hospital and Health Care) sa Kolkata Area, India.
english: He is also associated with West Bengal Medical Education Service (Hospital and Health Care) in Kolkata Area, India.

text: Sa nahibal-an ta na, ang India kilala sa kalibutan sa pag-manufacture sang masaligan kag mas barato nga mga generic drugs.
english: As we already know, India is known in the world for manufacturing reliable and cheaper generic drugs.

text: Kilala man si Dr. Mandal bilang manunulat sang mga health articles, reviewer sang medical journals, ga-analisa kag ga-edit sang mga medical documents, kag sa pag-organisa sang mga Medical Education Program.
english: Also known as Dr. Mandal as a writer of health articles, reviewer of medical journals, analyzing and editing medical documents, and in organizing Medical Education Programs.

text: Ang pila ka mga medical journal nga ginsalig kay Dr. Mandal bilang peer reviewer nagalakip sang Journal of Clinical Diagnostics and Research, International Journal of Applied and Basic Medical Research, Journal of Pharmacology and Pharmaceuticals, kag iban pa.
english: Several medical journals entrusted to Drs. Mandal as peer reviewer includes Journal of Clinical Diagnostics and Research, International Journal of Applied and Basic Medical Research, Journal of Pharmacology and Pharmaceuticals, among others.

text: Ang Pharmacology gali, sa diin si Dr. Mandal isa ka espesyalista, isa ka siyensya kag pagtuon sa kapuslanan sang mga biochemical properties sang mga buhi nga mga bagay (living organisms) angot sa pagdiskubre sang mga bulong.
english: Pharmacology, where Dr. Mandal is a specialist, a science and study of the usefulness of the biochemical properties of living organisms in connection with the discovery of drugs.

text: Sa sining aton karon nahibal-an kay Dr. Mandal, ang iya kwalipikasyon sobrante na seguro agud masaligan ta siya sa paghatag sing otorisado nga panugdaon parti sa mga generic drugs.
english: From what we now know about Dr. Mandal, his qualifications are probably too much for us to trust him to give authorized advice on generic drugs.

text:
***

Sunu kay Dr. Mandal sa iya sinulatan (Drug Patents and Generic Pharmaceutical Drugs) sa News Medical Life Sciences nga gin-update sadtong Setyembre 8, 2014, ang isa ka bulong sa masami gina-aplayan ini sing patent.
english:
***

According to Dr. Mandal in his article (Drug Patents and Generic Pharmaceutical Drugs) in News Medical Life Sciences updated on September 8, 2014, a drug is usually applied for a patent.

text: Kag kon aprubado na, puede na ibaligya ini sa idalom sang isa ka brand name, ukon rehistrado nga trademark, sang pharmaceutical company nga nag-develop sini.
english: And once approved, it can be sold under a brand name, or registered trademark, of the pharmaceutical company that developed it.

text: Ang patent sa bulong, sunu pa gid kay Dr. Mandal, amo ini ang nagahatag sing eksclusibo nga kinamatarong sa pharmaceutical company sa pag-manufacture kag pagbaligya sang bulong agud makaganar man sa ila kinabudlayan sa pag-develop sang ila nadiskubrihan nga bulong.
english: The patent on the drug, according to Dr. Mandal, it gives the pharmaceutical company the exclusive right to manufacture and sell the drug in order to profit from their hard work in developing the discovered drug.

text: Sa masami (sa Estados Unidos kag sa Pilipinas), ang drug patent gina-award sa sulod sang 20 anyos.
english: Usually (both in the United States and in the Philippines), a drug patent is awarded for 20 years.

text: Kon mag-expire na ang patent period, puede na ang bulong ma-manufacture kag ibaligya sang iban nga kumpaniya.
english: When the patent period expires, the drug can be manufactured and sold by other companies.

text: Sa ina nga tion, siling ni Dr. Mandal, ang bulong ginakilala na nga isa ka generic drug.
english: At the time, Drs. Mandal, the drug is now recognized as a generic drug.

text: Bilang generic drug, ginakilala ini bilang isa gid lang sa grupo sang mga bulong.
english: As a generic drug, it is recognized as just one of a group of drugs.

text: Indi na ini protektado bilang specific trademark ukon brand name, kag sa masami nagadala gid lang sang ngalan nga ihatag sang generic drug manufacturer.
english: It is no longer protected as a specific trademark or brand name, and usually carries only the name that the generic drug manufacturer will give it.

text: Sa tion nga yara na sa merkado ining generic drug, sunu kay Dr. Mandal, ang monopoliya sa pag-manufacture kag pagbaligya sang bulong madula na.
english: Once the generic drug is on the market, Dr. Mandal, the monopoly on manufacturing and selling of medicine will be abolished.

text: Tungod sini, ang interesado nga mga kumpaniya sa pag-manufacture sang generic drug maga-kumpetensyahanay na.
english: As a result, interested companies in the manufacture of generic drugs will compete with each other.

text: Ining kumpetensyahanay, dugang ni Dr. Mandal, maga-resulta sa pagnubo sang presyo sang generic drug agud puede na mabakal sing mas barato sang mga kubos kag sang gobyerno mismo agud mahatag sing malapnagon sa mga pumuluyo.
english: This competition, added Dr. Mandal, will result in a reduction in the price of generic drugs so that they can be purchased cheaper by the poor and the government itself to be distributed widely to the people.

text: Luas sa kumpetensya, ang mga manufacturer sang generic drug makabaligya man sang mas barato tungod wala man sila dapat bawion nga gasto sa research kag iban pa nga kabudlayan sa pag-develop sang orihinal nga bulong.
english: In addition to competition, generic drug manufacturers can also sell cheaper because they do not have to recover the cost of research and other difficulties in developing the original drug.

text: Tungod ang generic drug kopya lang sang patented nga bulong, sunu pa gid kay Dr.Mandal, dapat nga pareho gid ini sang patented nga bulong sa tanan nga bagay (lakip sa dosage, efficacy, kag safety).
english: Since the generic drug is just a copy of the patented drug, according to Dr. Mandal, it should be the same as the patented drug in all respects (including dosage, efficacy, and safety).

text: Sa karon, ang guidelines sa generic drug sang US Food and Drugs Administration ang ginasunod sang madamo nga pungsod, lakip na ang FDA sang Pilipinas.
english: Currently, the US Food and Drugs Administration's generic drug guidelines are followed by many countries, including the Philippine FDA.

text: Kabay nga naathagan ta sing lubos ang nangutana sa sining kolum parti sa “otorisado” nga pagpaathag sa generic drug.
english: Hopefully we have fully clarified the questioner in this column about the “authorized” definition of generic drug.

text: Ang pagpadulong sa ospital ukon sa aton doktor ang isa lang sa pamaagi agud nga mahibaluan naton ang aton balatian ukon nabatyagan.
english: Going to the hospital or our doctor is just one way to know our illness or feeling.

text: Sa Ohio, USA, may isa ka 19 anyos nga babaye nga nagpa-check up sa ospital sa pagpati nga may yara siya sang balatian nga appendicitis matapos nagpalanakit ang iya kilid kag likod.
english: In Ohio, USA, a 19-year-old woman went to the hospital for a check-up believing she had appendicitis after she felt pain in her side and back.

text: Apang tuman na lang ang kakibot niya sang nahibal-an nga nagabusong siya kag lapit na lang magbata.
english: But she was shocked to learn that she was pregnant and about to give birth.

text: Siya amo si Nadia Rhoads, kag regular nga nagainom sang birth control ukon pills.
english: She is Nadia Rhoads, and regularly takes birth control or pills.

text: Pahayag niya, halos wala man nagahabok ang iya nga tyan kag gina-abtan pa siya sang iya menstruation kada bulan rason nga daw indi siya makapati sa natukiban sang doktor.
english: She said her stomach almost never swells and she still gets her menstruation every month so she can't believe what the doctor found.

text: Sa pihak sini, normal man ang iya nangin pagbun-ag sa anak nga babaye nga may kabug-aton nga 6 pound kag 11 ounces.
english: Meanwhile, she gave birth normally to her daughter weighing 6 pounds and 11 ounces.

text: Wala man si Nadia nakahanda nga mangin isa ka iloy, apang sa bulig sang iya boyfriend kag iloy, amat-amat man niya nga nabaton ang grasya nga nag-abot sa iya kabuhi.
english: Nadia was not prepared to be a mother, but with the help of her boyfriend and mother, she gradually accepted the grace that came into her life.

text: ILOILO CITY-Ginplastar ni Gymnastics Association of the Philippines (GAP) president Cynthia Carrion ang mga pagpanghanda sang federation para sa Los Angeles Olympics sa 2028 sa paglaum nga masundan ang kadalag-an ni Carlos Yulo sa Paris.
english: ILOILO CITY-Gymnastics Association of the Philippines (GAP) president Cynthia Carrion laid out the federation's preparations for the Los Angeles Olympics in 2028 in the hope of following Carlos Yulo's victory in Paris.

text: Suno kay Carrion, plano nila nga mag-hire sang foreign coach nga sarang mag-uyat kay Yulo kag sa bug-os nga gymnastics team para sa masunod nga edition sang Summer Games sa United States.
english: Carrion said they plan to hire a foreign coach who can handle Yulo and the entire gymnastics team for the next edition of the Summer Games in the United States.

text: Nahibaluan nga indi na bag-o ang pag-hire sang foreign coach para sa asosasyon.
english: It is known that hiring a foreign coach is not new for the association.

text: Sang 2013, gin-tap sang gymnastics body ang services ni Japanese mentor Munehiro Kugimiya, nga nagbulig kay Yulo agud magiyahan ini para sa iya career tubtob nga nagseparar ang ila banas.
english: In 2013, the gymnastics body tapped the services of Japanese mentor Munehiro Kugimiya, who helped Yulo guide her for her career until their paths diverged.

text: Sa idalom ni Kugimiya, si Yulo nakadaug sang pila ka titles,kalakip na ang duha ka gold medals sa World Championships kag multiple titles sa SEA Games.
english: Under Kugimiya, Yulo won several titles,including two gold medals at the World Championships and multiple titles at the SEA Games.

text: Sunod nga nagdesisyon ang GAP nga mag-hire sang local coach nga magagiya kay Yulo para sa iya Olympic journey sa Paris kaupod ang Filipino tactician Aldrin Castaneda.
english: GAP next decided to hire a local coach to guide Yulo for his Olympic journey in Paris alongside Filipino tactician Aldrin Castaneda.

text: Ini nagbunga sang maayo nga resulta bangud sa pagdaug ni Yulo sang duha ka gold medals sa floor exercise kag vault.
english: This paid off with Yulo winning two gold medals in the floor exercise and vault.

text: Ang tikang nga ini magapreparar sa GAP sa misyon nga magpadala sang team sa LA 2028.
english: The move will prepare GAP for the mission to send a team to LA 2028.

text: Gina-target man ni Carrion nga ilakip ang manghud ni Yulo nga si Eldrew nga isa man ka promising gymnast.
english: Carrion is also targeting to include Yulo’s younger brother, Eldrew, who is also a promising gymnast.

text: Nakumpirma sa toxicology report sang Philippine National Police (PNP) nga nagpositibo sa antidepressant drug ang bangkay ni anay Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Undersecretary Catalina Cabral.
english: The toxicology report of the Philippine National Police (PNP) confirmed that the body of former Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Undersecretary Catalina Cabral tested positive for antidepressant drugs.

text: Sa resulta naman sang histopathological exam, wala sang abnormalities ukon terminal diseases ang anay opisyal.
english: The results of the histopathological exam showed that the former officer had no abnormalities or terminal diseases.

text: Nag-match man ang iya nga fingerprint sa nauna na naggwa nga imbestigasyon.
english: His fingerprint also matched the previous investigation.

text: Antes ang resulta sang toxicology report, una na nga ginkumpirma sang kapulisan nga may na-recover nga kutsilyo kag bulong sa hotel room nga gintiniran ni Cabral.
english: Before the result of the toxicology report, police had already confirmed that a knife and pills were recovered from the hotel room where Cabral stayed.

text: “‘Yong knife for self protection or panggamit niya lang inside the bag while the medication we secured, we put that into study that’s why during the conduct of autopsy we also took tissues so that we can study if these medications were used,” suno kay acting PNP chief Jose Nartatez, Jr.
english: “‘Young knife for self protection or panggam iya lang lang inside the bag while the medication we secured, we put that into study that’s why during the conduct of autopsy we also took tissues so that we can study if these medications were used,” said acting PNP chief Jose Nartatez, Jr.

text: Huwebes sang gab-i sang nasapwan ang lawas ni Cabral sa idalom sang pil-as sa Kennon Road sa Tuba, Benguet.
english: Cabral's body was found under a cliff on Kennon Road in Tuba, Benguet on Thursday night.

text: Ginpahayag sang Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) nga base sa autopsy, wala nakitaan nga may foul play sa kamatayon sini — wala sang senyales nga nagbato ini, wala sang skin cells sa iya nga fingerprints, kag wala man sang bala ukon samad sa iya lawas nga nagapatimaan nga ginsakit siya ukon gintiro.
english: The Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) said that based on the autopsy, no foul play was found in his death — there were no signs of throwing stones, no skin cells on his fingerprints, and no bullets or wounds on his body that indicated he was tortured or shot.

text: Nahibaluan nga isa si Cabral sa na-implicate sa flood control corruption kag isa sa ginapatihan nga may daku kuntani nga inugbulgar sa nagakatabo nga eskandalo sa ahensya.#
english: It is learned that Cabral is one of those implicated in flood control corruption and one of those believed to have a big expose in the ongoing scandal in the agency.

text: Regular bala ang imo pagpamuhin ?
english: Do you exercise regularly?

text: Ang normal nga pagpamuhin ang tubtob lamang sa tatlo ka beses sa isa ka adlaw.
english: Normal exercise is only up to three times a day.

text: Suno kay Dr. Endymion Tan, infectious disease specialist, makabig nga delikado ang pagpamus-on kun maglapaw sa tatlo ka beses kada adlaw kag likido na ang nagaguwa nga higko.
english: According to Dr. Endymion Tan, infectious disease specialist, said it is considered dangerous to defecate more than three times a day and the stool comes out liquid.

text: Dugang pa ni Tan, kun masobra sa tatlo ka beses nga pagpamus-on mahimo ini nga magtuga sang dehydration.
english: Tan added that if you drink more than three times, it can cause dehydration.

text: Bangud may yara sang kahigayunan ang diarrhea ukon ang tuman nga pagpamus-on ang nagatuga sang dehydration, importante gid ang pag-inom sang madamo nga tubig.
english: Because there is a chance that diarrhea or excessive sweating can cause dehydration, it is important to drink plenty of water.

text: Panugyan sang eksperto, mas maayo nga indi anay mag inom sang bulong nga nagapauntat sa pagpamuhin ilabi na kun ang rason sang diarrhea amo ang bakterya.
english: Experts advise that it is better not to take diarrhea medication especially if the cause of diarrhea is bacteria.

text: May gindugang ang Food and Drug Administration (FDA) nga mga bulong sa lista sang VAT-exempt medicines.
english: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has added some drugs to the list of VAT-exempt medicines.

text:
Suno sa advisory sang ahensya, yari ang ila bag-o nga ginbutang sa listahan:

Cancer Medicine

Degarelix: Freeze-dried powder for solution for injection (80 mg and 120 mg)Tremelimumab: Concentrate for solution for infusion (25 mg/1.25 mL, 20 mg/mL)

Diabetes Medicine

Sitagliptin: Film-coated tablet (25 mg, 50 mg, 100 mg)Sitagliptin (as hydrochloride) + Metformin Hydrochloride: Film-coated tablet (50 mg/1 g, 50 mg/850 mg)Sitagliptin (as hydrochloride monohydrate): Film-coated tablet (25 mg, 50 mg)Linagliptin: Film-coated tablet (5 mg)

Medicine for Mental Illness

Clomipramine Hydrochloride: Film-coated tablet (25 mg)Chlorpromazine (as hydrochloride): Tablet (200 mg)Midazolam: Film-coated tablet (15 mg)

Ginpaathag naman ni FDA spokesperson Atty. Pamela Sevilla nga ini nga mga bag-o nga mga bulong nga gindugang sa lista ang gindesisyunan sang mga tiglawas sang FDA, Department of Health (DOH), Department of Finance, kag Bureau of Internal Revenue matapos nga ang business nag-apply para sa VAT-exempt sa ila kumpaniya.
english:
According to the agency’s advisory, here are their new additions to the list:

Cancer Medicine

Degarelix: Freeze-dried powder for solution for injection (80 mg and 120 mg)Tremelimumab: Concentrate for solution for infusion (25 mg/1.25 mL, 20 mg/mL)

Diabetes Medicine

Sitagliptin: Film-coated tablet (25 mg, 50 mg, 100 mg)Sitagliptin (as hydrochloride) + Metformin Hydrochloride: Film-coated tablet (50 mg/1 g, 50 mg/850 mg)Sitagliptin (as hydrochloride monohydrate): Film-coated tablet (25 mg) tablet (5 mg)

Medicine for Mental Illness

Clomipramine Hydrochloride: Film-coated tablet (25 mg)Chlorpromazine (as hydrochloride): Tablet (200 mg)Midazolam: Film-coated tablet (15 mg)

FDA spokesperson Atty. Pamela Sevilla said these new drugs added to the list were decided by representatives of the FDA, Department of Health (DOH), Department of Finance, and Bureau of Internal Revenue after the business applied for VAT-exempt in their company.

text: “VAT exempt medicines is in line with our national internal revenue code po or tax code, which was amended by our train law, and was eventually amended by the CREATE law,” suno kay Sevilla.
english: “VAT exempt medicines is in line with our national internal revenue code po or tax code, which was amended by our train law, and was eventually amended by the CREATE law,” according to Sevilla.

text: Regular ang pag-update sa listahan suno sa natungdan kag may iban naman nga bulong nga ginakakas na.
english: The list is updated regularly, he said, and there are other drugs that are being removed.

text: Sang Agusto, nag-anunsyo man ang FDA sang 15 cancer, high cholesterol, hypertension, kag mental illness medicines bilang VAT-exempt.
english: In August, the FDA also announced 15 cancer, high cholesterol, hypertension, and mental illness medicines as VAT-exempt.

text: INDI lang ang kakulang sang generic drugs ang rason kon ngaa madamo pa sa aton mga pumuluyo ang wala nagagamit sang generic drugs agud itambal sa ila mga balatian.
english: The lack of generic drugs is not the only reason why many of our citizens do not use generic drugs to treat their illnesses.

text: Sa madamo pa nga rason.
english: For many other reasons.

text: Ang isa ka rason amo nga madamo pa sa aton ang wala sing salig sa pagka-epektibo (efficacy) kag kon bala hilway sa katalagman (safe) ang paggamit sini.
english: One reason is that many of us still lack confidence in its efficacy and safety.

text: In fact, ang gobyerno mismo ang isa sang mga rason kon ngaa wala sing pagsaligs a generic drugs ang pila naton ka mga kauturan, labi na gid ang makasarang magbakal sang mas mahal nga brandname, ukon branded, nga mga bulong.
english: In fact, the government itself is one of the reasons why some of our brothers and sisters do not trust generic drugs, especially those who can afford to buy more expensive brandname, or branded, drugs.

text: Ina tungod sa pagsulundan nga ginamando sang gobyerno sa mga doktor kon maghatag sila sang prescription (reseta) sa ila mga pasyente.
english: That's because of the rules that the government mandates for doctors when they give prescriptions to their patients.

text: Ang aton mga doktor gina-obligar sa pagpahayag sa reseta sang branded nga bulong nga luyag nila i-rekomendar, apang kaupod sini ang generic names ang bulong.
english: Our doctors are required to state on the prescription the branded drug they wish to recommend, but along with that comes the generic names the drug.

text: Kag tungod ang branded nga mga bulong ang una nga gina-rekomendar sang doktor, ang pagpati sang madamo nga ang gina-rekomendar sang doctor nga branded nga bulong amo gid ang mas mayo sang sa ang barato nga generic drug.
english: And since branded drugs are the first to be recommended by the doctor, many believe that the doctor-recommended branded drug is actually better than the cheap generic drug.

text: In fact, ara sa aton kultura ang pagpati nga kon mas mahal gani ang isa ka produkto ina ang mas maayo, kag ang baratuhon pigaw ini.
english: In fact, it is in our culture to believe that the more expensive a product is, the better it is, and the cheaper it is.

text: Ejemplo lang sa paggamit sang cellphone.
english: Just an example of using a cellphone.

text: Kon mahal ang bili sini, segurado nga mas madamo ini sing feature nga magamit sa madamo nga bagay sang sa baratuhon.
english: If it's expensive, it's sure to have more features that can be used in many ways than a cheaper one.

text: Ina man bala ang matuod sa tunga sang branded nga bulong kag ang generic sini?
english: Is that also true between a branded drug and its generic?

text: Daw amo gid seguro sa pila naton nga mga kauturan.
english: Some of our brothers and sisters may feel that way.

text: In fact, amo ina ang pagpati sang tatlo ka kostumer nga kadungan ko sa botika nga ginbaklan ko sang akon bulong sadtong Lunes.
english: In fact, that's what three customers who were with me at the pharmacy where I bought my medicine on Monday believed.

text: Samtang ang ginbakal ko amo ang generic nga bulong, ang tatlo ko nga kadungan nagpahibalo gid nga ang ila baklon amo ang branded nga bulong.
english: While I bought the generic drug, my three contemporaries made it very clear that they were going to buy the branded drug.

text: Ang isa nagpamangkot pa gani sa gabantay sa botika kon bala mas mayo gid man baklon ang branded drug sang sa generic, samtang ginpahibalo na niya nga branded ang iya baklon.
english: One even asked the pharmacy guard if it was better to buy a branded drug than a generic one, while he had already announced that he was buying a branded one.

text: Wala makasabat ang bantay kag nagyuhom lang.
english: The guard couldn't answer and just smiled.

text: Kon ngaa, wala ako makahibalo.
english: Why, I don’t know.

text: Indi ayhan tungod sala ang pagpati sang kostumer nga mas mayo nga bulong ang branded?
english: Isn't it because the customer mistakenly believes that branded medicine is better?

text: Ukon wala gid man siya itugda kay nagabaligya man lang siya kag wala sing hinalung-ong sang esensya (essential elements) sang branded ukon generic nga bulong?
english: Or was he never suggested because he was just selling and didn't know the essential elements of the branded or generic drug?

text: Ti, ano gid bala ang matuod?
english: Well, what exactly is true?

text: Sunu sa Generics Law wala sing dapat mangin diperensya sa tunga sang branded kag generic nga bulong.
english: According to the Generics Law there should be no difference between branded and generic medicine.

text: In fact, ginaseguro gid sang Food and Drug Administration (FDA) sa Pilipinas nga ang mga generic nga mga bulong nga ginabaligya sa mga botika – luas sa mga peke nga mga bulong, nga mahibal-an man sang FDA – pareho lang sing esensya sa branded nga bulong.
english: In fact, the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) in the Philippines ensures that generic drugs sold in pharmacies – except for counterfeit drugs, which the FDA can also detect – are essentially the same as the branded drug.

text: Upodsa  FDA sang Estados Unidos, ang FDA sang Pilipinas gapaseguro nga ang mga generic drugs sa aton pungsod may pareho nga “performance and quality” sa branded nga bulong.
english: Together with the US FDA, the Philippine FDA ensures that generic drugs in our country have the same “performance and quality” as branded drugs.

text: In other words, ang mga generic nga bulong nga ginahatag naton sa aton mga kubos nga pumuluyo wala sing pagka-lain sa mga branded nga mga bulong nga luyag baklon sang aton pumuluyo nga makasarang sunu sa pag-reseta sang ila mga doktor.
english: In other words, the generic medicines that we give to our poor people are no different from the branded medicines that our people who can afford them want to buy according to the prescription of their doctors.

text: Tungod sini, ang dapat lang himuon naton amo nga seguruhon, sa bahin sang FDA, nga ang tanan nga generic drugs nga gina-manufacture diri sa Pilipinas, lakip ang gina-import diri sa aton, na-inspection sang FDA sing tul-id agud maseguro nga ang ginatomar nga bulong sang aton mga pumuluyo amo gid ang husto nga bulong.
english: Therefore, all we have to do is ensure, on the part of the FDA, that all generic drugs manufactured here in the Philippines, including those imported here to us, are inspected by the FDA properly to ensure that the medicine taken by our people is the right medicine.

text: Dapat man nga ang FDA magpahibalo sang nagakaigu sa mga pumuluyo sining kamatuoran nga wala sing kinalain ang branded sa generic nga bulong, kay amo gid ang otorisado sa pag-deklarar sini.
english: The FDA should also properly inform the public of the fact that there is no difference between a branded and a generic drug, as it is authorized to declare it.

text: Manami sa ikaayong lawas kag madamo ang benepisyo sa lawas sang isa ka tawo ang pagkaon kag pag-inom sang ano man nga sahi sang soybeans product.
english: Eating and drinking any kind of soybeans product is good for health and has many benefits for the human body.

text: Santu sa pagtuon sang Institute of Plant Breeding sang University of the Philippines Los Banos (IPB-UPLB) sa pagpanguna ni  Elmer Enicola, ang soybeans ang may mataas nga protina kag calcium, may yara man ini sang omera 3, fiber kag iban pa.
english: According to a study by the Institute of Plant Breeding of the University of the Philippines Los Banos (IPB-UPLB) led by Elmer Enicola, soybeans are high in protein and calcium, they also contain omera 3, fiber and others.

text: Ginpaathag naman ni Enicola nga wala sang kamatuoran kag wala sang scientific studies ang nagapamatuod nga nagaresulta sang balatian nga gout ang pagkaon sang soybeans.
english: Enicola explained that there is no truth and no scientific studies that prove that eating soybeans causes gout.

text: Ginpaathag ni Enicola nga ang gout ang gikan sa pagdamo sang uric acid sa dugo nga nagikan sa fluid pinaagi dang mga joints gikan sa waste products nga halin sa metabolism sang purines.
english: Enicola explained that gout is caused by an increase in uric acid in the blood from the fluid through joints from waste products from the metabolism of purines.

text: Suno kay Enicola, makuha sa pagkaon sang karne kag atay sang sapat, anchovies, sardines, mussels, bacon, scallops kag tuman nga pag-inom sang makahulubog nga ilimnon  ang purines.
english: According to Enicola, purines are obtained from eating animal meat and liver, anchovies, sardines, mussels, bacon, scallops and excessive consumption of alcoholic beverages.

text: Ang mga beans kaangay sang stringbean, chickpea, mungbean kag soyfood kaangay sang  tofu, tokwa, taho kag soymilk ang may manubo lamang nga purines content.
english: Beans like stringbean, chickpea, mungbean and soyfood like tofu, tokwa, taho and soymilk have only low purines content.

text: Dugang pa sang natungdan, ang pagkaon kag pag-inom sang soybeans product ang isa ka anti cancer kag manami man sa tul-an sang tawo.
english: He added that eating and drinking soybeans product is an anti cancer and good for human bones.

text: Magatrabaho si President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr. will work.

text: bisan sa Paskwa.
english: even at Christmas.

text: Ginpahayag ini sang Malacañang duha ka adlaw antes ang pagselebrar sang Christmas Day.
english: Malacañang made the announcement two days before the celebration of Christmas Day.

text: Suno kay Presidential Communications Office Secretary Dave Gomez, subong pa lang, gin-mobilize na ang team sang presidente agud nga ma-facilitate ang gilayon nga pagrepaso sang kantidad kag tanan nga probisyon nga nakasugtan sa bicameral conference committee session.
english: According to Presidential Communications Office Secretary Dave Gomez, the president's team has already been mobilized to facilitate the immediate review of the amount and all provisions agreed upon in the bicameral conference committee session.

text: Lantawon man sang presidente ang mga pagbag-o nga ginhimo halin sa orihinal nga ginpasa nga National Expenditure Program ukon NEP.
english: The president will also review the changes made since the originally submitted National Expenditure Program or NEP.

text: Suno sa Palasyo, ini nga maid-id nga pagrepaso amo ang magapasiguro nga magakadto sa husto ang kuwarta sang mga taxpayers.
english: According to the Palace, this thorough review will ensure that taxpayers' money goes to the right place.

text: “This thorough review will ensure that taxpayers’ money will be put to good use, contributing to the attainment of societal goals that will be felt by all Filipinos, consistent with his pronouncement in the last State of the Nation Address (SONA),” suno kay Gomez.
english: “This thorough review will ensure that taxpayers’ money will be put to good use, contributing to the attainment of societal goals that will be felt by all Filipinos, consistent with his pronouncement in the last State of the Nation Address (SONA),” according to Gomez.

text: Pareho nga nag-extend sang session ang Kamara kag ang Senado tubtub sa Disyembre 30, 2025 agud nga maratipikahan ang proposed 2026 budget nga gin-aprubahan sa bicam.
english: Both the House and Senate extended their sessions until December 30, 2025 to ratify the proposed 2026 budget that was approved in bicam.

text: Ang pagratipika sang Kamara kag Senado amo ang gina-require sa idalom sang layi antes pa man ipasa ang hagna sa lamesa sang presidente nga amo ang magapirma agud dalayon ini nga mangin layi.
english: The ratification of the House and Senate is required under the law before the bill can be passed to the desk of the president who will sign it into law.

text: Isa pinakatalalupangdon nga probisyon sa proposed P6.793-trillion nga 2026 budget amo ang pagbuhin sang pondo sang Department of Public Works and Highways.
english: One of the most notable provisions in the proposed P6.793-trillion 2026 budget is the defunding of the Department of Public Works and Highways.

text: Halin sa P880-billion, ginhimo ini nga P529.6 billion.
english: From P880-billion, it was made P529.6 billion.

text: Sang nagtuhaw ang eskandalo sa flood control kickback scheme, didto kag nag-compute liwat ang DPWH sa presyo sang nagapadayon nga mga proyekto, kag mga proyekto nga buot pa lang nga obrahon.#
english: When the flood control kickback scheme scandal broke out, the DPWH recalculated the price of ongoing projects, and projects that are just about to be done.

text: ANG aton Department of Health (DOH) naghandom sa paglakip sa health care sang tanan naton nga pumuluyo bag-o matapos ang 2016.
english: Our Department of Health (DOH) aims to include in health care all our citizens before the end of 2016.

text: Apang wala ini matuman.
english: But this was not fulfilled.

text: Sa subong gani, mga 82 ka porsyento lang sang aton mga pumuluyo ang na-enrol sa National Health Insurance sang PhilHealth.
english: Currently, only about 82 percent of our residents are enrolled in PhilHealth's National Health Insurance.

text: Tubtub subong, indi man ta gani lubos makahatag sing libre nga bulong sa aton labing kubos nga mga pumuluyo, ukon bisan maka-provide man lang sang mas barato nga bulong sa ila.
english: Until now, we have not been able to provide free medicine to our poorest people, or even provide cheaper medicine to them.

text: Tungod sini, sang sini lang, ginhandom sang aton gobyerno nga mag-import sang mga generic nga bulong sa India, sa diin kilala ini sa pagbaligya sang mas barato nga mga bulong.
english: For this reason, recently, our government dreamed of importing generic drugs to India, where it is known for selling cheaper drugs.

text: Ginhandom man gani sang gobyerno ang makig-partner sa India sa pag-producir sang generic nga mga bulong diri sa pungsod.
english: The government has even sought to partner with India in the production of generic drugs in the country.

text: Ngaa, ano gid bala ang aton problema sa bulong?
english: Why, what exactly is our problem with medicine?

text: Ang ideya sang isa ka Universal Health Care sa Pilipinas una nga gintagaan kahulugan sang Republic Act No.
english: The idea of ​​a Universal Health Care in the Philippines was first defined by Republic Act No.

text: 6675, ukon ang Generics Act of 1988 nga gin-sponsor sadto sang aton kasimanwa nga si anay congressman Narciso Monfort.
english: 6675, or the Generics Act of 1988 sponsored by our fellow citizen, former congressman Narciso Monfort.

text:
Ining Generics Law, nga sinundan sang Universally Accessible Cheaper and Quality Medicines Act of 2008,nagapasalig sa aton kubos nga mga pumuluyo agud maka-angkon sang barato nga mga bulong nga kon tawgon “generic drugs.”

Sa nahibal-an ta na, ining mga generics, luas nga mas barato ini, may kasubong man nga epekto kag hilway nga paggamit sa mga brand-name nga mga bulong.
english:
This Generics Law, followed by the Universally Accessible Cheaper and Quality Medicines Act of 2008, assures our poor citizens to have access to affordable medicines called “generic drugs.”

As we already know, these generics, besides being cheaper, have the same effect and free use as brand-name drugs.

text: Pero, natigayon gid bala ang ining handom?
english: But, was this dream really achieved?

text: Sa matuod, may problema kita gihapon sa pagpa-presyo sining mga generics nga bulong kag ang iban nga bulong nga indi generic.
english: In fact, we still have a problem with the pricing of these generics drugs and other non-generic drugs.

text: May daku man kita nga kakulangan sang mga bulong, labi na gid para sa mga kubos nga nagasalig sa libre ukon barato nga bulong sa ila mga ginabatyag, labi na gid sa tuberkulosis, pagtaas sang presyon (hypertension), kag diabetes.
english: We also have a serious shortage of medicines, especially for the poor who rely on free or cheap medicine for their illnesses, especially tuberculosis, hypertension, and diabetes.

text: Tungod sini, ginapensar na gani sang aton gobyerno, sa namitlang ko na sa ibabaw, ang makig-partner sa India nga kilala sa pagbaligya sang mga mas barato nga mga bulong.
english: Because of this, our government is even considering, as I mentioned above, partnering with India which is known for selling cheaper medicines.

text: Ga-mass produce man ini gani sang mga generics.
english: It also mass produces generics.

text:
***

Kon sa akon lang, ugaling, indi kita luyag sining pakig-partner sa India tungod patyon sini ang mga parmasyutika diri sa pungsod nga indi maka-kumpetensya sa bili kag ikasangkol sa pag-produce sang generics diri.
english:
***

In my opinion, however, we do not want this partnership with India because it will kill the pharmaceutical companies here in the country that cannot compete on price and contribute to the production of generics here.

text: Mas mayo seguro nga buligan na gid lang naton ang mga local nga parmasyutika sa kon paano sila maka-producir sang generics nga mas barato; samtang ginatugtan ang mga parmasyutika nga taga-gwa sa pag-producir sang nagapabilin nga branded nga mga bulong agud makabaligya sila sini sang barato diri man sa aton.
english: It's probably better to help local pharmaceutical companies produce generics cheaper; while allowing foreign pharmaceutical companies to produce the remaining branded drugs so that they can sell them cheaply here in our country.

text: Mahimo ta man magbulig sa mga local nga parmasyutika agud mag-producir sang mga generics paagi sa masangkad nga ihibalo sang gobyern okon paano ini sila makakinot sa ila pag-producir sang generics diri, kag sa iban pa nga paagi.
english: We can also help local pharmaceutical companies to produce generics through the government's extensive knowledge or how they can save money in their production of generics here, and in other ways.

text: Ang isa pa naton nga problema amo ang kakulangon sang supply sang bulong, labi na gid ang napatungod sa mga kubos.
english: Another problem we have is the lack of medicine supply, especially for the poor.

text: Kinahanglan dira sang gobyerno ang mas dako nga budget agud ibakal sining mga bulong.
english: The government needs a bigger budget to buy these drugs.

text: Kag tungod ang pagbakal ta sini wholesale (indi retail) daku ang aton ma-minus sa bili.
english: And because we buy it wholesale (not retail) we can reduce the price a lot.

text: Isa pa gid ka problema amo ang kakulangon sang panggastos sa pagbakal sang bulong.
english: Another problem is the lack of funds to buy medicines.

text: Mabuligan ta ini sa pagpadamo sang myembro sang PhilHealth.
english: We can help increase the number of PhilHealth members.

text: Medyo mabantayon man kita sa pag-alsa sang mga presyo sang mga basic nga kinahanglanon.
english: We are also quite cautious about the price hikes of basic necessities.

text: Ipatuman sing husto ang mga Tag Price Law kag Price Act kag iban pa nga kasuguan pabor sa mga pumuluyo.
english: Properly enforce the Tag Price Laws and Price Act and other laws in favor of the people.

text: Lagson gid sing husto ang mga naga-hoard sang bugas kag iban pa nga produkto nga kinahanglan gid sang aton mga pumuluyo.
english: Those who hoard rice and other products that our people really need will be punished.

text: Kinahanglan ta man nga engganyuhon ang mga negosyante sa pagbulig sa pag-regulate sang presyo agud indi matam-an ang aton kubos nga mga pumuluyo.
english: We must also encourage businessmen to help regulate prices so that our poor people are not overwhelmed.

text: Sa matuod, madamo pa kita sing mahimo agud masolbar ang aton problema sa bulong kag iban pa naton nga kinahanglanon.
english: In fact, there is much more we can do to solve our problem of medicine and other needs.

text: Importante lang nga sinsero kita agud masolbar ini.
english: It is only important that we are sincere in order to resolve it.

text: Wala sing lugar diri ang mga mukhang pera nga mga negosyante kag ang mga mapatumbayaon nga mga opisyales sang gobyerno.
english: There is no place for greedy businessmen and negligent government officials.

text: Masami sa aton ang mahilig nga sud-anon ang kamatis.
english: Many of us like to eat tomatoes.

text: Santu sa pagtuon sang The University of Montreal, ang kamatis ang may yara sang carotenoids kaangay sang alpha kag beta carotene, lutein kag lycopene nga manami para sa ikaayong lawas.
english: According to a study by The University of Montreal, tomatoes contain carotenoids such as alpha and beta carotene, lutein and lycopene that are good for health.

text: Ang lycopene ang may mataas nga antioxidant activity nga nagabulig agud protektahan ang cells sang tawo gikan sa oxidative damage.
english: Lycopene has a high antioxidant activity that helps to protect human cells from oxidative damage.

text: Nagabulig man ang kamatis sa paglikaw sang risgo sa pag-angkon sang pancreatic cancer.
english: Tomatoes also help in preventing the risk of developing pancreatic cancer.

text: May yara man ang kamatis sang vitamin E kag vitamin C nga nagabulig agud mapanubo ang blood pressure.
english: Tomatoes also contain vitamin E and vitamin C which help lower blood pressure.

text: Magluwas sa mga nasambit nga mga benepisyo, nagapanubo man sa risgo sang pag-angkon sa balatian sa tagipusuon ang pagkaon sang kamatis.
english: In addition to the above benefits, eating tomatoes also reduces the risk of heart disease.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang kamatamis ang isa ka sahi sang prutas kag indi utan.
english: It is known that the sweet potato is a kind of fruit and not a vegetable.

text: ILOILO CITY- Aton kilalahon ang lalaki nga may pinakamadamo nga pirma.
english: ILOILO CITY- Let's recognize the man with the most signatures.

text: Indi sa mga dokumento ha kundi sa iya lawas.
english: Not in the documents but in his body.

text: Siya amo si Funky Matas, isa ka social media entertainer nga na-base sa Florida, nga ginauyatan ang world record para sa pinakamadamo nga pirma nga gin-tattoo sa iya likod lakip na ang pirma sang mga celebrities kaangay nanday Will Smith kag Gerard Butler.
english: He is Funky Matas, a Florida-based social media entertainer, who holds the world record for the most signatures tattooed on his back including the signatures of celebrities like Will Smith and Gerard Butler.

text: si Funky, nga ang iya matuod nga pangalan amo si Juan Matas, ang isa ka tattoo artist kag naghimo sang project nga magapanami sang iya career bilang online entertainer gamit ang iya lawas bilang canvas.
english: Funky, whose real name is Juan Matas, is a tattoo artist and has created a project that will spice up his career as an online entertainer using his body as a canvas.

text: Didto na niya nadesisyunan nga pun-on ini sang pirma sang mga tawo gamit ang tattoo machine.
english: That's when he decided to fill it with people's signatures using a tattoo machine.

text: Sa masami, ginalagas niya ang mga celebrities agud magpirma sa iya likod agud nga permanente niya ini nga matatoo sa iya lawas.
english: Often, he would chase down celebrities to sign his back so he could permanently tattoo it on his body.

text: Ang iya likod sa subong ang may yara na sang masobra 225 tattooed signatures, nga isa na ka world record.
english: His back currently has more than 225 tattooed signatures, which is already a world record.

text: GINKASUBO gid ni Mrs. ang nadangtan sang iya oportunidad nga ma-promote sa trabaho sa Iloilo City Hall.
english: Mrs. was very sad. was denied his opportunity to be promoted to a job at Iloilo City Hall.

text: Ina tungod samtang siya ang dapat ma-promote, siya pa ang nadis-ug tungod sang sala nga paghangop sa patakaran sang Civil Service.
english: That's because while he should have been promoted, he was promoted because of a misunderstanding of the Civil Service policy.

text: Sa patakaran sang Civil Service sa idalom sang Merit and Ranking System ang next in rank, nga amo ang akon asawa, tani ang dapat na-promote.
english: According to the Civil Service policy under the Merit and Ranking System, the next in rank, which is my wife, should have been promoted.

text: Bag-o ina nga isyu, nag gwa anay ang kuno nalipatan siya ilakip sa organizational chart sang Office of the City Administrator (OCA) nga iya iloy nga ahensya.
english: Before that issue, it came out that he was forgotten to be included in the organizational chart of the Office of the City Administrator (OCA) which is his parent agency.

text: Ina tungod na-detail siya sang madugay sa Administrative Division sang Mayor’s Office.
english: That's because he was detailed for a long time in the Administrative Division of the Mayor's Office.

text: In fact, nakita ko nga wala gid man sing ngalan si Mrs. sa organizational chart sang OCA.
english: In fact, I found that Mrs. in the OCA’s organizational chart.

text: Sa matuod, si Mrs. yara sa plantilla sang OCA nga sang ulihi na-diskubrihan mismo ni City Administrator Hernando Galvez sang mag gwa na ang reklamo.
english: In fact, Mrs. was on the template of the OCA which was later discovered by City Administrator Hernando Galvez himself when the complaint came out.

text: Sang maghilibalo na, gin-akuni Galvez ang kapaltahan, apang gintudlo niya ang Human Resource Office, nga ginapangunahan ni Mr. Leo Elevencione, nga amo ang may sala kay mayor nga obligasyon ina sang HR ang mag-evaluate kon sin-o gid ang dapat i-promote nga empleyado.
english: When he became aware, Galvez admitted the mistake, but he pointed to the Human Resource Office, headed by Mr. Leo Elevencione, who is guilty because it is the main obligation of HR to evaluate who should be promoted as an employee.

text: Ginsiling man ni Galvez nga wala iya sing nahibal-an si Mayor Joe III sa pagsikway sang HR sang promotion ni asawahon kay wala man kinahanglan i-pulitika ini.
english: Galvez also said that he had no knowledge of Mayor Joe III's rejection of his wife's promotion by HR because it did not need to be politicized.

text: “Wala rason nga hingabuton ni mayor si ‘Nang Jo’,” dugang gani ni Galvez nga gakilala sa akon nga paryente niya.
english: “There is no reason for the mayor to harass 'Nang Jo',” added Galvez, who identified me as his relative.

text: Gintumod ni Galvez ang mga suod nga relasyones sang pila ka Espinosa sa amon.
english: Galvez referred to the close relationships of some Espinosas with us.

text: Madamo sang mga Espinosa sa Guimaras ang tapik sa amon pamilya.
english: Many of the Espinosas in Guimaras are close to our family.

text: Ang iban nga yara sa siyudad sang Iloilo nga suod man nagalakip sang tatlo ko ka frat brods sa Sigma Rho Fraternity kag mga kumara kag kumpare.
english: Others in Iloilo City who are also close include my three frat bros in Sigma Rho Fraternity and my cousins.

text: Isa pa, bilang civil service eligible indi puede maka-pangampanya si Mrs. sa kon sin-o man nga luyag niya nga kandidato kon mag-eleksyon.
english: Furthermore, as a civil service eligible, Mrs. to whoever he wants to be the candidate in the election.

text: Sa pagtudlo sa kay HR officer Elevencione, ginsiling ni Galvez nga sang mahibal-an niya ang matuod nga position ni Mrs. sa iya upisina, ginreklamo dayon niya ini sa HR.
english: Pointing to HR officer Elevencione, Galvez said that when he learned the true position of Mrs. in her office, she immediately complained about it to HR.

text: Ugaling nadaug siya sang panindugan sang HR, labi na gid sang ginpirmahan na ni Elevencione ang pag-attest sa assumption of office sang nasal-an nga i-promote sa lugar ni asawahon.
english: However, he was defeated by the position of HR, especially when Elevencione signed the attestation of the assumption of office of the one who was wrong to be promoted in place of his wife.

text: “Na blame ko gani ang HR (Human Resource).
english: “I even blamed HR (Human Resource).

text: Gin-clear ko gid na sa ila ang rule pero interpretation nila lain…Nakibot lang gani ako nga (lain ang nabotohan sang HR nga i-promote)…” siling pa gani ni Galvez sa iya paathag sa iya text sa akon.
english: I cleared the rule to them but their interpretation is different...I was surprised that (HR voted differently to promote)...” Galvez said in his explanation in his text to me.

text: Ang “rule” nga ginatumod ni Galvez amo ang Civil Service Policy Guidelines on the Three-Salary Grade Limitation on Promotion No.
english: The “rule” Galvez was referring to was Civil Service Policy Guidelines on the Three-Salary Grade Limitation on Promotion No.

text: 1600732 nga napetsahan Hulyo 7, 2016.

Gin-akuni Galvez nga bagay gid man nga na-promote si Mrs. “Next in rank siya kag nalab-ut na niya ang ceiling sang sueldo sa iya pwesto sa plantilla kag, tungod sina, dapat na siya ma-promote agud maka-qualify siya sa dugang nga sueldo sa dason nga salary step nga indi na niya matigayon.”

Nag-apologize si Galvez sa amon nga mag-asawa sa iya mismo upisina sadtong Lunes sang hapon.
english:
Galvez acknowledged that it was appropriate that Mrs. “He is next in rank and he has reached the salary ceiling for his position in the squad and, because of that, he should be promoted so that he can qualify for an increase in salary in the next salary step that he will not be able to achieve.”

Galvez apologized to my wife and me in his own office on Monday afternoon.

text: Ginaproblema niya ugaling kon paano ibalik kay Mrs. ang iya nabagay nga promotion.
english: He is, however, worried about how to return Mrs. his appropriate promotion.

text: Siling niya na-sumite na sa Civil Service ang mga promotion kag mabudlay na bawion.
english: He said the promotions have already been submitted to the Civil Service and it is difficult to withdraw.

text: “Puede kamo ugaling mag-file appeal sa Civil Service kay may panahon pa man sa pag-appeal.
english: “You can however file an appeal with the Civil Service because there is still time to appeal.

text: Kon may opening nga bag-o dira ta lang abe ipasulod si Nang Jo (si Mrs)?” siling niya.
english: If there is a new opening, can we let Nang Jo (Mrs) in?” he said.

text: Sa karon, indi pa namon mahibal-an nga mag-asawa ang himuon.
english: Right now, we don't know what to do as a couple.

text: Ma-appeal ukon hulaton ang grasya sang bag-o nga promotion nga, ugaling, indi namon mahibal-an pa kon san-o matupa.
english: Appeal or wait for the grace of the new promotion that, however, we do not know when it will fall.

text: May nag-suhestyon gani nga dapat mag-file gid kami sang kaso kontra sa HR tungod sa sining “violation” sang patakaran sa promotion sang Civil Service nga natabo kay asawahon.
english: Someone even suggested that we should file a case against HR because of this “violation” of the Civil Service promotion policy that happened to my wife.

text: “Para madudla!” siling niya.
english: “To play!” he said.

text: Meantime, gapasalamat kami kay City Administrator Galvez sa pag-aku sang kapaltahan sa na-unsyami nga promotion ni asawahon.
english: Meantime, we thank City Administrator Galvez for admitting the shortcomings in his wife's promotion.

text: Gapasalamat man kami sa pagpasalig niya nga koreheran ang ining kapaltahan sa una nga kahigayunan.
english: We are also grateful for his assurance that this error will be corrected at the earliest opportunity.

text: Kon san-o ugaling, wala pa mahibal-an namon.
english: When however, we do not yet know.

text: Kumpyansa ang National Economic and Development Authority (NEDA) nga malab-ot sini ang target nga mapondohan ang priority projects sang Marcos administration sa 2025 bisan nga indi na pagpasakaan sang panibag-o ang buwis.
english: The National Economic and Development Authority (NEDA) is confident that it will achieve the target of funding the Marcos administration's priority projects by 2025 even without raising taxes again.

text: Ini nga budget para sa ginaduso nga 2025 national budget kag priority projects sa idalom sang Philippine Development Plan (PDP) ang na-istoryahan sa meeting ni President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: This budget for the proposed 2025 national budget and priority projects under the Philippine Development Plan (PDP) was discussed in a meeting of President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.

text: kaupod sa economic managers, Speaker Martin Romualdez kag Senate President Francis Escudero sa Malaca ang.
english: along with economic managers, Speaker Martin Romualdez and Senate President Francis Escudero in Malaca the.

text: Suno kay NEDA Secretary Arsenio Balisacan, daku nga parte sini ang iga-pain para sa food security kag pagpaayo sang economic climate paagi sa pagpaayo sang access sa imprastraktura kag kalidad sini.
english: According to NEDA Secretary Arsenio Balisacan, a large part of this will be allocated for food security and improving the economic climate by improving access to infrastructure and its quality.

text: Indi na kinahanglan ang pagpanukot sang dugang nga buwis suno sa tiglikom bangud may yara na sang fiscal consolidation program.
english: The secretary said there is no need to collect additional taxes because there is already a fiscal consolidation program.

text: Ginpasalig man sini nga on track sila sa pagpatuman sini nga plano.
english: He also assured that they are on track in implementing this plan.

text: “We have our fiscal consolidation program that tries to meet the targets, the deficits, the debt and at what levels those are in the medium term and we re keeping track in implementing, you know, we re on track in implementing that plan, pahayag sang opisyal.
english: “We have our fiscal consolidation program that tries to meet the targets, the deficits, the debt and at what levels those are in the medium term and we re keeping track in implementing, you know, we re on track in implementing that plan, the official said.

text: Kahapon sang ginpangunahan sang Senado kag Kamara ang una nga adlaw sang pagsapol sang bicameral conference committee sa proposed P6.352-trillion national budget.
english: The first day of the bicameral conference committee's meeting on the proposed P6.352-trillion national budget was led by the Senate and House of Representatives yesterday.

text: Sa nanuhay-tuhay nga bahin sang kalibutan, ginakabig sa gihapon nga problema ang pagpamatok sang kadam-an sa pagpaidalom sa COVID-19 vaccination kalakip na ang pagka-pislian sang iban angot sa vaccine brand.
english: In various parts of the world, the opposition of the public to undergoing COVID-19 vaccination is still considered a problem, including the bias of others regarding the vaccine brand.

text: Apang sa Rio de Janeiro sa Brazil, baliskad ang natabo bangud may isa ka lalaki nga ginapahayag nagpabakuna sang indi lang isa ka dose sang vaccine halin sa isa ka brand, kundi lima ka doses halin sa tatlo ka nanari-sari nga manufacturer sang bakuna.
english: But in Rio de Janeiro in Brazil, the opposite happened because a man allegedly vaccinated not just one dose of vaccine from one brand, but five doses from three different vaccine manufacturers.

text: Santo sa rekord sang mga opisyal, ang wala ginhingadlan nga lalaki ang nag-umpisa sa pagpabakuna sang Mayo tubtob sa Hunyo kag sang imbukada nga semana sang Agusto, diri na nadiskubrehan sang isa ka staff sa vaccination station ang vaccination marathon sang lalaki sang mapatublok pa kuntani ini sang isa pa ka COVID-19 shot.
english: According to official records, the unnamed man started vaccinating from May to June and in the opening week of August, a staff at the vaccination station discovered the man's vaccination marathon when he was about to get another COVID-19 shot.

text: Natukiban man nga nagpatublok sang una nga Pfizer shot ang lalaki sang Mayo 12, second dose naman sang AstraZeneca sang Hunyo 5, first dose sang Coronavac sang Hunyo 17, second dose sang Pfizer sang Hulyo kag second dose sang Coronavac sang Hulyo 21.
english: It was also discovered that the man received his first Pfizer shot on May 12, second dose of AstraZeneca on June 5, first dose of Coronavac on June 17, second dose of Pfizer on July and second dose of Coronavac on July 21.

text: Sa iya pinakaulihe nga attempt, wala pa natumod sang mga otoridad kun ano kuntani nga brand sang bakuna ang luyag naman sini nga itublok sa iya.
english: In his latest attempt, the authorities have not yet determined what brand of vaccine he wanted to inject him with.

text: Padayon naman subong ang imbestigasyon sang mga otoridad angot sa hitabo.
english: Authorities are still investigating the incident.

text: Apisar nagalalapta na sa social media ang pictures sang ginapahayag vote-buying sa probinsya sang Iloilo subong nga nagahingapos na ang election campaign period, wala sang pormal nga reklamo nga napalab-ot sa Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO).
english: Although pictures of alleged vote-buying in Iloilo province are circulating on social media as the election campaign period draws to a close, no formal complaint has been filed with the Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO).

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Senior Master Sergeant Francisco Lindero, Jr., spokesperson sang IPPO, iya ginpahayag nga mismo ang pulis ang naka-monitor man online sa alegasyon sang pila ka mga residente nga may yara sang mga pulitiko ukon partido nga nagapamakal sang boto.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Senior Master Sergeant Francisco Lindero, Jr., IPPO spokesperson, said the police themselves are also monitoring online allegations by some residents that there are politicians or parties buying votes.

text: Apang suno kay Lindero, ginahulat sang pulis nga ma-formalize sang mga tawo ini nga reklamo kag makabitbit sang ebidensya.
english: However, Lindero said the police are waiting for the people to formalize the complaint and bring evidence.

text: Nagmandu man si IPPO director Pol.
english: IPPO director Pol.

text: Colonel Adrian Acollador nga pabaskugon pa ang presensya sang mga pulis paagi sa checkpoint operations sa probinsya.
english: Colonel Adrian Acollador said the police presence will be strengthened through checkpoint operations in the province.

text: Paagi sa random checkpoint, ginalauman nga matapna ang vote buying, vote selling, kag harassment.
english: Through the random checkpoint, vote buying, vote selling, and harassment are expected to be prevented.

text: May yara sang masobra 1,600 ka augmentation personnel para sa IPPO subong nga tion agud masigurado nga mangin matalunsay ang eleksyon.
english: There are more than 1,600 augmentation personnel for the IPPO at this time to ensure the smooth running of the election.

text: 𝗠𝗔𝗡𝗜𝗟𝗔 —Madamo sang mga social media users ang nagpamangkot ko ngaa ang duha ka Filipino Olympic gymnasts nga sanday Aleah Finnegan kag Emma Malabuyo ang wala sa reception sa Malacañang Palace sang Agosto 13 kag sa heroes’ parade sa Manila sang Agosto 14.
english: 𝗠𝗔𝗡𝗜𝗟𝗔 —Many of the social media users asked me why the two Filipino Olympic gymnasts Aleah Finnegan and Emma Malabuyo were absent from the reception at Malacañang Palace on August 13 and the heroes’ parade in Manila on August 14.

text: Gilayon naman nga nagsabat si Aleah Finnegan nga wala sila ginpahibalo nahanungod sa amo nga kahiwatan rason nga wala sila nakakadto.
english: Aleah Finnegan immediately replied that they were not informed about the event and that is why they did not attend.

text: Dugang pa ni Aleah nga “luyag gid niya mag-upod” sa selebrasyon nga natabo.
english: Aleah added that she “really wanted to join in” on the celebration that took place.

text: Samtang ang isa naman ka fan ang nagmangkot man kon ngaa wala makatambong si Emma Malabuyo sa Heroes’ Welcome, sa diin nagsabat siya nga luyag niya kuntani magkadto, apang wala siya ginsugiran nahanungod sa kahiwatan.
english: Meanwhile, another fan also asked why Emma Malabuyo did not attend the Heroes' Welcome, to which she replied that she wanted to go, but she was not told about the event.

text: Sa mga bag-o nga TikTok videos, nagapakita nga si Emma yara sa Pilipinas samtang si Aleah ang yara man sa pungsod.
english: In recent TikTok videos, it appears that Emma is in the Philippines while Aleah is also in the country.

text: Sanday Aleah, Emma, ​​kag Levi Jung-Ruivivar ang una nga babaye nga gymnasts nga nagrepresentar sa Pilipinas sa Olympics sa sulod sang anum ka dekada.
english: Aleah, Emma, ​​and Levi Jung-Ruivivar are the first female gymnasts to represent the Philippines at the Olympics in six decades.

text: Ang mga gymnast nagtapos sang ila pasundayag sa Paris 2024 nga si Finnegan yara sa ika-47 nga pwesto, si Malabuyo sa ika-41, kag Jung-Ruivivar sa ika-40 nga pwesto sa Women’s Artistic Gymnastics All-Around.
english: The gymnasts finished their performance at Paris 2024 with Finnegan ranked 47th, Malabuyo 41st, and Jung-Ruivivar 40th in the Women’s Artistic Gymnastics All-Around.

text: Sang nag-abot sa pungsod ang mga Filipino Olympians, gin-abi-abi sila ni Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Jr., kon sa diin, ang First Family sa Palasyo sang Malacañang naghatag sang P1 million ang tagsa ka atleta.
english: When the Filipino Olympians arrived in the country, they were welcomed by President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., where the First Family at Malacañang Palace gave P1 million to each athlete.

text: Wala lamang naghatag sang signos ang former beauty queen nga si Priscilla Meirelles nga malapit na lang sila magbulagay sang iya bana nga si John Estrada, kundi maisog pa sini nga ginpangalanan kun sin-o nga babaye ang kaupod sang 51-anyos nga actor samtang yara sa Boracay.
english: Former beauty queen Priscilla Meirelles not only gave a sign that she and her husband John Estrada are about to separate, but she also boldly named which woman the 51-year-old actor was with while in Boracay.

text:
Nagguwa ini nga isyu sang nag-post si Estrada sang mga laragway sini sa Instagram nga may caption nga “What an awesome place.”

Sunod nga nag-komento ang isa ka social media user: “Sino kasama mo rigoooor?
english:
This issue came to light when Estrada posted pictures of it on Instagram with the caption “What an awesome place.”

A social media user next commented: “Who’s with you rigoooor?

text: Si lena or marites?” Ginatumod sang netizen ang papel ni Estrada bilang si Rigor sa “Batang Quiapo” kun sa diin sanday Lena kag Marites naman ang ginadala sang aktres nga sanday Mercedes Cabral kag Cherry Pie Picache.
english: Is it Lena or Maris?” The netizen is referring to Estrada's role as Rigor in “Batang Quiapo” where Lena and Marites are played by actresses Mercedes Cabral and Cherry Pie Picache.

text: Diri kag nag-reply ang asawa ni Estrada: “Si @ Lily Hallman_”.
english: Estrada's wife replied: “Si @ Lily Hallman_”.

text:
Wala pa nakuntento si Priscilla kag nagdugang pa gid sa iya komento, “Looking very divorced Mr. Estrada.”

Sa subong, gin-off na sang actor ang comment option sa iya post apang madamo na ang naka-screenshot sa komento sang iya asawa nga isa ka Brazilian model kag television host.
english:
Priscilla was not satisfied and added to her comment, “Looking very divorced Mr. Estrada.”

As of now, the actor has turned off the comment option on his post but many have screenshotted the comment of his wife, a Brazilian model and television host.

text: Sang 2023, matandaan nga gin-ako ni Priscilla nga may mga pagpangkat sa ila relasyon ni Estrada nga ginsundan pa gid sang iya cryptic posts nahanungod sa cheating allegations.
english: In 2023, Priscilla admitted that there were challenges in her relationship with Estrada followed by her cryptic posts about cheating allegations.

text:
Isa sa iya post ang nagtatak sa iya followers: “What to call a female that entertains married man?” kag “Married men/women who chase single boys/girls are seriously so pathetic!”

Sunod sini nga ginklaro nga indi cryptic ang iya posts kundi “very direct to the point.”

Matandaan nga ginkasal sanday Estrada kag Priscilla sa La Union sang 2011 kag may isa sila ka anak nga babaye.
english:
One of her posts marked her followers: “What to call a female that entertains married man?” and “Married men/women who chase single boys/girls are seriously so pathetic!”

He subsequently clarified that his posts were not cryptic but “very direct to the point.”

Estrada and Priscilla were married in La Union in 2011 and have a daughter.

text: Nagnubo sa number 3 ang Filipino Olympian kag pole vaulter nga si Ernest John “EJ” Obiena sandig sa rankings nga ginpaguwa sang World Athletics.
english: Filipino Olympian and pole vaulter Ernest John “EJ” Obiena dropped to number 3 according to the rankings released by World Athletics.

text: Gin-release ini nga update inadlaw matapos ang 2024 Paris Olympics kun sa diin ginkabos ang Pinoy pride sa men’s pole vault finals kag nagpang-apat lamang sa kumpetisyon.
english: The update was released a day after the 2024 Paris Olympics where the Filipino pride was defeated in the men's pole vault finals and finished fourth in the competition.

text: Halin sang Hulyo 2023 tubtub sa Summer Games, naka-pwesto ang 28-anyos nga tumandok sang Tondo, Manila sa ikaduha nga rank.
english: From July 2023 to the Summer Games, the 28-year-old native of Tondo, Manila is ranked second.

text: Nagpabilin naman sa una nga pwesto ang pole vault superstar nga si Mondo Duplantis sang Sweden nga nakadepensa man sang iya gold medal sa Paris; samtang ang American naman nga si Sam Kendricks nga anay number 3 ang nagsaka sa ikaduha nga pwesto kasunod man sang silver medal finish sini sa Olympiada.
english: Pole vault superstar Mondo Duplantis of Sweden, who also defended his gold medal in Paris, remained in first place; while American Sam Kendricks, formerly number 3, rose to second place following his silver medal finish at the Olympiad.

text: Ang bronze medalist naman nga si Emmanouil Karalis sang Greece ang nagsaka sa no.
english: Bronze medalist Emmanouil Karalis of Greece rose to no.

text: 4 halin sa number 8 sini nga rank nga nakuha sang Hulyo.
english: 4 from number 8 of this rank obtained in July.

text:
‘I AM BACK IN THE GAME’

Lakip si Obiena sa Filipino Olympians nga nagpauli sa Pilipinas sang nagligad nga adlaw kag nagpakigkita sa First Family sa Malacañan Palace, nagtambong sa homecoming ceremony sa iya alma mater nga Chiang Kai Shek College, kag nagbisita man sa Manila City Hall kun sa diin nakabaton ini sang P500,000 cash incentive.
english:
‘I AM BACK IN THE GAME’

Obiena was among the Filipino Olympians who returned to the Philippines yesterday and met with the First Family at Malacañan Palace, attended the homecoming ceremony at his alma mater Chiang Kai Shek College, and also visited Manila City Hall where he received a P500,000 cash incentive.

text: Una ini nagpangayo sang pasaylo sa mga Pilipino bangud wala nakadala-pauli sang medalya, apang nagpasalig nga magabalik ini sa training.
english: He first apologized to the Filipinos for not bringing home a medal, but promised to return to training.

text:
Yari ang kabahin sang iya katapusan nga post kasunod sang Paris Games:

“I have been trying to read everyone’s messages to me, post-Olympics.
english:
Here is part of his final post following the Paris Games:

“I have been trying to read everyone’s messages to me, post-Olympics.

text: So much to take from it but I draw two immediate conclusions.
english: So much to take from it but I draw two immediate conclusions.

text: Let’s get on with it!.”
english: Let’s get on with it!.”

text: Ginkumpirma ni Education Secretary Sonny Angara nga kapin 50 ka mga alkalde ang nagboluntar­yo nga magpatukod sang hulot-klasehan sa ila nga mga lugar.
english: Education Secretary Sonny Angara confirmed that more than 50 mayors have volunteered to build classrooms in their areas.

text: Angot ini sa programa sang Department of Education (DepEd) nga nagapahanugot sa mga local government units (LGUs) nga magpatindog sang mga classrooms.
