english: This is in connection with the Department of Education (DepEd) program that allows local government units (LGUs) to build classrooms.

text: Suno kay Angara, pila sa mga ginatumod nga alkalde amo sanday Mayor Benjie Magalong sang Baguio City, Mayor Joy Belmonte sang Quezon City, Mayor Vico Sotto sang Pasig City, Mayor Dada Hataman sang Isabela, Basilan, kag madamo nga iban pa.
english: According to Angara, some of the mayors in question are Mayor Benjie Magalong of Baguio City, Mayor Joy Belmonte of Quezon City, Mayor Vico Sotto of Pasig City, Mayor Dada Hataman of Isabela, Basilan, and many others.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) lamang ang nagapatindog sang mga classrooms apang sa idalom sang bag-o nga programa, tugutan na ang mga LGUs nga magbulig diri.
english: It is known that only the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) is building the classrooms but under the new program, LGUs will be allowed to help here.

text: Gin-ako naman ni Angara nga naglala ang problema sang pungsod sa kakulangan sang classrooms bangud sa mga daan nga school buildings, nga kalabanan ag napatukod sang panahon pa ni anay Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Sr..
english: Angara acknowledged that the country's problem of lack of classrooms has worsened due to the old school buildings, most of which were built during the time of former President Ferdinand Marcos Sr..

text: Ginatun-an naman subong sang DepEd ang posibilidad nga magsulod sa public-private partnerships (PPP) agud padasigon ang pagtukod sang mga hulot-klasehan.
english: The DepEd is now studying the possibility of entering into public-private partnerships (PPP) to accelerate the construction of classrooms.

text: ILOILO CITY- Naeksperyensiyahan mo na bala nga mangin rason ikaw sang pagpugok sang trapiko?
english: ILOILO CITY- Have you ever experienced being the cause of traffic jams?

text: Indi bala makahuluya kon halimbawa magub-an ikaw sang salakyan sa tunga sang dalan kag bangud sa imo, naapektuhan ang trapiko bisan sa sulod lang sang pila ka oras?
english: Wouldn't it be embarrassing if, for example, you broke down in the middle of the road and because of you, traffic was affected even for a few hours?

text: Apang kon may ara man sang kabalan kon pagtuga sang huol sa mga motorista ang pagahambalan, ini na siguro ang lalaki sa England nga ginbansagan nga “Silent Man” nga nangin rason sang trapiko sa iya lugar sa sulod na sang pito ka tuig.
english: But if there is anyone who knows when it comes to causing trouble to motorists, it is probably the man in England who is nicknamed the “Silent Man” who has been the cause of traffic in his area for seven years.

text: Ini amo sa David Hampson sang Swansea City.
english: This was to David Hampson of Swansea City.

text: Sa sulod sang pito ka tuig, blessing na nga makabig para sa mga motorista ang isa ka adlaw nga wala siya sa tunga sang dalan.
english: For the past seven years, it has been a blessing for motorists to consider a day without him in the middle of the road.

text: Ginahimo niya ini humalin pa sang 2014.
english: He has been doing this since 2014.

text: Indi man siya buang apang kun pamangkuton siya kon ngaa ginahimo niya ini,wala siya sang sabat, rason nga Silent Man siya gani.
english: He's not stupid but if you ask him why he does this, he doesn't have an answer, that's why he's a Silent Man.

text: Makatilingala man nga sa pareho nga spot sang dalan siya nagatindog adlaw-adlaw.
english: It is also strange that he stands on the same spot of the road every day.

text: Sang 2018, si Hampson ang ginkasuhan kag nasentensiyahan sang tatlo ka tuig nga pagkapreso bangod sa pagtuga sang huol sa dalan sa atubang mismo sa Swansea Central Police Station.
english: In 2018, Hampson was charged and sentenced to three years in prison for causing a nuisance on the street right in front of Swansea Central Police Station.

text: Wala sang pulis ukon sin- o man ang nakapasabat sa iya agud magpaathag kon ngaa ginahimo niya ini.
english: No police officer or anyone else could answer him to explain why he was doing this.

text: Sang damlag lang sa isa ka hearing, napamatud-an sang huwes nga makahambal man si David apang indi lang gid niya luyag nga maghambal.
english: Recently at a hearing, the judge confirmed that David could talk too but just didn’t really want to talk.

text: Natalana naman siya nga basahan sang sentensiya sa Agusto 31 bangod sa pareho man nga kaso.
english: He is scheduled to be sentenced on August 31 for the same case.

text: Natalana nga pirmahan ni US President Donald Trump ang mega budget bill sang America nga labi nga nagapabaskog sang pirmado nga second-term policy ni Trump.
english: US President Donald Trump is set to sign America's mega budget bill that further strengthens Trump's signature second-term policy.

text: Suno sa White House, ginalauman nga pirmahan ini ni Trump sa alas 5 sang hapon sa Byernes, Hulyo 4, oras sang Amerika, nga nagadungan sa makasaysayan nga ika-250 nga anibersaryo sang Independence Day sang Amerika, ukon alas 5 sang aga sang Sabado, oras sang Pilipinas.
english: According to the White House, Trump is expected to sign it at 5 pm on Friday, July 4, American time, which coincides with the historic 250th anniversary of America’s Independence Day, or 5 am on Saturday, Philippine time.

text: Natabo ini pagkatapos nga ginpasar sang lower assembly sang Kongreso sang Estados Unidos ang budget bill paagi sa boto nga 218-214, nga may duha lamang ka Republicans, sanday Reps.
english: This came after the lower assembly of the U.S. Congress passed the budget bill by a vote of 218-214, with only two Republicans, Reps.

text: Thomas Massie sang Kentucky kag Brian Fitzpatrick sang Pennsylvania, upod ang tanan nga 212 ka mga Democrats, nga nagapamatok sa hagna.
english: Thomas Massie of Kentucky and Brian Fitzpatrick of Pennsylvania, along with all 212 Democrats, opposing the bill.

text: Una na nga ginpasar sang Senado ang mega budget bill, nga gintawag nga “big, beautiful bill,” sang Martes.
english: The Senate previously passed the mega budget bill, dubbed the “big, beautiful bill,” on Tuesday.

text: Lakip sa mga pagbuhin amo ang Healthcare lakip ang Medicaid, Medicare, ang Affordable Care Act, Planned Parenthood, subong man ang pagnubo sang alokasyon sa pondo sa mga benepisyo sang federal Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP), nga ginagamit sang gobyerno sa pagbulig sa mga pumuluyo nga magbakal sang pagkaon kon indi nila ini masarangan, kag Clean Energy Tax Credits.
english: Among the cuts are Healthcare including Medicaid, Medicare, the Affordable Care Act, Planned Parenthood, as well as reduced funding allocations to federal Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) benefits, which the government uses to help citizens buy food when they cannot afford it, and Clean Energy Tax Credits.

text: Ang budget proposal nagahatag man sang prayoridad sa pagpalawig sang 2017 Tax Cuts and Jobs Act ni Trump, nga nagabuhin sang mga buhis nga ginabayad sang mga korporasyon kag mga indibidwal sa kalabanan nga mga bracket sang kita kag natalana nga mag-expire sa Disyembre.
english: The budget proposal also prioritizes extending Trump’s 2017 Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, which slashes taxes paid by corporations and individuals in most income brackets and is set to expire in December.

text: Ang budget nagadugang man sang pondo para sa pagpatuman sang imigrasyon, pondo sang militar kag ang programa sa kahawaan, nga nalakip sa mga saad ni Trump sa kampanya.Samtang, ginatawag naman sang White House nga daku nga kadalag-an ang budget bill.
english: The budget also increases funding for immigration enforcement, military funding and the space program, which were among Trump's campaign promises. Meanwhile, the White House called the budget bill a big victory.

text: Malab-ot sa 30 ka mga indibidwal ang pilason matapos mag lupok ang isa ka gasolinahan sa Roma.
english: At least 30 people were injured after a gas station exploded in Rome.

text: Suno kay Roberto Gualtieri, Mayor sang Rome, nawasak ang mga bintana sang katupad nga building kag bisan ang mga salakyan nga naka-park sa amo nga lugar.
english: According to Roberto Gualtieri, Mayor of Rome, the windows of the adjacent building and even the cars parked in the area were broken.

text: Antes ang paglupok, ginpatawag ang mga otoridad agud i-report ang gas leak rason nga nag-evacuate ang mga pumuluyo sa lugar.
english: Before the explosion, authorities were called to report the gas leak, prompting residents to evacuate the area.

text: Lakip sa mga napilasan amo ang napulo ka mga pulis kung sa diin isa sa mga myembro nila ang isa ka bombero.
english: Among the injured were 10 policemen, one of whom was a firefighter.

text: Gindala gilayon sa ospital ang mga pilason nga biktima.
english: The injured victims were rushed to the hospital.

text: ILOILO CITY- Makahalanusbo ang gindangatan sang masobra 500 ka mga karnero sa kabukiran sang Ninotsminda, sa southern Georgia.
english: ILOILO CITY – The fate of more than 500 sheep in the mountains of Ninotsminda, in southern Georgia, is tragic.

text: Trahedya para sa sin-o man nga mangunguma ng mapatyan sang sapat nga iya ginasagod.
english: It is a tragedy for any farmer to lose his livestock.

text: Apang didto sa Georgia, masobra pa sa trahedya ang natabo bangod sa isa lang ka pag-igo sang kilat, indi lima, indi 10, indi isa ka gatos, kundi 550 ka mga karnero ang nagkalamatay.
english: But in Georgia, more than tragedy occurred because in a single lightning strike, not five, not 10, not a hundred, but 550 sheep died.

text: Suno sa manugbantay sang mga karnero,wala na siya sang may nadumduman matapos nag-igo ang kilat kon sa diin nadulaan siya sang pangalibutan kag maswerte nga nabuhi.
english: According to the shepherd, he lost consciousness after the lightning struck and lost consciousness and was lucky to survive.

text: Sang iya pagbugtaw, nakibot na lang siya nga patay na ang tanan nga mga karnero.
english: When he woke up, he found all the sheep dead.

text: Kasunod sang insidente, ginsunog nalang ang nasambit nga mga karnero sa lugar.
english: Following the incident, the sheep were burned at the scene.

text: Indi naman makapati ang tag-iya sang mga karnero nga nadula tanan sa isa lang ka kilat ang iya mga kasapatan.
english: The owner of the sheep could not believe that his animals had disappeared in a flash.

text: Magaabot na sa Pilipinas subong nga adlaw, Agusto 13, ang Filipino Olympians nga nagpasakop sa Paris Olympics 2024.
english: The Filipino Olympians who participated in the Paris Olympics 2024 will arrive in the Philippines today, August 13.

text: Suno kay Reichel Quiñones, chief sang Presidential Protocol and Presidential Assistant on Foreign Affairs, ‘las sais karon sa gab-i ginabanta nga maghugpa sa Pilipinas ang two-time Olympic champion nga si Carlos Edriel Yulo kag iban pa nga kaupdanan.
english: According to Reichel Quiñones, chief of Presidential Protocol and Presidential Assistant on Foreign Affairs, “two-time Olympic champion Carlos Edriel Yulo and others are expected to land in the Philippines at 6 pm tonight.

text: Abi-abihon sila sang First Family sa Malacañang kag magasunod ang awarding ceremony kag dinner reception para sa ila.
english: They will be welcomed by the First Family in Malacañang followed by an awarding ceremony and dinner reception for them.

text: Ginpahayag man sang Presidential Communications Office (PCO) nga may cash incentive para sa Olympians apang si President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: The Presidential Communications Office (PCO) also said that there is a cash incentive for the Olympians but President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: na ang maga-anunsyo kun pila ang ila batunon.
english: will announce how much they will receive.

text: Magabaton si Yulo sang Presidential Medal of Merit samtang hatagan naman ang iban nga atleta sang presidential citations kadungan sang heroes’ welcome sa palasyo.
english: Yulo will receive the Presidential Medal of Merit while the other athletes will be given presidential citations during the heroes’ welcome at the palace.

text: Sa amo nga event, gintugutan ang mga atleta nga mag-imbita sang tubtub apat ka miyembro sang ila pamilya apang indi pa sigurado suno sa opisina kun sin-o ang magakadto kay Yulo ilabi na bangud sa kontrobersiya nga nagpalibot sa ila pamilya kasunod sang iya pagdaog sang gold medal sa Olympics.
english: At the event, athletes are allowed to invite up to four family members but the office is not sure who will attend Yulo especially due to the controversy that surrounded their family following his gold medal win at the Olympics.

text: Buwas, Agusto 14, naka-schedule ang 7.7-kilometer parade bilang pagkilala sa mga atleta.
english: Tomorrow, August 14, a 7.7-kilometer parade is scheduled to recognize the athletes.

text: Una nga gin-schedule ang parada subong nga adlaw apang ginsaylo buwas bangud gab-i na sila magaabot diri sa pungsod.
english: The parade was originally scheduled for today but was moved to tomorrow because they will arrive in the country late at night.

text: Magluwas kay Yulo nga nakabulsa sang gold sa floor kag vault finals sa men’s artistic gymnastics sa Paris Games, nahibaluan nga bronze medalists man sanday Nesthy Petecio kag Aira Villegas nga lunsay halin sa Philippine boxing team.
english: Besides Yulo who pocketed gold in the floor and vault finals in men's artistic gymnastics at the Paris Games, Nesthy Petecio and Aira Villegas, both from the Philippine boxing team, are also bronze medalists.

text: Manamit!
english: Delicious!

text: Ini ang masami nga mabatian sa mga tawo nga mahilig magkaon sang Avocado.
english: This is most commonly heard from people who love to eat Avocados.

text: Apang ano bala ang kamatuoran sa likod sang prutas nga ini?
english: But what is the truth behind this fruit?

text: Suno kay David Heber, M.D., Ph.D., ang avocado ang nagabulig likaw sa mga balatian sa tagipusuon.
english: According to David Heber, M.D., Ph.D., avocados help prevent heart disease.

text: May yara ini sang vitamin e, monounsaturated fats kag glutathione nga manami man para sa tagipusuon.
english: It contains vitamin e, monounsaturated fats and glutathione which is also good for the heart.

text: Ang avocado ang manami man sa vision sang mata kag may yara man ini sang carotenoid lutein nga nagaprotekta batuk sa mascular degeneration kag katarata.
english: Avocado is also good for eye vision and it also contains the carotenoid lutein which protects against muscular degeneration and cataracts.

text: Nagapanubo man sang cholesterol bangud sa mataas nga beta-sitosterol sang avocado.
english: Also lowers cholesterol due to the high beta-sitosterol content of avocados.

text: Nagabulig man sa paglikaw sa balatian nga cancer ang pagkaon sang avocado.
english: Eating avocados also helps prevent cancer.

text: Isa man sa manami nga solusyon ang avocado agud nga mapanubo ang kabug-aton sang isa ka tawo.
english: Avocado is also a good solution to lose weight.

text: Panugyan sang eksperto sa publiko, agud mangin healthy, mangin disiplinado sa mga ginakaon nga pagkaon kag magkaon sang prutas kaangay sang avocado nga sa subong season na sang sini nga prutas.
english: Experts advise the public to stay healthy, be disciplined in their diet and eat fruits such as avocado which is now in season.

text: Mahimo maka-avail sang calamity loans kag sweldo gikan sa state-led pension fund nga Social Security System (SSS) ang mga myembro sang SSS nga apektado sang sunod-sunod nga mga bagyo nga bag-o lang nag-igo sa pungsod.
english: SSS members affected by the series of typhoons that recently hit the country can avail of calamity loans and salaries from the state-led pension fund, the Social Security System (SSS).

text: Suno Social Security System, ang mga myembro sini sa mga lugar nga gin-igo sang tropical cyclones (TCs) Kristine, Marce, Nika, Ofel, kag Pepito sa nagligad nga pila ka semana mahimo nga maka-avail sang calamity loan tubtob Disyembre 19.
english: According to the Social Security System, its members in areas hit by tropical cyclones (TCs) Kristine, Marce, Nika, Ofel, and Pepito in the past few weeks can avail of the calamity loan until December 19.

text: Ang kantidad sang loan ang nagalab-ot sa isa ka bulan nga salary credit tubtub P20,000 suno kay SSS Officer-in-Charge Voltaire Agas.
english: The loan amount is up to one month's salary credit of up to P20,000, according to SSS Officer-in-Charge Voltaire Agas.

text: Ang mga myembro sang SSS sa mga lugar nga ginpaidalom sa state of calamity ang kwalipikado nga mag-aplay para sa loan.
english: SSS members in areas under the state of calamity are eligible to apply for the loan.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang mga pautang sa kalamidad kag sweldo, mahimo bayaran sa hulugan sa sulod sang 24 months ukon duha ka tuig nga may manubo nga tuigan nga interes nga 10 percent base sa members’ diminishing balance.
english: It is known that the disaster and salary loans, can be repaid in installments within 24 months or two years with a low annual interest rate of 10 percent based on the members’ diminishing balance.

text: Kaangay sa iya ginhimo sang nagligad nga Comelec-organized debates, indi magtambong si former senator Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english: As he did in previous Comelec-organized debates, former senator Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr. will not attend.

text: sa katapusan nga presidential panel interview nga iga-organisar sang poll body.
english: in the final presidential panel interview to be organized by the poll body.

text: Suno sa kampo ni Marcos, magatutok sila sa iya nga presidential campaign samtang nagahilapit ang Mayo 9.
english: According to Marcos' camp, they will focus on his presidential campaign as May 9 approaches.

text: “With less than 2 weeks before the May 9 elections, frontrunner Ferdinand ‘Bongbong’ Marcos Jr.
english: “With less than 2 weeks before the May 9 elections, frontrunner Ferdinand ‘Bongbong’ Marcos Jr.

text: has decided to forego his participation in the Comelec’s presidential panel interview, which was scheduled on May 1, 2022,” suno sa iya spokesman, si Atty. Vic Rodriguez.
english: has decided to forego his participation in the Comelec’s presidential panel interview, which was scheduled on May 1, 2022,” according to his spokesman, Atty. Vic Rodriguez.

text:
Ginpasalamatan man ni Marcos ang Comelec sa imbitasyon, apang dugang sa statement, “He opted, however, to conclude the entire 90-day campaign period with visits to his supporters and compliances with previous commitments for political events, like town hall meetings and political rallies.”

Suno naman sa Comelec, duha pa lang ka kandidato ang nagkumpirma nga magatambong sa presidential interview kag duha man sa vice presidential interview.
english:
Marcos also thanked the Comelec for the invitation, but added in a statement, “He opted, however, to conclude the entire 90-day campaign period with visits to his supporters and compliances with previous commitments for political events, like town hall meetings and political rallies.”

According to the Comelec, only two candidates have confirmed that they will attend the presidential interview and two for the vice presidential interview.

text: Wala na ginsapubliko kun sanday sin-o ini nga mga kandidato.
english: The identities of these candidates were not made public.

text: Isa mga mga masami nga napabay-an nga parte sang lawas amo ang kamot nga ginagamit adlaw-adlaw sa nagkalain-lain nga trabaho.
english: One of the most neglected parts of the body is the hand that is used daily in various jobs.

text: Gani, naghatag sang panugyan si Aikee Ocampo, managing director sang hand kag foot wellness.
english: So, Aikee Ocampo, managing director of hand and foot wellness, gave advice.

text: Suno kay Ocampo, pila sa mga nagaguba sa kamot amo ang mga trabaho sa sulod balay kaangay sang masami nga paghugas sang pinggan kag paglaba nga rason sang dryness, brittleness kag pagkaguba sang mga kuko.
english: According to Ocampo, some of the causes of hand damage are household chores such as frequent dishwashing and laundry that cause dryness, brittleness and damage to the nails.

text: Bilang solusyon sa mga nasambit nga problema, naghatag si Ocampo sang mga natural nga pamaagi agud mabalik ang pagkalum-ok kag pagkabakod sang kapoy nga mga kamot.
english: As a solution to these problems, Ocampo gave natural ways to restore the softness and strength of tired hands.

text: Sa moisturizing, mahimo nga gamiton ang kalamay, gata kag suha.
english: In moisturizing, sugar, milk and honey can be used.

text: Simpunon ang tatlo nga mga nasambit kag ipahid sa kamot sa sulod sang 10 ka minuto kag bunlawan.
english: Mix the three above and apply on hands for 10 minutes and rinse.

text: Para naman sa Whitening, maggamit sang Fresh milk ukon powdered milk, Lemon ukon kalamansi juice kag Baking soda.
english: For Whitening, use Fresh milk or powdered milk, Lemon or lime juice and Baking soda.

text: Simpunon ang mga mga ini kag imasahe man sa kamot.
english: Combine them and massage them with your hands.

text: Putson ang kamot sa cling wrap sa sulod sang 10 ka minuto kag bunlawan.
english: Wrap hand in cling wrap for 10 minutes and rinse.

text: Para naman sa pagpabakod sang mga kuko, gamiton lang ang coconut oil kag ahos.
english: As for strengthening the nails, just use coconut oil and garlic.

text: Simpunon ang tanan, itusmog ang mga kuko sa sulod sang lima ka minuto.
english: Combine everything, soak the nails for five minutes.

text: Kada pungsod, may lain-lain nga pamaagi agud nga masunod sang pumuluyo ang mga ginapatuman nga minimum public health standard.
english: Each country has different ways to ensure that citizens comply with the minimum public health standards.

text: Apang nangin trending ang mga estudyante sa Taiyuan, China sa Shanxi province bangud bilang kabahin sang COVID-19 protocol, ginpasuksok ang mga ini sang costume nga ‘pakpak;’ agud masunod ang physical distancing.
english: But students in Taiyuan, China in Shanxi province became trending because as part of the COVID-19 protocol, they were made to wear costumes that say 'wings;' to observe physical distancing.

text:
Magluwas sa ila facemask, required man sa mga estudyante ang pagsuksok sang mga pakpak nga may lain-lain nga disenyo kag ginbansagan “wings for social distancing.”

Nagapati naman ang mga otoridad nga epektibo ini nga pamaagi agud nga malikawan ang paglatnanay sang virus sa mga eskwelahan.
english:
In addition to their facemasks, students are also required to wear wings with different designs and nicknamed “wings for social distancing.”

Authorities believe that this is an effective way to prevent the spread of the virus in schools.

text: Enjoy man ang mga kabataan sa sini nga inisyatibo bangud mas nagbukas pa ang ila nga imagination.
english: The children also enjoyed this initiative because it opened their imagination.

text: Nakaandan naman sang mga kabataan ang magsuksok sang ila mga pakpak antes magsulod sa eskwelahan sa China sa diin ini nga lihok ang nakalab-ot naman sa iban nga mga pungsod.
english: It is customary for children to wear their wings before entering school in China, where the practice has spread to other countries.

text: Aprubado na ni Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr.
english: Approved by Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr.

text: ang importasyon sang 25,000 metric tons (MT) sang frozen fish kag aquatic products.
english: the importation of 25,000 metric tons (MT) of frozen fish and aquatic products.

text: Sa Memorandum Order 51, ginsiling sang tiglikom nga ang 24,000 MT amo ang salmon, squid, tuna, black-cod, gindara, halibut sardines kag red snapper.
english: In Memorandum Order 51, the secretary said the 24,000 MT were salmon, squid, tuna, black-cod, dindara, halibut sardines and red snapper.

text: Ang nabilin naman nga 1,000 MT amo ang para sa small pelagic fishes nga igabaligya sa idalom sang Kadiwa ng Pangulo (KNP) program.
english: The remaining 1,000 MT is for small pelagic fish to be sold under the Kadiwa ng Pangulo (KNP) program.

text: Ginplastar sang tiglikom nga pagpaniguro ini nga steady ang suplay sang barato nga isda kag kaangay nga mga produkto.
english: The secretary laid out this assurance to ensure a steady supply of cheap fish and related products.

text: “In order to ensure the steady supply of affordable fish and fishery/aquatic products for a food-secure country, taking into consideration public welfare and to support the implementation of KNP, a total volume of 1,000 MT shall be allocated for distribution to the Kadiwa Centers,” suno kay Tiu Laurel.
english: “In order to ensure the steady supply of affordable fish and fishery/aquatic products for a food-secure country, taking into consideration public welfare and to support the implementation of KNP, a total volume of 1,000 MT shall be allocated for distribution to the Kadiwa Centers,” according to Tiu Laurel.

text: Ginpakigbahin man sini nga ginpresentar sang Fisheries and Aquaculture Board of the Philippines sa meeting sang National Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Management Council (NFARMC) sang Sept.
english: He also shared that the Fisheries and Aquaculture Board of the Philippines presented at the meeting of the National Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Management Council (NFARMC) on Sept.

text: 2 nga may yara sang request para sa issuance sang Certificate of Necessity to Import (CNI) para sa isda kag aquatic products para nga matapna ang inflation, masiguro ang food security kag mangin mas madamo ang food choices.
english: 2 which contains a request for the issuance of a Certificate of Necessity to Import (CNI) for fish and aquatic products to curb inflation, ensure food security and increase food choices.

text: “The NFARMC issued Resolution 35 approving and recommending the issuance of a special CNI 25,000 MT of salmon (whole), species of squid that will not compete with local production, tuna (by-products only), black-cod (whole), gindara (whole), and halibut (whole) for the months of September to December 2024,” dugang sang tiglikom.
english: “The NFARMC issued Resolution 35 approving and recommending the issuance of a special CNI 25,000 MT of salmon (whole), species of squid that will not compete with local production, tuna (by-products only), black-cod (whole), gindara (whole), and halibut (whole) for the month of September 2024,” it added. of the secretary.

text: Kuwalipikado nga maka-import ang mga indibidwal, corporations, partnerships, registered fisheries associations ukon cooperatives nga may active accreditation bilang importers sang food fish sa idalom sang Fisheries Administrative Order 195 ukon rehistrado sa idalom sang FAO 259.
english: Individuals, corporations, partnerships, registered fisheries associations or cooperatives with active accreditation as importers of food fish under Fisheries Administrative Order 195 or registered under FAO 259 are eligible to import.

text: Ang kada qualified importer ang mahimo maka-import sang initial volume nga 28 MT.
english: Each qualified importer can import an initial volume of 28 MT.

text: Nagpanguna ang Pilipinas sa mga pungsod sa Southeast Asia sa may pinakamaayo nga performance sa 2024 Paris Olympics.
english: The Philippines topped Southeast Asian countries with the best performance at the 2024 Paris Olympics.

text: Kadungan sang ika-100 nga pagpasakop sang pungsod sa Olympiada, maragtason man ang nakuha sini nga duha ka gold medals kag duha ka bronze.
english: Along with the country's 100th participation in the Olympics, it also won two gold medals and two bronze medals.

text: Ang duha ka bulawan nga medalya ang pareho nga halin sa 24-anyos nga gymnast nga si Carlos Edriel Yulo nga nagkampyon sa vault kag floor exercise sa artistic gymnastics, samtang ang mga boksidor naman nga sanday Nesthy Petecio kag Aira Villegas ang nakabulsa sang duha ka bronze nga mga medalya.
english: The two gold medals went to 24-year-old gymnast Carlos Edriel Yulo who won the vault and floor exercise in artistic gymnastics, while boxers Nesthy Petecio and Aira Villegas pocketed two bronze medals.

text: Ini nga performance sang Pilipinas ang nakalapaw pa sa nahimo sini sa Tokyo Games kun sa diin may isa ini ka gold medal, duha ka silver kag isa ka bronze.
english: The Philippines' performance surpassed its performance at the Tokyo Games where it won one gold medal, two silver and one bronze.

text: Sa Tokyo 2020, nangin best performing nation man ang Pilipinas sa Southeast Asia.
english: In Tokyo 2020, the Philippines also became the best performing nation in Southeast Asia.

text: Ang Paris kag Tokyo Games ang nagamarka man sang labing-una nga tion nga nakaangkon ang Pilipinas sang multiple medals sa back-to-back Olympics.
english: The Paris and Tokyo Games also mark the first time the Philippines has won multiple medals in back-to-back Olympics.

text: Nagapangaduha sa Pilipinas subong nga tuig amo ang Indonesia nga may duha ka golds — courtesy sang weightlifter ng si Rizki Juniansyah kag sport climber nga si Veddriq Leonardo — kag isa ka bronze.
english: Second in the Philippines this year is Indonesia with two golds — courtesy of weightlifter Rizki Juniansyah and sport climber Veddriq Leonardo — and a bronze.

text: Nagpangatlo naman ang Thailand nga apisar may anum ka medalya, isa lang ang gold.
english: Thailand came third with six medals, but only one gold.

text: Nagpang-apat ang Malaysia nga may duha ka badminton bronzes samtang may isa naman ka bronze ang Singapore.
english: Malaysia came fourth with two badminton bronzes while Singapore had one bronze.

text: Tanan nga tawo ang may yara sang ginakahadlukan, fears ukon phobia.
english: Everyone has something they are afraid of, fears or phobias.

text: Ang iban mga insekto nga nagakamang, kadulom ukon madalom nga tubig ang ginakahangaw-an.
english: Some are crawling insects, darkness or deep water is a concern.

text: Apang sa United Kingdom, may isa ka 12 anyos nga solterito nga indi aswang ukon kalag ang ginakahadlukan kundi pagkaon.
english: But in the United Kingdom, there is a 12-year-old boy who is not afraid of ghosts or ghosts but of food.

text: Siya amo si Ashton Fisher kag isa na ka dekada nga nagamantinir sa pagkaon sang isa ka sahi sang puti nga tinapay kag fruit yogurt bag-o gin-diagnose nga may food phobia.
english: He is Ashton Fisher and has been maintaining a diet of one kind of white bread and fruit yogurt for a decade before being diagnosed with food phobia.

text: Suno kay Cara Fisher, iloy ni Ashton, humalin sang duha ka-tuig, naga-panic attack, ginakulbaan kag nagahibi ang iya nga anak kun pakan-on ini sang iban nga mga pagkaon magluwas sa banana yogurt kag slice sang white bread ukon tinapay.
english: According to Cara Fisher, Ashton's mother, since he was two years old, her son has been having panic attacks, getting nervous and crying when he is fed other foods besides banana yogurt and a slice of white bread.

text: Apisar indi pa matumod sang eksperto kun paano na-develop sang solterito ang tumalagsahon kag pinasahi nga kondisyon, nagapati naman ang iloy sini nga ang reflux sang iya anak humalin sang lapsag ang gintunaan sang iya food phobia.
english: Although experts cannot yet determine how the boy developed the unusual condition, his mother believes that her son's reflux since infancy caused his food phobia.

text: Nag-atras si House Deputy Speaker Rodante Marcoleta sa pagpadalagan sa pagka-senador.
english: House Deputy Speaker Rodante Marcoleta withdrew from the senatorial race.

text: Si Elections Commissioner George Garcia mismo ang nagkumpirma nga nabaton sang COMELEC en banc ang nangin withdrawal papers sang mamalidha.
english: Elections Commissioner George Garcia himself confirmed that the COMELEC en banc received the withdrawal papers of the lawmaker.

text: Suno kay Garcia, tanan nga boto para kay Marcoleta sa Mayo 9 ang kilalahon nga stray kag indi pag-isipon.
english: Garcia said all votes for Marcoleta on May 9 will be recognized as stray and will not be counted.

text: Si Marcoleta amo ang representative sang SAGIP Partylist sa Kamara kag kabahin sang UniTeam slate ni presidential kag vice presidential candidates Ferdinand ‘Bongbong’ Marcos Jr.
english: Marcoleta is the representative of the SAGIP Partylist in the House of Representatives and part of the UniTeam slate of presidential and vice presidential candidates Ferdinand ‘Bongbong’ Marcos Jr.

text: kag Sara Duterte-Carpio.
english: and Sara Duterte-Carpio.

text: Suno anay sa Marcos spokesman nga si Atty. Vic Rodriguez, siya ang “first pick” sa ila nga senatorial lineup.
english: Former Marcos spokesman Atty. Vic Rodriguez, he is the “first pick” in their senatorial lineup.

text: Sa official statement sang opisina ni Marcoleta, ginpahayag sini nga nabasa na niya kun ano ang dalagan sang eleksyon bangud base sa surveys, wala siya nakasulod sa Magic 12.
english: In an official statement from Marcoleta's office, he said he had read the election results because based on surveys, he did not make it to the Magic 12.

text: “The fighter in me should also be brave enough to read the writings on the wall.
english: “The fighter in me should also be brave enough to read the writings on the wall.

text: Let’s call a spade a spade,” pahayag sini.
english: Let’s call a spade a spade,” stated sini.

text: Apisar wala na ini nagapadalagan, nagpasalig ini sang padayon nga suporta sa BBM-Sara tandem, kag sa mga senador sa idalom sang UniTeam kag PDP-Laban slates.
english: Although he is no longer running, he assured continued support to the BBM-Sara tandem, and to senators under the UniTeam and PDP-Laban slates.

text: Subong nga summer, tuman ang ma eksperyensyahan nga init sa palibot.
english: This summer, the environment is experiencing a lot of heat.

text: Nahibaluan mo bala nga mahimo man maangkon ang nagkalain-lain nga balatian sa mata bangud sa tuman nga init?
english: Did you know that various eye diseases can also be caused by extreme heat?

text: Suno sa mga health experts nga sanday Dr. Sharlene Nogueraisa ka ophthalmologist kag cornea specialist kag si Dr. Patricia Grulla-Quilendrino isa ka retina specialist, delikado ang ultraviolet (UV) rays sang adlaw sa mga mata sang tawo sa diin mahimo ini nga maguba.
english: According to health experts Dr. Sharlene Nogueraisa ophthalmologist and cornea specialist and Dr. Patricia Grulla-Quilendrino is a retina specialist, the ultraviolet (UV) rays of the sun are dangerous to human eyes where they can be damaged.

text:
Paathag pa sang mga eksperto, may yara sang tatlo ka mga kategorya ang UV rays: ini amo ang UV-A, UV-B kag UV-C.

Ang UV-C ang pinakamalala nga sahi sang UV radiation.
english:
Experts explain that there are three categories of UV rays: UV-A, UV-B and UV-C.

UV-C is the most harmful form of UV radiation.

text: Ang UV-A kag UV-B naman ang masami nga nagalapaw sa ozone layer kag nagaguba sa mata.
english: UV-A and UV-B, on the other hand, often penetrate the ozone layer and damage the eyes.

text: Ang epekto sang madugay nga pagbabad sa UV-B sang mata amo ang pag-angkon sang sakit nga pterygium kag pagkasunog sang cornea sang mata.
english: The effect of prolonged UV-B exposure of the eye is the development of pterygium disease and burning of the cornea of ​​the eye.

text: Samtang ang UV-A naman amo ang pagsulod sang radiation sa mata nga nagalab-ot sa lente kag retina rason nga nagakaguba ang mga mata sang tawo.
english: Meanwhile, UV-A is the entry of radiation into the eye that reaches the lens and retina causing damage to the human eyes.

text: Panugyan sang mga eksperto, maggamit sang shades nga kontra sa UV rays kag pilion ang shades nga may proteksyon sa UV-A kag UV-B radiation.
english: Experts recommend using shades that are anti-UV rays and choosing shades that protect against UV-A and UV-B radiation.

text: Mahimo man nga maggamit sang polarized glasses.
english: You can also use polarized glasses.

text: Nakahingagaw-balik ang Estados Unidos sang Amerika sa pinakaibabaw nga pwesto sang medal tally inoras antes ang closing ceremony sang Paris Olympics 2024.
english: The United States of America has regained the top spot in the medal tally hours before the closing ceremony of the Paris 2024 Olympics.

text: Nahimo ini paagi sa nangin makahalawat-hawat nga hampang sang women’s basketball team sa tunga sang Team USA kag host nga France.
english: This was done through what turned out to be a thrilling women’s basketball team match between Team USA and host France.

text: Diutayan lang nakahimo sang isa sa makabig all-time Olympic upsets ang French basketball players apang napunggan ini sang Americans kag nakuha ang kadalag-an sa isa gid lamang ka puntos, 67-66.
english: The French basketball players almost caused one of the all-time Olympic upsets but the Americans held it off and won by just one point, 67-66.

text: Ini na ang ila ikawalo nga sunod-sunod nga Olympic gold sa women’s basketball kag amo man ang ika-40 nga gold medal sang US sa medal table sa Paris Games.
english: This is their eighth straight Olympic gold in women’s basketball and also the 40th gold medal for the US on the medal table at the Paris Games.

text: Pareho ini nga numero sa 40 ka bulawan nga medalya sang China apang may 44 silver ang US kag 27 lamang ang China.
english: This is the same number as China’s 40 gold medals but the US has 44 silvers and China only 27.

text: May 126 medals overall man ang Americans ipaanggid sa 91 sang mga Chinese.
english: The Americans also have 126 medals overall compared to 91 for the Chinese.

text: Ini na ang ika-apat nga sunod-sunod nga Olympiada nga nagpangibabaw ang USA.
english: This is the fourth consecutive Olympiad that the USA has dominated.

text: Nagpangatlo sa medal tally ang Japan nga may 20 ka golds — pareho man sa ila pwesto sa Tokyo 2020.
english: Japan finished third in the medal tally with 20 golds — the same as their Tokyo 2020 position.

text: Ini naman ang best-ever medal haul sang Australia nga nagpang-apat nga may 18 golds, samtang nagpangalima naman ang host nga France nga may 16 golds nga amo ang ila best result halin sang 1900 sang sila man ang nag-host sang Olympics.
english: This is Australia's best-ever medal haul, which finished fourth with 18 golds, while host France finished fifth with 16 golds, their best result since 1900 when they also hosted the Olympics.

text: Nagpanguna sanday Piolo Pascual, Julia Montes, kag Charlie Dizon sa mga nakabaton sang awards sa seventh edition sang annual Entertainment Editors’ Choice (Eddy) Awards.
english: Piolo Pascual, Julia Montes, and Charlie Dizon topped the award recipients at the seventh edition of the annual Entertainment Editors’ Choice (Eddy) Awards.

text:
Yari ang lista sang winners:

Best Picture: “About Us But Not About Us”

Best Actor: Piolo Pascual for “Mallari”

Best Actress: Julia Montes for “Five Break-Ups and a Romance”; Charlie Dizon for “Third World Romance”

Best Supporting Actor: Enchong Dee for “GomBurZa”

Best Supporting Actress: Gladys Reyes for “Apag”

Best Director: Jun Robles Lana for “About Us But Not About Us”

Best Screenplay: Jun Robles Lana for “About Us But Not About Us”

Best Production Design: Mariel Hizon for “Mallari”

Best Cinematography: Juan Lorenzo Orendain for “Mallari”

Best Editing: Lawrence S. Ang for “About Us But Not About Us”

Best Original Theme Song: “Sa Duyan ng Bayan” for “GomBurZa”

Best Visual Effects: “Shake, Rattle & Roll Extreme”

Best Sound: Immanuel Verona and Nerrika Salim for “Mallari”

Best Musical Score: Von De Guzman for “Mallari”

Box Office Heroes: Dingdong Dantes, Marian Rivera, Piolo Pascual, Alden Richards, Julia Montes, and Kathryn Bernardo

Movie Icon Awardees: Nova Villa, Leo Martinez, Lito Lapid, Eva Darren, and Gina Alajar

Ang “The Eddys” ang gin-organisa sang Society of Philippine Entertainment Editors sa tuyo nga maengganyo ang local filmmakers, producers, writers, kag actors nga padayunon ang paghimo sang sini nga mga obra-maestra nga replika sang matuod nga nagakatabo sa sosyudad.
english:
Here is the list of winners:

Best Picture: “About Us But Not About Us”

Best Actor: Piolo Pascual for “Mallari”

Best Actress: Julia Montes for “Five Break-Ups and a Romance”; Charlie Dizon for “Third World Romance”

Best Supporting Actor: Enchong Dee for “GomBurZa”

Best Supporting Actress: Gladys Reyes for “Apag”

Best Director: Jun Robles Lana for “About Us But Not About Us”

Best Screenplay: Jun Robles Lana for “About Us But Not About Us”

Best Production Design: Mariel Hizon for “Mallari”

Best Cinematography: Juan Lorenzo Orendain for “Mallari”

Best Editing: Lawrence S. Ang for “About Us But Not About Us”

Best Original Theme Song: “Sa Duyan ng Bayan” for “GomBurZa”

Best Visual Effects: “Shake, Rattle & Roll Extreme”

Best Sound: Immanuel Verona and Nerrika Salim for “Mallari”

Best Musical Score: Von De Guzman for “Mallari”

Box Office Heroes: Dingdong Dantes, Marian Rivera, Piolo Pascual, Alden Richards, Julia Montes, and Kathryn Bernardo

Movie Icon Awardees: Nova Villa, Leo Martinez, Lito Lapid, Eva Darren, and Gina Alajar

“The Eddys” was organized by the Society of Philippine Entertainment Editors to encourage local filmmakers, producers, writers, and actors to continue creating these works of art that are replicas of what is really happening in society.

text: Ginpadayon pa ang Estados Unidos sang Amerika ang paghari sini sa men’s basketball sa Olympiada matapos nabulsa na naman ang gold medal sa Paris paagi sa paglutos sa NBA Rookie of the Year nga si Victor Wembanyama kag sa host nation nga France sa finals, 98-87.
english: The United States of America continued its reign in men's basketball at the Olympics after pocketing another gold medal in Paris by defeating NBA Rookie of the Year Victor Wembanyama and host nation France in the finals, 98-87.

text: Ini na ang ikalima nga sunod-sunod nga Olympic title para sa men’s basketball team sang US kag ika-17 sa bug-os nga Olympic history sang pungsod.
english: This is the fifth consecutive Olympic title for the US men’s basketball team and the 17th in the country’s entire Olympic history.

text: Nagpanguna si Stephen Curry sa team nga may 24 points kag 5 assists; may 14 points, 9 assists kag 6 rebounds si LeBron James; samtang may 15 points, 4 rebounds, kag 4 assists si Kevin Durant.
english: Stephen Curry led the team with 24 points and 5 assists; LeBron James had 14 points, 9 assists and 6 rebounds; while Kevin Durant had 15 points, 4 rebounds, and 4 assists.

text: Ini ang rematch sang duha ka pungsod sa natabo sa Tokyo 2020 kun sa diin nakuha man sang US ang Olympic title sang ginlutos sini ang France, 87-82, sa final match.
english: This is a rematch of the two countries in Tokyo 2020 where the US also won the Olympic title when it defeated France, 87-82, in the final match.

text: Talalupangdon ini nga tuig sa Olympiada bangud ini na ang posible katapusan nga Summer Games appearance sang basketball legends kaangay kanday James kag Durant bangud man sa ila edad.
english: This year is notable for the Olympiad because it is likely to be the last Summer Games appearance of basketball legends like James and Durant due to their age.

text: “You just simply marvel,” pahayag ni James sa iya NBA rival nga si Curry.
english: “You’re just simply marvelous,” James said of his NBA rival Curry.

text:
“Having him on your side, you just try to get stops and figure out other ways on the other end but keep finding him, keep getting him the ball.”

Sa iya late-game heroics, nag-react naman ang Warriors superstar: “I was just trying to settle us down.
english:
“Having him on your side, you just try to get stops and figure out other ways on the other end but keep finding him, keep getting him the ball.”

On his late-game heroics, the Warriors superstar reacted: “I was just trying to settle us down.

text: All we wanted to do was get a good shot.
english: All we wanted to do was get a good shot.

text: It had been a while since we had a good possession… (Finally) the momentum was on our side.
english: It had been a while since we had a good possession… (Finally) the momentum was on our side.

text: At that point, your mind goes blank.
english: At that point, your mind goes blank.

text: You don’t really care about setting or the scenario or anything.
english: You don’t really care about setting or the scenario or anything.

text:
It’s just a shot.”

Ini na ang ikaapat nga Olympic gold ni Durant, ikatatlo ni James, kag bisan isa na ka four-time NBA champion si Steph, ini pa lang ang iya una nga gold medal sa Summer Games bangud ini man ang iya una nga Olympic appearance.
english:
It’s just a shot.”

This is Durant's fourth Olympic gold, James' third, and although Steph is a four-time NBA champion, this is his first gold medal at the Summer Games as it is also his first Olympic appearance.

text: “There’s a lot of relief,” dugang ni Curry.
english: “There’s a lot of relief,” Curry added.

text: “It wasn’t easy but, damn, I’m excited, man.
english: “It wasn’t easy but, damn, I’m excited, man.

text:
This is everything that I wanted it to be and more, so I’m excited.”

Nakuha naman sang Serbia ang bronze medal matapos ang 93-83 victory batok sa World Cup champions nga Germany.
english:
This is everything that I wanted it to be and more, so I’m excited.”

Serbia won the bronze medal after a 93-83 victory over World Cup champions Germany.

text: Ang three-time NBA Most Valuable Player nga si Nikola Jokic ang naghimo sang triple double nga 19 points, 12 rebounds kag 11 assists para pangunahan ang pungsod.
english: Three-time NBA Most Valuable Player Nikola Jokic notched a triple double of 19 points, 12 rebounds and 11 assists to lead the nation.

text: Antes ang bronze medal match, ginlutos sila sang US sa semis, 95-91.
english: Before the bronze medal match, the US defeated them in the semis, 95-91.

text: ILOILO CITY- Kon ang Pilipinas, may Toyang Ermitanya, ang iban nga pungsod may yara man sang ila.
english: ILOILO CITY- If the Philippines has Toyang Ermitanya, other countries have theirs.

text: Ini amo si Panta Petrović nga nagaistar sa kweba sa canyon sang Gradašnička river sa Serbia sa sulod na sang 16 ka tuig nga malayo sa moderno nga sibilisasyon kag kaupod niya ang mga kasapatan lakip na ang dako 200-kilogram nga baboy talunon nga ang pangalan amo si Mara.
english: This is Panta Petrović who has been living in a cave in the canyon of the Gradašnička river in Serbia for 16 years away from modern civilization and with him animals including a large 200-kilogram wild boar named Mara.

text: May yara ini sang isa ka treehouse kag may balay man ini sa sulod sang kweba.
english: It has a treehouse and it also has a house inside the cave.

text: Nagapaligo siya sa suba kag nagatulog sa duta.
english: He bathes in the river and sleeps on the ground.

text: Suno kay Panta, sadto,antes siya nangin ermitanyo, manggaranon ini apang sang nagpamigado siya, nadula man ang mga abyan niya.
english: According to Panta, before he became a hermit, he was rich but when he became poor, he lost his friends.

text: Bangod sini, nagdesisyon siya nga magkabuhi bilang isa ka ermitanyo.
english: Because of this, he decided to live as a hermit.

text: Sa subong, may mga tawo nga nagabisita sa iya kag nagadala man sang supplies kag pagkaon para sa mga sapat kag para sa iya, ini na ang pinakamanami nga eksperyensa samtang nagakabuhi siya sa kalibutan.
english: Now, there are people who visit her and also bring supplies and food for the animals and for her, this is the best experience while she is alive in the world.

text: Makabulig ang mga steel barriers nga ginpahamtang sang Traffic and Transportation Management Office ukon TTMO sa pagpahagan-hagan sang kagutok sang trapiko sa Iloilo City subong nga holiday rush.
english: The steel barriers installed by the Traffic and Transportation Management Office (TTMO) will help ease traffic congestion in Iloilo City during the holiday rush.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Retired Police Colonel Uldarico Garbanzos, ginapatuman ang pagbutang sang barriers agud ma-manage ang dalagan sang trapiko, ilabi na nga ginapaabot nga madamo sang mga selebrasyon kag bisita nga magakadto sa syudad sang Iloilo subong nga holiday season.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Retired Police Colonel Uldarico Garbanzos said the barriers are being installed to manage the flow of traffic, especially as many celebrations and visitors are expected to come to Iloilo City this holiday season.

text: Gindugang pa ni Garbanzos nga ginapaabot man ang pagsaka sang pedestrian cases, ilabi na nga may mga tawo nga kun kis-a wala nagasunod sa ginapatuman nga traffic rules kag regulations.
english: Garbanzos added that an increase in pedestrian cases is also expected, especially since there are people who sometimes do not follow the enforced traffic rules and regulations.

text: Nagpanumdum man siya sa mga motorista nga sundon gid ang husto nga pag-uturn, kun sa diin ang inner lane lamang ang dapat okupahon, agud malikawan ang dugang nga kagutok sang trapiko.
english: He also reminded motorists to follow the correct uturn, where only the inner lane should be occupied, to avoid further traffic congestion.

text: Subong nga holiday season, yara sa full duty status ang mga traffic auxiliary kag iban pa nga personnel sang TTMO agud makabulig sa pagpatuman sang kaayusan sa dalan, ilabi na kun kinahanglanon.
english: This holiday season, traffic auxiliaries and other personnel of the TTMO are on full duty status to assist in the implementation of road maintenance, especially when necessary.

text: Ginapangabay man sang otoridad ang kooperasyon sang publiko, nga maghalong sa pagpanakayan agud malikawan ang aksidente, sundon ang traffic signages kag rules, kag respetuhon ang mga traffic personnel nga naga-duty sa karsada.
english: The authorities also ask for the cooperation of the public, to be careful while driving to avoid accidents, follow traffic signages and rules, and respect the traffic personnel on duty on the road.

text: Nagpangibabaw sa 39 ka iban pa nga mga kandidata kag ginkoronahan bilang Binibining Pilipinas International 2024 ang kandidata sang Abra nga si Myrna Esguerra.
english: Abra candidate Myrna Esguerra topped 39 other candidates and was crowned Miss Pilipinas International 2024.

text: Ginhiwat ang koronasyon sa Araneta Coliseum kagab-i, Hulyo 7.
english: The coronation was held at the Araneta Coliseum last night, July 7.

text: Magluwas nga nangin successor ni Binibining Pilipinas International 2023 Angelica Lopez, nakuha man ni Esguerra ang tatlo ka special awards nga amo ang Best in National Costume, Best in Swimsuit, kag Best in Evening Gown.
english: Besides being the successor of Binibining Pilipinas International 2023 Angelica Lopez, Esguerra also won three special awards namely Best in National Costume, Best in Swimsuit, and Best in Evening Gown.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, nangin Binibining Pilipinas Globe 2024 si Jasmin Bungay sang Pampanga nga amo naman ang nagbulos kay Anna Valencia Lakrini nga nangin 2nd runner-up anay sa Miss Globe 2023 pageant.
english: Meanwhile, Jasmin Bungay of Pampanga became Binibining Pilipinas Globe 2024, replacing Anna Valencia Lakrini who was 2nd runner-up in the Miss Globe 2023 pageant.

text: Sanday Christal dela Cruz sang Zambales kag Trisha Martinez sang Pila, Laguna ang gindeklarar naman nga 1st runner-up kag 2nd runner-up.
english: Christal dela Cruz of Zambales and Trisha Martinez of Pila, Laguna were declared 1st runner-up and 2nd runner-up.

text: Ini nga koronasyon amo man ang nagmarka sa ika-60 nga tuig sang Binibining Pilipinas nga amo ang pinakamalawig na nga national pageant sa Pilipinas.
english: The coronation also marked the 60th anniversary of Binibining Pilipinas, the longest-running national pageant in the Philippines.

text: Gintambungan ini sang masobra isa ka gatos ka Binibining Queens kun sa diin nangin highlight man ang grand union sang apat sini ka produkto nga lunsay nakakuha sang Miss Universe title nga sanday Gloria Diaz (1969), Margarita Moran (1973), Pia Wurtzbach (2015), kag Catriona Gray (2018).
english: It was attended by more than 100 Binibining Queens where the grand union of four of her products who all won the Miss Universe title, Gloria Diaz (1969), Margarita Moran (1973), Pia Wurtzbach (2015), and Catriona Gray (2018), was also a highlight.

text: Nangin hosts sa programa sanday Gray, Nicole Cordoves, MJ Lastimosa, Kylie Versoza, kag Ruffa Gutierrez samtang lakip naman sa special guests si reigning Miss International 2023 Andrea Rubio.
english: Gray, Nicole Cordoves, MJ Lastimosa, Kylie Versoza, and Ruffa Gutierrez hosted the program while reigning Miss International 2023 Andrea Rubio was among the special guests.

text: Sa lamharon naton nga edad, masami kita ginapamangkot sang aton ginikanan, kun ano ang aton nga handom kun kita magdako.
english: At a young age, our parents often ask us what we want to be when we grow up.

text: Ang iban, luyag nga mangin doktor, manunudlo, nurse ukon abogado.
english: Others, want to be doctors, teachers, nurses or lawyers.

text: Apang sa iban nga pungsod may yara man sang mga tawo nga humalin sang gamay, handom na ang mangin isa ka ‘yaya, suluguon ukon nanny’.
english: But in other countries there are also people who from an early age, dream of becoming a 'nanny, servant or nanny'

text: Sa sulod na sa sang 120 ka-tuig, nangin kilala sa England ang Norland College sa bilog nga kalibutan bangud sa ila masangkad nga nanny-training program sa diin kadam-an sa mga graduate ang naga-landing sa manggaranon nga pamilya kag may kita nga masobra $170,000 per year ukon kapin P8.6 million kada tuig.
english: For 120 years, Norland College in England has become known worldwide for its extensive nanny-training program where most graduates land in wealthy families and earn more than $170,000 per year or more than P8.6 million per year.

text: Ini nga eskwelahan ang gintukod sang late 1800’s ni Emily Wizard nga amo ang nakarealisar nga wala sang opisyal nga childcare training sang amo nga tion.
english: This school was founded in the late 1800’s by Emily Wizard who was the one who realized that there was no official childcare training at the time.

text: Kalabanan sa mga kliyente sa Norland College amo ang manggaranon nga mga mag-asawa ukon couples kalakip na ang Royal families.
english: Most of the clients at Norland College are wealthy couples including Royal families.

text: Ang pinasahi nga curriculum nga ginatudlo sa Norland ang rason kun ngaa makabig nga tuman ka expensive ukon mahal ang Norland-trained nannies ukon mga suluguon.
english: The special curriculum taught at Norland is the reason why Norland-trained nannies are considered very expensive.

text: Buhion liwat ni Pope Leo XIV ang ginatos na ka tuig nga tradisyon sang mga Santo Papa paagi sa iya pagpahuway sa Castel Gandolfo sa Italya sa Summer.
english: Pope Leo XIV will revive the centuries-old tradition of Popes by resting at Castel Gandolfo in Italy this Summer.

text: Magabakasyon ang Santo Papa halin sa Hulyo 6 tubtob Hulyo 20 sa amo nga lugar nga isa ka oras ang biyahe halin sa Roma.
english: The Pope will be on vacation from July 6 to July 20 in the area, which is an hour's drive from Rome.

text: Sa banwa nga ini, ginabanta 8,900 nga mga residente nga nahamtang sa baybayon sang Lake Albano.
english: In this town, approximately 8,900 residents are located on the shores of Lake Albano.

text: Ang alkalde sang banwa kag mga negosyante nagalaum nga ang pagtinir ni Pope Leo (nga amo ang una nga pagbisita sang isa ka Papa sa sulod sang 12 ka tuig) ang magapadamo sang mga turista nga luyag makakita sang bag-o nga lider sang Roman Catholic Church.
english: The town’s mayor and businessmen hope that Pope Leo’s stay (which is the first visit by a Pope in 12 years) will increase the number of tourists eager to catch a glimpse of the new leader of the Roman Catholic Church.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagapanag-iya ang Vatican sang papal palace sa amo nga banwa lakip na ang Renaissance-style gardens halin pa sang 1596.
english: The Vatican has owned the papal palace in the town including the Renaissance-style gardens since 1596.

text: Apang sang tion ni Francis, wala ini nagbakasyon kag nagpili nga sa iya puluy-an sa Vatican magatinir bisan nga summer.
english: But during Francis' time, he did not take a vacation and chose to stay at his home in the Vatican even in the summer.

text: Bisan pa ginapaabot nga indi man masyado makita si Leo sa publiko, may kahigayunan gihapon ang mga tawo nga makakita sa iya sa mga relihiyoso nga selebrasyon sa Hulyo 13 kag Hulyo 20.
english: Although Leo is expected to be less visible in public, people will still have the opportunity to catch a glimpse of him during religious celebrations on July 13 and July 20.

text: Nahibaluan nga madamo na nga Santo Papa antes kay Pope Francis ang nagbakasyon sa Castel Gandolfo kun sa diin mas malamig ipaanggid sa Rome.
english: It is known that many Popes before Pope Francis have vacationed in Castel Gandolfo where it is cooler than in Rome.

text: Nagalab-ot sa 37 degrees Celsius (99 degrees Fahrenheit) ang temperatura sa Roma kun summer.
english: The temperature in Rome reaches 37 degrees Celsius (99 degrees Fahrenheit) in summer.

text: Magapadala ang Canada sang ila “largest trade delegation” sa Pilipinas sa Disyembre agud nga malantaw ang posible nga investment opportunities kag partnerships sa sektor sang depensa, agrikultura, pag-mina, enerhiya, kag imprastraktura.
english: Canada will send its “largest trade delegation” to the Philippines in December to explore possible investment opportunities and partnerships in the defense, agriculture, mining, energy, and infrastructure sectors.

text: Si Mary Ng nga minister sang Export Promotion, International Trade and Economic Development amo ang magapanguna sa “powerhouse” nga Team Canada Trade Mission sa Manila sa December 4 to 6 santo sa gin-anunsyo sang Canadian officials.
english: Mary Ng, Minister of Export Promotion, International Trade and Economic Development, will lead the “powerhouse” Team Canada Trade Mission in Manila from December 4 to 6, Canadian officials announced.

text: “One of the objectives of the team is to provide a platform to expand and diversify our international business portfolios and reach into growing markets,” suno kay Guy Boileau, Senior Trade Commissioner sa Canadian Embassy.
english: “One of the objectives of the team is to provide a platform to expand and diversify our international business portfolios and reach into growing markets,” according to Guy Boileau, Senior Trade Commissioner at the Canadian Embassy.

text: Ginapahayag nga 300 business leaders halin sa masobra 180 organizations sa 17 ka nagkalain-lain nga sektor ang maga-upod sa mission.
english: It is reported that 300 business leaders from more than 180 organizations in 17 different sectors will join the mission.

text: Suporta ini sa Indo-Pacific Strategy sang Canada nga may tuyo nga pabakuron pa ang relasyon sini sa Indo Pacific region lakip na sa Pilipinas sa trade, security, kag people-to-people ties.
english: This is in support of Canada's Indo-Pacific Strategy which aims to further strengthen its relations with the Indo Pacific region including the Philippines in trade, security, and people-to-people ties.

text: “At the end of the day, we are looking for a stable and predictable business environment.
english: “At the end of the day, we are looking for a stable and predictable business environment.

text: And what we have seen over the past few years is that the Philippines is indeed going in that direction, so that’s quite interesting and promising for partnerships in collaboration,” dugang ni Boilaeu.
english: And what we have seen over the past few years is that the Philippines is indeed going in that direction, so that’s quite interesting and promising for partnerships in collaboration,” Boilaeu added.

text: Ginpadayaw man sang Team Canada nga napamatud-an na nila nga epektibo nga paagi ang trade missions para sa ekonomiya bangud sa kaangay man nga misyon nga ila gihimo sa Japan kun sa diin may resulta nga 70 new contracts.
english: Team Canada also boasted that they have proven that trade missions are an effective way for the economy because of a similar mission they conducted in Japan which resulted in 70 new contracts.

text: Matandaan nga sang Enero, may yara man sang US Presidential Trade and Investment Mission sa Pilipinas nga ginpangunahan sang US Secretary of Commerce kag gin-updan sang high-level executives, mga kumpaniya, kag business organizations.#
english: In January, there was also a US Presidential Trade and Investment Mission to the Philippines led by the US Secretary of Commerce and accompanied by high-level executives, companies, and business organizations.

text: Napilian ang medalists nga sanday Carlos Yulo kag Aira Villegas nga amo ang mangin flagbearers sang Pilipinas sa closing ceremony sang 2024 Paris Olympics.
english: Medalists Carlos Yulo and Aira Villegas have been selected to be the flagbearers of the Philippines in the closing ceremony of the 2024 Paris Olympics.

text: Matabo ang seremonya ‘las tres sa kaagahon sa Lunes (Philippine time) sa Stade de France.
english: The ceremony will take place at 3 am on Monday (Philippine time) at the Stade de France.

text: Si Yulo amo ang nagpanguna sa delegasyon sang pungsod subong nga tuig matapos nabulsa ang duha ka gold medals sa vault kag floor exercise sa men’s artistic gymnastics samtang debutant naman si Villegas sa Olympiada nga nakakuha sang bronze medal sa women’s 50kg division sa boxing.
english: Yulo led the country's delegation this year after pocketing two gold medals in the vault and floor exercise in men's artistic gymnastics while Villegas is a debutant at the Olympiad who won a bronze medal in the women's 50kg division in boxing.

text: Suno sa Philippine Olympic Committee (POC), magaupod man sa closing ceremony ang isa pa ka bronze medalist kag flagbearer sa opening ceremony nga si Nesthy Petecio kag iban pa nga mga tiglawas sang Pilipinas nga sanday Carlo Paalam, Hergie Bacyadan kag Eumir Marcial, John Ceniza, Elreen Ando, Vanessa Sarno, kag Lauren Hoffman.
english: According to the Philippine Olympic Committee (POC), another bronze medalist and flagbearer of the opening ceremony, Nesthy Petecio, and other representatives of the Philippines, Carlo Paalam, Hergie Bacyadan and Eumir Marcial, John Ceniza, Elreen Ando, ​​Lauren Lauren, Van Hoff and Sarnoff, will also attend the closing ceremony.

text: Lakip man sa 20-strong delegation amo ang boxing kag weightlifting coaches.
english: Also among the 20-strong delegation are boxing and weightlifting coaches.

text: Ang duha ka gold medals ni Yulo amo ang naglapaw sa impresibo man nga performance sang Pilipinas sa Tokyo 2020 sang naka-isa ini ka gold medal, duha ka silver medals, kag isa ka bronze.
english: Yulo's two gold medals surpassed the Philippines' impressive performance at Tokyo 2020 when it won one gold medal, two silver medals, and one bronze.

text: Magaabot ang Olympians sa Martes sang hapon kag natalana nga mag-diretso sa Malacañan Palace kun sa diin nagahulat si President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: The Olympians will arrive on Tuesday afternoon and are scheduled to proceed to the Malacañan Palace where President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. is waiting.

text: agud mag-abi-abi sa ila bilang mga baganihan.
english: to welcome them as heroes.

text: Handa ka bala nga batakon ang imo pinalangga agud ma-eksperyensyahan sini ang kabuhi?
english: Are you willing to let your loved one down so they can experience life?

text: Sa Espanya, may isa ka lalaki nga nag-viral sa social media matapos nagserbe bilang mga tiil sang iya hinuptanan nga ido sa pagbibit sini samtang nagadalagan kadungan sang tatlo ka playmate sini nga mga ido.
english: In Spain, a man went viral on social media after serving as the legs of his pet dog to pull it while running alongside three playmates of his dogs.

text: Ang hinuptanan amo si Canelo, isa ka pit bull nga nagasuprer sang isa ka medical condition nga amo ang naghimo sang upang sa iya paghulag sang normal sa diin nagakabtyag ini sang sakit sa lawas kun magtesting ini sa pagdalagan ukon lakat.
english: The pet is Canelo, a pit bull who suffers from a medical condition that prevents him from moving normally where he feels pain in his body when he tries to run or walk.

text: Ang heartwarming nga hitabo ang ginpakigbahin sa social media sang anak sang lalaki nga amo nagkuha sa ila sang video.
english: The heartwarming incident was shared on social media by the son of the man who took the video.

text: Natukiban sang lalaki nga nakahiligan ni Canelo maghampang kaupod ang tatlo ka hinuptanan man nga ido apang indi ini makaupod sa ila pagtumbo-tumbo kag dalagan sa field bangud sa iya kondisyon.
english: The man discovered that Canelo liked to play with three pet dogs but he could not join them in jumping and running on the field because of his condition.

text: Bangud sini, ginhakwat sang lalaki si Canelo kag gindalagan sa field kaupod ang mga playmate nga lunsay man pit bull.
english: As a result, the man picked up Canelo and ran to the field with his playmates who are also pit bulls.

text: Makit-an naman ang kalipay ni Canelo samtang ‘feel na feel’ ang hangin nga nagadapya sa iya nawong kag daw kaangay nga nagayuhom.
english: Canelo's happiness was visible as he felt the wind blowing on his face and seemed to be smiling.

text: Gindayaw naman sang netizens ang tagipusuon sang lalaki para sa iya hinuptanan nga ido.
english: Netizens praised the man's heart for his pet dog.

text: Ginbalik ni anay Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Bulacan District Engineer Henry Alcantara sa Department of Justice (DOJ) ang ikaduha nga bahin sang P300-million kickbacks halin sa flood control project, suno kay Acting Justice Secretary Fredderick Vida.
english: Former Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Bulacan District Engineer Henry Alcantara returned to the Department of Justice (DOJ) the second part of the P300-million kickbacks from the flood control project, according to Acting Justice Secretary Fredderick Vida.

text: Nahibaluan nga masobra P70 million nabalik sa gobyerno.
english: More than P70 million was returned to the government.

text:
Matandaan nga una na ginbalik sang anay opisyal ang yara sa P110 million sang Nobyembre 28, nga kabahain sang ginapahayag nga ginpromisa nga‘restitution.’

Ginkumpirma man ni Prosecutor General Richard Anthony Fadullon nga kwalipikado na si Alcantara bilang state witness.
english:
It can be recalled that the former official had already returned the P110 million on November 28, which is part of the alleged promised 'restitution.

Prosecutor General Richard Anthony Fadullon also confirmed that Alcantara is now qualified as a state witness.

text: Nagalaom ang kampo ni Alcantara nga makabulig ang pagbalik sang kwarta para mapilian ini bilang state witness sa kaso.
english: Alcantara's camp hopes that the return of the money will help him be selected as a state witness in the case.

text: Kadungan sa iya mismo birthday, nakuha ni Vice President Leni Robredo ang endorsement sang Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF) kag ang political party sini nga United Bangsamoro Justice Party (UBJP).
english: On her birthday, Vice President Leni Robredo won the endorsement of the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF) and its political party, the United Bangsamoro Justice Party (UBJP).

text: Gin-anunsyo ini sang MILF kag UBJP officials lakip na ang pila ka mga katapo sang Bangsamoro Government sa isa ka press conference sa Camp Darapanan sa Maguindanao.
english: This was announced by MILF and UBJP officials including some members of the Bangsamoro Government at a press conference at Camp Darapanan in Maguindanao.

text: Sang nagligad nga bulan, ginbisita ni Robredo ang Bangsamoro Government Center sa Cotabato City apang sang amo nga tion, ginpahayag nanday Bangsamoro Minister of Education Mohagher Iqbal kag Minister of Interior Naguib Sinarimbo nga indi pa sila preparado sa pag-endorso sang isa ka partikular nga kandidato.
english: Last month, Robredo visited the Bangsamoro Government Center in Cotabato City but at the time, Bangsamoro Minister of Education Mohagher Iqbal and Minister of Interior Naguib Sinarimbo said they were not yet prepared to endorse a particular candidate.

text: Subong nga adlaw, Abril 23, mismo si MILF chairman kag Bangsamoro Interim Chief Minister Murad Ebrahim, chairman sang UJBP, ang nagbayaw sang kamot ni Robredo.
english: Today, April 23, MILF chairman and Bangsamoro Interim Chief Minister Murad Ebrahim, chairman of the UJBP, raised Robredo's hand.

text: Ang isa pa sa nagbayaw sa iya nga kamot amo si 2nd District Representative Esmael “Toto” Mangudadatu, kandidato sang UJBP sa pagka-gobernador sa Maguindanao.
english: Another one who raised his hand was 2nd District Representative Esmael “Toto” Mangudadatu, UJBP candidate for governor of Maguindanao.

text: Bangud nakuha ni Robredo ang endorsement sang isa ka myembro sang influential nga Mangudadatu clan kag mga lider sang transitional government sang Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM), isa naman ini ka makabig huge blow sa kandidatura ni presidential candidate Manila Mayor Isko Moreno.
english: Robredo's endorsement from a member of the influential Mangudadatu clan and leaders of the transitional government of the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) is another huge blow to the candidacy of presidential candidate Manila Mayor Isko Moreno.

text: Ini bangud antes ang endorsement kay Robredo, si Moreno anay ang ginsuportahan ni Mangundadatu.
english: This is because before the endorsement of Robredo, Moreno was supported by Mangundadatu.

text: Subong, nag-liso kay Robredo ang suporta sang mamalidha.
english: Now, the lawmakers' support has turned to Robredo.

text: Antes sini, nangin aktibo man si Moreno sa pagpangaluyag sa endorsement sang MILF kag BARMM officials.
english: Earlier, Moreno was also active in seeking the endorsement of MILF and BARMM officials.

text: Hiwaton na subong nga Domingo, Hulyo 7, ang coronation para sa Binibining Pilipinas 2024 kun sa diin nagahulat ang tag-P1-million nga padya para sa mapilian nga tagdaog — pinakadaku nga prize money nga ihatag sa sulod sang 60-anyos nga maragtas sang prestihiyoso nga national pageant.
english: The coronation for Binibining Pilipinas 2024 will be held this Sunday, July 7, where a P1-million prize awaits the selected winner — the largest prize money to be awarded in the 60-year history of the prestigious national pageant.

text: Kaangay sa kumpetisyon sa nagligad nga tuig, duha ka winners ang iproklamar kag magabaton sang titulo nga Bb.
english: As in last year's competition, two winners will be proclaimed and will receive the title of Bb.

text: Pilipinas International kag Bb.
english: Philippines International and Bb.

text: Pilipinas Globe.
english: Philippine Globe.

text: Magluwas nga pareho nga makabaton sang P1-million prize, pareho man sila nga magasuksok sang bag-o nga korona nga gin-design sang renowned jewelry kag accessories maker nga si Manny Halasan.
english: Besides both receiving the P1-million prize, they will also both wear a new crown designed by renowned jewelry and accessories maker Manny Halasan.

text: Gin-anunsyo man sang organisasyon nga magadonar ang Bb.
english: The organization also announced that Bb.

text: Pilipinas Charities Inc.
english: Philippines Charities Inc.

text: (BPCI) sang P1-million sa napilian sini nga charity institution subong nga tuig nga amo ang World Vision Philippines.
english: (BPCI) of P1-million to its chosen charity institution this year, World Vision Philippines.

text: Magaserbe nga hosts sa koronasyon amo sanday Miss Universe 2018 Catriona Gray, Miss International 2016 Kylie Verzosa, Miss Grand International 2016 first runner-up Nicole Cordoves, Miss Universe Philippines 2014 MJ Lastimosa, kag 1993 Miss World princess Ruffa Gutierrez.
english: Serving as hosts at the coronation will be Miss Universe 2018 Catriona Gray, Miss International 2016 Kylie Verzosa, Miss Grand International 2016 first runner-up Nicole Cordoves, Miss Universe Philippines 2014 MJ Lastimosa, and 1993 Miss World princess Ruffa Gutierrez.

text: 40 ka mga kandidata ang maga-compete para magbulos sa korona nanday Bb.
english: 40 candidates will compete to succeed the crown of Bb.

text: Pilipinas International Angelica Lopez kag Bb.
english: Pilipinas International Angelica Lopez and Bb.

text: Pilipinas Globe Anna Valencia Lakirini.
english: Pilipinas Globe Anna Valencia Lakirini.

text: Balantayan man ang all-male squad sang musical acts Martin Nievera, Gary Valenciano, TJ Monterde, Maki kag ang phenomenal P-Pop group nga SB19.
english: Also watch out for the all-male squad of musical acts Martin Nievera, Gary Valenciano, TJ Monterde, Maki and the phenomenal P-Pop group SB19.

text: Nahibaluan nga lakip sa na-produce sang Binibining Pilipinas amo ang apat ka Miss Universe winners sang Pilipinas nga sanday Gloria Diaz, Margie Moran, Pia Wurtzbach, kag Gray.
english: Among the producers of Binibining Pilipinas are four Miss Universe winners of the Philippines, Gloria Diaz, Margie Moran, Pia Wurtzbach, and Gray.

text: May yara man sang lima ka Miss International winners Aurora Pijuan, Melanie, Marquez, Precious Lara Quigaman, Bea Rose Santiago, kag si Verzosa.
english: There were also five Miss International winners Aurora Pijuan, Melanie, Marquez, Precious Lara Quigaman, Bea Rose Santiago, and Verzosa.

text: Gikan man sa Bb.
english: Also from Bb.

text: Pilipinas sanday Miss Intercontinental winners Karen Gallman kag Cinderella Faye Obe ita amo man sanday Maricar Balagtas, Ann Colis kag Maureen Montagne nga pareho ginkoronahan sa Miss Globe pageant system.
english: Philippines are Miss Intercontinental winners Karen Gallman and Cinderella Faye Obe ita as well as Maricar Balagtas, Ann Colis and Maureen Montagne who were both crowned in the Miss Globe pageant system.

text: Labi pa nga nagluya ang balor sang Philippine peso batok sa US dollar sang nagtakop sa P59 ang bayluhanay sang local unit kahapon, Nobyembre 21.
english: The Philippine peso weakened further against the US dollar when the local unit exchange rate closed at P59 yesterday, November 21.

text: Ini ang lowest kag weakest level sang local currency batok sa US dollar halin sang Oktubre 17, 2022.
english: This is the lowest and weakest level of the local currency against the US dollar since October 17, 2022.

text: Ini nga depreciation ang kasunod sang pagbaskog sang US dollar batok sa kadam-an nga global currencies bangud ginasiling sang analysts nga indi na magpatigayon ang US Federal Reserve sang interest rate cut sa masunod nga bulan.
english: The depreciation follows the strengthening of the US dollar against most global currencies as analysts say the US Federal Reserve will not implement an interest rate cut next month.

text: May economists man nga nagaangot sini nga movement sa geopolitical risks matapos ang strike sang Ukraine sa Russia gamit ang US-supplied missiles.
english: Some economists also link this movement to geopolitical risks after Ukraine’s strike on Russia with US-supplied missiles.

text: Gin-angot man ini sa gina-antisipar nga seasonal increase kag conversion sa pesos para sa OFW (overseas Filipino workers) remittances agud nga ma-finance ang holiday- ukon Christmas-related spending sa masunod nga bulan.
english: This was also linked to the anticipated seasonal increase and conversion to pesos for OFW (overseas Filipino workers) remittances to finance holiday- or Christmas-related spending next month.

text: Nagpaandam man ang analysts nga kun magpadayon sa pagluya ang balor sang peso, maapektuhan sini ang inflation bangud naga-import ang Pilipinas sang mga produkto nga ginabayaran sa dolyar.
english: Analysts also warned that if the peso continues to depreciate, it will affect inflation because the Philippines imports products paid in dollars.

text: Una na nga ginsiling sang Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) nga gina-monitor sini ang movement sang peso batok sa dollar, apang wala gid sini ginakahangaw-an ang depreciation bangud ginapabay-an lang sini nga diktahan sang market ang movement.
english: Earlier, the Central Bank of the Philippines (BSP) said it was monitoring the movement of the peso against the dollar, but it was not concerned about depreciation because it was letting the market dictate the movement.

text: Ang gahod nga aton mabatian sa aton palibot ang normal na nga kabahin sang aton nga pagpangabuhi.
english: The noise we hear around us is a normal part of our lives.

text: Apang ang wala naton nahibaluan nga amat-amat na nga gina-guba ang aton dulunggan bangud sa nagkalain-lain nga huni nga aton mabatian.
english: But what we don't know is that our ears are slowly being destroyed by the various sounds we hear.

text: Santu sa pagtuon sang World Health Organization (WHO), ang noise pollution ang ika-tatlo sa pinakadako nga problema sa polusyon.
english: According to a study by the World Health Organization (WHO), noise pollution is the third biggest pollution problem.

text: Dako man ang epekto sang gahod sa ikaayong lawas sang tawo.
english: Noise also has a significant impact on human health.

text: Kasunod sini ang stress nga mahimo mangin epekto sang pagtaas sang presyon sang dugo nga mahimo magtuga sa atake sa tagipusuon.
english: This is followed by stress which can be the effect of increased blood pressure which can cause a heart attack.

text: Wala man sang bulong sa pagkabungol, gani kun indi ka na makabati, indi na ini mahimo nga mabalik pa.
english: There is no cure for deafness, so if you lose your hearing, it cannot be reversed.

text: Kakulang sa ihibalo ang isa sa mga rason kun ngaa nagadamo ang tawo nga nagabungol sa Pilipinas.
english: Lack of knowledge is one of the reasons why the number of deaf people in the Philippines is increasing.

text: Nahibaluan nga wala sang layi ukon regulasyon nga direkta nga nagahatag sang solusyon sa nagalala nga problema sang noise pollution.
english: It is known that there is no law or regulation that directly provides a solution to the worsening problem of noise pollution.

text: Agaw atensyon sa social media ang pinasahi nga marriage proposal sang lalaki nga si William Hunn para sa iya kahagugma nga si Brittney Miller sa Atlanta, Georgia.
english: William Hunn's unique marriage proposal to his girlfriend Brittney Miller in Atlanta, Georgia has caught the attention of social media.

text: Ini bangud agud makapili ang iya nobya, indi lang isa kundi lima ka engagement rings ang ginhanda ni Hunn para sa babaye nga luyag niya makaupod sa bug-os niya nga kabuhi.
english: This is because in order for his bride to choose, Hunn prepared not one but five engagement rings for the woman he wants to spend the rest of his life with.

text: Tuman naman ang kakibot sang babaye bangud matapos nagluhod ang lalaki kag ginbuy-an ang mga tinaga nga “will you marry me?” halos indi naman siya makapili sang singsing nga pagasuksukon kasunod sang iya pagsabat sang iya matam-is nga ‘HUO’.
english: The woman was shocked because after the man knelt down and released the words “will you marry me?” he could hardly choose a ring to wear after he answered with his sweet 'YES'.
