text: Magluwas diri, nangin mas enggrande pa ang proposal bangud may helicopter pa nga nagahulat sa magkahagugma sa rooftop kun sa diin natigayon ang wedding proposal.
english: In addition, the proposal became even more grand because there was a helicopter waiting for the couple on the rooftop where the wedding proposal was held.

text: Nagpahayag si Judge Modesto D. Bahul Jr.
english: Judge Modesto D. Bahul Jr.

text: sang Baguio City Regional Trial Court Branch 2 nga ginpamatbatan nga guilty si Father Mark Batolne beyond reasonable doubt of three counts of rape bangud sa pagpanghimulos sini sa isa ka 16-anyos nga estudyante.
english: of the Baguio City Regional Trial Court Branch 2 that Father Mark Batolne was found guilty beyond reasonable doubt of three counts of rape for raping a 16-year-old student.

text: Ginpasakaan ini sang kaso nga reclusion perpetua nga may prison term nga 20 tubtob 40 years.
english: He was charged with reclusion perpetua with a prison term of 20 to 40 years.

text: Base sa imbestigasyon, duha ka beses nga ginhimuslan sang pari ang biktima kun sa diin nag-gamit ini sang deadly weapon.
english: According to the investigation, the priest raped the victim twice with a deadly weapon.

text: Natabo ang insidente sang Marso 2023 sa isa ka kwarto sa Diocese of Baguio compound kun sa diin nagatinir ang biktima.
english: The incident occurred in March 2023 in a room in the Diocese of Baguio compound where the victim was staying.

text: Ginpanginwala man ni Batolne ang alegasyon bangud ginpahayag sini nga indi nya maobra ang alegasyon bangud sa iya busy schedule bilang finance administrator sang Diocese kag general manager sang Mountain Province Broadcasting Company.
english: Batolne also denied the allegation because he said he could not do the allegation because of his busy schedule as finance administrator of the Diocese and general manager of the Mountain Province Broadcasting Company.

text: Madumduman nga isa man ka pari nga ginkilala kay Father Jovito Galit sang Legazpi ang convicted sang multiple counts of acts of lasciviousness and sexual assault bangud man sa paghimulos sa isa ka altar boy.
english: It can be recalled that a priest identified as Father Jovito Galit of Legazpi was also convicted of multiple counts of acts of lasciviousness and sexual assault for raping an altar boy.

text: Nangin makahalawat-hawat ang pagtakop sang kampanya sang Pilipinas sa Paris Olympics 2024 matapos diutayan lang makabulsa sang medalya ang Filipina golfer nga si Bianca Pagdanganan.
english: The Philippines' Paris Olympics 2024 campaign ended in a thrilling way after Filipina golfer Bianca Pagdanganan almost won a medal.

text: Rank no.125 sa Ladies Professional Golf Association (LPGA) si Pagdanganan apang diutayan lang naghimo sang upset sang nagpang-apat ini sa women’s individual stroke play nga daku nga paglukso halin sa ika-43 sini nga pwesto sa iya Olympic debut sa Tokyo 2020.
english: Pagdanganan is ranked no.125 in the Ladies Professional Golf Association (LPGA) but almost caused an upset when she finished fourth in women’s individual stroke play, a big jump from her 43rd place in her Olympic debut in Tokyo 2020.

text: Impresibo nga 6-under par total ang na-rekord sang 26-anyos nga golfer sa kumpetisyon kag naka-pungko pa sa ikatatlo nga pwesto antes ang birdie sang China sa final hole nga amo ang naghatag sang third spot sa Chinese golfer nga si Xiyu Lin.
english: The 26-year-old recorded an impressive 6-under par total in the competition and was still sitting in third place before China's birdie on the final hole gave third place to Chinese golfer Xiyu Lin.

text: Nakuha ni Lydia Ko sang New Zealand ang gold samtang si Esther Henseleit sang Germany ang silver medalist.
english: Lydia Ko of New Zealand took the gold while Esther Henseleit of Germany was the silver medalist.

text: Naghilibion man si Pagdanganan pagkatapos sang hampang bangud gusto gid kuntani sini nga mabutang ang pangalan sang Pilipinas sa podium sa labing-una nga tion sa golf kag sa katapusan nga tion para sa delegasyon sang pungsod sa Paris Games.
english: Pagdanganan also cried after the game because he wanted to put the Philippines' name on the podium for the first time in golf and for the last time for the country's delegation to the Paris Games.

text: Ang isa pa ka golfer nga si Dottie Ardina ang nagtapos man sa iya una nga Olympics stint sa T13 kaupod sa apat ka iban pa nga golfers nga may total nga 3-under 285.
english: Another golfer Dottie Ardina also finished in her first Olympics stint in T13 alongside four other golfers with a total of 3-under 285.

text: Ang pagsulod nila nga duha sa top 15 sang women’s individual stroke play amo na ang pinakamaayo nga resulta sang Pilipinas sa golf sa Olympiada.
english: The duo's entry into the top 15 of women's individual stroke play is the Philippines' best result in golf at the Olympics.

text: Ang Pilipinas lamang kag ang China ang may duha ka players nga nag-abanse sa Top 15 sa 25 ka mga nasyon nga palareho nga may multiple entries.
english: Only the Philippines and China have two players who advanced to the Top 15 out of 25 countries with multiple entries.

text: Naputos man sa kontrobersiya ini nga hampang bangud wala sang official uniforms ang duha ka golfers — bagay nga ginbasol sang publiko sa Philippine Olympic
english: The match was also wrapped in controversy because the two golfers were not wearing official uniforms — something the public blamed on the Philippine Olympics

text: Gintudlo sang isa ka tagreklamo nga ang quarry operation sang banwa sang Maasin, Iloilo nga ginpahanugutan ni Mayor Francisco ‘Ansing’ Amboy ang rason kun ngaa nagdalum ang suba sa Barangay Caigon kun sa diin nalumos kag napatay ang duha ka bata kahapon.
english: A complainant pointed out that the quarry operation of Maasin, Iloilo town approved by Mayor Francisco 'Ansing' Amboy was the reason why the river in Barangay Caigon drowned and died yesterday.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo sa tagreklamo nga si Ronel Florentino, himata sang 7-anyos kag 6-anyos nga babayi nga magpakaisa nga napatay, iya ginpahayag nga bangud sa quarrying, naguba na ang suba kag nangin delikado para sa mga residente sang ila nga barangay.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, complainant Ronel Florentino, relative of the 7-year-old and 6-year-old girls who died, said that due to quarrying, the river has been destroyed and become dangerous for the residents of their barangay.

text: Pahayag sini, sang nagligad nga tuig, may meeting nga ginpatawag sa barangay kag ginkuha ang ila nga sentimyento kaangot sa patigayunon nga quarrying.
english: He said that last year, a meeting was called in the barangay and their sentiments were taken regarding the quarrying.

text: Sa alegasyon ni Florentino, wala sila nagpasugot apang ginpadayon gid sang local government unit (LGU) ang operasyon.
english: Florentino alleged that they did not agree but the local government unit (LGU) continued the operation.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga wala man siya nangisog nga magreklamo kun wala man sang kabuhi nga nautas bangud sa amo nga aktibidad.
english: He also explained that he would not have dared to complain if no lives were lost due to the activity.

text:
SABAT SANG ALKALDE

Gintawag naman ni Amboy nga troll si Florentino kag nagapamulitika.
english:
MAYOR'S RESPONSE

Amboy called Florentino a troll and a politician.

text: Suno kay Amboy, nakadangop na siya sa National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) agud imbestigaran si Florentino bangud may mga daan na ini nga isyu nga nagatum-ok sa alkalde.
english: Amboy said he has already approached the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) to investigate Florentino because he has old issues against the mayor.

text: Pahayag pa ni Amboy, ginpadulungan sang Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (MDRRMO) ang lugar kun sa diin nalumos ang duha ka bata.
english: Amboy said the Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (MDRRMO) rushed to the scene where the two children drowned.

text: Sa report sang MDRRMO, tuman ini ka layo sa quarry site nga ginakuhaan sang LGU sang balas nga ginapadala sa iban nga mga barangay sa Maasin.
english: According to the MDRRMO, it is too far from the quarry site where the LGU gets the sand that is sent to other barangays in Maasin.

text: Ginpahayag sang alkalde nga pulitika lang ang rason kun ngaa may amo sini nga reklamo si Florentino kag maabot gid ang tyempo suno sa iya nga pasabton ini bangud naga-imbestigar na ang NBI.
english: The mayor said that politics is the only reason why Florentino has such a complaint and the time will come when he will be held accountable because the NBI is already investigating.

text: Dugang pa sini, bugaon ang lugar nga ginatudlo ni Florentino — dalipi ukon malum-ok ang duta kag indi pwede nga nga i-quarry.
english: He added that the area Florentino is pointing to is fertile — the soil is soft and cannot be quarried.

text: ‘Gahuro-huro gid sya sa pagtum-ok sa akon.
english: 'He's so busy stabbing me.

text: Tani mangin tampad siya, indi ya paglaktan sang pulitika.
english: I hope he is honest, he doesn't walk in politics.

text: Ginapa-imbestigaran ko na ang tawo nga ini,” suno kay Amboy.
english: I am investigating this person,” Amboy said.

text: Nagpasalig man ang alkalde sang bulig sa pamilya sang magpakaisa nga babayi nga napatay bangud sa pagkalumos.
english: The mayor also assured assistance to the families of the couple who died due to drowning.

text: Naghingyo si Iloilo City Councilor Sheen Marie Mabilog kay Iloilo City Mayor Raisa Treñas nga pirmahan na ang Coordinated Executive Sangguniang Panlungsod Efforts for the Development of Iloilo City (CESPEDIC ) Budget agud masweldohan na ang iya mga staff.
english: Iloilo City Councilor Sheen Marie Mabilog urged Iloilo City Mayor Raisa Treñas to sign the Coordinated Executive Sangguniang Panlungsod Efforts for the Development of Iloilo City (CESPEDIC) Budget so that her staff can be paid.

text: Sa ginpatigayon nga Special Session subong nga adlaw, Disyembre 19, nagpabutyag si Mabilog sang pagkadismaya bangud wala sa gihapon ma-release ang iya CESPEDIC budget.
english: In the Special Session held today, December 19, Mabilog expressed disappointment that his CESPEDIC budget has not been released yet.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mabilog, iya ginpahayag nga anom na ka bulan nga wala sang sweldo ang iya 3 ka mga staff bangud wala pa mapirmahan sang alkalde ang iya CESPEDIC.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Mabilog said his three staff have not been paid for six months because the mayor has not yet signed his CESPEDIC.

text: Suno kay Mabilog, kun matuod nga nagapanawagan ang alkalde sang “unity”, respetuhon man niya ang kada opisina nga nagakinahanglan sang budget agud masweldohan ang mga staff.
english: According to Mabilog, if the mayor is truly calling for “unity”, he will also respect each office that needs a budget to pay the staff.

text: Dugang pa niya, humalin pa sang Hulyo nga naga-follow-up sila sa opisina sang alkalde apang tubtob subong wala sa gihapon sang sabat.
english: He added that they have been following up with the mayor's office since July but there is still no response.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang CESPEDIC Budget nga naka-alokar kay Mabilog ang nagalab-ot sa P2-million.
english: The CESPEDIC Budget allocated to Mabilog is P2-million.

text: Base sa Regulation Ordinance No.
english: Based on Regulation Ordinance No.

text: 2007-003, may yara sang P92,000 ang opisina sang kada konsehal sang siyudad.
english: 2007-003, the office of each city councilor had P92,000.

text: Indi na pag-aprubahan sang Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) ang iban pa nga petisyon para sa pagsaka sa presyo sa basic goods subong nga tuig.
english: The Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) will not approve any other petitions for price increases on basic goods this year.

text: Ini ang kasunod sa ila nga ginpaguwa nga price guide sang nagligad nga adlaw nga partikular nga naka-sentro sa Noche Buena items.
english: This follows the price guide they released yesterday that is specifically focused on Noche Buena items.

text: Kun matandaan sang nagligad nga binulan, ginsiling sang ahensya gina-review nila ang mga petisyon nga pasakaan ang presyo sang mga 60 ka items kaangay sang tinapay, sardinas, habon, gatas, canned meat, noodles, pandesal kag iban pa.
english: Last month, the agency said it was reviewing petitions to raise the prices of about 60 items such as bread, sardines, soap, milk, canned meat, noodles, pandesal and others.

text: Ginrason sang manufacturers ang pagsaka sa presyo sang ila raw materials ukon ingredients amo man ang paghina sang peso batok sa dolyar.
english: Manufacturers cited the increase in the price of their raw materials or ingredients as well as the weakening of the peso against the dollar.

text: Dugang sang ahensya, yara na sila sa pinal nga bahin sang konsultasyon sa stakeholders kaangot sa plano nga indi na mag-isyu sang suggested retail price ukon SRP scheme nga dinekada na nga nakaandan sang mga customer.
english: The agency added that they are in the final stages of consultation with stakeholders regarding the plan to no longer issue the suggested retail price or SRP scheme that has been accustomed to customers for decades.

text: Sa idalom sang sini nga scheme, may yara sang 217 ka shelf-keeping units ukon SRPs nga amo ang gina-set sang manufacturers kag gina-aprubahan naman sang gobyerno.
english: Under this scheme, there are 217 shelf-keeping units or SRPs which are set by manufacturers and approved by the government.

text: Suno kay former DTI Usec.
english: According to former DTI Usec.

text: Ruth Castelo, ini ang nagaserbe nga proteksyon sang masa bangud nga ginalikawan sini nga pasakaan sang manufactures ang presyo.
english: Ruth Castelo, this serves as a protection for the masses because it prevents manufactures from raising prices.

text: Apang pabor man ang DTI nga ibasura na ini nga SRP scheme kag islan ini sang price range guide para sa consumers.
english: However, the DTI is also in favor of scrapping the SRP scheme and replacing it with a price range guide for consumers.

text: May mga sardine makers kag bread producers man nga pabor sa plano nga kakason ang SRP kag idepende na lamang ini sa market forces kag sa kumpetisyon nga yara sa merkado.#
english: There are also sardine makers and bread producers who are in favor of the plan to remove the SRP and it will depend on market forces and competition in the market.

text: Nakalab-ot na sa talatapan sang Philippine Army Reserve Command ang ginreport nga hazing incident nga nagluntad sa Reserve Officers’ Training Corps (ROTC) sang University of Iloilo.
english: The reported hazing incident that occurred at the Reserve Officers' Training Corps (ROTC) of the University of Iloilo has reached the office of the Philippine Army Reserve Command.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Col.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Col.

text: Michael Asuncion, Director sang 604th Community Defense Center (CDC), iya ginpahayag nga nagapadayon karon ang separado nga imbestigasyon sang opisina kag nakihabalo na si Major General Ronald Jess S. Alcudia nga Chief of Staff sang Philippine Army kun sa diin, ginpasiguro nga manabat ang personalidad sa likod sang nagakatabo nga hazing.
english: Michael Asuncion, Director of the 604th Community Defense Center (CDC), said a separate investigation is ongoing by the office and Major General Ronald Jess S. Alcudia, Chief of Staff of the Philippine Army, has been informed and assured that the personality behind the hazing will be held accountable.

text: Gin-athag man sang natungdan nga may-ara na sang mga nauna nga insidente kun sa diin, na-terminate ang ginatudlo responsable sa hazing kag may ginpatigayon nga briefing, rason nga ang mga ginikanan sang complainant ang direkta nalang nga nag-report sa talatapan sang CDC kag bangud otorisado man si Col.
english: He also explained that there have been previous incidents where the alleged responsible for the hazing was terminated and a briefing was conducted, which is why the parents of the complainant directly reported to the CDC office and because Col.

text: Asuncion, gin-aktuhan ini sang opisina apisar nga wala na nag-agi kay Col Rolando Palomar nga Commandant sang University of Iloilo-ROTC.
english: Asuncion, the office acted on it despite not going through Col Rolando Palomar, Commandant of the University of Iloilo-ROTC.

text: Apisar pa suno sa natungdan kun iya ka unibersidad ukon iya ka ROTC nga aktibidad kun sa diin natabo ang hazing, importante sa gihapon nga maaktuhan bangud ROTC officers ang naulamid sa insidente.
english: Regardless of whether it was his university or his ROTC activity where the hazing occurred, it is still important to be caught because ROTC officers were involved in the incident.

text: Sa ika-duha nga semester, may patigayunon naman nga reorganization sang mga training officers, ini ang ginaubra nga tikang kun may nakita nga kapaltahan sa mga tinalikdan nga training sang ROTC.
english: In the second semester, there will be a reorganization of the training officers, this is the step taken if there are shortcomings in the previous training of the ROTC.

text: 16 ka adlaw na lang ang nabilin antes ang adlaw sang eleksyon kag nagalaum ang 80 anyos nga si Mel Carreon nga makakuha sang pwesto sa konseho sa syudad sang Iloilo paagi sa iya nga pagpangaluyag sa mga informal settlers, apisar nga wala siya sang daku nga budget.
english: With only 16 days left before election day, 80-year-old Mel Carreon hopes to win a council seat in Iloilo City through his appeal to informal settlers, despite not having a large budget.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Carreon, iya ginpahayag nga nagasakay siya sa tricyle kag nagapang-barangay agud nga bisitahon ang iya ginapahayag depressed areas.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Carreon said he rides a tricycle and goes from barangay to barangay to visit what he says are depressed areas.

text:
Suno kay Carreon, nagapanguna sa iya nga legislative agenda ang ikaayo sang mga senior citizens, apang wala na sini ginpahayag kun ano pa ang iban nga mga plano bangud suno sa iya, ‘basi kopyahon sang iya mga kasumpong.’

Dala man ni Carreon sa iya pagpangampanya ang lain-lain nga duag sang props, bangud suno sa iya, wala siya sang ginasuportahan nga presidential candidate.
english:
Carreon said the welfare of senior citizens is at the forefront of his legislative agenda, but he did not disclose any other plans because, he said, 'his opponents might copy them.'

Carreon also brought different colors of props to his campaign, because he said he does not support any presidential candidate.

text: Kilala si Carreon sa syudad sang Iloilo bangud nagapadalagan ini kada eleksyon apang wala man nagadaog.
english: Carreon is known in Iloilo City because he runs every election but does not win.

text: Halin 1992, nagatilaw si Carreon sa pagpadalagan.
english: Since 1992, Carreon has been trying to run.

text: Ini na ang iya ika-11 nga pagpasimpalad.
english: This is his 11th lucky charm.

text: Sa 11 straight elections sa syudad, ginapahanugutan sang Comelec ang kandidatura ni Carreon bangud sang iya nga mga maathag nga plataporma kag mga adbokasiya.
english: In 11 straight elections in the city, the Comelec approved Carreon's candidacy because of his clear platforms and advocacies.

text: Lakip sa iya una nga ginpangplastar amo ang pagpanubo sa presyo sang water utility sa syudad, pagbutang sang dugang nga stalls sa mga comfort rooms, kag pag-review sa mga building ordinances.
english: Among his first priorities were reducing the price of water utilities in the city, installing more stalls in comfort rooms, and reviewing building ordinances.

text: 𝗣𝗔𝗥𝗜𝗦 𝗙𝗥𝗔𝗡𝗖𝗘 —Apisar nga si Elreen Ando wala makakuha sang medalya, nakuha niya sa gihapon ang respeto sang kadam-an sa women’s weightlifting 59-kilogram division sang Paris Olympics.
english: 𝗣𝗔𝗥𝗜𝗦 𝗙𝗥𝗔𝗡𝗖𝗘 —Although Elreen Ando didn’t win a medal, she still earned the respect of many in the women’s weightlifting 59-kilogram division of the Paris Olympics.

text: Naghugyaw ang mga tumalan-aw sa South Paris Arena sang natapos ni Ando ang iya clean and jerk sequence sa 130 kg sa iya final try, nga nagtugot sa Pilipino nga magdala pauli sang isa ka bag-o nga personal nga best kag magtapos sa ika-anom nga pwesto.
english: The spectators at the South Paris Arena cheered as Ando completed his clean and jerk sequence at 130 kg in his final try, allowing the Filipino to take home a new personal best and finish in sixth place.

text: Si Ando nagguwa sa medal hunt nga may kabug-usan nga 230kgs.
english: Ando went out in the medal hunt with a total of 230kgs.

text: Samtang, si Luo Shifang sang China ang nagdaug sang bulawan nga may Olympic record nga 241kg, nga naghimo sang three-for-three para sa mga Chinese sa paindis-indis sa weightlifting.
english: Meanwhile, China’s Luo Shifang won gold with an Olympic record of 241kg, making it three-for-three for the Chinese in the weightlifting event.

text: Si Maude Charron sang Canada ang nagtapos nga may silver sa 236 samtang si Kuo Hsing Chun sang Chinese Taipei ang nag-settle para sa bronze nga may 235.
english: Canada’s Maude Charron finished with silver at 236 while Kuo Hsing Chun of Chinese Taipei settled for bronze with 235.

text: Si Kuo, ang 25-anyos nga duha ka beses nga Olympian, naka-miss sang duha ka beses sa snatch kag sa clean and jerk.
english: Kuo, the 25-year-old two-time Olympian, missed twice in the snatch and the clean and jerk.

text: Si Ando ang may indi maayo nga pagsugod sa snatch, nga napaslawan sa pag-alsa sang 100kgs sa iya una nga attempt.
english: Ando had a poor start to the snatch, failing to lift 100kgs on his first attempt.

text: Apisar sini, ang Cebuano nga lifter, nakuha ini sa ikaduha nga attempt, apang nag-uyog sang magamay sa kilid antes ginpalig-on ang iya kaugalingon para sa isa ka madinalag-on nga pag-alsa nga nag-garantiya para makapadayon sa clean and jerk.
english: Despite this, the Cebuano lifter, got it on the second attempt, but wobbled slightly to the side before steadying himself for a successful lift that guaranteed to continue with the clean and jerk.

text: Pagkatapos sang break, si Ando naghanda sa 130 bilang iya una nga pag-alsa para sa clean and jerk, 2kg nga mas mabug-at sangsa iya personal nga best.
english: After the break, Ando prepared for 130 as his first lift for the clean and jerk, 2kg heavier than his personal best.

text: Nadula niya ang una kag natigayon nga mamanehar ang matinlo sa ikaduha, apang natumba siya sa iya tuhod sa tion sang pag-jerk.
english: He missed the first and managed a clean on the second, but he fell to his knee during the jerk.

text: Sa ikatlo nga pagtinguha, ginkontrol ni Ando ang jerk sing maayo agud makuha ang pag-ugyon sang tatlo ka mga hukom.
english: On the third attempt, Ando controlled the jerk well enough to win the approval of all three judges.

text: Apang, si Ando kag si John Ceniza natapos na ang ila pag-alagad sa Paris Olympics nga may kalig-on kag kasaysayan nga balik-balikon.
english: However, Ando and John Ceniza have finished their stint at the Paris Olympics with stability and history to look back on.

text: Si Ceniza nag-three-and-out sa tion sang snatch sa men’s 61kg apang napaslawan sa pag-padayon sa clean and jerk pagkatapos nga nagpaindis-indis nga nagabanog ang abaga.
english: Ceniza went three-and-out during the snatch in the men’s 61kg but failed to keep up with the clean and jerk after competing with a swollen shoulder.

text: Nagpalapit na sa National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) agud nga magpangayo sang bulig ang pamilya sang missing Mutya ng Pilipinas Pampanga contestant nga si Geneva Lopez kag Israeli fiancé sini nga si Yitshak Cohen.
english: The family of missing Mutya ng Pilipinas Pampanga contestant Geneva Lopez and her Israeli fiancé Yitzhak Cohen have approached the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) for help.

text: Matandaan nga Hunyo 21 pa sang ulihi nga nakit-an sanday Lopez kag Cohen.
english: Lopez and Cohen were last seen on June 21.

text: Halin sila sa Angeles City, Pampanga, kag nagbyahe pakadto sa Tarlac bangud may lantawon nga duta.
english: They were from Angeles City, Pampanga, and traveled to Tarlac because there was a land to see.

text: Pagkaaga, nakit-an ang ila sunog nga salakyan sa kilid sang dalan sa Capas, apang ang makatilingala, wala sila nga duha sa sulod kag wala sang ihibalo ang pamilya kun sa diin na ang ila lokasyon.
english: The next morning, their burnt vehicle was found on the side of the road in Capas, but surprisingly, they were not inside and the family had no idea where their location was.

text: May isa pa ka abandonado nga salakyan nga nakit-an naman sa Tarlac City kag ginadudahan nga may kaangtanan sa pagkadula sang mag-nobya.
english: Another abandoned vehicle was found in Tarlac City and is suspected to be involved in the disappearance of the couple.

text: Sandig sa gin-report sang utod ni Cohen kag utod ni Geneva sa NBI headquarters, wala sang namensyonar si Cohen nga may nagapamahog sa iya kabuhi.
english: According to Cohen's brother and Geneva's brother reported to the NBI headquarters, Cohen did not mention any threats to his life.

text: Nagpasalamat man ang pamilya sa law enforcers sa Pilipinas bangud sa inisyatibo nga padayunon ang pagpangita sa magkarelasyon.
english: The family also thanked law enforcers in the Philippines for taking the initiative to continue the search for the couple.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, naghatag naman sang sworn statement ang real estate consultant nga si “Brandon” nga amo ang gina-alegar nga katapusan nga tawo nga gintabo sang duha.
english: Meanwhile, real estate consultant “Brandon” who is allegedly the last person the two met, gave a sworn statement.

text: Ginpanginwala sini nga nagapanago siya, ginpanindugan nga professional ang iya relasyon kanday Geneva kag Cohen, kag nagpasugot man ini sa polygraph test agud mapamatud-an nga wala siya nagabutig.
english: He denied that he was hiding, insisted that his relationship with Geneva and Cohen was professional, and he also agreed to a polygraph test to prove that he was not lying.

text: Una na nga ginkumpirma sang Philippine National Police (PNP) nga pito ang ila persons of interest sa sini nga kaso lakip ang isa ka pulis nga middleman man sang couple sa ila kuntani baklon nga duta.
english: Earlier, the Philippine National Police (PNP) confirmed that they have seven persons of interest in this case including a policeman who is also the middleman of the couple in their land purchase.

text: Tatlo ka motibo ang ginalantaw sang otoridad apang wala pa sang ginsapubliko kun ano ini nga mga anggulo.
english: Authorities are looking into three motives but have not yet made public what these angles are.

text: Naglab-ot naman subong sa P1.4-million ang reward money para makahatag sang impormasyon kaangot sa nahamtangan sang duha.
english: The reward money for information on the whereabouts of the two has now reached P1.4-million.

text: Naghalin ang P1-million kanday Pampanga Governor Dennis Pineda kag Vice-Governor Lilia Pineda; P150,000 halin kay Sto.Tomas, Pampanga Mayor Johnny Sambo; P250,000 halin sa pamilya ni Cohen; kag P100,000 halin kay Angeles City Mayor Carmelo “Pogi” Lazatin Jr.
english: The P1-million came from Pampanga Governor Dennis Pineda and Vice-Governor Lilia Pineda; P150,000 from Sto.Tomas, Pampanga Mayor Johnny Sambo; P250,000 from Cohen's family; and P100,000 from Angeles City Mayor Carmelo “Pogi” Lazatin Jr.

text: Nagpanguna ang West Visayas State University (WVSU) sa Top Performing Schools sa Elementary kag Secondary Level sa bag-o lang ginpaguwa nga resulta sang September kag November 2025 Licensure Examination for Teachers (LET).
english: West Visayas State University (WVSU) topped the Top Performing Schools at Elementary and Secondary Level in the recently released results of the September and November 2025 Licensure Examination for Teachers (LET).

text: Suno sa Professional Regulation Commission (PRC), sa elementary level, 134 sa 135 ka mga estudyante sang WVSU ang nakapasar sa exam ukon katumbas sang rating nga 99.26%.
english: According to the Professional Regulation Commission (PRC), at the elementary level, 134 out of 135 WVSU students passed the exam or equivalent to a rating of 99.26%.

text: Sa secondary level, 241 sa 242 examinees ang nakapasar.
english: At the secondary level, 241 out of 242 examinees passed.

text: May rating ang unibersidad nga 99.59%.
english: The university has a rating of 99.59%.

text: Duha man ka graduates sang Main Campus ang nalakip sa topnotchers sa secondary level.
english: Two Main Campus graduates were also among the topnotchers at the secondary level.

text: Ini amo sanday Bea Mae Balanza nga Rank 9 kag may rating nga 93.20%; kag si Francheska Kimberly Anne Louise Altes nga Rank 10 nga may rating nga 93.00%.
english: These are Bea Mae Balanza who is Rank 9 and has a rating of 93.20%; and Francheska Kimberly Anne Louise Altes Rank 10 with a rating of 93.00%.

text: Sandig sa Silak Media, ang official student publication sang WVSU-College of Education, pareho nga graduates sang Bachelor of Secondary Education major in English ang duha ka nasambit nga topnotchers.
english: According to Silak Media, the official student publication of the WVSU-College of Education, both topnotchers are graduates of the Bachelor of Secondary Education major in English.

text: Suno naman sa report sang Forum-Dimensions, ang official student publication sang WVSU-Main Campus, ini ang una nga tion sa sulod sang pila ka mga tuig nga naka-produce sang topnotchers ang English majors.
english: According to a report by Forum-Dimensions, the official student publication of WVSU-Main Campus, this is the first time in several years that English majors have produced topnotchers.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, sa record sang PRC, nagpang-anum man sa Top Performing Schools ang Iloilo Science and Technology University sa elementary level.
english: Meanwhile, in the PRC record, Iloilo Science and Technology University also ranked sixth among the Top Performing Schools at the elementary level.

text: 114 sa 123 examinees ang nakapasar ukon may rating nga 92.68%.
english: 114 out of 123 examinees passed or with a rating of 92.68%.

text: Ginpatigayon ang LET sang September 21, 2025 kag November 30, 2025 sa nanuhay-tuhay nga testing centers sa Pilipinas lakip na sa Iloilo.
english: The LET was conducted on September 21, 2025 and November 30, 2025 at various testing centers in the Philippines including Iloilo.

text: POLAND – Nakuha sang pambato sang Pilipinas nga si Brandon Esperitu ang 2nd runner up title sa bag-o lang natapos nga Mr. Suprational 2024 pageant nga ginpatigayon sa Poland.
english: POLAND – Philippine wrestler Brandon Esperitu won the 2nd runner up title in the recently concluded Mr. Suprational 2024 pageant held in Poland.

text: Ang 29 anyos nga si Brandon ang nabun-ag sa U.S. island territory nga Guam, apang temporaryo na subong nga nagapuyo sa Metro Manila.
english: The 29-year-old Brandon was born in the U.S. island territory of Guam, but is now temporarily living in Metro Manila.

text: Sa katapusan sang event, ginpasa naman ni Iván Álvarez Guedes sang Spain ang iya korona kay Fezile Mkhize sang South Africa bilang iya successor.
english: At the end of the event, Iván Álvarez Guedes of Spain passed his crown to Fezile Mkhize of South Africa as his successor.

text: Naghimo naman sang maragtas ang competition matapos nga isa ka delegado sang South Africa ang nagdaog sa Mister Supranational pageant, sa diin sila ang pinakauna nga African country kag first black winner nga nakakuha sang titulo.
english: The competition made history after a South African delegate won the Mister Supranational pageant, making them the first African country and first black winner to win the title.

text: Handa na ang Pinay weightlifter nga si Elreen Ando nga magbalik sa weightlifting stage sa Olympiada matapos ang debut sini sa Tokyo Olympics 2020.
english: Filipino weightlifter Elreen Ando is ready to return to the weightlifting stage at the Olympiad after her debut at the Tokyo Olympics 2020.

text: 9:00 karon sa gab-i sa South Paris Arena, magasugod ang kumpetisyon sa women’s 59-kilogram (kg) class kun sa diin tuyo sini nga malapawan ang iya seventh place finish sa Japan tatlo ka tuig na ang nagligad.
english: 9:00 tonight at the South Paris Arena, the competition will begin in the women's 59-kilogram (kg) class where she aims to surpass her seventh place finish in Japan three years ago.

text: Matandaan nga ang 25-anyos nga Pinoy pride halin sa Cebu ang nangin balabag sa qualifications sa 2024 IWF World Cup sa Thailand rason kun ngaa wala nakasulod sa Paris Games ang Olympic gold medalist nga si Hidilyn Diaz.
english: It can be recalled that the 25-year-old Filipino pride from Cebu became an obstacle in the qualifications for the 2024 IWF World Cup in Thailand which is why Olympic gold medalist Hidilyn Diaz did not enter the Paris Games.

text: Sang amo nga tion, nagpang-pito si Ando nga may final tally nga 228kg.
english: At that time, Ando finished seventh with a final tally of 228kg.

text: Sa bag-o sini nga weight category, indi mahapos ang banas para sa Cebuna ilabi na bangud makasumpong sini ang Tokyo gold medal winners nga sanday Kuo Hsing-chun sang Chinese Taipei kag Luo Shifang sang China.
english: In her new weight category, the path will not be easy for Cebuna especially as she will face Tokyo gold medal winners Kuo Hsing-chun of Chinese Taipei and Luo Shifang of China.

text: Yara man ang World No.
english: There is also the World No.

text: 3 nga si Maude Charron kag No.
english: 3 Maude Charron and No.

text: 5 Kamila Konotop sang Ukraine.
english: 5 Kamila Konotop of Ukraine.

text: Ang iban pa nga kasumpong sini amo sanday Yenny Alvarez sang Colombia, Dora Tchakounte sang France, Janeth Gomez Valdivia sang Mexico, Mathlynn Sasser sang Marshall Islands, Lucrezia Magistris sang Italy, Anyelin Venegas Valera sang Venezuela, kag Rafiatu Lawal sang Nigeria.
english: Its other opponents are Yenny Alvarez of Colombia, Dora Tchakounte of France, Janeth Gomez Valdivia of Mexico, Mathlynn Sasser of the Marshall Islands, Lucrezia Magistris of Italy, Anyelin Venegas Valera of Venezuela, and Rafiatu Lawal of Nigeria.

text: As of press time, may apat ka medalya ang Pilipinas sa 2024 Summer Games — duha ang gold medals ni Carlos Yulo kag tag-isa ka bronze medal sanday Aira Villegas kag Nesthy Petecio.#
english: As of press time, the Philippines has four medals at the 2024 Summer Games — two gold medals for Carlos Yulo and one bronze medal each for Aira Villegas and Nesthy Petecio.#

text: Ginbuyagyag ni Baguio City Mayor Benjamin Magalong indi na gusto sang pamilya ni anay DPWH Undersecretary Maria Catalina Cabral nga ipaidalom ang bangkay sini sa autopsy.
english: Baguio City Mayor Benjamin Magalong revealed that the family of former DPWH Undersecretary Maria Catalina Cabral does not want her body to be subjected to an autopsy.

text: Ini ang kabaliskaran sang nauna nga report sang Department of Interior and Local Government (DILG) nga ipaidalom na sa autopsy ang bangkay sang napatay nga anay DPWH undersecretary.
english: This is contrary to the earlier report of the Department of Interior and Local Government (DILG) that the body of the deceased former DPWH undersecretary will be subjected to an autopsy.

text: Suno kay Magalong nga anay man nagserbe bilang lider sang Criminal Investigation and Detection Group, mas maayo kuntani kun ipaidalom sa autopsy ang bangkay sang napatay nga opisyal, ilabi na tuman nga makaduluda ang iya kamatayon.
english: Magalong, who also served as the leader of the Criminal Investigation and Detection Group, said it would have been better if the body of the deceased officer had been subjected to an autopsy, especially since his death was very suspicious.

text: Tubtob subong, nagapadayon ang pagkwestyon kun hungod nga nagpamakamatay ang anay opisyal ukon may foul play sa iya pagkapatay.
english: Until now, the question continues whether the former officer committed suicide or there was foul play in his death.

text: Ini matapos ma-recover ang iya lawas sa isa ka pil-as sa syudad sang Tuba, Benguet sang Disyembre 18.
english: This was after his body was recovered from a cliff in Tuba City, Benguet on December 18.

text: Una man nag-apelar ang Independent Commission for Infrastructure nga magpatigayon sang hugot nga imbestigasyon sa pagkapatay ni Cabral agd mahibaluan kun may yara sang foul play natabo.
english: Earlier, the Independent Commission for Infrastructure appealed for a thorough investigation into Cabral's death to determine if there was any foul play.

text: Nagapadayon naman sa kustodiya sang mga otoridad ang driver ni Cabral nga si Ricardo Munos Hernandez.
english: Cabral's driver, Ricardo Munos Hernandez, remains in police custody.

text: Si Hernandez ang ginapatihan nga ulihi nga nakakita kay Cabral antes siya nasapwan nga patay.
english: Hernandez is believed to have last seen Cabral before he was found dead.

text: Nag-rekomendar si Health Undersecretary Maria Rosario Vergeire sa Commission on Elections (Comelec) nga limitahan ang tion sang botante sa sulod sang voters precinct agud nga malikawan ang paglapta sang Covid-19.
english: Health Undersecretary Maria Rosario Vergeire recommended to the Commission on Elections (Comelec) to limit the time voters spend inside the voters precinct to prevent the spread of Covid-19.

text: Suno kay Vergeire nga amo man ang spokesperson sang Department of Health (DOH), “Ang rekomendasyon ko rin… baka meron ng time limit.
english: According to Vergeire, who is also the spokesperson of the Department of Health (DOH), “My recommendation is... maybe there is a time limit.

text:
Kasi minsan it takes too long for a person to cast their votes, nakipagkwentuhan pa dun sa kakilala sa loob.”

Pwede man nga limitado sa 10 ukon 15 minutos suno kay Vergeire agud nga mahagan-hagan man ang pag-inupdanay sang mga tawo.
english:
Because sometimes it takes too long for a person to cast their votes, even talking to an acquaintance inside.”

It can also be limited to 10 or 15 minutes, Vergeire said, to facilitate social interaction.

text: Nagpangabay man ini sa mga botante nga indi na maglinagaw-lagaw pagkatapos magboto.
english: He also urged voters not to loiter after voting.

text: “Pagdating din sa labas, labas na agad diretso.
english: “When you get outside, you go straight out.

text: Ang iba nag-stay on pa sa labas, nakikipagtsikahan sa kapitbahay.
english: Others still stayed outside, chatting with the neighbors.

text: I think this is important for us to prevent further crowding sa area because that would be one of the major challenges come election day,” pahayag sini.
english: I think this is important for us to prevent further crowding in the area because that would be one of the major challenges come election day,” it said.

text: Mangin istrikto ang Department of Trade and Industry (NBI) sa monitoring sang Noche Buena items sa bilog nga pungsod matapos nga ginpaguwa na ang price guide.
english: The Department of Trade and Industry (NBI) will be strict in monitoring Noche Buena items nationwide after the price guide was released.

text: Pananglitan may overpricing, mahimo ini direkta nga ma-report sa ahensya paagi sa 1-DTI hotline (1-384) ukon i-email sa consumercare@dti.gov.ph.
english: In case of overpricing, it can be reported directly to the agency through the 1-DTI hotline (1-384) or emailed to consumercare@dti.gov.ph.

text: Kadungan sini, nagpahanumdom man ang ahensya sa publiko nga mag-doble sa pag-check sa expiration dates para masiguro ang product quality kag ikonsiderar man ang bulk purchases para sa potential cost savings per unit.
english: Meanwhile, the agency also reminded the public to double check expiration dates to ensure product quality and also consider bulk purchases for potential cost savings per unit.

text: Sa statement sang DTI, covered sang price guide ang 236 shelf-keeping units sang Noche Buena items sa kategorya sang ham, queso de bola, fruit cocktail, cheese, sandwich spread, all-purpose cream, mayonnaise, pasta, elbow kag salad macaroni, tomato kag spaghetti sauce.
english: According to the DTI, the price guide covered 236 shelf-keeping units of Noche Buena items in the categories of ham, queso de bola, fruit cocktail, cheese, sandwich spread, all-purpose cream, mayonnaise, pasta, elbow and salad macaroni, tomato and spaghetti sauce.

text: May pagsaka sa presyo sa pila brands sa tanan nga categories lakip na sa ham nga naga-range sa P170 to P928.50 depende sa size, kag sa queso de bola nga ang presyo nagahalin sa P210 to P445.
english: There was an increase in prices for some brands in all categories including ham which ranges from P170 to P928.50 depending on the size, and queso de bola which ranges from P210 to P445.

text: Suno pa sa ahensya, ang 121 ka SKUs ang may amo sa gihapon nga presyo samtang 12 naman ang may price reductions.
english: According to the agency, 121 SKUs will have the same price while 12 will have price reductions.

text:
Yari ang iban nga price ranges sandig sa gin-publish nga price guide:

These are the price ranges for key Noche Buena items:

Ham: P170 to P928.50

Queso de bola: P210 to P445

Fruit cocktail: P61.76 to P302.50

Cheese: P56.50 to P310

Mayonnaise: P20.40 to P245.85

All-purpose cream: P36.50 to P72

Sandwich spread: P27 to P263.60

Pasta/spaghetti: P32 to P114

Elbow macaroni: P30.50 to P126.25

Tomato sauce: P16.50 to P92.85

Salad macaroni: P36.50 to P126.25

Spaghetti sauce: P28.50 to P103

Ginpahayag sang DTI nga ini nga mga presyo ang magapabilin tubtub sa Disyembre 31, 2024.
english:
Here are the other price ranges based on the published price guide:

These are the price ranges for key Noche Buena items:

Ham: P170 to P928.50

Cheese ball: P210 to P445

Fruit cocktail: P61.76 to P302.50

Cheese: P56.50 to P310

Mayonnaise: P20.40 to P245.85

All-purpose cream: P36.50 to P72

Sandwich spread: P27 to P263.60

Pasta/noodles: P32 to P114

Elbow macaroni: P30.50 to P126.25

Tomato sauce: P16.50 to P92.85

Macaroni salad: P36.50 to P126.25

Spaghetti sauce: P28.50 to P103

The DTI said these prices will remain in place until December 31, 2024.

text: Ini nga price guide ang ginalauman nga makabulig sa mga Pinoy nga mapaanggid ang mga presyo kag makapili sang produkto nga sulod sa budget kag sa nagustuhan subong nga holiday season.
english: This price guide is expected to help Filipinos compare prices and choose products within their budget and preferences this holiday season.

text: Gin-aresto ang grupo sang mga bata nga babaye sa Arizona, U.S.A. matapos mabuyagyag ang plano nila nga patyon ang ila nga classmate kag pagwaon nga nagpanginmatay ini.
english: A group of girls were arrested in Arizona, U.S.A. after their plan to kill their classmate was exposed and it turned out that he committed suicide.

text: Sa imbestigasyon sang pulis, nagsugod ang plano matapos mangin boyfriend sang isa sa mga akusado nga bata ang biktima nga isa ka bata nga lalaki nga gin-alegar nga nagluib sa iya.
english: According to police investigation, the plot started after the victim became the boyfriend of one of the accused children, a boy who allegedly cheated on her.

text: Suno sa report, nagsugtanay ang apat nga bata nga babaye nga nagaedad 10 tubtob 11, nga butungon ang biktima pakadto sa restroom sang eskwelahan kag bun-on ini sa tiyan.
english: According to the report, the four girls, ages 10 to 11, agreed to drag the victim to the school restroom and stab her in the stomach.

text: Kabahin man sang plan nga maghimo sang peke nga suicide note kag magsuksok sang gloves agud wala sang mabilin nga fingerprint.
english: Part of the plan was to make a fake suicide note and wear gloves so that no fingerprints were left.

text: Napalpak ang krimen matapos mabatian sang iban nga estud­yante ang ila nga plano kag ginsugid sa isa ka ginikanan.
english: The crime was foiled after other students overheard their plan and told a parent.

text: Sang gin-imbestigaran nga pamunuan sang eskwelahan kag pulis, natumod nga may iban sa ila ang indi seryoso sa pagpatay kag napilitan lang.
english: When the school administration and police investigated, it was determined that some of them were not serious about the killing and were forced to do so.

text: Ang iban sa ila ang naghinulsol apang isa sa mga akusado ang nagpabilin nga wala sang paghinulsol kag nagakadlaw pa samtang gina-interview sang mga pulis.
english: Some of them were remorseful but one of the accused remained unrepentant and was still laughing while being interviewed by the police.

text: Yara na sa kustodiya sang ila nga mga ginikanan ang apat ka bata kag ginsuspinde sa eskuwelahan.
english: The four children are now in the custody of their parents and suspended from school.

text: Padayon man ang imbestigasyon sa kaso batok sa ila.
english: The investigation into the case against them is ongoing.

text: Maga-file sang complaint si presidential candidate Leodegario “Ka Leody” de Guzman batok kay Mayor Pablo Lorenzo III sang Quezon sa Bukidnon bangud sang shooting incident nga nagluntad sa plantasyon sa amo nga banwa kun sa diin nagpatigayon siya sang iya nga campaign sortie.
english: Presidential candidate Leodegario “Ka Leody” de Guzman will file a complaint against Mayor Pablo Lorenzo III of Quezon in Bukidnon over the shooting incident that occurred at a plantation in the town where he conducted his campaign sortie.

text: Suno kay De Guzman, nalista si Lorenzo bilang general manager sang kumpaniya nga nagapanag-iya sang plantasyon kun sa diin natabo ang pagpinalupok.
english: According to De Guzman, Lorenzo is listed as the general manager of the company that owns the plantation where the shooting occurred.

text: Kun basehan ang statement sang Northern Mindanao Police Regional Office (PRO 10), 12:20 sang Martes sang udto natabo ang shooting incident.
english: According to the statement of the Northern Mindanao Police Regional Office (PRO 10), the shooting incident occurred at 12:20 pm on Tuesday.

text: Nagbisita sanday De Guzman kag senatorial candidates Roy Cabonegro kag David D’Angelo sa area — lugar nga gina-claim sang Manobo-Pulangihon tribe bilang ila nga ancestral domain.
english: De Guzman and senatorial candidates Roy Cabonegro and David D’Angelo visited the area — a place claimed by the Manobo-Pulangihon tribe as their ancestral domain.

text: Hilway sa katalagman si De Guzman, apang may ginapahayag lima ka tawo nga napilasan.
english: De Guzman was safe, but five people were reportedly injured.

text: Ginsaysay man ni De Guzman nga sa iya pagpati, indi mga guards ang nagpangluthang sang amo nga adlaw kundi mismo mga personnel sang company.
english: De Guzman also said that in his belief, it was not the guards who shot that day but the company personnel themselves.

text: Gin-alegar man sang presidential candidate nga may mga soldado man sa highway apang wala man sang ginhimo.
english: The presidential candidate also alleged that there were soldiers on the highway but nothing was done.

text: Malapit lang ang ila distansya suno kay De Guzman kag pat-od gid nga nabatian ang mga lupok apang wala sang bisan isa nga nag-responde.
english: De Guzman said they were only a short distance away and must have heard gunshots but no one responded.

text: Duda man ini nga may kasugtanan sa tunga sang National Commission on Indigenous Peoples (NCIP) kag sa Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP).
english: He also doubted that there was an agreement between the National Commission on Indigenous Peoples (NCIP) and the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP).

text: Una diri, nagpahayag na ang Philippine National Police (PNP) nga pre-mature pa agud kabigon nga election-related ang amo nga insidente.
english: Earlier, the Philippine National Police (PNP) said it was pre-mature to consider the incident election-related.

text: Ginkilala sang mga lokal nga opisyal sa Mandaue City, Cebu ang ginhimo ni Ei Mei Lee Chiu-Maningo nga nag-una anay salbar sang iya mga ido antes sini ginluwas ang iya kaugalingon sa daku nga sunog sa isa ka bulding.
english: Local officials in Mandaue City, Cebu have recognized the actions of Ei Mei Lee Chiu-Maningo who first saved her dogs before saving herself from a massive fire in a building.

text:
Ginhatag ang recognition sa regular city council session kun sa diin nagtambong man ang duha ka mga ido nga sanday “Miyah” kag “Kayen.”

Nagpahanumdom man si Maningo sa iban pa nga fur parents nga mangin responsable kag mangin mapinalanggaon sa ila nga mga hinuptanan.
english:
The recognition was given during the regular city council session where two dogs, “Miyah” and “Kayen,” were also present.

Maningo also reminded other fur parents to be responsible and loving towards their pets.

text: “Let us be responsible, because our pets have no way of telling us what they feel, so we must be responsible and compassionate enough to truly take care of them,” suno sa iya.
english: “Let us be responsible, because our pets have no way of telling us what they feel, so we must be responsible and compassionate enough to truly take care of them,” according to her.

text: Matandaan nga apisar tuman na kadaku ang kalayo kag tuman na ka damol ang aso, ginhakwat ni Maningo ang iya duha ka ido kag gin-itsa sa idalom antes siya nagpanaog sa ikatatlo nga panalgan sang H & E Industrial Inc.
english: It can be recalled that although the fire was so big and the smoke was so thick, Maningo picked up his two dogs and threw them down before he went down to the third floor of H & E Industrial Inc.

text: building.
english: building.

text: Ginsalo sang mga tawo sa idalom ang mga ido, samtang nag-assist naman ang mga katapo sang Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) sa pagpanaog sa fur mom.
english: People downstairs picked up the dogs, while members of the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) assisted in lowering the fur mom.

text: May ipatuman nga rollback sa presyo sang produktong-petrolyo sa masunod nga semana.
english: There will be a rollback in the price of petroleum products next week.

text:
Base sa estimates sang Department of Energy, yari ang iganubo sa presyo:

Gasoline – rollback of P0.70 to P1.00Diesel – rollback of P0.65 to P0.95Kerosene – rollback of P0.70 to P0.80

Suno kay DOE-Oil Industry Management Bureau assistant director Rodela Romero, naka-base ini sa nauna nga apat ka adlaw sang trading sa international oil market.
english:
Based on the Department of Energy's estimates, here are the price reductions:

Gasoline – rollback of P0.70 to P1.00Diesel – rollback of P0.65 to P0.95Kerosene – rollback of P0.70 to P0.80

According to DOE-Oil Industry Management Bureau assistant director Rodela Romero, this is based on the previous four days of trading in the international oil market.

text: Lakip sa ginaangot nga rason sa rollback amo ang pagpanubo sang OPEC+ sang ila nga oil demand forecasts sa ikaapat nga tion.
english: Among the reasons linked to the rollback is OPEC+'s reduction of its oil demand forecasts for the fourth time.

text: Ginaangot man ini sa pagpanubo sang US Energy Information Administration sang ila 2025 crude price forecast sa $1.53 per barrel bangud sa ginalantaw mas mataas nga global oil production.
english: This is also linked to the US Energy Information Administration lowering its 2025 crude price forecast to $1.53 per barrel due to anticipated higher global oil production.

text: Ginalantaw man ang mahina nga ekonomiya sang China kun sa diin negatibo ang panglantaw sang investors sa Chinese demand.
english: China's weak economy is also being looked at where investors have a negative view of Chinese demand.

text: Lunes masami nga gina-anunsyo sang oil companies ang price adjustments kag ipatuman epektibo sa Martes sang aga.
english: Oil companies usually announce price adjustments on Monday and will be implemented effective Tuesday morning.

text:
WARNING SENSITIVE CONTENT:

Patay ang isa ka 15 anyos nga solterito kadungan sang ginpatiigayon nga opening lights sa Dueñas Iloilo kagab-i Disyembre 12, matapos ginpa-arakan kag ginbuno ini sang 13 ka beses.
english:
WARNING SENSITIVE CONTENT:

A 15-year-old boy was killed during the opening lights in Dueñas, Iloilo last night, December 12, after he was stabbed 13 times.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay PLT.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, PLT.

text: Floripis Subere, Deputy Chief of Police sang Dueñas Iloilo, iya ginpahayag nga papauli na kuntani ang biktima upod ang iya mga kaupdanan sakay sa motorsiklo sang ginsundan sila sang grupo sang mga suspek.
english: Floripis Subere, Deputy Chief of Police of Dueñas Iloilo, said the victim was on his way home with his companions on a motorcycle when they were followed by a group of suspects.
